 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight]"
 — "b'makom keriyah sham yihyeh oneg
 [in the place of the calling — there shall be delight]."
 For the Shabbos meals of oneg
 are in the aspect of:
 "Hashem karo
 [Hashem has called it]"
 — in the aspect of:
 "b'makom keriyah sham oneg
 [in the place of the calling — there is the delight]"
 — for Shabbos is the Name of the Holy One,
 blessed be He, and so on. [וכו']

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל (שבת קיח) 'המשמר שבת וכו' אפילו עבד עבודה זרה וכו' מוחלין לו'. כי שבת הוא בחינת ארץ ישראל בחינת אמונה וביטול מחשבות עבודה זרה, וזה בחינת ענג שבת, בחינת "שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה והתענג על ה'" וכו', וכמו שדרשו רז"ל ענין "והתענג על ה'" לענין ענג שבת. גם עיקר התגלות סודות התורה הוא בשבת כנ"ל כמה פעמים. גם המחשבות זרות הם נקראים מבול כמבואר בפנים. ושבת הוא בחינת נח, נייחא דעילאין ותתאין כידוע. ובו ניצולין ממחשבות זרות בחינת (בראשית ח) "ויזכור אלהים את נח וכו' וישוכו המים". גם שבת הוא בחינת עולם המחשבה כידוע. ועל ידי זה נזדכך המוח והמחשבה וזה בחינת 'שבות ממחשבת עבודה'.
segments.en:
And therefore the essential time
 for the union of Torah scholars
 is on Shabbos.

segments.he: גם שבת הוא בחינת קדושת הדיבור דקדושה הנ"ל כמה פעמים בשם הזוהר הקדוש, כי שבת הגדול הוא בחינת בינה לבא. כי בשבת נפתחים כל החמשים שערי בינה כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש, ועל ידי זה נתהוה בחינת פה בבחינת "מי שם פה לאדם" כמבואר בפנים. וזה בחינת שבת הקטן שהוא בחינת מלכות פה כמובא בתיקונים. ועל כן מסוגל ביותר בשבת לדבר דיבורים קדושים היוצאים מן הלב בבחינת 'כפי כן לבי'. וזה שכתוב בפרשת ואתחנן (דברים ה): "שמור את יום השבת וכו' וזכרת כי עבד היית בארץ מצרים" וכו'. כי יציאת מצרים היה שיצא הדיבור מן הגלות וכמבואר בפנים, והקול של הדיבור יוצא מכנפי ריאה, והוא בבחינת תפארת כידוע. וזה בחינת הג' שבתות המבואר בזוהר יתרו דף צ"ב. גם עיקר שלימות התפלה וכן שלימות קדושות הזווג הוא בשבת כנ"ל כמה פעמים.
segments.en:
For during the weekdays
 the external forces have grip —
 which are the aspects of darkness, ignorance, and so on —
 until sometimes even holy souls
 are trapped within the scale-pan
 [tikla] — as explained within —
 and therefore it is then difficult
 to draw a holy soul through one's union —
 as also explained further in the holy Zohar and the writings.
 And for the most part —
 the great souls trapped within the scale-pan
 in the husk of Nogah
 are clothed in sons of the unlearned
 whose ways are like animals —
 and they also engage in marital union
 during the six weekdays —
 as explained in Zohar Yisro, folio 89 —
 see there.
 And likewise our Sages of blessed memory
 [Tractate Pesachim 49b] expounded
 on the daughters of the unlearned [Deuteronomy 27:21]:
 "arur shochev im kol behemah
 [cursed is one who lies with any animal]"
 — for their union is literally in the aspect of animality.
 Even so — sometimes specifically:
 "mibnay am ha'aretz tetze Torah
 [from the sons of the unlearned Torah will go forth]"
 — which is why they need to be respected —
 as explained within.
 But on the holy Shabbos —
 then is the essential illumination of the soul —
 for Shabbos is the World of Souls,
 as mentioned above.
 And also the good within the husk of Nogah —
 which is the aspect of animality —
 is encompassed within holiness,
 as mentioned above.
 And therefore through the Shabbos union —
 when it is the union of the Matronisa —
 one also merits to draw holy souls for one's children —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 and this is what is explained in the aforementioned
 Zohar Yisro:
 "u'chad alma salik b'dina —
 istagal Kub"H b'inun bnoi
 [when the world is subject to judgment —
 the Holy One, blessed be He,
 looks upon those sons]"
 (that is, upon those sons
 born from the Shabbos union)
 "u'merachem al alma —
 v'al da chsiv:
 kulah zera emes
 [and has mercy on the world —
 and about this it is written:
 'wholly a seed of truth']"
 [Jeremiah 2:21]
 and so on —
 "k'mah d'at amar:
 titen emes l'Yaakov
 [as it says:
 'give truth to Yaakov']"
 and so on. [וכו']

 That is — for on Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the breath without sin —
 the illumination of the Patriarchs
 is revealed in the world —
 to protect the world —
 and to repel the judgment and the darkness and the ignorance
 and so on —
 from the world.
 (This is the aspect of
 "Magen Avos
 [the shield of the Patriarchs]"
 recited on Shabbos night.)
 And therefore the sons born from the union
 of Torah scholars on Shabbos
 are drawn from the aspect of the breath without sin —
 through which all the judgments are sweetened —
 and Chesed and mercy are drawn,
 as mentioned above.
 And as explained within —
 and Yaakov our Patriarch
 is the aspect of the totality of the Patriarchs —
 for he encompasses all of them — as is well-known.

segments.he: גם שבת הוא המתקת הדינים כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש.
segments.en:
And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of
 the ultimate purpose of the creation
 of heaven and earth.
 For [Zohar Shemos, folio 42b]:
 "ikkar tachlis haberiyah kula —
 hu b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei
 [the essential ultimate purpose of all Creation
 is so that they should know Him]"
 — as explained within.
 And it is impossible to recognize Him, blessed be He,
 and to know of Him —
 except through the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the totality of the entire Torah —
 through which the darkness and the ignorance
 and the external wisdoms
 are repelled from the world —
 and one merits the wisdom and intellect of holiness —
 through which one attains Him, blessed be He —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "ki ot hi beinai u'vein'chem l'doroseichem —
 lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem
 [for it is a sign between Me and between you
 throughout your generations —
 to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And see Shulchan Aruch,
 Orach Chayyim, Siman 307, subsection 17:
 "assur lilmod b'Shabbas v'Yom Tov
 zulas b'divray Torah —
 v'afilu b'sifray chochmot assur
 [it is forbidden to study on Shabbos and Yom Tov
 anything other than words of Torah —
 and even books of secular wisdom are forbidden]."
 And even though it states there:
 "and there are those who permit,"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — since he brought the opinion of the prohibitors
 as the primary opinion in an unattributed ruling —
 it appears that he agreed with their words.
 (And see Chayey Adam, section 61 —
 and Eshel Avraham, Siman 308,
 subsection 76.)

segments.he: כי שבת הוא בחינת אור האבות שהם בחינת הג' ידים המבואר בפנים. כי הם בחינת הזרועות עולם כמובא במקום אחר, ועל ידי זה נמתקין הדינים, והג' ידים הנ"ל הם בחינת השם מ"ב. וכמבואר גם לעיל בסימן מ"א. וידוע כי שם זה שולט בשבת כמובא בכוונות, וזה בחינת הראשי תיבות של "וישם לך שלום" הם של"ו גמטריא ג' פעמים הוי"ה וג' פעמים אלקים וכו' כמובא בפנים. וזה בחינת שבת שלום, ועל כן נקראת שבת בחינת ביטול המחלוקת והקטרוגים כמו שכתוב "משבית מלחמות עד קצה הארץ" וכתיב (משלי יח) "מדנים ישבית הגורל" וכמבואר במקום אחר.
segments.en:
And this is [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — that is — for during the weekdays
 the Sitra Achra —
 the aspect of darkness and ignorance, and so on —
 has grip on the holy legs —
 in the aspect of [Proverbs 5:5]:
 "raglehah yordos maves
 [her legs descend to death]."
 But on Shabbos the holy legs ascend from among them —
 as is well-known from the writings.
 And then also the good within the animality —
 the bodily pleasures —
 is encompassed within holiness,
 as mentioned above.
 And this too is in the aspect of:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha"
 — that even the animality and materiality —
 which are the aspects of legs —
 as it is written [II Kings 3:9]:
 "v'lo hayah mayim lamachaneh
 u'livhemah asher b'ragleihem
 [and there was no water for the camp —
 and for the animals that were at their feet]"
 — and likewise the body in general
 is called a leg [regel] relative to the soul —
 as understood from the words of our Sages —
 in the parable of the lame one and the blind one.
 And this:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — he should refrain from pursuing his own affairs
 in which there is sometimes a grip of
 the darkness and the ignorance and so on —
 but rather engage in the affairs of Heaven —
 which are the wisdoms of the Torah —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 1:2]:
 "ki im b'Toras Hashem cheftzo
 [but in the Torah of Hashem is his desire]"
 — and it is written [Proverbs 3:15]:
 "v'chol chafatzecha lo yishvu vah
 [and all your desires cannot compare with it]."
 And it is written [Isaiah 42:21]:
 "Hashem chafetz l'ma'an tzidko
 yagdil Torah v'ya'adir
 [Hashem desired — for the sake of His righteousness —
 to magnify the Torah and to make it glorious]"
 — and this:
 "l'ma'an tzidko
 [for the sake of His righteousness]"
 — for the Torah is called tzedakah —
 as explained within.
 And likewise the Land of Israel is called:
 "eretz chefetz
 [a land of desire]."
 [Malachi 3:12]
 And this is how the prophet rebuked them [Isaiah 58:3]:
 "hen b'yom tzomchem timtze'u chefetz
 [behold — on the day of your fast
 you find your desire],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 That is — for the essential purpose of fasting
 and self-affliction
 is to subdue the matter and the ignorance of the body —
 which are the aspects of desire [chefetz]
 and lust gripped in the four elements.
 And you — on the day of your fast —
 are eagerly pursuing your own desires and lusts.

segments.he: גם שבת הוא בחינת ביטול השכחה. כי שבת הוא מוחין דגדלות בחינת זכרון כמו שכתוב "זכור את יום השבת" וכו', וזה (ישעיה נח) "אם תשיב משבת רגלך עשות חפציך ביום קדשי", היינו שימנע עצמו מלילך חוץ לתחום בשבת, בבחינת "אל יצא איש ממקומו" הנ"ל בכדי שלא לצאת על ידי זה ח"ו מבחינת אוירא דארץ ישראל. וכן שלא לעשות חפציו בשבת, כי על ידי זה פוגם ח"ו בבחינת כח מעשיו כי הוא כאלו כופר ח"ו במעשה בראשית כמו שאמרו רז"ל, ועל ידי זה נפגם קדושת ארץ ישראל. וזה "וקראת לשבת ענג לקדוש ה' מכובד", כי 'אוירא דארץ ישראל מחכים', ועל ידי זה עיקר הענג והכבוד כנ"ל כמה פעמים. גם השגת סודות התורה שמשיגין על ידי קדושת שבת הם גם כן בחינת ענג וכבוד, ענג על דרך "אז תתענג על ה'" וכמבואר בסימן מ"ט בפנים. וכבוד הם מלבושים של שבת, וכמו שדרשו רז"ל וזה בחינת "כבשים ללבושך" 'דברים שהם כבשונו של עולם וכו' וכמבואר בפנים. גם כי הם בחינת ולמכסה עתיק כמו שדרשו רז"ל.
segments.en:
And this is the aspect of:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — he should refrain from his own affairs —
 and not only that —
 for on Shabbos even his own personal pleasures —
 the bodily delights —
 are encompassed within holiness —
 through the wisdom and intellect
 that shines on Shabbos —
 the aspect of:
 "ki kodesh hu
 [for it is holy]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight]"
 — for the intellect and wisdom are the aspect of delight —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and the delight of Shabbos is the aspect
 of the delight of the soul —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 55:2]:
 "shim'u shamo'a elay v'ichlu tov —
 v'tis'anag b'deshen nafshechem
 [hearken diligently to Me and eat good —
 and let your soul delight in abundance]."
 And this:
 "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [the holy one of Hashem, honored]"
 — for honor is the aspect of the root of the soul
 and the Torah
 that are revealed in the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above and as brought within.
 And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — he should refrain from his own ways —
 which sometimes have a grip of ignorance within them —
 the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 10:3]:
 "v'gam badarech keshe'hasachal holech —
 v'amar l'chol sachal hu
 [and also on the road —
 when the fool walks —
 he says to everyone that he is a fool]."
 And it is written [Proverbs 19:3]:
 "ivelesah adam tesalef darko
 [the foolishness of a person distorts his way]."

segments.he: וזה "וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך", ודרשו רז"ל שלא יפסיע פסיעה גסה, כי שבת הוא בחינת עולם המחשבה בחינת זכות וצחות המוחין והמחשבה כנ"ל. ופסיעה גסה מבלבלת את המחשבה כמובא בספר המדות אות דעת. וזה "ממצוא חפציך ודבר דבר", היינו שישמור עצמו מלדבר אפילו שום דיבור של חול בכדי שלא יפגום בקדושת שבת שהוא בחינת אוירא דארץ ישראל מחכים, ו'סייג לחכמה שתיקה', גם כי הדר בארץ ישראל דומה כמי שיש לו אלוק. ועל כן צריך ליזהר בדבריו בבחינת "אל תבהל על פיך ולבך אל ימהר להוציא דבר לפני אלקים". כי האלקים בשמים ואתה על הארץ על כן יהיו דבריך מועטים" (קהלת ה'). וזה "אז תתענג על ה'", כי זה עיקר בחינת 'כמו שיש לו אלוק' הנ"ל, היינו שמתענג עמו ומתפאר בו ובוטח רק עליו. וזה גם כן בחינת קדושת ארץ ישראל כמו שכתוב "שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה והתענג על ה' ויתן לך משאלות לבך" וכו'.
segments.en:
And this:
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — he should refrain even from speaking
 a single word of the weekday —
 so as not to blemish in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the holy speech —
 the aspect of the breath without sin,
 as mentioned above.
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — that is, he will merit to purify
 all four of his elements
 to such a degree —
 that his entire delight shall be only for Hashem —
 for this is the essential ultimate purpose of Creation —
 "b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei
 [so that they should know Him]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And in the holy Zohar
 it is expounded on this:
 "da Atika
 [this is the Ancient One],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — that is, he merits the ultimate perfection
 of attainment in the wisdom of the holy Torah —
 until he attains the aspect of Atika.

segments.he: ובזוהר הקדוש דרש 'דא עתיקא קדישא', היינו שיזכה להמשיך סודות התורה כאלו שהם בחינת עתיק. גם כי זה בחינת שורש קדושת המוחין של ארץ ישראל בבחינת "ואכלתם ישן נושן" ותרגומו 'עתיקא דעתיק' וכמובא בדברינו בקונטרס "זמרת הארץ".
segments.en:
"v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz
 [and I will cause you to ride
 upon the heights of the earth]"
 — "da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [this is the Holy Apple Orchard]"
 — which alludes to the ascent of Malchus —
 until she is united, as it were,
 to draw new souls —
 as explained in the writings —
 and our Sages expounded in the Gemara:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 that is, one is saved from the grip of ignorance —
 which is in the aspect of:
 "melech zaken u'chesil
 [an old and foolish king]."
 [Ecclesiastes 4:13]
 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — "da Ze'ir Anpin
 [this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — the aspect of Tiferes —
 this is the aspect of the revelation of the Patriarchs
 in the world —
 the aspect of [Proverbs 17:6]:
 "v'tiferes banim avosam
 [and the glory of children is their fathers]."
 And this is the aspect of Yaakov —
 who is the aspect of Tiferes —
 and he is the aspect of the totality of the Patriarchs,
 as mentioned above.
 And this is what our Sages expounded:
 one merits an inheritance without limits —
 in the manner in which our Sages disputed
 [Midrash Rabbah, Bechukosai, section 36]:
 "how long does the merit of the Patriarchs endure?"
 — and likewise in the Gemara
 [Tractate Shabbos 55a] —
 and the Midrash Rabbah concludes:
 "Rav Acha said:
 the merit of the Patriarchs endures forever —
 forever they mention and say:
 'for Hashem your G-d is a merciful G-d —
 He will not fail you — and He will not destroy you —
 and He will not forget the covenant of your fathers'"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And also in its plain meaning —
 he intends that one should draw
 the aspect of the holiness of the Land of Israel
 — the aspect of the breath without sin —
 upon the entire world —
 until the darkness and the ignorance and the judgment
 shall be nullified from all the world —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 33:5]:
 "chesed Hashem mal'ah ha'aretz
 [the earth is full of the lovingkindness of Hashem]"
 — and it is written [Isaiah 11:9]:
 "ki mal'ah ha'aretz de'ah es Hashem
 [for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Hashem],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 and it is written:
 "va'yimaleh chevod Hashem es kol ha'aretz
 [and the glory of Hashem filled all the earth]"
 [Numbers 14:21]
 — in the aspect of:
 "yachiru v'yeda'u kol yoshvey sevel
 [they shall recognize and know —
 all the inhabitants of the world],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 for this is the essential ultimate purpose of Creation —
 "b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei
 [so that they should know Him]"
 — as it is written:
 "l'chevodi bera'asiv
 [for My glory I created it],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 [Isaiah 43:7]
 as explained within.
 And this:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — that is — for Shabbos is the aspect
 of the holy speech —
 which is in the aspect of the holy breath
 that has no sin —
 as understood within and as mentioned above.
 And through this the judgment and the darkness
 are repelled from the world —
 through the revelation of the Patriarchs —
 and Chesed and wisdom are drawn into the world —
 the wisdom of holiness —
 the wisdom of the Torah —
 until one merits the aspect of:
 "oraissa d'Atika
 [the Torah of the Ancient One]"
 — which is in the aspect of:
 "v'rav chesed
 [and abundant in lovingkindness]"
 — as explained elsewhere.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "v'Atika Kadisha galei r'usa dilei
 [and the Holy Ancient One reveals His will]"
 — as explained in the holy Zohar —
 regarding the holiness of the holy Shabbos.

segments.he: "והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ", רומז לעליית המלכות וביטול המלכות דסטרא אחרא כנ"ל בשם רז"ל, היינו שיזכה לבטל כל מיני מחשבות זרות של פגם אמונה שהם מבחינת המלכות דסטרא אחרא אלקים אחרים, ויזכה לשלימות האמונה שהוא בחינת מלכות דקדושה. והאמונה תהיה עם שלימות המוחין והדעת בבחינת (דברי הימים-א כח) 'דע את אלקי אביך' (וכמבואר במקום אחר) שזה עיקר קדושת ארץ ישראל שכלול מאמונה ומוחין דגדלות כידוע. וזה בחינת חקל תפוחין קדישין שמרמז על עליית המלכות, בחינת האמונה הקדושה, בבחינת נה"י חג"ת חב"ד היינו כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Shabbos is the day of souls
 and not the day of the body —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And then the corporeality and the animality —
 which is the aspect of
 the power of the lust within a person
 for material things —
 is subdued through the greatness
 of the illumination of the holy soul
 that shines on the holy Shabbos.
 And then all the shames and hatreds
 and disputes —
 which are the aspects of the impure husks —
 are nullified —
 and the aspect of
 "Bris Shalom
 [covenant of peace]"
 is revealed —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 as is well-known.
 And there is peace below and above —
 for Shabbos is the aspect of:
 "Melech she'hashalom shelo
 [the King whose peace is His]"
 — as is well-known.

segments.he: "והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך" 'דא זעיר אנפין', בחינת תפארת, כי זה בחינת (ישעיה סב) "והיית עטרת תפארת ביד ה'" המבואר בפנים. גם "נחלת יעקב אביך" כפשוטו, רצה לומר ירושת ארץ ישראל, כמו שכתוב "ויעמידה ליעקב וכו' לך אתן את ארץ כנען", וכמו שפירשו המפרשים ז"ל. ורז"ל דרשו (שבת קיח) 'שיזכה לנחלה בלי מצרים'.
segments.en:
Shabbos = seven qualities of the nefesh/Adam: (1) Nefesh: "ki vo shavas vayinafash" = Zohar Vayakhel 205: "yoma d'nishmatin hu v'lo yoma d'gufa." (2) Adam = "nefesh chayyah" = "ruach memalela" (Targum) = holy speech = "v'daber davar" (Zohar Bereishis 32). (3) Tzurah/form = wisdom and Da'as = "ki kodesh hu" = Chochmah. (4) Light = "barchu b'orah." (5) Life = "to'amehah chayyim zachu." (6) Zikaron = "zachor es yom haShabbas." (7) Chesed = "kol dinin iskafyan v'lo mis'arin" (Zohar). Also: wisdom of Torah (all agree it was given on Shabbos). Also: tzedakah = "shemesh tzedakah" (Malachi 3:20) = "shemesh b'Shabbas tzedakah l'ani'im."
 Evil of the four elements subdued / Aleph-Dalet-Mem: Evil of four elements subdued on Shabbos (Simanim 4 and 8 cross-reference). Shabbos has the virtue of fasting = nullifies lusts of four elements (Siman 57 cross-reference). Aleph-Dalet-Mem: Mem-satum = World to Come = foretaste; Dalet = rectification of four elements; Aleph = wisdom/intellect. Body and matter (behemah) also encompassed in Shabbos holiness = oneg Shabbos. Bodily pleasures precious = elevation of tzurah through them specifically. Shabbos meals allude to very high mochin (Ari kavannos). "L'ma'an yanuach shorcha va'chamorecha." Men of deeds fast every Erev Shabbos (SA OC 249) = breaks appetite = subdues the evil of four elements.
 Shabbos = Land of Israel / hevel she'ain bo chet / Patriarchs revealed: Shabbos = kedushah of Eretz Yisrael = the breath without sin = through which the Patriarchs are revealed and judgment/darkness repelled. "Im mekablin eschem haShabbas — nichnasim atem la'aretz." "Lo charevah Yerushalayim ela al Shabbas." Fifth of the last Tikunim: extra soul of Shabbos = aspect of Eretz Yisrael. Angels say "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar." "Even one who worshipped idolatry like the generation of Enosh — he is forgiven." Torah study of Shabbos = in the aspect of hevel she'ain bo chet. "V'zacharti es brisi Yaakov v'ha'aretz ezkor" = Shabbas = Shin-Beis-Tav: Shin = three Patriarchs; Beis-Tav = the holy Shechinah = kedushah of Eretz Yisrael (Zohar). Zohar Yisro 88b: "b'hadein yoma mis'atrin avahan" = cited in full. Zohar Vayikra 12: "eimasai israbyat ara'ah kadisha — b'yom haShabbas" = cited. Charity of Shabbos = charity for Eretz Yisrael.
 Honor of Shabbos / eating and drinking / "ba'al nefesh": Honor of Shabbos → receive illumination of soul and Torah more. Eating and drinking on Shabbos = raise the souls and sparks within the food. "Ba'al nefesh" (Torah scholar) eats with intention = "tzadik ochel l'sova nafsho." Eating meat = elevates the soul within the animal from behemah to Adam = great yichud = livelihood drawn. "Am ha'aretz assur le'echol basar." Even Torah scholar who hasn't rectified his deeds = Torah not in the aspect of hevel she'ain bo chet → difficult to eat meat (Sefer haKaneh, note about weakness of the generation). Must speak Torah at the table. Essential rectification of eating = on Shabbos = all holiness; Nogah's good encompassed. Shammai ate all his days in honor of Shabbos (Beitzah 16a) = draw Shabbos holiness onto eating. "V'tavoch tevach v'hachayn" = Yosef guarded Shabbos = rectification of the shechitah = soul of animal ascends to medaber.
 Shabbos zivug / new holy souls / "kulloh zera emes": Shabbos = Malchus peh = Shabbas Malkesah = clarified souls ascend as m"n = great yichud = "zivuga d'Matronisa." All abundance flows from Shabbos. Mechalel Shabbos b'farhesya = shechitah disqualified (SA YD 2). Mntzpch = five gidin = "tzofim amrum" (Shabbos 104a) = rectification accomplished on Shabbos. Na'ar → Na'arah (five Alafin of Binah sweeten five times Din of Malchus): five times Din = 320 = na'ar; five times Adonai = 325 = na'arah. This = drawing Shabbas haGadol (Binah) onto Shabbas haKatan (Malchus) = Siman 32. Three Patriarchs × 72 = 216 = riv → Aleph = 216 → din → Adonai = from mntzpch = pur → parah. All = accomplished on Shabbos. "Shabbas v'dinim v'parah b'Marah nitztavu" (Sanhedrin 56b) = one aspect. Melamdei tinokos = hevel she'ain bo chet → on Shabbos = "hachazan ro'eh heichan hatinokos korin" (Shabbos 11a). "Ein Kiddush ela b'makom se'udah" = "b'makom keriyah sham oneg" = "Shabbos shemei d'Kub'H." Weekday zivug: external forces trap holy souls in the tikla. Zohar Yisro 89: most sons of the am ha'aretz = great trapped souls in Nogah = animal-like unions. "Mibnay am ha'aretz tetze Torah." BUT on Shabbos = World of Souls = Nogah's good encompassed = "zivuga d'Matronisa" → holy souls drawn. Zohar Yisro: "u'chad alma salik b'dina — istagal Kub'H b'inon bnoi u'merachem al alma" = "kulloh zera emes" (Jeremiah 2:21) = "titen emes l'Yaakov." Shabbos sons = hevel she'ain bo chet = judgments sweetened = Chesed drawn = Magen Avos. Yaakov = totality of the Patriarchs.
 Shabbos = ultimate purpose of Creation / SA OC 307: Zohar Shemos 42b: "ikkar tachlis haberiyah kula — hu b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei." Can only know G-d through Shabbos = totality of Torah = repels darkness/external wisdom. SA OC 307 §17: "assur lilmod b'Shabbas v'Yom Tov zulas b'divray Torah v'afilu b'sifray chochmot assur." Chayey Adam §61; Eshel Avraham §308 §76.
 Isaiah 58 — Siman 37: "Feet" = Sitra Achra of darkness/ignorance grips holy legs in weekdays ("raglehah yordos maves"); on Shabbos feet ascend; also the bodily/animal aspect = feet = "u'livhemah asher b'ragleihem" (II Kings 3:9) = body = regel relative to soul (parable of lame and blind). "Affairs" = refrain from his own desires that have the grip of ignorance; engage in Torah = "ki im b'Toras Hashem cheftzo"; "v'chol chafatzecha lo yishvu vah"; "Hashem chafetz l'ma'an tzidko yagdil Torah"; Torah = tzedakah; Eretz Yisrael = "eretz chefetz"; Isaiah 58:3: "hen b'yom tzomchem timtze'u chefetz" = rebuked for pursuing lusts instead of fasting properly. On Shabbos bodily pleasures are encompassed in holiness through the wisdom = "ki kodesh hu." "Call it delight" = wisdom/intellect = oneg; oneg Shabbos = "v'tis'anag b'deshen nafshechem" (Isaiah 55:2). "Honored" = root of the soul and Torah. "Honor it/from your ways" = refrain from ignorant ways = "v'gam badarech keshe'hasachal holech" (Ecclesiastes 10:3); "ivelesah adam tesalef darko." "Speaking words" = holy breath without sin. "Then delight in Hashem" = purify all four elements = delight only in Hashem = ultimate purpose = "b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei" = Zohar: Atika = ultimate attainment in wisdom of Torah. "Heights of earth" = Chakla Tupichin = Malchus ascends to draw new souls (Ari); saved from subjugation = saved from "melech zaken u'chesil." "Heritage of Yaakov" = Ze'ir Anpin = Tiferes = revelation of Patriarchs = "v'tiferes banim avosam" = Yaakov = totality of Patriarchs; saved from constraints = merit of Patriarchs endures forever ("Rav Acha" in Midrash Rabbah); also plain meaning: draw kedushah of Eretz Yisrael onto all the world = nullify darkness everywhere = "chesed Hashem mal'ah ha'aretz" = "ki mal'ah ha'aretz de'ah es Hashem" = "va'yimaleh chevod Hashem es kol ha'aretz" = "yachiru v'yeda'u kol yoshvey sevel" = "l'chevodi bera'asiv." "Ki pi Hashem diber" = Shabbos = holy speech = hevel she'ain bo chet = repels judgment/darkness = reveals Patriarchs = draws Chesed and wisdom = "oraissa d'Atika" = "v'rav chesed" = "v'Atika Kadisha galei r'usa dilei" (Zohar on Shabbos).
 

 Siman 38 onward continues in the next installment.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

Yikara DiShabsa — Simanim 38–42

 Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Part One — Simanim 38–42

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Siman 38 — סימן לח
 Merkavos Par'oh — "The chariots of Pharaoh…"
 [Song of Songs 1:9]
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 38]

 Shabbos is the aspect of tefillin —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 which is why on Shabbos one is exempt from tefillin —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar and in the Tikunim —
 that Zachor [Remember] and Shamor [Guard]
 of Shabbos correspond to the brain and the heart —
 and to the tefillin shel yad [of the hand]
 and shel rosh [of the head].
 And also then is the essential ascent of speech
 and its rectification.
 For Shabbos is the aspect of the holy speech —
 the aspect of:
 "v'daber davar
 [and speaking words]"
 — as mentioned above many times
 in the name of the holy Zohar.
 And then the aspect of the stormy spirit
 [ruach se'arah] is subdued —
 which is the great accuser [mekateig gadol] —
 the aspect of:
 "ketz kol basar
 [the end of all flesh]"
 — from which all arousal of harsh judgments
 and accusations comes —
 and they are subdued then
 under the holy speech —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'chol shaltanay rogzin —
 u'maray d'dina — kulhu arkin —
 v'chulhu almim — v'leis shaltana achara
 b'chulhu almin bar mina
 [and all the wrathful rulers —
 and the masters of judgment —
 all of them flee —
 and are entirely silenced —
 and there is no other dominion
 in all the worlds except her],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And then all the holy sparks of the aspect
 of the holy speech —
 that had fallen among them
 and drew sustenance from them —
 ascend and return to their root in holiness —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — and regel [foot] is the aspect of speech —
 as explained within.

 And the beginning of the ascent of speech
 is from its head —
 that is, from the choicest truth
 that is within speech, and so on —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of:
 א'ם ת'שיב מ'שבת
 — the initial letters spell
 אֶמֶת [emes] —
 as explained in the writings.
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Yerushalmi Demai]:
 "even an unlearned person
 fears to lie on Shabbos."
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "zachor es yom haShabbas
 [remember the day of Shabbos]"
 — "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas
 [remember it from the first day of the week for Shabbos]"
 — for one must draw the holiness of Shabbos
 also onto the six weekdays.
 For during the six weekdays —
 then the dominion of the
 "ketz kol basar"
 holds sway — as is well-known —
 and as explained within.
 And when one strengthens oneself then
 to draw the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the rectification of speech —
 through fulfilling:
 "kava'ta itim l'Torah
 [establish fixed times for Torah]"
 — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "hevay mema'et b'esek v'esok b'Torah
 [minimize your engagement in business
 and engage in Torah]"
 [Avos 4:10] —
 especially through Torah studied at night —
 for then the dominion of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 strengthens even more —
 the aspect of:
 "ketz sam l'choshech
 [he sets an end for the darkness]"
 [Job 28:3] —
 and likewise through Torah studied in poverty and hardship —
 which is likewise the aspect of night —
 and the essential poverty and hardship
 is felt most strongly during the six weekdays —
 which are the days of labor —
 when the poor person is occupied
 pursuing his livelihood through great toil.
 Which is not the case on the holy Shabbos —
 which is a day of rest and joy for all —
 and as our Sages of blessed memory asked
 [on the verse Proverbs 15:15]:
 "kol yemay ani ra'im
 [all the days of a poor person are evil]"
 — "but are there not Shabbosim and Yom Tovim?"
 — see there what they resolved.
 It follows that the essential strengthening of poverty
 and hardship in its plain sense is during the weekdays.

 And when one strengthens oneself then
 to draw the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 especially through the aforementioned Torah study —
 for:
 "lo nitnetu Shabbasos ela l'divray Torah
 [Shabbosim were given only for words of Torah]"
 — and all agree that:
 "b'Shabbas nitnah Torah
 [the Torah was given on Shabbos]"
 [Tractate Shabbos 88a] —
 as mentioned above many times.

 And through the fact that one detaches oneself
 from labor and occupation even during the weekdays —
 and establishes fixed times for Torah as mentioned above —
 and even during the time of occupation and labor
 one's thought is bound to the holy Torah
 and to the holiness of Shabbos —
 and one intends that one's engagement in work
 is in order to earn money
 and be able to receive Shabbos with honor —
 and also in order to be able to support Torah scholars —
 who even during the weekdays are in the aspect
 of the holiness of Shabbos
 compared to other people —
 as mentioned above in Siman 35 —
 through this one subdues the side of
 "ketz kol basar"
 under the holy speech
 even during the weekdays —
 and the harsh judgments are sweetened —
 and acts of lovingkindness are drawn
 even then —
 in the aspect of:
 "moshchin alav chut shel chesed bayom
 [they draw upon him a thread of lovingkindness by day]"
 — as explained within —
 and through this one merits afterward
 to receive the illumination of the holiness
 of the holy Shabbos itself even more —
 and then speech comes forth
 in song and praise and hallel
 to the Holy One, blessed be He —
 as explained within.

 And this is the aspect of
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos —
 tov l'hodos laHashem —
 v'chol haggid baboker chasdecha
 [a psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos —
 it is good to give thanks to Hashem —
 to declare Your kindness in the morning]"
 — the aspect of the morning of Avraham [boker d'Avraham] —
 "v'emunascha ballaylos
 [and Your faithfulness in the nights]"
 — for even at night —
 when then the dominion of
 "ketz kol basar"
 holds sway —
 and one cannot draw fully
 the aspect of the holy mental faculties —
 which are the aspect of the revelation of the acts of lovingkindness —
 nonetheless one must strengthen oneself
 even then through complete faith [emunah sheleimah] —
 for [Lamentations 3:22–23]:
 "chasdey Hashem ki lo samnu —
 v'chol —
 chadashim labekarim —
 rabbah emunasecha
 [the kindnesses of Hashem — for they are not ended —
 and so on —
 they are new every morning —
 great is Your faithfulness]"
 — for even the darkness of night
 one must believe is only for the sake of
 the renewal of the acts of lovingkindness
 each morning —
 in the aspect of:
 "chadashim labekarim
 [new every morning]"
 — as explained elsewhere.
 And this is the secret of the flame of fire
 [shalhava d'asha]
 that descends on Erev Shabbos
 to singe the heads of the impure husks —
 so that they cannot attach themselves
 to the holiness, and so on —
 and as explained in the kavannos.
 For on the holy Shabbos
 the Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the holy speech —
 ascends to Chochmah and Binah —
 which are
 יָה [Yah] —
 and then the husks —
 the aspect of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 — also wish to ascend with her —
 since during the weekdays
 they have some sustenance from speech —
 in the aspect of:
 "achar hadevarim
 [after the matters/words]"
 [Genesis 15:1; 22:1; 39:7] —
 for then it is in the aspect of:
 "raglehah yordos maves
 [her legs descend to death]"
 [Proverbs 5:5]
 and in the aspect of:
 "nachash karuch al akevah
 [the serpent coiled around the heel]."
 And therefore on Erev Shabbos
 the flame of fire descends —
 the aspect of the holy Gevuros
 [powers of severity] —
 whose root is from the side of Imma —
 the aspect of Binah libah
 [Binah — the heart] —
 as explained in the writings.
 For from Binah harsh judgments are aroused —
 as is well-known —
 and through this the husks fall below —
 and the aspect of the side of
 "ketz kol basar"
 is subdued —
 and then the speech —
 which is the aspect of Malchus —
 ascends to its root —
 which is the aspect of the flame of the aforementioned Gevuros
 whose root is in the heart —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 39:4]:
 "cham libi b'kirbi —
 b'hag'igi tiv'ar esh
 [my heart grew hot within me —
 in my meditation a fire burned]."
 And there too is the true root of the truth of speech —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 15:2]:
 "v'dover emes b'levavo
 [and speaks truth in his heart]."
 And then one begins to speak —
 with the warmth of his heart —
 words of truth from his heart —
 with an awakening to repentance —
 and he sees his own lowliness
 and the greatness of the Creator —
 and great shame enters into him
 over the greatness of his transgressions
 against the great and ruling
 root and source of all the worlds, and so on —
 as explained within.

 And this is the aspect of the awakening to repentance
 and the great shame
 that a person must have
 before entering the holiness of Shabbos —
 as explained in the kavannos.
 And afterward —
 when one actually receives the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of complete repentance —
 and merits to receive the illumination
 of the holy mental faculties
 that shine on the holy Shabbos —
 one is then even more ashamed —
 until the shame and the awe
 are revealed on one's face —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of the great shame and awe
 visible on the face of the true Tzadik
 on the holy Shabbos.
 And this shame is the aspect of the light of tefillin —
 and therefore a person is obligated
 to greet the face of his teacher on Shabbos —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 and likewise then is the essential time
 to draw close to the truly righteous ones —
 as mentioned above many times —
 for then through the very gazing alone —
 gazing at their faces —
 one merits to receive knowledge
 and mental faculties of the greatness
 of the Creator, blessed be He —
 until he too merits the awe and shame of holiness —
 which is the aspect of the light of tefillin —
 for this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 the letters:
 שַׁבָּת — בֹּשֶׁת [boshes] —
 as brought in the writings and the holy Tikunim.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "barchu b'or panav shel Adam
 [He blessed them with the light of the face of a person]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught
 regarding Shabbos.
 For the light of this shame
 revealed on his face through the holiness of Shabbos —
 this is the aspect of [Exodus 34:29]:
 "ki karan or panav
 [for the skin of his face radiated light]"
 — as brought within.

segments.he: היינו שימשוך קדושת ארץ ישראל על כל העולם בבחינת 'עתידה ארץ ישראל שתתפשט בכל העולם' כנ"ל. "כי פי ה' דיבר", כי שבת הוא בחינת קדושת הדיבור שכלול מבחינת חכמה ובחינת אמונה כנ"ל כמה פעמים, שזה גם כן בחינת קדושת ארץ ישראל כנ"ל, גם "אז תתענג על ה'" מרמז על שלימות תיקון הדיבור שזוכין על ידי בחינת ג' שבתות הנ"ל. כי בחינת בינה בחינת יובל הוא בבחינת "על ה'" וכו,' ובמותי ארץ הוא בחינת הדיבור פה, בחינת מלכות פה, כמו שכתוב (קהלת ח) "באשר דבר מלך שלטון", ובחינת ביטול המלכיות דסטרא אחרא שנקראים מצרים, כמו שאמרו רז"ל שלפעמים הדיבור בגלות אצלם ח"ו. ונחלת יעקב אביך הוא בחינת "הקול קול יעקב", בחינת הקול היוצא מכנפי ריאה הנ"ל.
segments.en:
And therefore Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him —
 who merited the light of tefillin in its perfection —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "ki karan or panav"
 — stated regarding Moshe —
 as explained within —
 therefore he also merited in its perfection
 the holiness of Shabbos —
 in the aspect of:
 "yismach Moshe b'matan chelko
 [Moshe rejoices in the gift of his portion]."
 And this is the aspect of what is explained
 in the writings of the holy Ari z"l —
 that Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
 returns the adayim [adornments] to Israel on Shabbos —
 for regarding them it is stated [Exodus 33:6]:
 "vayisnatzlu es adayim —
 u'Moshe yikach es ha'ohel
 [and the children of Israel stripped themselves of their adornments —
 and Moshe took the tent]"
 — for he took those lights
 in order to complete the one thousand lights
 that had been taken from him [Adam haRishon] —
 and on Shabbos those one thousand lights
 are returned to him —
 and he acts with a generous spirit toward Israel —
 and returns to them as well
 the light of the aforementioned adayim —
 see there.
 And behold — the light of the adayim
 is the aspect of the light of tefillin —
 as explained within.
 It follows clearly that on Shabbos
 all of Israel merits to receive back
 from Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
 the light of tefillin in its perfection —
 which is the aspect of the light of the awe and shame
 mentioned above —
 which is the aspect of the light of the face.
 And therefore each and every person of Israel
 according to his own aspect
 merits on Shabbos the aspect of
 the radiance of the skin of the face —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "ain domeh or panav shel adam b'yemay hachol
 l'or panav b'Shabbas
 [the light of a person's face
 during the weekdays
 is not comparable
 to the light of his face on Shabbos]"
 — that is, as mentioned above.

 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "afilu al am ha'aretz she'eymas Shabbas alav
 [even upon an unlearned person
 — the awe of Shabbos is upon him]"
 — the aspect of the aforementioned awe and shame.
 And this is what is brought in Tikkun Vav, folio 24:
 "kad nafik Shabbata —
 v'chulhu Yisrael inun tachos memshelah d'Samach-Mem
 v'shiv'in memanan —
 v'chulhu —
 kala nafik min shemaya l'gabei —
 v'yeimah hachi:
 yira boshes —
 v'chulhu —
 yihyeh lach kissufa min shemaya
 [when Shabbos departs —
 and all of Israel is under the dominion of Samach-Mem
 and the seventy appointed officers —
 and all of them —
 a voice goes out from Heaven toward him —
 and it says thus:
 awe and shame —
 and all of them —
 there shall be for you shame from Heaven],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — that is, as mentioned above —
 for through the shame and awe
 that Israel merits to receive on Shabbos and Yom Tov —
 which is the aspect of the light of tefillin —
 through this shame and awe also falls
 upon the nations —
 who are from the aspect of the dominion
 of the Samach-Mem
 and the seventy appointed officers —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'yiru mimecha
 [and they shall fear you]"
 [Deuteronomy 28:10] —
 as explained within.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "hameshamer Shabbas —
 v'chol haggid — mochalin lo
 [one who guards Shabbos —
 and so on —
 he is forgiven]"
 — for this is the aspect of what
 our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Berachos 12b]:
 "ha'over aveirah u'misbayesh bah —
 mochalin lo
 [one who commits a transgression
 and is ashamed of it —
 he is forgiven]"
 — as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of Shabbos —
 the aspect of shame [boshes] —
 "boshes panim
 [shamefacedness]"
 — the opposite of brazenness [azus] —
 which is the pollution of the serpent [zohamat hanachash] —
 the side of:
 "ketz kol basar."
 For this is the aspect of:
 "v'hishbati ge'on azim
 [and I will put an end to the pride of the powerful]"
 [Ezekiel 7:24] —
 as mentioned above many times.

 And this is what one says in the Haggadah:
 "ilu natan lanu es haShabbas —
 v'lo keirvanu lifnay Har Sinai —
 dayenu
 [had He given us the Shabbos —
 and not brought us before Mount Sinai —
 it would have been enough for us]."
 For Israel who stood at Mount Sinai —
 the pollution of the serpent [zohamat hanachash]
 ceased from them —
 and the brazenness of the Sitra Achra
 was nullified from them.
 For this reason our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "kol mi she'yesh bo azus —
 beidua she'lo amdu raglav shel avosav al Har Sinai
 [anyone who has brazenness —
 it is known that the feet of his ancestors
 did not stand at Mount Sinai]"
 — as explained within —
 and shame was drawn upon them —
 for this is the aspect of [Exodus 20:17]:
 "l'ma'an tihyeh yir'aso al peneichem
 [so that His awe shall be upon your faces]"
 — stated at the revelation of Mount Sinai.
 And through the holiness of Shabbos
 one merits this as well, as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "to'amehah chayyim zachu
 [those who taste it have merited life]"
 — for it is the aspect of the light of tefillin —
 which is the aspect of the Etz haChayyim [Tree of Life] —
 the aspect of:
 "Hashem aleihem yichyu
 [Hashem — through them they shall live]"
 [Isaiah 38:16] —
 as explained within.
 And therefore:
 "lo nitrash Adam haRishon
 mi'Gan Eden —
 ad achar haShabbas
 [the first Adam was not driven out of the Garden of Eden
 until after the Shabbos]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 for the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of
 "boshes panim l'Gan Eden
 [shamefacedness — [an entryway] to the Garden of Eden]."
 And therefore — even though he blemished
 in the aspect of tefillin —
 as explained within —
 "ba Shabbas v'heigin alav
 [Shabbos came and protected him]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

 And therefore also Kayin —
 who blemished the light of tefillin —
 and likewise Korach —
 who blemished the honor of Moshe —
 who had merited in its perfection the light of tefillin
 — and this too came about through
 the spark of Kayin that was clothed in him —
 as brought
 (and see in Likutay Torah,
 Parashas Korach)
 — therefore their rectification as well
 comes through the holiness of Shabbos —
 as brought in the kavannos
 regarding:
 "Mizmor l'David — havu,"
 and so on —
 and likewise in:
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos"
 — and the psalm:
 "Hashem melech ge'us lavesh
 [Hashem reigns — He is robed in pride],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 that when the first Adam encountered Kayin —
 and [Kayin] said to him:
 "I did repentance
 and was reconciled"
 — the first Adam said:
 "if so — repentance is so powerful!"
 — and he opened and said:
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos."
 That is — he understood that his repentance
 had been accepted through the merit of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of great mental faculties —
 through which one merits complete repentance —
 until the shame is revealed on one's face.
 And see in Zohar Chadash Shir HaShirim —
 where it is also explained
 that leil Shabbas [the Shabbos night]
 and yom Shabbas [the Shabbos day]
 are the aspects of
 tefillin shel yad [of the hand]
 and shel rosh [of the head].
 And there it is explained
 that the tefillin of weekdays
 are the aspect of:
 "diyukna d'chotma d'malka
 [the image of the seal of the King]"
 — and the tefillin of Shabbos and Yom Tov
 are the aspect of:
 "tefillin d'marei alma mamash
 [the tefillin of the Master of the world literally]"
 — and therefore it is forbidden
 to put on tefillin on them, and so on —
 see there.
 And this is what the first Adam opened with —
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos —
 tov l'hodos laHashem —
 v'lezammer l'shimcha elyon
 [a psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos —
 it is good to give thanks to Hashem —
 and to sing praises to Your Name, Most High]."
 That is — for even though the light of tefillin
 is very great —
 for they are in the aspect of the:
 "shema d'Kub"H
 [the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He]"
 — the aspect of [Deuteronomy 28:10]:
 "ki shem Hashem nikra alecha —
 v'yaru mimecha
 [for the Name of Hashem is called upon you —
 and they shall fear you]."
 But also among the holy Names —
 there is higher above higher —
 as is well-known.

 And therefore the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is likewise the Name of the Holy One,
 blessed be He —
 is higher and more supernal —
 until it is forbidden to put on tefillin
 on it at all —
 for the holiness of Shabbos is higher than this —
 and from there is drawn the power of repentance —
 which is higher than the holy Torah, as it were.
 For even though:
 "oraissa shema d'Kub"H
 [the Torah is the Name of the Holy One,
 blessed be He]"
 — and through blemishing,
 heaven forfend, any matter of the holy Torah —
 through this one causes a blemish, heaven forfend,
 in the holiness of His blessed Names —
 as is well-known —
 but the power of complete repentance —
 which is the aspect of Shabbos —
 is great and exalted to such a degree —
 that through it all the blemishes are rectified.
 And not only that — but:
 "bimkom she'ba'alay teshuvah omdin —
 ain tzadikim gemurim yecholim laamod
 [in the place where penitents stand —
 the perfectly righteous are unable to stand]."
 And the essential perfection of repentance
 to its utmost is with the highest Tzadikim —
 who serve G-d with great clinging
 and great intellect.

 And when they have some aspect of fall
 and descent in their mental faculties —
 even though even now they are at a very great level
 compared to other people —
 and even compared to other Tzadikim —
 nonetheless they are deeply ashamed of this —
 as if they had actually committed some sin,
 heaven forfend —
 and they do great repentance for this —
 until through this they arrive at a new recognition
 and awareness — far higher —
 much more elevated
 than the awareness they had at the beginning —
 even before they fell from their level.
 And likewise they merit through this
 great shame and awe —
 which are the aspects of the light of tefillin
 at the highest level —
 which is the aspect of the holiness
 of Shabbos and Yom Tov —
 which are the aspect of:
 "tefillin d'marei alma mamash"
 — as mentioned above.
 (And one can say that this is the aspect of
 what Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
 merited the radiance of the skin of his face —
 specifically after the second tablets —
 as explained about this elsewhere.)

 And this is the aspect of:
 "v'lezammer l'shimcha elyon
 [and to sing praises to Your Name, Most High]"
 — for through repentance —
 which is the aspect of:
 "tov l'hodos laHashem
 [it is good to give thanks to Hashem]"
 — from the language of verbal confession
 [vidduy devarim] —
 as our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer
 and in Midrash Shocher Tov —
 through this specifically
 one merits afterward
 an even greater and more exalted attainment
 of the greatness and holiness
 of His blessed Names —
 which is the aspect of:
 "v'lezammer l'shimcha elyon."
 And this:
 "l'haggid baboker chasdecha —
 v'emunascha ballaylos
 [to declare Your kindness in the morning —
 and Your faithfulness in the nights]"
 — for through the rectification of speech —
 merited through Torah study at night —
 and likewise through drawing the holiness of Shabbos
 onto the six weekdays —
 one merits afterward the holiness of Shabbos
 in its perfection, as mentioned above.
 "ki simachtani Hashem b'fo'olecha —
 b'ma'aseh yadecha aranen
 [for You have gladdened me, Hashem, through Your work —
 in the works of Your hands I shall shout for joy]"
 — one must rejoice and sing
 even during the six days of action —
 since through them the holiness of Shabbos comes —
 and through this too
 one draws the holiness of Shabbos
 onto the six weekdays.
 And this:
 "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem
 [how great are Your works, Hashem]"
 — for the works of G-d are certainly
 exceedingly great and holy —
 and they are the aspects of the holy Torah —
 through which everything is called —
 as it is written [Proverbs 8:30]:
 "va'ehyeh etzlo amun
 [and I was with Him as a craftsman]"
 — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 that the Torah is the craft of the Holy One,
 blessed be He —
 through which all the works of creation were created.

 "me'od amku machshevosecha
 [how very deep are Your thoughts]"
 — this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the World of Thought —
 which is the aspect of the supernal repentance —
 exceedingly great and deep —
 so that through it everything can be rectified.
 And not only that — but the descent itself —
 which is the aspect of the side of death —
 the side of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 — for this is the aspect of:
 "me'od"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 "me'od — this is the side of death [sitra d'musa]"
 — will also be transformed
 into a great elevation —
 until through repentance
 one merits afterward a supremely exalted attainment —
 which is the aspect of
 the holy light of the tefillin of Shabbos,
 as mentioned above.
 And conversely —
 the rise and success of the wicked
 is the ultimate perfection of their downfall —
 in the aspect of:
 "bifroach resha'im —
 v'chol haggid —
 l'hishmaedam adey ad —
 v'atah marom l'olam Hashem
 [when the wicked flourish —
 and so on —
 to destroy them forever —
 but You are exalted forever, Hashem]"
 — forever Your hand is on top —
 for:
 "how very deep are Your thoughts"
 — and He is [Deuteronomy 32:4]:
 "El emunah v'ein avel —
 tzadik v'yashar hu
 [a G-d of faithfulness
 and without iniquity —
 righteous and upright is He]."
 And on this the entire psalm revolves —
 until it concluded:
 "l'haggid ki yashar Hashem —
 tzuri
 [to declare that Hashem is upright —
 my Rock],"
 and so on. [וכו']

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — that is, the speech —
 which is the aspect of regel [foot] —
 shall ascend to holiness.
 א'ם ת'שיב מ'שבת —
 initial letters: אֶמֶת [emes] —
 for the beginning of the ascent of speech
 is from its head —
 that is, from the choicest truth in speech —
 as mentioned above.
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — that is, through drawing the holiness of Shabbos
 onto the six weekdays —
 as mentioned above and as explained within.
 And also in its plain meaning —
 one should refrain on Shabbos
 from pursuing one's affairs
 and weekday deeds —
 in which the Sitra Achra —
 the side of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 — has a grip.
 For they are in the aspect of [Psalms 68:31]:
 "yechpetzu korbos
 [they desire tributes / battles]"
 — the meaning being:
 that they always desire war —
 for they are the aforementioned Sitra Achra
 who accuse a person and war against him continually —
 and weary him with great turmoil and toil —
 primarily through the sorrow of earning a livelihood
 and the turmoil of the thirty-nine melachos
 [categories of Shabbos labor]
 during the six weekdays —
 until all of a person's hope and all his desire
 is only in this —
 and through this he is prevented
 from engaging in Torah —
 which:
 "kol chafatzim lo yishvu vah
 [all desires cannot compare with it]."
 [Proverbs 8:11]
 But on Shabbos one must engage
 only in the affairs of Heaven —
 that is, in the engagement with Torah —
 about which our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "chafatzai v'chafatzecha lo yishvu vah
 [My affairs and your affairs —
 none compare with it]."
 And this is the aspect of [Psalms 1:2]:
 "ki im b'Toras Hashem cheftzo
 [but in the Torah of Hashem is his desire]."
 And through this Chesed is drawn —
 in the aspect of [Hosea 6:6]:
 "ki chesed chafatzti
 [for it is lovingkindness that I desire]."
 And through this one merits awe and shame —
 in the aspect of [Nehemiah 1:11]:
 "hachafetzim l'yira es Shimcha
 [those who desire to fear Your Name]"
 — the aspect of tefillin —
 which is the aspect of the Etz haChayyim —
 the aspect of repentance —
 as it is written [Ezekiel 18:23]:
 "hachafetz achphotz —
 v'chol haggid —
 ki im b'shuv rasha midarkav v'chayah
 [Is it My desire —
 and so on —
 is it not rather in the repentance
 of the wicked from his way — that he should live?]"

 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight]"
 — for the holy speech
 is called sacred delight [oneg d'kedushah] —
 the opposite of the speech
 of the Sitra Achra
 of the aspect of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 — which finds fault and refuse in everyone.
 About this it is stated [Isaiah 57:4]:
 "al mi tis'angeu —
 al mi tarchivhu peh —
 ta'arichu lashon
 [against whom do you delight —
 against whom do you open wide the mouth —
 do you stretch out the tongue?]"
 And speech is the aspect of the daughter of Avraham —
 which is the aspect of Chesed —
 the aspect of love —
 for this is the aspect of delight —
 the aspect of [Song of Songs 7:7]:
 "ahavah b'ta'anugim
 [love with delights]."
 And through this one merits repentance —
 and repentance is the aspect of Shadai —
 as explained in the teaching
 Betach b'Hashem, Siman 79.
 And this is the aspect of delight —
 the aspect of [Job 22:26]:
 "ki az al Shadai titanag
 [for then you shall delight in Shadai]."
 And through this one receives new mental faculties —
 and the mental faculties are the essential delight —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and through this one merits shame and awe —
 which are the aspects of tefillin.
 And tefillin are likewise the aspect of Shadai
 — as is well-known —
 and as explained in Likutay Moharan Tinyana,
 Siman 5 in the teaching:
 "Tik'u Emunah
 [Sound the Shofar — Faithfulness]."
 And this is the aspect of delight —
 the aspect of:
 "ki az al Shadai titanag"
 — as mentioned above.

 And this:
 "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [the holy one of Hashem, honored]."
 For all the aforementioned aspects
 are likewise the aspects of kavod [honor].
 The Torah is the aspect of honor —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "ain kavod ela Torah
 [there is no honor except Torah]."
 The holy speech is the aspect of honor —
 as explained elsewhere —
 and in the teaching
 Ani Hashem Hu Shemi, Siman 11 —
 and likewise below within in Siman 194.
 And this is the aspect of [Psalms 30:13]:
 "l'ma'an yezamercha kavod v'lo yidom
 [so that my kavod shall sing to You
 and not be silent]"
 — as explained within in this teaching.
 And through this one merits repentance —
 which is the aspect of kavod —
 the aspect of:
 "zovei'ach todah yechabdenni
 [one who offers a sacrifice of thanksgiving
 will honor Me]"
 [Psalms 50:23] —
 as explained in the teaching
 Kra es Yehoshua, Siman 6 —
 and through this one receives new mental faculties.
 And this is the aspect of kavod —
 the aspect of:
 "kavod chachamim yinchalu
 [the wise shall inherit honor]"
 [Proverbs 3:35] —
 and through this one merits awe and shame —
 and this is the aspect of kavod —
 as it is written [Deuteronomy 28:58]:
 "l'yira es haShayim hanichbad
 [to fear the glorious Name]"
 — and as explained elsewhere.
 And this is the aspect of the commandments
 of the delight and honor of Shabbos —
 for then the pollution of the serpent is repelled —
 and great holiness is drawn
 even upon the bodily pleasures —
 the aspect of:
 "to'amehah chayyim zachu
 [those who taste it have merited life]"
 — the aspect of eating from the Etz haChayyim.
 And this is likewise what is explained
 in the holy Zohar —
 that:
 "Oneg"
 — the initial letters of:
 "Eden — Nahar — Gan."
 — the aspect of:
 "boshes panim l'Gan Eden
 [shamefacedness — [an entryway] to the Garden of Eden]."

 And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha —
 mimitzo chafatzecha — v'daber davar
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways —
 from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — he should withhold himself even from weekday speech —
 so that the dominion of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 should not grip him, heaven forfend.
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]."
 For one merits to attain the highest mental faculties —
 which are the aspect of Atika.
 "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz
 [and I will cause you to ride
 upon the heights of the earth]"
 — "da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [this is the Holy Apple Orchard]"
 — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus
 — which is the holy speech.
 And our Sages expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 that is, the side of:
 "ketz kol basar"
 is subdued beneath the holy speech —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 47:4]:
 "yedaber amim tachteinu —
 v'le'umim tachas raglainu
 [He subdues peoples beneath us —
 and nations beneath our feet]"
 — "and there is no kingdom
 except Malchus"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — "da Ze'ir Anpin
 [this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — the aspect of Tiferes —
 this is the aspect of the awe and shame —
 which is the aspect of Tiferes —
 the totality of colors —
 the aspect of tefillin —
 as explained within.
 (And see also below within
 in the teaching
 V'Achaltem Achol v'Savoa,
 Siman 47 —
 where it is also explained
 that Yaakov is the secret of the aspect of tefillin.)
 And this is the aspect of:
 "b'yir'asecha
 [in Your awe]"
 — "bizchus Yaakov she'amar: mah nora
 [in the merit of Yaakov who said: how awesome],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 29:22]:
 "lo atah yevosh Yaakov —
 v'lo atah panav yecharru
 [not now shall Yaakov be ashamed —
 and not now shall his face grow pale],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 — for since he has merited
 the holy shame and awe —
 which is the aspect of the light of tefillin
 — therefore he need be ashamed of no person —
 on the contrary!
 all must be ashamed before him —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'yiru mimecha
 [and they shall fear you]"
 — as explained within.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 [Tractate Shabbos 118]:
 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha"
 — that one merits an inheritance without limits.
 For the matter of this shame and awe
 is without limit and boundary whatsoever —
 for every time one merits to receive
 new and more exalted mental faculties —
 one is even more ashamed
 of one's previous attainment —
 and does repentance for it —
 and through this one merits
 to receive even more exalted mental faculties —
 and then one merits even greater shame and awe —
 and through this one merits
 to receive even more exalted mental faculties —
 and so it cycles back again — without end.
 And this is what concluded:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]."
 For everything is accomplished through the rectification
 of the holy speech
 through the holiness of Shabbos —
 through which one merits all the above —
 as also explained within.

segments.he: גם "אז תתענג על ה'" מרמז על המתקת הדינים על ידי הג' שמות הוי"ה, שהם בחינת ג' פעמים יד, בחינת השם מ"ב שבבינה, שזה בחינת "כי ב"י חשק", שנתגלה החשק שבלב בהידים שזה בחינת "אז תתענג" בחינת חשק וענג. "והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ". זה בחינת עליית המלכות בחינת מלכות פה שזה בחינת הג' שמות אלקים שבגרון. כי פ"ה עם הכולל גמטריא אלקי"ם כמבואר בכוונות על "וישם לך שלום" הנ"ל. ועל ידי זה נתבטלין המלכיות דסטרא אחרא שהם בחינת שלשה שרי פרעה היונקים משם כמבואר בכוונות הנ"ל.
segments.en:
All the journeys are for the sake of
 the damage to emunah [faith] —
 as explained within.

segments.he: "והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך" הוא בחינת היד רמה שהוא בחינת כלליות הידים, שהם בחינת האבות שזה בחינת תפארת, בחינת "ותפארת בנים אבותם" (משלי יז), וזה בחינת 'נחלה בלי מצרים', כי על ידי זה נתבטלין כל המצרים בבחינת (שמות יד) "ובני ישראל יוצאים ביד רמה". וגם כי על ידי זה נמשך בחינת "כל העמים תקעו כף" (המבואר בפנים), שזה בחינת "אז אהפוך אל העמים שפה ברורה לקרוא כולם בשם ה'", וזה בחינת 'נחלה בלי מצרים'. גם המוחין דגדלות הם בחינת ענג כמבואר כבר כמה פעמים. גם ביטול המחלוקת בבחינת "וישם לך שלום" הוא בחינת ענג כמו שכתוב (תהלים לז) "והתענגו על רוב שלום". וזה "כי פי ה' דיבר", היינו שנמתק הדיבור היוצא מהגרון ששם שמות אלקים שהם בחינת פה עם הכולל כנ"ל, ונמתקין על ידי השמות הקדושים של הויה ברוך הוא וכנ"ל שזה בחינת פי ה' דיבר ה' דייקא כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Shabbos = tefillin / speech ascends / ketz kol basar subdued: Sages: exempt from tefillin on Shabbos. Zohar + Tikunim: Zachor/Shamor = brain/heart = tefillin shel yad/rosh. Shabbos = essential ascent of speech = "v'daber davar" (Zohar Bereishis 32). "Ketz kol basar" = the great accuser = all arousal of judgments and accusations; subdued under holy speech on Shabbos = "v'chol shaltanay rogzin… arkin… leis shaltana achara b'chulhu almin bar mina." Holy sparks of speech that fell rise back = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = regel = speech. Ascent of speech begins from its head = from the choicest truth in speech. "Im Tashiv miShabbat" acrostic = emes. "Even an unlearned person fears to lie on Shabbos" (Yerushalmi Demai).
 Drawing Shabbos holiness onto weekdays / Torah at night / poverty: "Zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas." During weekdays: dominion of "ketz kol basar." Strengthen through: "kava'ta itim l'Torah" / "hevay mema'et b'esek v'esok b'Torah." Torah at night = dominion of "ketz kol basar" even more = "ketz sam l'choshech" (Job 28:3). Torah in poverty/hardship = also aspect of night. Poverty strongest during weekdays; Shabbos = rest and joy = "kol yemay ani ra'im — v'ha'ika Shabbasos v'yamim tovim?" Support Torah scholars (= Shabbos-holiness on weekdays even for them — Siman 35 cross-reference). Through all this: subdue "ketz kol basar" on weekdays too → sweetened judgments → "moshchin alav chut shel chesed bayom" → merit even greater Shabbos illumination → speech in song and praise to G-d.
 Psalm 92 mapped — boker d'Avraham / Lamentations 3 / shalhava d'asha: "L'haggid baboker chasdecha" = boker d'Avraham. "V'emunascha ballaylos" = even at night when "ketz kol basar" holds sway and full mochin cannot shine, strengthen in emunah = "chasdey Hashem ki lo samnu… chadashim labekarim rabbah emunasecha" (Lamentations 3:22–23). Even the darkness of night is for the renewal of Chesed every morning. Shalhava d'asha on Erev Shabbos (Ari kavannos): on Shabbos Malchus/speech ascends to Chochmah-Binah (Yah). "Ketz kol basar" wishes to rise with her (grip in weekdays through "achar hadevarim"). Weekday aspect: "raglehah yordos maves / nachash karuch al akevah." On Erev Shabbos: holy Gevuros from side of Imma/Binah = "Binah libah" descend = husks fall = "cham libi b'kirbi b'hag'igi tiv'ar esh" (Psalms 39:4). Root of true speech = "dover emes b'levavo" (Psalms 15:2). Speech begins with warmth of heart = words of truth = awakening to teshuvah = sees own lowliness and greatness of Creator = great shame.
 Shame before Shabbos / shame = light of tefillin / greet the face of the Tzadik: Must feel shame and awakening to teshuvah before entering Shabbos (kavannos). On Shabbos itself: receive great mochin → even greater shame revealed on the face. Shame and awe visible on the face of the true Tzadik on Shabbos = aur hatefillin. Therefore obligated to greet teacher's face on Shabbos (Zohar). Gazing at their faces alone → receive Da'as and mochin of the Creator's greatness → merit awe and shame = aur hatefillin. Shabbas = Boshes (writings and Tikunim). "Barchu b'or panav shel Adam" (Sages on Shabbos). "Ki karan or panav" = Shabbos shame = radiance of the face.
 Moshe / the 1000 lights / aur ha'adayim / "ain domeh or panav…": Moshe = merited aur hatefillin perfectly = "ki karan or panav" = merited Shabbos = "yismach Moshe b'matan chelko." Ari's writings: Moshe returns the adayim to Israel on Shabbos. Exodus 33:6: "vayisnatzlu es adayim — u'Moshe yikach es ha'ohel." Moshe took those lights to complete the 1000 lights taken from Adam haRishon. On Shabbos: 1000 lights returned to Adam; with generous spirit Moshe also returns the aur ha'adayim to Israel. Aur ha'adayim = aur hatefillin. Therefore every Jew merits on Shabbos the aur hatefillin = awe and shame = aur hapanim. "Ain domeh or panav shel adam b'yemay hachol l'or panav b'Shabbas." "Afilu al am ha'aretz she'eymas Shabbas alav." Tikkun Vav folio 24: "kad nafik Shabbata… kala nafik min shemaya… yira boshes… yihyeh lach kissufa min shemaya" = Israel's Shabbos shame → shame falls on the 70 appointed officers too → "v'yiru mimecha." "Hameshamer Shabbas — mochalin lo" = "ha'over aveirah u'misbayesh bah mochalin lo" (Berachos 12b). Shabbas = boshes = opposite of azus = zohamat hanachash = "ketz kol basar" = "v'hishbati ge'on azim."
 Haggadah: "ilu natan lanu es haShabbas… dayenu" / Adam haRishon / Kayin / Korach: Haggadah: had He given us Shabbos but not brought us to Sinai — dayenu. Sinai: zohamat hanachash ceased; azus of Sitra Achra nullified; shame drawn on Israel. "Kol mi she'yesh bo azus — beidua she'lo amdu avosav al Har Sinai." "L'ma'an tihyeh yir'aso al peneichem" (Sinai). Shabbos accomplishes the same. "To'amehah chayyim zachu" = aur hatefillin = Etz haChayyim = "Hashem aleihem yichyu." "Lo nitrash Adam haRishon miGan Eden ad achar haShabbas" = boshes panim l'Gan Eden = even though he blemished tefillin, "ba Shabbas v'heigin alav." Kayin blemished aur hatefillin; Korach blemished kevod Moshe (who had aur hatefillin; Korach also had a spark of Kayin — Likutay Torah Korach). Their rectification: kavannos on "Mizmor l'David havu," "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbas," "Hashem melech ge'us lavesh." Adam haRishon met Kayin → Kayin's teshuvah → Adam opened with "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" = understood teshuvah accepted through Shabbos = great mochin = complete teshuvah = shame revealed on face. Zohar Chadash Shir HaShirim: leil Shabbas = tefillin shel yad; yom Shabbas = tefillin shel rosh. Weekday tefillin = "diyukna d'chotma d'malka"; Shabbos/Yom Tov tefillin = "tefillin d'marei alma mamash" → forbidden to put on tefillin on them.
 "Tov l'hodos" = viduy / Shabbos higher than Torah / ba'alay teshuvah / highest Tzadikim: "Tov l'hodos laHashem" = language of viduy (Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer + Midrash Shocher Tov). Through teshuvah → "v'lezammer l'shimcha elyon" = higher attainment of the greatness and holiness of G-d's Names. Shabbos = the Name of G-d = higher than tefillin (which are also the Name of G-d) → forbidden to put on tefillin on Shabbos. Torah = also the Name of G-d. Power of complete teshuvah (= Shabbos) = even greater than Torah, as it were. "Bimkom she'ba'alay teshuvah omdin ain tzadikim gemurim yecholim laamod." Essential perfection of teshuvah = with the highest Tzadikim serving with great Da'as. When they have a "fall" in their mochin → they are deeply ashamed → great teshuvah → arrive at even higher recognition than before the fall → greater mochin → higher aur hatefillin = "tefillin d'marei alma mamash." ("Ki karan or panav" was specifically after the second tablets.)
 Isaiah 58 — Siman 38: "Feet" = speech = regel. Acrostic = emes = choicest truth in speech. "Affairs" = (1) draw Shabbos holiness onto weekdays; (2) refrain on Shabbos from weekday deeds = "ketz kol basar" = "yechpetzu korbos" (Psalms 68:31) = always desire war/battle/toil = 39 melachos = prevent Torah study = "kol chafatzim lo yishvu vah"; on Shabbos: only Torah = "chafatzai v'chafatzecha lo yishvu vah"; Chesed drawn = "ki chesed chafatzti"; awe and shame = "hachafetzim l'yira es Shimcha" = tefillin = Etz haChayyim = teshuvah = "hachafetz achphotz… ki im b'shuv rasha midarkav v'chayah." "Call Shabbos delight" = holy speech = oneg d'kedushah = opposite of "ketz kol basar" speech that finds fault in everyone = Isaiah 57:4 "al mi tis'angeu"; speech = daughter of Avraham = Chesed = love = "ahavah b'ta'anugim" → teshuvah = Shadai (Siman 79) = "ki az al Shadai titanag"; new mochin; shame and awe = tefillin = Shadai (LM Tinyana 5); "ki az al Shadai titanag." "Honored" = all aspects = kavod: Torah = kavod ("ain kavod ela Torah"); holy speech = kavod (Siman 11; Siman 194; "l'ma'an yezamercha kavod v'lo yidom"); teshuvah = kavod ("zovei'ach todah yechabdenni" — Siman 6); new mochin = "kavod chachamim yinchalu"; awe and shame = kavod = "l'yira es haShayim hanichbad." Oneg Shabbos = zohamat hanachash repelled → holiness on bodily pleasures = "to'amehah chayyim" = eating from Etz haChayyim. Oneg = Eden/Nahar/Gan = "boshes panim l'Gan Eden." "Honor it / your ways / speaking words" = no weekday speech; no grip for "ketz kol basar." "Delight in Hashem" = highest mochin = Atika. "Heights of earth" = Chakla Tupichin = ascent of Malchus/speech; saved from subjugation = "ketz kol basar" subdued = "yedaber amim tachteinu"; "ain le'om ela malchus." "Heritage of Yaakov" = Ze'ir Anpin = Tiferes = awe and shame = Tiferes = totality of colors = tefillin (Siman 47); "b'yir'asecha b'zchus Yaakov she'amar mah nora"; "lo atah yevosh Yaakov"; saved from shame = need not fear anyone = "v'yiru mimecha"; Shabbos 118: nachalah b'li metzarim = awe and shame are boundless: new mochin → greater shame → repentance → even higher mochin → even greater shame → ad ain sof. "Ki pi Hashem diber" = everything through rectification of the holy speech through Shabbos.

segments.he:
סימן מז-ואכלתם אכול ושבוע 
שבת הוא בחינת שביעה, בחינת שבירת תאוות האכילה כמובן לקמן בפנים בסימן רע"ו. גם שבת הוא בחינת אור הפנים בחינת 'ואנפהא נהירין' וכו' ואמרו רז"ל 'ברכו באור פניו של אדם'. גם שבת הוא בחינת אמת כנ"ל כמה פעמים. גם בשבת כל דינין אתכפיין ולא מתערין כלל כמובא בזוהר הקדוש (ח"ב פח:), גם שבת הוא בחינת עשירות כמו שדרשו רז"ל "ברכת ה' היא תעשיר" וכו' לענין שבת שנאמר בו "ויברך". גם שבת הוא בבחינת "ולקדוש ה' מכובד", היפך חרפות ובזיונות, בחינת "וישבת דין וקלון", וכן "והשבית קצין חרפתו" (דניאל יא) וכנ"ל בסימן ל"ד. גם שבת הוא בחינת נסים ונפלאות בחינת 'אות היא לעולם' וכו' כמובא לקמן בפנים בסימן נ"ט. גם שבת הוא בחינת יעקב בחינת "והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך". כי הוא הראשון שמבואר בו ששמר את השבת.
segments.en:
Siman 39 — סימן לט
 V'Nasati Esev — "And I will give grass…"
 [Deuteronomy 11:15]
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 39]

 Shabbos is the day of souls
 and not the day of the body —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And then the corporeality and the animality —
 which is the aspect of
 the power of the lust within a person
 for material things —
 is subdued through the greatness
 of the illumination of the holy soul
 that shines on the holy Shabbos.
 And then all the shames and hatreds
 and disputes —
 which are the aspects of the impure husks —
 are nullified —
 and the aspect of
 "Bris Shalom
 [covenant of peace]"
 is revealed —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 as is well-known.
 And there is peace below and above —
 for Shabbos is the aspect of:
 "Melech she'hashalom shelo
 [the King whose peace is His]"
 — as is well-known.

segments.he: גם שבת הוא בחינת תפילין כמו שאמרו רז"ל שעל כן בשבת פטורין מן התפילין. גם שבת הוא בחינת כלליות הגוונין בחינת תפארת, שזה בחינת 'תפארת עטה ליום המנוחה'.
segments.en:
And great abundance and plenty multiply in the world —
 for all the abundance and livelihood is drawn from Shabbos —
 as explained within.
 And also — on the holy Shabbos —
 through the subduing of the animal soul —
 the lusting soul —
 and the good within it being encompassed
 within holiness —
 through this the union is then in great holiness —
 and one merits through this
 to children who live and endure —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:16]:
 "v'shamru Bnay Yisrael es haShabbas
 [and the children of Israel shall guard the Shabbos]"
 — which alludes to the Shabbos union —
 as brought.
 And this:
 "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosaym
 [to make the Shabbos throughout their generations]"
 — for this is propitious for children.

segments.he: וזה בחינת "אם תשוב משבת רגלך". רגל הוא בחינת ממון ועשירות כמבואר בפנים. א'ם ת'שוב מ'שבת ראשי תיבות אמ"ת. כי על ידי אור האמת שמאיר בשבת על ידי זה בא עשירות בבחינת 'קושטא קאי' כמבואר בפנים. גם עיקר השפע של ארץ ישראל בא משבת כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש (ויקרא דף יב) 'אימתי אתרביאת ארעא קדישא וכו' הוי אומר ביום השבת' וכו'. כי עיקר השפע דקדושה הוא רק משבת כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש בכמה מקומות, ובשביל זה נקראת גם כן ארץ החיים בחינות 'טועמיה חיים זכו'. וזה בחינת הלחם משנה של שבת שהוא בחינת שפע ארץ ישראל בחינת "לכן בארצם משנה יירשו". וזה בחינת "ודבר דבר" הנאמר בשבת, כי על ידי קדושת השבת נשלם הדיבור עד שהוא בבחינת 'אמרי שפר' שעל ידי זה נעשין על ידי דיבוריו שמים וארץ חדשים, ונעשה כביכול להקב"ה שותף לברוא שמים וארץ כמובא בפנים.
segments.en:
The essential grip of the external forces
 is on the legs —
 in the aspect of the heels —
 in the aspect of:
 "nachash karuch al akevo
 [the serpent coiled around his heel]"
 — because akev [heel]
 equals in gematria
 two times אֱלֹקִים [Elokim] —
 which are harsh judgments.
 And through drawing the root of the Gevuros
 from Binah —
 through this the external forces flee from there —
 and one receives the birthright and the blessing.
 And Binah is the aspect of wine that gladdens —
 as all of this is explained within.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "zachrehu al haYayin
 [remember it [Shabbos] over wine]"
 — stated regarding the holy Shabbos —
 "Zachur"
 equals in gematria רֶגֶל [regel] —
 as brought —
 for then an illumination is drawn
 from the World of Binah —
 which is the aspect of the Great Shabbos —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And through this the external forces flee —
 and have no grip on the heels and legs —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — as mentioned above many times.
 And this is the aspect of [Genesis 26:5]:
 "ekev asher shama Avraham b'koli
 [because [ekev] Avraham hearkened to My voice],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 and our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 [Tractate Yoma 28b]:
 that Avraham our Patriarch, peace be upon him,
 fulfilled even eiruv tavshilin —
 for the guarding of Shabbos in its perfection
 is the aspect of the rectification of the heels.
 And therefore Yaakov our Patriarch —
 who was in the aforementioned aspect —
 as brought within —
 therefore he is the first
 about whom it is explicitly stated
 that he guarded the Shabbos —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 And it has already been explained above
 in Siman 10 —
 in the name of the book Or Yisrael —
 regarding the dancing of Shabbos —
 for dancing is the aspect of drawing
 the joy in the heart —
 which is the aspect of the World of Binah —
 the aspect of the Great Shabbos —
 down to the legs —
 the aspect of:
 "libo nasa es raglov
 [his heart carried his legs]"
 — stated regarding Yaakov our Patriarch —
 which is the aspect of the sweetening of the harsh judgments.
 And through this the external forces flee from there —
 and one receives the birthright and the blessing —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 of which it is stated [Exodus 31:14]:
 "ki kodesh hi
 [for it is holy]"
 — the aspect of [Exodus 13:2]:
 "kadesh li chol bechor
 [sanctify for Me every firstborn]"
 — as is well-known —
 and it is stated regarding it:
 "vayevarech
 [and He blessed],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — and it is the source of blessing.
 And this enthusiasm of the dancing
 is the aspect of:
 "shalheves Yah
 [a flame of G-d]"
 — stated regarding the holiness of Shabbos
 as explained in the kavannos —
 and it is the aspect of the holy fire —
 the fire of the holy Shabbos.

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל 'כל האומר ויכולו בערב שבת כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה וכו' אל תקרי ויכולו אלא ויכלו', כי עיקר תכלית הבריאה של שמים וארץ היה רק בשביל כבודו יתברך בגין דישתמודעין ליה (זהר בא מב:). אך מחמת שהשגחתו יתברך מלובשת בהנהגת הטבע, על כן יש שכופרין לגמרי ח"ו בהשגחתו יתברך עד שיש שכופרין ח"ו גם בחידוש העולם. אך על ידי קדושת שבת שעל ידי זה נעשין פלאות בחינת ביטול הטבע, על ידי זה נתגלה לכל בחינת חידוש העולם והשגחתו יתברך, שזה עיקר תכלית הבריאה בחינת "ויכלו השמים והארץ" וכו'.
segments.en:
Shabbos = day of souls / animality subdued / Bris Shalom: "Yoma d'nishmatin v'lo yoma d'gufa." Illumination of the holy soul on Shabbos subdues the corporeality and the lust for material things. All shames, hatreds, and disputes (= impure husks) nullified → "Bris Shalom" revealed = holiness of Shabbos. Peace above and below. Shabbos = "Melech she'hashalom shelo." Great abundance and plenty drawn from Shabbos. Shabbos union in great holiness (animal soul subdued; good within it encompassed in holiness) → children who live and endure. "V'shamru Bnay Yisrael es haShabbas" = allusion to the Shabbos union. "La'asos es haShabbas l'dorosaym" = propitious for children.
 

 Siman 40 — סימן מ'
 Eileh Mas'ay — "These are the journeys…"
 [Numbers 33:1]
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 40]

segments.he: כי שבת הוא בחינת תכלית מעשה שמים וארץ. ועל כן כשמעיד על זה בשבת בפה מלא ואומר "ויכלו" וכו' על ידי זה כאלו נעשה שותף וכו'.
segments.en:
All the journeys are for the sake of
 the damage to emunah [faith] —
 as explained within.

segments.he: והנה מבואר בפנים, שכשפוגמין ח"ו בכל הנ"ל, על ידי זה בא ח"ו להיות נצרך לבריות ופניו נשתנה ככרום לכמה גוונין מחמת בושה, וזה מחמת שפגם בתפארת שהוא כלליות הגוונין. ועל כן אמרו רז"ל 'עשה שבתך חול ואל תצטרך לבריות', כי כבוד וענג שבת הוא בחינת תפארת כלליות הגוונין דקדושה, שזה בחינת השלש סעודות שהם כנגד הג' אבות שהם כלליות הגוונין. ונצרך לבריות בא ממידות הנפולין על ידי שפגם בתפארת כמבואר בפנים. גם יש לרמז כי בשבת בוודאי כל אחד מישראל זוכה לבחינה הנ"ל בבחינת 'אפילו עם הארץ ירא לשקר בשבת', רק שהעיקר שימשוך קדושת שבת גם על ששת ימי החול בבחינת 'זכרהו מאחד בשבת'. וזה בחינת עשה שבתך חול ואז בוודאי יזכה על ידי זה שלא יצטרך לבריות כנ"ל.
segments.en:
And Shabbos is the aspect of emunah —
 as explained in Siman 31.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Shabbos 118]:
 "afilu oved avodah zarah v'chol haggid —
 mochalin lo
 [even one who worshipped idolatry
 and so on —
 he is forgiven]."

 And therefore it is stated regarding [Shabbos]
 [Exodus 16:29]:
 "shvu ish tachtav —
 al yetzei ish mimekomo
 [sit — each person in his place —
 let no person go out of his place],"
 and so on. [וכו']

segments.he: וזה "אם תשיב משבת רגלך" כנ"ל, "עשות חפציך ביום קדשי", כי חפצים ועובדין דחול שהם ל"ט מלאכות הם כנגד ל"ט קללות שנמשך על ידי שפגמו באכילת עץ הדעת שמזה נמשך עניות בחינת (בראשית ג) "בעצבון תאכלנה".
segments.en:
שַׁבָּת
 — the letters
 שִׁין ב"ת
 — the aspect of the three Patriarchs
 together with the Shechinah —
 as is well-known —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And then the Shechinah —
 which is the aspect of the letters of prayer —
 is clothed in shining garments [levushin d'nehirin] —
 which are the aspect of the light of the Patriarchs —
 which are the aspect of the voice of pure and clear melody
 [kol niginah zachah u'vehirah] —
 as explained within.
 And this is what is brought in the writings:
 "ב'יום ק'דשי ו'קראת לשבת"
 — the initial letters spell:
 בְּקוֹל [b'kol — with voice],
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is what is brought regarding the holy Ari z"l —
 that on Shabbos he would raise his voice in prayer.
 And this is the aspect of
 the sweetening of the harsh judgments
 that are sweetened on Shabbos —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 for when the Shechinah is clothed
 in shining garments —
