And all agree: on Shabbos the Torah was given — for they are one aspect. For Shabbos is equivalent to the entire Torah — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And therefore — in truth — it is the aspect of life — the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu [those who taste it merited life]." And regarding one who abandons it, heaven forfend — it is stated [Exodus 31:14]: "mechaleleha mos yumas" — and he is like one who denies the entire Torah — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.

And therefore: Shabbos was given only for words of Torah — in the aspect of: G-d, blessed be He, said: do for yourselves six days and do for Me one day. For all the days of the week the majority of the world is occupied with worldly matters [divrei alma] — and work — and labor. And therefore they need to engage in words of Torah on Shabbos at least — when then all the labors are forbidden. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — for the holiness of Shabbos is the vitality of all the weekdays. Therefore one must at least remember throughout all the weekdays: that the essential sacred vitality is Shabbos. And through this one draws some sacred vitality from the illumination of the holiness of Shabbos upon all the weekdays as well. For during the weekdays — when one is occupied with labor and the affairs of worldly matters — and is far from the Torah — then one needs to receive vitality only from the free lovingkindness [chesed chinam] — the aspect of the treasury of free gift — mentioned above. Which is the aspect of the free lovingkindness that sustained the world before the giving of the Torah — through the concealed Torah — which is clothed within worldly matters. And this is the aspect of: the path to Eretz Yisrael — as mentioned above. And the essential illumination of this free lovingkindness — which is the root of the aspect of the ten utterances — the aspect of [Psalms 89:3]: "ki amarti olam chesed yibbaneh" — and as brought elsewhere — is on Shabbos. For then is the essential fullness of the entire creation — which was created through the ten utterances — in the aspect of [Genesis 2:2]: "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" — and so on. And as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And therefore — then — all the judgments are sweetened — and great lovingkindnesses are drawn — as explained in the holy Zohar. And all of this is because at that time the aspect of the treasury of free gift mentioned above shines. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught in truth: even if one worshipped idolatry and so on — he is forgiven. For everything is rectified through the aforementioned treasury of free gift.

And therefore on Shabbos — then — the time that is most propitious for attaining the secrets of Torah [sitrei Torah] — as brought. For then — the aspect of the free lovingkindness shines — which is the aspect of the concealed Torah — mentioned above. And therefore the holiness of Shabbos itself is called a gift [matanah] — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay — v'Shabbas shemah [a good gift I have in My treasury — and Shabbos is its name]." For it is in the aspect of the treasury of free gift — mentioned above. But since from this treasury — only the great Tzadik can receive — the one who is cleaving to the holy Torah with the utmost fullness — and then when he is compelled to set it aside somewhat — he is then a simple person. And since he is cleaving so greatly to the holy Torah — and it is impossible for him to separate from it at all even for a brief moment — therefore he merits to receive vitality in his time of simplicity from the aspect of the concealed Torah within worldly matters — which is the aspect of the ten utterances within which the Ten Commandments are clothed — as mentioned above. And through this he draws vitality to all the simple people — as mentioned above.

And therefore these simple people must engage even more in the study of Torah on Shabbos at least — in order to have some connection and closeness to the holy Torah. Since at the time when they are idle from labor and worldly matters — they increase their engagement in the Torah. From this it is revealed and seen: that the fact that they do not engage in Torah during the weekdays — is only because of their being occupied with the affairs of livelihood and the way of the world. And through this they merit — that also during the weekdays they receive vitality through the aforementioned Tzadik — from the aspect of the concealed Torah within the way of the world. And therefore — the Torah scholars and Tzadikim — who are toiling in Torah all the days of the week — therefore they are permitted to set aside somewhat on Shabbos from the study of Torah — and to draw somewhat upon the delight of eating and drinking for the honor of Shabbos — (and as also brought in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 290) — and through this they have some connection to the aspect of the aforementioned simple people — and they draw for them sacred vitality from the aspect of the concealed Torah within worldly matters and the bodily affairs. And as explained within: for this very reason the great Tzadik is compelled to descend and fall sometimes into simplicity — and to be a simple person for some time. For through this he revives all the simple people — and so on. And each person — according to his greater closeness to holiness and to the aforementioned Tzadik — receives a higher vitality from him — as mentioned above.

segments.he: גם על ידי קדושת שבת נתבטלין כל החרפות ובזיונות שיש לאדם משונאים בבחינת "כל היום כלימתי נגדי וכו' מקול מחרף ומגדף מפני אויב ומתנקם". כי שבת בסגולתו להשבית אויב ומתנקם כמבואר לקמן בסימן נ"ז בפנים. ועל ידי זה נתבטלין כל החרפות ובושות בבחינת "והשבית קצין חרפתו". וזה בחינת שב"ת אותיות בש"ת, כי על ידי קדושת שבת ניצולין מחרפות ובושות ונתבטל בחינת קול מחרף ומגדף הנ"ל. וזה בחינת השבעה קולות שאומרין בכניסת שבת במזמור לדוד והם כנגד חג"ת נה"ימ כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש ובכוונות.
segments.en:
And therefore a person must receive the face of his teacher on Shabbos — as explained in the holy Zohar. And it is a very great matter to come on Shabbos to a true Tzadik — as explained elsewhere. For through this one merits even more to receive the aspect of the illumination of the sacred vitality — that the Tzadik draws from the aspect of the concealed Torah and the treasury of free gift — that shines and is revealed even more through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos. For even though he is far from the Torah — nonetheless — through the holiness of Shabbos — awe is drawn upon him as well — from the aspect of the concealed Torah within the ten utterances. And every utterance has the aspect of awe — the aspect of [Psalms 119:38]: "hakem l'avdecha imrasecha — asher l'yir'asecha" — and as explained within. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "Bereishis bara" — and so on — for the sake of awe — which is called "reishis." It follows that the entire ten utterances — through which the creation came about — are only for the sake of awe.

And this is what is brought within: how one must strengthen oneself in the service of G-d — and never despair — and to know and believe: that he too receives some sacred vitality from the Torah through the aforementioned Tzadik — and so on. And even a simple person must likewise have the awe of Heaven — and so on — as mentioned above. For this is the aspect of the awe that shines on Shabbos even for the amei ha'aretz [unlearned people] and simple people — as mentioned above. And since this path is the path of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael — therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: if you guard the Shabbos — you shall enter Eretz Yisrael — as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of [Genesis 49:15]: "vayar menuchah ki tov" — "menuchah" — this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — which is a day of rest and holiness. And this [Genesis 49:15]: "v'es ha'aretz ki na'amah" — for through this one merits the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. And therefore Eretz Yisrael itself is likewise called "menuchah" — in the aspect of [Psalms 95:11]: "im yavo'un el menuchasi" — and it is written [Deuteronomy 12:9]: "el haMenuchah v'el hanachalah."

And this [Genesis 6:8]: "v'Noach matza chen" — Noach is the aspect of Shabbos — rest [nayyicha] — and so on — as brought in the holy Zohar. "matza chen" — for through Shabbos one draws the aspect of the treasury of free gift — regarding which it is stated [Exodus 33:19]: "v'chanosi es asher achon [and I shall grant grace to whom I grant grace]" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught [Midrash Rabbah Parashas Ki Sisa]. And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times. For the essential tikkun of repentance is through the aspect of the aforementioned free lovingkindness. And therefore one must increase charity to the poor on Shabbos — and the charity box is distributed on Erev Shabbos — in order to draw through this the free lovingkindness mentioned above — that shines on Shabbos.

And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — which is the aspect of "rav chesed" — as explained in the holy Zohar — that is, the aspect of the treasury of free gift — mentioned above — which flows from the aspect of "rav chesed" — the aspect of Atik. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — which revives all the lower levels — which are the aspect of the aforementioned simple people — who are far from the holy Torah. And during the weekday — Malchus is in the aspect of: "ragleha yordos maves [her legs go down to death]" — and the Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra draw sustenance from her — as it were. But on Shabbos — when the aforementioned free lovingkindness shines — through which all the simple people are revived through the concealed Torah — then Malchus ascends to very great heights — and the Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra are pushed away and fall. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — as mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the Torah — as is well-known. That is — through this one can return and draw everyone close to the holy Torah. And also in its plain sense — that is, one merits the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — which is the heritage of Yaakov — for through this path one conquers Eretz Yisrael. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits [nachalah b'li metzarim]. That is — through this one can sanctify all the places in the world with the holiness of Eretz Yisrael — as explained within. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for everything was created through the ten utterances — within which the Ten Commandments are concealed. And the essential fullness of the ten utterances is through Shabbos — as mentioned above. And likewise — the Ten Commandments — which are the totality of the holy Torah — were given on Shabbos — as mentioned above. And one must yet explain further.

 Siman 79 — סימן עט (Part Two)
 haKol Kol Yaakov — Shabbos = repentance = "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha" — "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" — Likutay Moharan Siman 6 — Siman 58 of LM = teshuvah from love — love = unification of time — Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = above time — "u'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim" — through this: merits to hear the sacred voice — juxtaposed after "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" — "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" — the voices in "Mizmor l'David havu" said at entry of Shabbos

Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — in the aspect of [Deuteronomy 30:2]: "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha [and you shall return unto Hashem your G-d]." And "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 6. And in Siman 58 [of Likutay Moharan] — it is explained that it is the aspect of repentance from love [teshuvah mei'ahavah]. And love [ahavah] is the aspect of the unification of time [ichud haZman] — as explained within. For Shabbos is the foretaste of the World to Come [me'ein Olam haBa] — which is above time. And this is the aspect of [Prayer]: "u'verachto mikol hayamim — v'kidashto mikol hazmanim [and You blessed it above all days — and sanctified it above all times]." And through this — one merits to hear the sacred voice. And this is what is juxtaposed after the verse [Exodus 15:25]: "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" — (which our Sages of blessed memory taught: from this — that Shabbos was commanded at Marah) — [Exodus 15:26]: "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" — and so on. And this is the aspect of the voices in [Psalms 29]: "Mizmor l'David — havu" — and so on — which are said at the entry of Shabbos.

 ✦ Translator's Summary — Part Two, Simanim 77, 78, 79
 
 Siman 77 — Retzu'ah Hayesah Yotzeis — Shabbos = tefillin = mochin / awe of Shabbos = the strap / eating in holiness on Shabbos sweetens the awe / from the mouth: kumat Adam / Shechinah speaks from his throat / Zohar Pinchas 228a / Zohar Vayikra 16a / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = tefillin = mochin (well-known; many times). On Shabbos: merits awe = "yirey Shabbas." Shabbos = Malchus = source of awe = morah shel Malchus. Drawn upon a person: "mipnei she'eymas Shabbas alav" (Sages). Even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos. Therefore those who guard Shabbos called "yirey shmi" = "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi" (Malachi 3:20; Sages; many times). Aforementioned awe = aspect of the strap (retzu'ah) that passes through the maavarta of the tefillin = the awe that passes through the mochin and the tefillin = "reishis chochmah yiras Hashem" (Psalms 111:10; within). Even during the weekday: through eating in holiness and in awe of Heaven → sweetens the aforementioned awe = aspect of the strap → so that no sorrow should flow from it (within). On holy Shabbos: eating is certainly in holiness by every person = eating of Shabbos is entirely holy → through the eating: awe comes upon the person = "l'eis ha'ochel gashi halum" (Ruth 2:14; within) → through this: merits to be saved from all sorrow (eating of Shabbos = sweetening of the judgments [hamtakas haDinim]; as brought) → moreover: merits that from the mouth the stature of a person [kumat Adam] is made = the mouth [peh] is rectified = "v'daber davar" (Isaiah 58:13; stated regarding Shabbos); the mouth is completed in great light during the eating of Shabbos (within; Likutay Moharan Siman 57 cross-ref.) → merits even greater ascent = aspect of "Shechinah medaberes mitoch gerono" = Ru'ach haKodesh drawn upon each and every person according to his level on holy Shabbos (Zohar). (Very refined and very spiritual matters impossible to explain.) Isaiah 58: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha / v'karas l'Shabbas oneg (= aspect of Shabbos meals) / az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = root of supreme and most wondrous mochin + root of sweetening of all judgments + "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" (Sages) = saved from all sorrow; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus (= the awe); saved from subjugation of kingdoms = aspect of fallen awe (yira'os nefalos) = morah shel Malchus; "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = Adam hayoshev al haKissay (well-known); Yaakov our Patriarch is the Chariot [merkavah] for the aforementioned Adam; his form is engraved upon the Throne (Zohar); "v'ha'achalticha davka" = merits this through holy eating of holiness of Shabbos → mouth made into kumat Adam → then ascends further until reaches Adam hayoshev al haKissay; nachalah b'li metzarim = the aforementioned Adam is in the aspect of nachalah b'li metzarim (writings). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = merits the aspect of "Shechinah medaberes mitoch gerono" = aspect of "ki pi Hashem diber." One must yet explain further — not its place here. Cross-references: Zohar Pinchas folio 228a (regarding Adam hayoshev al haKissay); Zohar Vayikra folio 16a (regarding Yaakov); Mikdash Melech there.
 Siman 78 — B'Inyan Hanhagos haPeshutos — Shabbos = totality of all the Torah / hidden Torah within the ten utterances / the simple person receives vitality from the hidden Torah through the Tzadik / treasury of free gift / on Shabbos this free gift shines most / even an am ha'aretz fears to lie on Shabbos / "Bereishis bara" for the sake of awe / coming to the Tzadik on Shabbos / "Vihi no'am" / charity on Erev Shabbos / "v'Noach matza chen" / Shabbos = teshuvah / Isaiah 58: Sages: "chad amar lo nitnesah Shabbas ela l'ta'anug / v'chad amar lo nitnesah Shabbas ela l'divrei Torah / v'lo pfligi": the one who said for delight = Torah scholars (Talmidei Chachamim) who toil in Torah all the days of the week → on Shabbos: come and take delight; the one who said for words of Torah = laborers (po'alim) who toil in their work all the days of the week → on Shabbos: come and engage in Torah. Also Sages: "sheshes yamim ta'avod" = a mortal king says to his servants: do for yourselves one day and do for me six days; but G-d, blessed be He, is not so → G-d, blessed be He, said to Israel: My children — do for yourselves six days and do for Me one day (Pesikta d'Aseres haDevuros). According to what is explained within: the matter is well understood. Essential life = the Torah. All who separate from the Torah = as if separate from life. But: impossible to be constantly cleaving to the Torah without interruption → even the master of Torah and the master of attainment → inevitably idle from Torah for some time for the sake of bodily needs → when idle from Torah: in the aspect of ish pashut [simple person]. And also: literally simple people (anashim peshutim) who are nonetheless fit and G-d-fearing → need to receive some vitality from the Torah (= essential life) → in truth they are far from the Torah. But know: vitality of all these simple people = from the aspect of the sustaining of the world before the giving of the Torah (matan Torah) = when the world was sustained only through His lovingkindness = aspect of "otzar matnas chinam" [treasury of free gift]. In truth: the Torah certainly existed then too (= Torah is eternal [nitzchiyis]). But then: the Torah was in concealment and hiddenness = all the Torah encompassed in the Ten Commandments was then concealed within the way of the world (derech eretz) and the settling of the world (yishuv ha'olam) = which was created through the ten utterances. The great Tzadik — when compelled to separate from the Torah for a brief moment (= in the aspect of ish pashut) → receives vitality from the aspect of this otzar matnas chinam. This is the path to Eretz Yisrael = essential conquest of Eretz Yisrael = through "ko'ach ma'asav higid l'amo" (Psalms 111:6) = aspect of ten utterances through which world was created → through this: revives all the aforementioned simple people. The closer a person is to holiness and to the Tzadik → the higher the vitality he receives from him. Holiness of Shabbos = Zohar: "kelala d'chol orayta Neviim u'Chsuvim." All agree: Torah was given on Shabbos = they are one aspect. "Shabbas equivalant to entire Torah" (Sages). Shabbos = aspect of life = "ta'ameha chayyim zachu." "Mechaleleha mos yumas" = like one who denies the entire Torah (Sages). Therefore: "lo nitnesah Shabbas ela l'divrei Torah" = G-d said: do for yourselves six days and do for Me one day = all the days of the week: majority of the world is occupied with worldly matters and work → need to engage in Torah on Shabbos at least (when all labors are forbidden). Therefore: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" = holiness of Shabbos = the vitality of all the weekdays → must remember throughout all the weekdays: that the essential sacred vitality is Shabbos → through this: draws some sacred vitality from the illumination of holiness of Shabbos upon all the weekdays. During weekdays: occupied with labor and worldly matters and far from Torah → receives vitality only from chesed chinam = otzar matnas chinam (above) = free lovingkindness that sustained the world before matan Torah through the concealed Torah clothed within worldly matters = path to Eretz Yisrael. Essential illumination of this chesed chinam = root of aspect of ten utterances = "ki amarti olam chesed yibbaneh" (Psalms 89:3; elsewhere) = on Shabbos = then: essential fullness of entire creation created through ten utterances = "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" (Sages) → then: all judgments sweetened + great lovingkindnesses drawn (Zohar) = aspect of otzar matnas chinam shines. Therefore: "afilu aved avodah zarah mochalin lo" (Sages) = everything rectified through otzar matnas chinam. Therefore on Shabbos: most propitious time for attaining sitrei Torah (as brought) = chesed chinam shines = concealed Torah shines. Holiness of Shabbos called a "matanah" = "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay v'Shabbas shemah" (Sages) = aspect of otzar matnas chinam. From this treasury: only the great Tzadik can receive = the one cleaving to the holy Torah with utmost fullness → when compelled to set it aside somewhat: then ish pashut → since cleaving so greatly to Torah and impossible for him to separate from it even for a brief moment → merits to receive vitality in his time of simplicity from aspect of concealed Torah within worldly matters = aspect of ten utterances within which Ten Commandments are clothed (above) → through this: draws vitality to all the simple people. Therefore: these simple people must engage even more in Torah on Shabbos at least → in order to have some connection and closeness to the holy Torah; since at the time when they are idle from labor and worldly matters they increase engagement in Torah → from this it is revealed: that the fact that they do not engage in Torah during the weekdays is only because of their being occupied with livelihood and derech eretz → through this: merit that also during weekdays they receive vitality through the aforementioned Tzadik from the aspect of concealed Torah within derech eretz. Therefore: Torah scholars and Tzadikim who toil in Torah all the days of the week → permitted to set aside somewhat on Shabbos from Torah study + to draw somewhat upon delight of eating and drinking for honor of Shabbos (SA OC Siman 290) → through this: have some connection to the aspect of the aforementioned simple people → draw for them sacred vitality from the aspect of concealed Torah within worldly matters and bodily affairs (within): for this very reason: the great Tzadik is compelled to descend and fall sometimes into simplicity and to be ish pashut for some time → through this: revives all the simple people; each person according to greater closeness to holiness and to the Tzadik: receives higher vitality from him (above). Therefore: commandment to receive face of one's teacher on Shabbos (Zohar). Very great matter to come on Shabbos to a true Tzadik (elsewhere) = through this: merits even more to receive aspect of illumination of sacred vitality that the Tzadik draws from aspect of concealed Torah and otzar matnas chinam that shines and is revealed even more through holiness of Shabbos. Therefore: "afilu am ha'aretz yirey lishaker b'Shabbas" (Sages) = even though far from Torah → through holiness of Shabbos: awe is drawn upon him too from aspect of concealed Torah within the ten utterances; every utterance has the aspect of awe = "hakem l'avdecha imrasecha asher l'yir'asecha" (Psalms 119:38; within). Therefore: Sages expounded "Bereishis bara" = for the sake of awe = which is called "reishis" = entire ten utterances (through which the creation came about) = only for the sake of awe. Also (within): must strengthen oneself in service of G-d + never despair + know and believe that he too receives sacred vitality from Torah through the aforementioned Tzadik; even simple person must have awe of Heaven = awe that shines on Shabbos even for amei ha'aretz and simple people. Since this path = path of conquest of Eretz Yisrael → "im mishmartem es haShabbas nichansu l'Eretz Yisrael" (Sages). "Vayar menuchah ki tov" (Genesis 49:15) = "menuchah" = holiness of Shabbos = day of rest and holiness; "v'es ha'aretz ki na'amah" = through this: merits inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. Therefore Eretz Yisrael itself also called "menuchah" = "im yavo'un el menuchasi" (Psalms 95:11) + "el haMenuchah v'el hanachalah" (Deuteronomy 12:9). "V'Noach matza chen" (Genesis 6:8) = Noach = Shabbos = nayyicha (Zohar). "Matza chen" = through Shabbos: draws otzar matnas chinam = "v'chanosi es asher achon" (Exodus 33:19; Sages; Midrash Rabbah Ki Sisa). Therefore Shabbos = teshuvah (many times) = essential tikkun of teshuvah through aspect of chesed chinam. Must increase charity to poor on Shabbos. Charity box distributed on Erev Shabbos = to draw chesed chinam that shines on Shabbos. Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = "rav chesed" (Zohar) = otzar matnas chinam = flows from "rav chesed" = aspect of Atik; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus = revives all the lower levels = simple people far from holy Torah; during weekday: Malchus in aspect of "ragleha yordos maves" and Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra draw sustenance from her; on Shabbos: chesed chinam shines → all simple people revived through concealed Torah → Malchus ascends to very great heights → Malchuyyos d'Sitra Achra pushed away and fall → therefore: "nitstol mi'shibbud malchuyos"; "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = aspect of Torah (well-known) = through this: can return and draw everyone close to holy Torah; also plain sense = inheritance of Eretz Yisrael = heritage of Yaakov = through this path: conquers Eretz Yisrael; nachalah b'li metzarim = through this: can sanctify all the places in the world with holiness of Eretz Yisrael (within). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = everything created through ten utterances within which Ten Commandments are concealed = essential fullness of ten utterances through Shabbos = Ten Commandments (= totality of holy Torah) were given on Shabbos. One must yet explain further.
 Siman 79 — haKol Kol Yaakov — Shabbos = teshuvah = "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha" / "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" / LM Siman 6 / Siman 58 of LM = teshuvah from love / love = unification of time / Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = above time / "u'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim" / through this: merits to hear the sacred voice / juxtaposed after "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" / "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" / the voices in "Mizmor l'David havu" said at entry of Shabbos: Shabbos = aspect of teshuvah = "v'shavta ad Hashem Elokecha" (Deuteronomy 30:2). "Shabbas" has same letters as "boshes" = Likutay Moharan Siman 6. And in Siman 58 of LM: it is the aspect of teshuvah mei'ahavah [repentance from love]. Ahavah = aspect of ichud haZman [unification of time] (within). For Shabbos = me'ein Olam haBa = which is above time. "U'verachto mikol hayamim v'kidashto mikol hazmanim" (Prayer). Through this: merits to hear the sacred voice. Therefore: juxtaposed after "sham sam lo chok u'mishpat" (Exodus 15:25; Sages: from this — that Shabbos was commanded at Marah): "v'im shamo'a tishma l'kol Hashem Elokecha" (Exodus 15:26). Aspect of the voices in "Mizmor l'David havu" (Psalms 29) said at entry of Shabbos.

Yikara DiShabsa — Part Two Simanim 81, 82, 83, 87, 88, 91

 Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא

segments.he: וזה "קול ה' על המים", כנגד בחינת חסד ששרשו בחכמה כידוע, ששם שורש האמונה הקדושה כמו שכתוב "ה' בחכמה יסד ארץ", בחינת 'אבא יסד ברתא' כידוע. ועל כן נקרא חכמה אב האמונה כמבואר בהקדמת התיקונים, ועל ידי זה נתבטלין כל האמונות כוזביות, וזה בחינת "להגיד בבוקר חסדך ואמונתך" וכו'. קול ה' בכח כנגד גבורה ששרשה בבינה לִבָּא, היינו בחינת חיזוק הלב דקדושה (ששם עיקר הכח והגבורה כמבואר במקום אחר), שעל ידי זה נתבטל הפילוסופיא והאפיקורסות כנ"ל, "קול ה' בהדר" כנגד בחינת תפארת, בחינת "פאר וכבוד" בבחינת (תהלים ח) "וכבוד והדר תעטרהו", היפך בחינת החרפות ובזיונות הנ"ל ותנא והדר מפרש. כי מחמת שעיקר אחיזת הסטרא אחרא ויניקתה הוא מבחינת רגלין כידוע, על כן בכאן מבאר ביותר בחינת הכנעת הקולות דסטרא אחרא על ידי הקול דקדושה.
segments.en:
נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

✦ חלק ב · PART TWO ✦

 Siman 81 — סימן פא (Part Two)
 Keshe'Adam Mesamei'ach Atzmo — Dancing on Shabbos — the case of the book and the tefillin — the supporters of the Torah = the thighs of truth — the legs ascend through Shabbos — speech / money / wife / faith — everything called "leg" is elevated through Shabbos

It is already explained above many times — in the name of the book Or Yisrael — that there is a basis for dancing [rikudim] for joy on the holy Shabbos. For this is in accordance with: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — for then the legs [raglaim] ascend to holiness — which is the aspect of dancing. And it is explained within — in this teaching — that through dancing with the joy of Torah and commandments [simchas Torah u'mitzvah] — through this all the supporters of the Torah [tomchei orayta] are elevated — who are called: "samchei Kishut" — and so on. And perhaps this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Shabbos 116]: one saves the case of the sacred text [tik haSefer] together with the book [Sefer]. And it is brought in Megillas Amukos, Ofan 60: the case of the book [tik haSefer] is the initial letters of: "terin yarchei Kishut [the two thighs of truth]." That is — through the joy of Torah and commandments — which are called "Sefer" — in particular the holiness of Shabbos — which is equivalent to the entire Torah and commandments — as our Sages of blessed memory taught — and is likewise called "Sefer" — for it is the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He — and Shabbos is the Name of G-d — as mentioned above many times. And this likewise: the case of the tefillin together with the tefillin — for the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of tefillin — as mentioned above many times. And through the holiness of Shabbos — the legs of holiness are also elevated — which are the aspect of: "yarchei Kishut" — that is, the supporters of the Torah [tomchei orayta]. And this: "even though there are coins within it" — that is, even though they are occupied with labor and the business of money and coins [ma'os] all the days of the week — nonetheless — they too have an elevation through the holiness of Shabbos. And also — through the holiness of Shabbos — the speech [dibbur] is rectified and elevated — which is called "regel" — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos. And also — money [mamon] is elevated — which is called "regel" — for this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir" — and so on — "zeh Shabbas" — and those who are wealthy in other lands — because they honor the Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is the aspect of the holiness of the sacred union of Shabbos — for the wife [ishah] is likewise called "regel" — as explained within. And through the holiness of Shabbos — she too is elevated. And through this one merits worthy children — who are likewise called "regel" — in the aspect of [Aramaic]: "bera kara d'avuha [the son is the foot of the father]." And also — the sacred faith is rectified — which is likewise the aspect of "regel." And likewise — all the things that are called "regel" are elevated through the holiness of Shabbos — as understood according to what is explained within.

 Siman 82 — סימן פב (Part Two)
 Ki Seitzei — Shabbos = Malchus = speech [Chavah = disorder] — Shabbos = world of thought = Chochmah [Adam = order] — the essential perfection = Chavah/Malchus joined to G-d — zachor/shamor — the Sitra Achra's grip on Malchus during the weekday — on Shabbos: Malchus ascends to its root — no "disorder" — Shabbos = teshuvah — Shem Samech-Gimmel — Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph — Psalm 92 — Isaiah 58

It is already explained above many times: Shabbos is the aspect of Malchus — and it is the aspect of speech [dibbur] — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos — as brought in Zohar Bereishis, folio 32. And speech is the aspect of Chavah [Eve] — the aspect of disorder [shelo k'seder] — the aspect of: "Tashra"k" [the reversed alphabet]. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the world of thought [olam hamachshavah]. And thought is the aspect of: "chashuv mah" — the aspect of wisdom [Chochmah] — "koach mah" — and the gematria of "mah" is Adam. And this is the aspect of order [k'seder] — as explained within.

And the essential perfection is that the aspect of Chavah — the aspect of Malchus — should be joined to the aspect of mah — that is, to the Holy One, blessed be He. And then she has completeness. And this is the aspect of: "zachor" and "shamor" of Shabbos. And likewise: "Shabbas d'leila" and "Shabbas d'yoma" — which are the aspects of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah — as explained in the Tikunim. And therefore the essential perfection of the entire creation is through Shabbos. For the totality of the creation is the aspect of disorder — the aspect of "Tashra"k" — which is the secret of: "b'Tishrei nivra ha'olam [in Tishri the world was created]." And likewise — the fact that the letters came in the order of "Tashra"k" to create the world — as explained in the holy Zohar and in the Tikunim — and also see in Likutay Halachos. And during the weekday — the Sitra Achra has, as it were, some grip on the aspect of Malchus in the mode of disorder — for then are the days of deed and labor — and a person can, heaven forfend, separate the aspect of Malchus from the Holy One, blessed be He, and take it for himself. For this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 8:17]: "kochi v'otzem yadi asah li" — and so on. But on Shabbos — Malchus ascends to its root. And then is the essential perfection of the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah. And then the aspect of the conduct of disorder is nullified relative to the aspect of order. And then — for the person — everything goes in an orderly manner [k'seder]. And this is the aspect of Shabbos — the aspect of: "meishiv milchamos" [quieting the wars] — and so on. For disorder is the aspect of war — as explained within. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 14:3]: "b'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha u'meirogzecha" — and so on — and all the judgments are subdued and do not awaken at all.

And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: they give him all the desires of his heart — for everything goes for the person as he wishes — in an orderly and complete manner. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: it is forbidden to ask for one's needs on the holy Shabbos — so that he should not be reminded of his sorrow. That is — so that at that time he should not be reminded at all of any aspect of disorder. And this is what one prays: "u'virtzoncha hani'ach lanu — shelo sehey tzarah v'yagon" — and so on — "b'yom menuchaseinu."

And this is the aspect of [Psalms 92]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on — [Psalms 92:3]: "lehagid baboker chasdecha" — that is, when things go in an orderly manner — in the aspect of lovingkindnesses [chasadim]. And [Psalms 92:3]: "v'emunascha baleilos" — that is, even in the aspect of the conduct of disorder — which is the aspect of Chavah — the aspect of night. As it is written [Psalms 19:3]: "v'lailah l'lailah yechaveh" — and in its plain sense too: the conduct of disorder is the aspect of the darkness of night. And nonetheless — through the holiness of Shabbos — one merits to strengthen oneself in faith — and to believe: that certainly everything is for the good — which is the aspect of order. And this [Psalms 92:5]: "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" — and so on — for the entire creation is from the aspect of disorder. But when Shabbos comes — and it is encompassed in the aspect of order — then the aspect of joy is drawn — and one rejoices over the fact that everything was created. And this [Psalms 92:6]: "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" — the aspect of deed [asiyah] — which is the aspect of Malchus — disorder. [Psalms 92:6]: "me'od amku machshevosecha" — thought is the aspect of wisdom — the aspect of order. And afterward he explains: that even the conduct of the aspect of a righteous person who suffers — a wicked person who prospers [tzaddik v'ra lo — rasha v'tov lo] — which certainly appears to be the aspect of disorder — but in truth this too is correct and upright. For the success of the wicked is only for a brief time — and for their destruction forever. But [Psalms 92:13]: "Tzadik katamar yifrach" — and so on. And this [Psalms 92:16]: "lehagid ki yashar Hashem" — the aspect of order.

And also — Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times. For the essential path of repentance — (explained within — which flows from the aspect of the Name Samech-Gimmel [63] and the Name Kuf-Samech-Aleph [161]) — shines on the holy Shabbos. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — and as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 6. For through the holiness of Shabbos — the light of the divine vitality is revealed and shines — that exists even within the least of Israel. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]: "Vayakhel Moshe es kol Yisrael."

For Moshe was unifying and connecting himself with all of Israel — even with the least of them — which is the aspect of: "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" — as explained within.

And therefore he commanded them then regarding Shabbos. And this is the aspect of the illumination of the sacred Name Samech-Gimmel — which is in the world of Beriah — the aspect of Binah — the aspect of Shabbos. And also — then the Name Kuf-Samech-Aleph shines — which is the aspect of [Psalms 139:8]: "im esak shamayim sham Atah [if I ascend to heaven — there You are]."

segments.he: וזה "קול ה' שובר ארזים", היינו בחינת ביטול הקול כסיל ברוב דברים ואמונות כוזביות שהם בחינת ארז כמבואר בפנים. "קול ה' חוצב להבות אש" היינו חיזוק הלב דקדושה, שיוכל להכיל את דברי החכמה בתוכו והשכל הוא כאש עצור בלבו כמבואר בפנים. "קול ה' יחיל מדבר" וכו' 'מדבר' הוא בחינת שפלות בחינת "וממדבר מתנה" כמו שדרשו רז"ל (עירובין נד), היינו בחינת "ואנכי תולעת ולא איש חרפת אדם" וכו' שזה בחינת "מדבר לא אדם בו" (איוב לח), שזה בחינת ביטול קול מחרף ומגדף, בחינת "טוב שבת בארץ מדבר מאשת מדינים וכעס" (משלי כא). וזה גם כן "קול ה' יחולל אילות" כנגד בחינת מלכות בחינת תפלה. וזה שמבואר בכוונות לכוון בקול זה השם שק"ו צי"ת שהוא בחינת התפלה המקובלת בחינת שועתינו קבל ושמע צעקתינו וכו', ושם זה גימטריא תולעת כמבואר בכוונות פרשת התמיד וכנ"ל בסימן כ"ח, היינו בחינת "אנכי תולעת ולא איש" וכו'. וזה שסיים "ובהיכלו כולו אומר כבוד", שזה בחינת שלימות ביטול הקול מחרף הנ"ל, על ידי שבשעת תפלה הוא עומד בהיכל המלך ושם נתהפכין כל הבזיונות לצירופי כבוד כמבואר בפנים. ומחמת שעל ידי זה נתגלה קדושת ארץ ישראל שהיא בחינת "גם זאת", בחינת שיעור חלה כמבואר בפנים, על כן מבואר בשלחן ערוך אורח חיים סימן רמ"ב שנוהגין ללוש שיעור חלה לבצוע ממנה לכבוד שבת וכו'.
segments.en:
For then is the essential ascent of the worlds — upward and upward — which is the aspect of: "im esak shamayim" — and so on.

And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — where is the root of the supreme mental faculties — the aspect of thought and wisdom — the root of the aspect of order. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: they give him all the desires of his heart — that is, everything goes for him in an orderly manner — as mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — that is, the ascent of Malchus — which is the aspect of disorder — to be encompassed within the aspect of order. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — that is, so that the Malchus d'Sitra Achra should have no sustenance and grip on the sacred Malchus — which is the aspect of disorder. (And therefore the destruction and the exile are called by the name: "tzalmavet v'lo sederim [death-shadow and no order]" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Sotah 49] — for their sustenance is from the aspect of disorder — as mentioned above.) And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the Name Mah — the aforementioned Adam. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one merits an inheritance without limits — for all the limitations — which are from the aspect of disorder — are nullified relative to the aspect of order — as mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for the speech [dibbur] — which is the aspect of Malchus — the mouth — the aspect of disorder — is unified with the Name Havayah — which is the aspect of order. And this likewise the aspect of: "im tashiv miShabbas" — the aspect of the repentance of Shabbos — as mentioned above. [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — that is, one merits to ascend to great sacred ascents — which is the aspect of: "im esak shamayim" — the aspect of the Name Kuf-Samech-Aleph — which is the Name Ehyeh spelled out with Yudim. And the Name Ehyeh shines on Shabbos — as explained in Bris Menuchah, the path of Dales. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus to the mental faculties — which is the aspect of the Name Samech-Gimmel — the aspect of: "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" — that is, the divine vitality that is found even in the least of Israel. Through which one can also unify and connect with him — and draw him close to holiness — and bring him back in repentance. For this is the aspect of the chirik of Samech-Gimmel — the aspect of: "u'v'chirik l'anchata lah l'tata — l'amlecha lah al tata'in — l'kayem u'malchusei b'chol mashlah [and through the chirik to lower it below — to make it reign over those below — to fulfill: and His kingship rules over all]" — as explained within. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the middle bolt [bri'ach hatichon] that passes from one end to the other — for it joins both the aforementioned aspects together — and encompasses them as one. For these two aspects — the aspect of "esak" and "Samech-Gimmel" — mentioned above — are themselves likewise the aspects of order and disorder — mentioned above. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 139:5]: "achor va'kedem tzartani [You formed me from behind and before]." For those who ascend to great heights — they are the aspect of "kedem" — the aspect of face [panim] — the aspect of order. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded in truth: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — they give him all the desires of his heart — which is the aspect of order. And toward the least of Israel — whom one must revive and draw close — through the aspect of the chirik of Samech-Gimmel — the aspect of: "u'malchusei b'chol mashlah" — mentioned above — they are in the aspect of "achor" — the aspect of disorder. For they have turned backward from their holiness — and the Sitra Achra has a very strong grip on them. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "v'hirkavticha" — and so on — one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — as mentioned above. And "nachalas Yaakov" — which joins both the aforementioned aspects together. That is — he unifies and connects the aspect of disorder with the aspect of order — the aspect of [Psalms 139:5]: "achor va'kedem tzartani — v'tashet alai kapecha" — do not read "kapecha" [Your hand] but rather "kafecha" [Your palm] — for Yud equals the gematria of "kaf" — as explained within. That is — the aspect of disorder — the aspect of "achor" — is encompassed within the aspect of "kedem" — the aspect of order. And then from this is made the aspect of "kaf" — that is, from this is made the aspect of a vessel [kli] and a constriction — to receive the light of the aspect of order — the aspect of "kedem" — so that the abundance of light should not damage him, heaven forfend. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 33:22–23]: "v'sachosi chapi alecha" — and so on — "v'ra'ita es achorai" — and so on — and as understood within. And also see what is explained above — on the teaching "Kra es Yehoshua" — in Siman 6 of Likutay Moharan.

 Siman 83 — סימן פג (Part Two)
 Al Yedei Tikkun haBris — Shabbos = tikkun of the covenant = bris olam — prayer is rectified — the first sprouting of the horn of Mashiach — the hidden of Shabbos = Eliyahu / Mashiach ben David — Mashiach is encompassed in the Patriarchs — the speech of prayer = fire + water + wind = Shabbos: Shin-Beis — the man of freedom — tachlis haDe'ah — al yetzei ish mimekomo — garments of Shabbos — exaltation of one's mazal — the yetzer tov is strengthened — sadness nullified — mockery nullified — sacred love and awe — darkness covering the eyes is removed — redemption awakened — leaven and chametz of the heart nullified — emunas Chachamim — flames of love — boshes — the Shechinah covers with her wings — forgiveness of all sins

Shabbos is the aspect of the rectification of the covenant [tikkun habris] — the aspect of: "bris olam" — and so on — as mentioned above many times. And through this — prayer is rectified. For this is the aspect of: "tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on. And then — the first sprouting of the horn of Mashiach [tzemichas keren Mashiach] — in the aspect of: "ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu [had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would have been redeemed immediately]." And the hidden [nig'lam] of Shabbos is numerically equal to Eliyahu — Mashiach ben David — as mentioned above in Siman 32. (See Midrash Rabbah Beshalach, Parashah 25.) And Mashiach in totality is encompassed in the Patriarchs [Avos] — that is, the speech [dibbur] with which one prays encompasses fire and water and wind — for this is the aspect of Shabbos: "Shin-Beis" — Shin represents the Patriarchs — Beis is the aspect of prayer. And as also explained within. And then one becomes a free man [ben chorin] — the aspect of the freedom of Shabbos — which is forbidden in labor — as explained within. And the holiness of Shabbos — this is the aspect of the ultimate of knowledge [tachlis haDe'ah]. For the aspect of: the ultimate of knowledge — is: that we do not know. And this ultimate is the essential place — that is, the aspect of: the place of the world [mekomo shel Olam]. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "al yetzei ish mimekomo b'yom hashevi'i" — as explained within. And then one sheds the garment of the leper [guf haMetzora] — and dresses in a holy body from the Garden of Eden — for this is the aspect of the Shabbos garments [bigdei Shabbas] — as explained within. And then one's mazal is elevated — and one merits wealth — and so on. And this is the aspect of [Proverbs 10:22]: "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir" — and so on — which our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding Shabbos. And then the good inclination [yetzer tov] is strengthened — as mentioned above many times in the name of the holy Zohar. And sadness is nullified — in the aspect of [Isaiah 14:3]: "b'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha [on the day Hashem gives you rest from your sorrow]." And mockery is also nullified — the aspect of: the laughter of the fool [sechok haKesil]. For then Da'as is magnified — and foolishness [kesilut] is subdued. And one merits the aspect of: "lev chacham limino [the heart of the wise man to his right]" — as explained in the Tikunim. And through this all the fallen loves and awe are nullified. And one merits sacred loves and awe — for this is the aspect of the love and awe that one merits on Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.

And also — through this — the darkness that covers the eyes is removed. And then the eyes see wonders — the aspect of [Psalms 119:18]: "gal einai v'abitah nifla'os miTorasecha" — for this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" — and then is the essential time for attaining Torah and innovating wonders. And through this — all the prayers and requests are elevated — and the redemption is awakened. And the leaven and chametz [se'or v'chametz] in a person's heart — which entice a person to have thoughts against the Torah scholars of the generation — and so on — are nullified. For Shabbos is the aspect of the nullification of the leaven and the chametz — the aspect of [Exodus 12:15]: "tashbisu se'or" — and then one merits to the faith in the Sages [emunas Chachamim] in fullness — as mentioned above many times. And then the heart can be set ablaze in the study of Torah — with the flames of love [shalhavim d'rachimusa] that are awakened on Shabbos — as explained in the Tikunim. And this is the aspect of [Song of Songs 8:6]: "reshafeha reshpei eish shalheves Yah — mayim rabbim lo yuchlu l'chabes es ha'ahavah" — and so on — which is stated regarding the matter of Shabbos — as explained in the writings. And then shame [boshes] is drawn upon each and every person of Israel — for "Shabbas" has the same letters as "boshes" — as brought. And shame is the aspect of the shedding of blood [shefichas damim]. And the Shechinah covers with her wings over the blood of Israel — through this love. And through this — all the sins are covered — in the aspect of [Proverbs 10:12]: "v'al kol pesha'im techaseh ahavah [and over all sins — love covers]." And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who guard the Shabbos — he is forgiven for all his sins.

 Siman 87 — סימן פז (Part Two)
 Da sheKavannos Elul — On Shabbos: the holy path of the kavannos of Elul shines even more — "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — tikkun habris — finding one's match — "v'karas l'Shabbas" — "retzei b'menuchaseinu"

On Shabbos — the holy path of the kavannos [sacred meditations] of Elul shines even more. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — stated regarding Shabbos. And as explained above regarding the teaching "Kra es Yehoshua" — in Siman 6 of Likutay Moharan. And regarding the teaching "Ki Seitzei" — in Siman 82 of this pamphlet [Likutay Tinyana]. And this path is the aspect of the rectification of the covenant [tikkun habris] — and is propitious for finding one's match [zivug] — and that she should have a will toward him — and so on — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos itself — the aspect of: "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha [the Congregation of Israel shall be your partner]." And regarding this one prays: "retzei na b'menuchaseinu" — and so on — and [Prayer]: "v'hanchileynu b'ahavah u'v'ratzon Shabbas Kodshecha [and grant us as an inheritance — with love and with will — Your holy Shabbos]." And therefore the essential time of the sacred union is on Shabbos.

 Siman 88 — סימן פח (Part Two)
 Shelo Le'echol Pri shelo Nisbashel — The time of lost objects is during the weekday — at the entry of Shabbos: many lost things are found and return to their resting place — the ascent of the sacred sparks — the shofar blowings on Erev Shabbos — announcing a lost object on Shabbos is permitted

The essential time of lost objects [aveidos] is during the weekday — for this is the aspect of: "keivan sheShabbas — vav — avdah nefesh [since Shabbos ended — woe — the soul is lost]." And when the holiness of Shabbos arrives — then many lost things are found — and they return and ascend to their resting place. For this is the aspect of the ascent of the sacred sparks [nitzotzos haKodesh] that ascend through the holiness of Shabbos. And this is the aspect of the shofar blowings that they would blow on Erev Shabbos — the aspect of [Isaiah 27:13]: "v'hayah b'yom hahu yitaka b'shofar gadol — u'va'u ha'ovdim" — and so on. And this is what is brought [Shulchan Aruch Orach Chayyim Siman 306]: it is permitted to announce a lost object on Shabbos.

 Siman 91 — סימן צא (Part Two)
 Vayedabber Elokim — Through Shabbos: complete repentance and atonement — the judgments are sweetened — the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah — Shabbos = teshuvah (many times) — "ilu shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos" — "Vayakhel Moshe" — gathering of students to the teacher — the Torah scholars increase in eating and the laborers in Torah — Isaiah 58

Through the holiness of Shabbos — one merits complete repentance and the atonement of sin.

And the judgments are sweetened and nullified entirely — and the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah is made. For the holy Shabbos is the aspect of repentance — as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: וזה "אם תשיב משבת רגלך", היינו שעל ידי קדושת שבת תזכה לשלימות התפלה שהוא בחינת רגל כמבואר בפנים, והתפלה תהיה בשלימות כל כך, עד שיתנוצץ על ידה אור זכות אבות שהם בחינת רגלי הכסא כמבואר בפנים. גם מרמז על עליית רגלי הקדושה מאחיזת הסטרא אחרא שזה בחינת תיקון השלש קולות הנ"ל. וזה "עשות חפציך ביום קדשי" שיזהר מעשיית חפציו שיש בהם אחיזת הכסילות, בחינת (במדבר יא) "שטו העם ולקטו"-בשטותא, שזה בחינת "כי אין חפץ בכסילים" בחינת "קול כסיל ברוב דברים לא יחפוץ כסיל בתבונה". ובשבת צריכין לעסוק רק בחפצי שמים שהם בחינת חכמה ושכל דקדושה וביטול כל מיני אמונות כוזביות שהן כסילות ממש. "וקראת לשבת ענג" זה בחינת חיזוק הלב שיוכל להכיל החכמה והשכל דקדושה בתוכו שזה עיקר הענג כנ"ל כמה פעמים. כי עיקר הענג הוא בלב כמבואר במקום אחר, והפילוסופים וכו' הנ"ל הם רחוקים לגמרי מענג דקדושה, וכל ימיהם מלאים כעס ומכאובות כמבואר במקום אחר. וזה (משלי יט) "לא נאוה לכסיל תענוג" מכל שכן אלו שעליהם נאמר (משלי כו) "ראית איש חכם בעיניו תקוה לכסיל ממנו", כי הם גרועים יותר מן הכסילים. וזה "נואף אשה חסר לב" דקאי על אלו הנ"ל כמבואר בפנים. וזה "נגע וקלון ימצא", כי ענג וכבוד נתהפך אצלם לנגע וקלון. וזה "ולקדוש ה' מכובד" בחינת ביטול החרפות ובזיונות שהם היפוך הכבוד.
segments.en:
And our Sages of blessed memory taught: one who guards the Shabbos — he is forgiven all his sins.

And it is explained in the holy Zohar: for then the judgments are subdued — and do not awaken at all.

And then is the essential fullness of the union of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:4]: "u'vacharti ba'asher chafatzti — da zivuga d'Matronita [and I have chosen what I desire — this is the union of the Matronita]." For Shabbos is the aspect of the supernal wisdom [chochmah ila'ah] and the lower wisdom [chochmah tata'ah] — which is the secret of the two Shabbosim — as mentioned above many times. And therefore then is the essential time of the gathering of students to the teacher.

For this is the aspect of: "Vayakhel Moshe" — and our Sages of blessed memory taught: they need to make congregations on every Shabbos and expound words of Torah to them. And the wisdom of the teacher is the aspect of the supernal wisdom. And what the students receive from him is the aspect of the lower wisdom. And during the weekday — then it is in the aspect of [Proverbs 5:5]: "ragleha yordos maves" — and then the Sitra Achra has sustenance from the aspect of the lower wisdom — as it were. But on Shabbos — then the legs ascend — in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha." And then one can bind all the wisdoms of the world to the Almighty — and to the Torah — which is the aspect of the supernal wisdom. And through this — the intellect of the multitude [seichel haHamon] is also bound — from wherever they are — to the Almighty and to the holy Torah. And through this they come to complete repentance. And this is the aspect of what the Torah scholars are permitted to draw somewhat more upon the delights of the body also for the honor of Shabbos — and to diminish somewhat in their studies. And the laborers — and so on — need to increase on Shabbos in the engagement with the Torah. For through the fact that the Torah scholars and the Tzadikim increase somewhat in the delight of Shabbos — in bodily pleasures. And in truth — even their bodily pleasures have wondrous wisdom and great holiness clothed within them. And through this — the intellect of the multitude is bound to the holy Torah. And therefore they engage in Torah much on the holy Shabbos at least. And this is already explained above regarding this matter — many times.

 ✦ Translator's Summary — Part Two, Simanim 81, 82, 83, 87, 88, 91
 
 Siman 81 — Keshe'Adam Mesamei'ach Atzmo — Dancing on Shabbos / supporters of the Torah = thighs of truth / everything called "leg" is elevated through Shabbos: Explained above many times in name of book Or Yisrael: basis for dancing (rikudim) for joy on holy Shabbos = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = then the legs (raglaim) ascend to holiness = aspect of dancing. Within (in this teaching): through dancing with the joy of Torah and commandments (simchas Torah u'mitzvah) → all the "tomchei orayta" (supporters of the Torah) are elevated = called "samchei Kishut." Perhaps this is the aspect of: Sages (Tractate Shabbos 116): one saves "tik haSefer" (case of sacred text) together with the Sefer (book). Megillas Amukos Ofan 60: "tik haSefer" = roshei teivos = "terin yarchei Kishut" [the two thighs of truth] = through joy of Torah and commandments (called "Sefer") — in particular holiness of Shabbos (= equivalent to entire Torah and commandments; Sages; also called "Sefer" = it is the Name of G-d = "Shabbas shema d'KBH"; many times). Also: "the case of the tefillin together with the tefillin" = holiness of Shabbos = aspect of tefillin (many times). Through holiness of Shabbos: legs of holiness also elevated = "yarchei Kishut" = tomchei orayta. "Even though there are coins within it" = even though occupied with labor and business of money (ma'os) all the days of the week → they too have elevation through holiness of Shabbos. Through holiness of Shabbos: speech (dibbur) is rectified and elevated = called "regel" = "v'daber davar" (Isaiah 58:13; stated regarding Shabbos). Also: money (mamon) elevated = called "regel" = "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir / zeh Shabbas" (Sages) + wealthy in other lands because they honor Shabbos (Sages). Holiness of sacred union of Shabbos = wife (ishah) also called "regel" (within) → elevated through Shabbos → through this: merits worthy children = also called "regel" = "bera kara d'avuha" (Aramaic). Sacred faith also rectified = also aspect of "regel." All the things called "regel" are elevated through holiness of Shabbos (as understood according to within).
 Siman 82 — Ki Seitzei — Shabbos = Malchus = speech (Chavah = disorder) / Shabbos = world of thought = Chochmah (Adam = order) / essential perfection = Chavah/Malchus joined to G-d / the Sitra Achra's grip on Malchus during weekday / on Shabbos Malchus ascends / no disorder / Shabbos = teshuvah / Shem Samech-Gimmel / Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph / Psalm 92 / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = Malchus = aspect of speech (dibbur) = "v'daber davar" (stated regarding Shabbos; Zohar Bereishis folio 32). Speech = aspect of Chavah = aspect of disorder (shelo k'seder) = aspect of "Tashra"k" [reversed alphabet]. Also: Shabbos = world of thought (olam hamachshavah) = thought = aspect of "chashuv mah" = Chochmah = "koach mah" = gematria of "mah" = Adam = aspect of order (k'seder) (within). Essential perfection = Chavah/Malchus should be joined to the aspect of "mah" (= G-d, blessed be He) → then she has completeness. Aspect of "zachor" and "shamor" of Shabbos. Also: "Shabbas d'leila" and "Shabbas d'yoma" = aspects of G-d and His Shechinah (Tikunim). Therefore: essential perfection of entire creation is through Shabbos. Totality of the creation = aspect of disorder = aspect of "Tashra"k" = secret of "b'Tishrei nivra ha'olam." Letters came in order of "Tashra"k" to create the world (Zohar; Tikunim; also see Likutay Halachos). During weekday: Sitra Achra has, as it were, some grip on Malchus in mode of disorder = days of deed and labor → a person can separate the aspect of Malchus from G-d and take it for himself = "kochi v'otzem yadi asah li" (Deuteronomy 8:17). But on Shabbos: Malchus ascends to its root → essential perfection of the union of G-d and His Shechinah → aspect of disorder is nullified relative to aspect of order → for the person: everything goes in orderly manner. Shabbos = aspect of "meishev milchamos" = disorder is the aspect of war (within). "B'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha u'meirogzecha" (Isaiah 14:3) + all judgments subdued and do not awaken at all. Sages: "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" = everything goes for the person as he wishes = orderly and complete. Therefore: forbidden to ask for one's needs on holy Shabbos so that he should not be reminded of his sorrow = should not be reminded at all of any aspect of disorder. Prays: "u'virtzoncha hani'ach lanu shelo sehey tzarah v'yagon / b'yom menuchaseinu." Psalm 92: "lehagid baboker chasdecha" = when things go in orderly manner = aspect of chasadim; "v'emunascha baleilos" = even in conduct of disorder = aspect of Chavah = aspect of night = "v'lailah l'lailah yechaveh" (Psalms 19:3); plain sense: conduct of disorder = aspect of darkness of night; nonetheless: through holiness of Shabbos: strengthened in faith = believe that certainly everything is for the good = aspect of order; "ki simachtani Hashem b'fa'alecha" = entire creation from aspect of disorder; but when Shabbos comes and it is encompassed in aspect of order → then: joy is drawn = one rejoices over the fact that everything was created; "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" = aspect of asiyah (deed) = Malchus = disorder; "me'od amku machshevosecha" = thought = Chochmah = aspect of order; even "tzaddik v'ra lo rasha v'tov lo" = appears to be disorder but in truth is correct and upright = success of wicked only for a brief time = for their destruction; "Tzadik katamar yifrach"; "lehagid ki yashar Hashem" = aspect of order. Shabbos = teshuvah (many times). Essential path of teshuvah (within; flows from Shem Samech-Gimmel [63] and Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph [161]) shines on holy Shabbos = "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" (Isaiah 58:13; Likutay Moharan Siman 6 cross-ref.). Through holiness of Shabbos: light of divine vitality revealed = that exists even within the least of Israel = "Vayakhel Moshe es kol Yisrael." Moshe was unifying and connecting himself with all of Israel including the least of them = "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" (within). Therefore he commanded them then regarding Shabbos = aspect of illumination of sacred Shem Samech-Gimmel = which is in Beriah = aspect of Binah = aspect of Shabbos. Also: Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph shines = "im esak shamayim sham Atah" (Psalms 139:8) = then: essential ascent of the worlds upward and upward. Isaiah 58: "az tis'anag = da Atika Kadisha" = root of supreme mochin = thought and Chochmah = root of aspect of order + "nosnim lo kol mishalos libo" = everything goes for him in orderly manner; "hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus (= disorder) to be encompassed within aspect of order; saved from subjugation of kingdoms = so that Malchus d'Sitra Achra should have no sustenance and grip on sacred Malchus = (therefore destruction and exile called "tzalmavet v'lo sederim" [Tractate Sotah 49] = sustained from aspect of disorder); "nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = aspect of Shem Mah = Adam (above); nachalah b'li metzarim = all limitations (from aspect of disorder) nullified relative to aspect of order; "ki pi Hashem diber" = speech (Malchus = mouth = disorder) unified with the Name Havayah (= aspect of order) = also aspect of teshuvah of Shabbos. "Az tis'anag" = merits to ascend to great sacred ascents = "im esak shamayim" = Shem Kuf-Samech-Aleph = Shem Ehyeh spelled out with Yudim; Shem Ehyeh shines on Shabbos (Bris Menuchah, path of Dales). "Hirkavticha = da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" = ascent of Malchus to the mochin = Shem Samech-Gimmel = "kullo Samech-Gimmel yachdav" = divine vitality that exists even in the least of Israel → through which: can unify and connect with him + draw him close to holiness + bring him back in teshuvah = aspect of chirik of Samech-Gimmel = "u'v'chirik l'anchata lah l'tata l'amlecha lah al tata'in l'kayem u'malchusei b'chol mashlah" (within). "Nachalas Yaakov = da Ze'ir Anpin" = aspect of bri'ach hatichon = passes from one end to the other = joins both aforementioned aspects together. These two aspects (esak and Samech-Gimmel) = themselves also aspects of order and disorder = "achor va'kedem tzartani" (Psalms 139:5) = those who ascend to great heights = aspect of "kedem" = face = order. Sages: "az tis'anag" = nosnim lo kol mishalos libo = aspect of order. Toward the least of Israel = whom must revive and draw close = chirik of Samech-Gimmel = "u'malchusei b'chol mashlah" = aspect of "achor" = disorder = turned backward from their holiness = Sitra Achra has very strong grip = "hirkavticha / nitstol mi'shibbud malchuyos." "Nachalas Yaakov" = joins both aspects together = unifies and connects disorder with order = "achor va'kedem tzartani v'tashet alai kapecha" = don't read "kapecha" [Your hand] but "kafecha" [Your palm] = Yud = gematria of "kaf" (within) = disorder (= "achor") is encompassed within order (= "kedem") → makes the aspect of "kaf" = vessel and constriction → receives the light of order without the abundance of light damaging him = "v'sachosi chapi alecha / v'ra'ita es achorai" (Exodus 33:22–23; within). Also see: "Kra es Yehoshua" = LM Siman 6 cross-ref.
 Siman 83 — Al Yedei Tikkun haBris — Shabbos = tikkun habris = bris olam / prayer rectified / first sprouting of horn of Mashiach / hidden of Shabbos = Eliyahu / Mashiach ben David / Mashiach encompassed in Avos / speech of prayer = fire + water + wind = Shin-Beis / ben chorin / tachlis haDe'ah / al yetzei ish mimekomo / garments of Shabbos / mazal elevated / yetzer tov strengthened / sadness nullified / mockery nullified / sacred love and awe / darkness covering the eyes is removed / redemption awakened / leaven and chametz of the heart nullified / emunas Chachamim / flames of love / boshes / Shechinah covers with her wings / forgiveness of all sins: Shabbos = tikkun habris = "bris olam" (many times). Through this: prayer is rectified = "tov lehodos laHashem." Then: first sprouting of horn of Mashiach = "ilmalai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos miy'yad nig'alu." Hidden (nig'lam) of Shabbos = numerically equal to Eliyahu Mashiach ben David (Siman 32 cross-ref.; Midrash Rabbah Beshalach Parashah 25). Mashiach in totality is encompassed in the Avos = speech with which one prays encompasses fire + water + wind = aspect of Shabbos: "Shin-Beis" = Shin represents the Avos; Beis = aspect of prayer (also explained within). Then: becomes "ben chorin" = freedom of Shabbos = forbidden in labor (within). Holiness of Shabbos = aspect of "tachlis haDe'ah" = "tachlis haDe'ah asher lo neda" [the ultimate of knowledge is that we do not know]. This ultimate is the essential place = "mekomo shel Olam" = "al yetzei ish mimekomo b'yom hashevi'i" (Exodus 16:29; within). Then: sheds garment of the leper (guf haMetzora) + dresses in holy body from Garden of Eden = garments of Shabbos (bigdei Shabbas) (within). Then: mazal is elevated + merits wealth = "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir" (Proverbs 10:22; Sages: regarding Shabbos). Then: yetzer tov strengthened (many times in name of Zohar). Sadness nullified = "b'yom hani'ach Hashem l'cha mei'itz'vecha" (Isaiah 14:3). Mockery nullified = "sechok haKesil" = then Da'as is magnified + kesilut subdued + "lev chacham limino" (Tikunim). Through this: all fallen loves and awe nullified → merits sacred loves and awe = the love and awe one merits on Shabbos (many times). Also: darkness covering the eyes is removed → eyes see wonders = "gal einai v'abitah nifla'os miTorasecha" (Psalms 119:18) = holiness of Shabbos = "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" = essential time for attaining Torah and innovating wonders. Through this: all prayers and requests elevated + redemption awakened. Leaven and chametz (se'or v'chametz) in person's heart — which entice a person to have thoughts against the Torah scholars of the generation — nullified = Shabbos = aspect of nullification of leaven and chametz = "tashbisu se'or" (Exodus 12:15) → then: merits emunas Chachamim in fullness (many times). Then: heart can be set ablaze in study of Torah = flames of love (shalhavim d'rachimusa) awakened on Shabbos (Tikunim). "Reshafeha reshpei eish shalheves Yah mayim rabbim lo yuchlu l'chabes es ha'ahavah" (Song of Songs 8:6) = stated regarding Shabbos (writings). Then: shame (boshes) drawn upon each and every person of Israel = "Shabbas" = same letters as "boshes" (as brought). Shame = aspect of shefichas damim [shedding of blood]. Shechinah covers with her wings over the blood of Israel through this love → all sins are covered = "v'al kol pesha'im techaseh ahavah" (Proverbs 10:12). Therefore: "kol hamishmor es haShabbas mochlin lo al kol avonosav" (Sages).
 Siman 87 — Da sheKavannos Elul — Kavannos of Elul / tikkun habris / finding one's match / "retzei b'menuchaseinu": On Shabbos: holy path of the kavannos of Elul shines even more = "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" (Isaiah 58:13; stated regarding Shabbos). Explained above: "Kra es Yehoshua" = LM Siman 6; "Ki Seitzei" = this pamphlet Siman 82. This path = aspect of tikkun habris + propitious for finding one's match (zivug) + that she should have a will toward him (within). Aspect of holiness of Shabbos itself = "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha." Regarding this one prays: "retzei na b'menuchaseinu" + "v'hanchileynu b'ahavah u'v'ratzon Shabbas Kodshecha" (Prayer). Therefore: essential time of sacred union (zivug d'Kedushah) is on Shabbos.
 Siman 88 — Shelo Le'echol Pri shelo Nisbashel — Time of lost objects / entry of Shabbos: lost things return / ascent of sacred sparks / shofar blowings on Erev Shabbos / announcing a lost object on Shabbos: Essential time of lost objects (aveidos) = during the weekday = "keivan sheShabbas vav avdah nefesh." When holiness of Shabbos arrives → many lost things are found and return and ascend to their resting place = aspect of ascent of sacred sparks (nitzotzos haKodesh) that ascend through holiness of Shabbos. Aspect of shofar blowings on Erev Shabbos = "v'hayah b'yom hahu yitaka b'shofar gadol u'va'u ha'ovdim" (Isaiah 27:13). SA OC Siman 306: permitted to announce a lost object on Shabbos.
 Siman 91 — Vayedabber Elokim — Complete repentance and atonement / judgments sweetened / union of G-d and His Shechinah / Shabbos = teshuvah / chochmah ila'ah / chochmah tata'ah / two Shabbosim / gathering of students to teacher / Torah scholars increase in eating and laborers in Torah / Isaiah 58: Through holiness of Shabbos: complete repentance and atonement of sin. Judgments sweetened and nullified entirely. Union of G-d and His Shechinah made. Shabbos = aspect of teshuvah (many times). Sages: "hamishmor es haShabbas mochlin lo al kol avonosav." Zohar: "dinin iskafyan v'la misaarin klal" [judgments are subdued and do not awaken at all]. Then: essential fullness of union of G-d and His Shechinah = "u'vacharti ba'asher chafatzti da zivuga d'Matronita." Shabbos = chochmah ila'ah and chochmah tata'ah = secret of the two Shabbosim (many times). Therefore: essential time of gathering of students to the teacher. "Vayakhel Moshe" + Sages: need to make congregations on every Shabbos and expound Torah to them. Wisdom of the teacher = aspect of chochmah ila'ah; what students receive from him = aspect of chochmah tata'ah. During weekday: "ragleha yordos maves" (Proverbs 5:5) → Sitra Achra has sustenance from chochmah tata'ah. On Shabbos: legs ascend = "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" → can bind all wisdoms of the world to G-d and to the Torah (= chochmah ila'ah) → seichel haHamon [intellect of the multitude] also bound from wherever they are to G-d and to holy Torah → come to complete teshuvah. Torah scholars are permitted to increase in delight of Shabbos in bodily pleasures somewhat + diminish somewhat in their studies. Laborers need to increase in Torah on Shabbos. For: through Torah scholars increasing in oneg Shabbas in bodily pleasures → (in truth: even their bodily pleasures have wondrous wisdom and great holiness clothed within them) → through this: seichel haHamon is bound to holy Torah → therefore they engage in Torah much on holy Shabbos at least. Already explained above many times.
 

 Siman 104 continues in the next installment.

segments.he: וזה "וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך" ודרשו רז"ל 'שלא יפסיע פסיעה גסה כי נוטלת אחת מת"ק ממאור עיניו של אדם'. וזה פגם בקדושת שבת שהוא בחינת חיזוק הראיה לראות למרחוק צדקת משפטיו של השם יתברך כנ"ל, שעל ידי זה זוכה לשלימות התפלה שנקראת דרך כמבואר בפנים. "ממצוא חפצך ודבר דבר" שלא יבקש על צרכיו, כי אז התפלה בשלימות בבחינת "שבע ביום הללתיך", ואין שואלין אפילו על צרכיו הגשמיים מחמת כבוד שבת, בכדי שלא לזכור בצערו ושלא להרהר אחר יושר משפטיו יתברך שהם גם כן בבחינת חפץ, כמו שכתוב (קהלת ח') "כי לכל חפץ יש עת ומשפט" וכו' עיין רש"י שם. וזה "אם עושק רש וגזל משפט וצדק תראה במדינה אל תתמה על החפץ" וכו' עיין רש"י שם (קהלת ה') "אז תענג על ה'" 'דא עתיקא קדישא', כי על ידי כל הנ"ל זוכין לראות במפלת רשעים, ועל ידי זה נתגלין פני ה' לעושי טוב כמבואר בפנים, ובבחינת עתיק שם עיקר אור הפנים כידוע. "והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך" זה בחינת ירושת ארץ ישראל שהיא גבוה מכל הארצות, ונקראת נחלת יעקב כמו שפירשו המפרשים ז"ל. ובזוהר הקדוש דרשו "והרכבתיך על במתי ארץ" 'דא חקל תפוחין קדישין' היינו בחינת שלימות עליית המלכות שהיא בעצמה בחינת אמונה בחינת תפלה בחינת קדושת ארץ ישראל כידוע. ורבותינו ז"ל דרשו שניצול משעבוד מלכיות כמו שכתוב "ואתה על במותימו תדרוך" וכו', היינו שרואה במפלת הרשעים ונכנעים תחתיו.
segments.en:
✦ חלק ב · PART TWO ✦

 Siman 104 — סימן קד (Part Two)
 Shabbos as the comprehensive context of Sippur Ma'asiyos — the Bat Melech and the holiness of Shabbos — the Ba'al Tefillah and the tikkun of all the factions — Shivos ha'Kabtzonim and the sacred life — the Shabbos as the totality of all the stories and all the teachings

It is explained within that one must be careful to sing the Shabbos songs [zemiros Shabbas] — and the songs of the going out of Shabbos — and so on.

Story One — Ma'aseh 1 — Regarding the Lost Princess and her Finding

It is explained in the introduction to the Sippur Ma'asiyos [the book of stories]: how it was implied from the words of our Rebbe, of blessed memory — that the teaching "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — Siman Samech [60] in Likutay Moharan — is an explanation and interpretation of the matter of this story. And it is already clarified in this pamphlet: how the entire matter of the teaching of "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — mentioned above — is encompassed in the matter of the holiness of the holy Shabbos. See there. And it is well-known that the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of the princess [Bat Melech] — for this is the secret of: "Shin Beis." And it is explained in the holy Zohar and in the writings of the holy Ari z"l — from the secret of the six days — which correspond to the Vav [six] ends — the aspect of the six sons. And Shabbos is the aspect of the princess and she is called "tov [good]" — as it is written [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov" — and so on. And as explained in the holy Zohar, Parashas Noach, folio 60 [Samech]. And she was given to the good ones — who are Israel — in the aspect of: "Keneses Yisrael yehei ben zugecha." And in our many sins — the holiness of Shabbos became somewhat concealed — in the aspect of [Lamentations 2:6]: "shachach Hashem b'Tziyon mo'ed v'Shabbas" — and as it is written [Hosea 2:13]: "v'hishbati kol masosah — chagah — chadshah — v'Shabtah." Until — many times — the nations have decreed upon Israel to desecrate the Shabbos, heaven forfend. And Israel sacrificed their souls over this. And likewise in every generation and generation — there are Tzadikim and fit people — who have genuine self-sacrifice [mesirat nefesh] over the matter of the holiness of Shabbos. And likewise — all of Israel in general — each and every one yearns and longs to receive some illumination of holiness from the pleasantness of the holiness of Shabbos — and they long for this with the annihilation of the soul [b'chalos hanefesh] — and they search for her in the hidden places. Until they sometimes merit some flash of her holiness. And then she herself makes it known to them — and gives them counsel — how to search and seek after her — and to find her — and to reveal somewhat of her holiness. And the essential way is through holy longings and yearnings and yearning of holiness — for this is the aspect of: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — for one must remember the holiness of Shabbos throughout all the weekdays — and to long and yearn and aspire after her holiness — and to prepare oneself in every way possible to receive her holiness. And also — one must diminish in the bodily matters — in particular in the desires of eating and drinking during all the weekdays. For this likewise is a great preparation to receive the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the world of souls — as brought in the holy Zohar: Shabbos is a day of souls and not a day of bodies. For this is the aspect of what is explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 249: the way of people of good deeds is to fast on every Erev Shabbos. Even though the holiness of Shabbos is so lofty — that then a great holiness is drawn even upon the bodily pleasures — for the eating of Shabbos is entirely holy — and so on — and as mentioned above many times. And likewise — the sleep of Shabbos — as much as one needs — is very holy — as explained in the holy books. But during the weekday — one must diminish in this as much as possible. For then is the essential rule and dominion of the Sitra Achra — whose essential grip is in the corporeal and the material. And this is the aspect of the thoughts of repentance that come to a person on the holy Shabbos — all of this is from the aforementioned aspect. For then — each person according to his level — merits to find the princess — and she herself awakens him and strengthens him — to strive to seek and search after her — until he merits to find her — and to draw and reveal her holiness — through the aforementioned sacred stratagems. But nonetheless — sometimes specifically — when a person draws near to the holiness — then the adversary [ba'al davar] intensifies upon him even more — and casts him down, heaven forfend — in the manner of two people fighting one another — when one of them sees that his fellow is close to defeating him — he too is then aroused — and strengthens himself and intensifies very much — to cast down his fellow, heaven forfend. And as explained elsewhere. Until there are those — who after great effort and much striving in the service of G-d — the adversary then intensifies upon the serving person, heaven forfend — until he casts him into the aspect of sleep and the small-minded faculties [mochin d'katnus] — so much so — that all his service and his Torah and so on — are all in the aspect of sleep and smallness — and he cannot elevate himself upward — because he does not have sacred vitality as fitting in fullness. And there are those who fall so much — that they are in the aspect of the sleep of seventy years — that is, they cannot be awakened to them in any aspect of holiness — from any of the seventy faces of the Torah. Only through the story-tales of ancient years [sipur d'shanin kadmoniyos] — which are from the aspect of Atik — as explained in the teaching: "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — mentioned above. And both — the awakening through the seventy faces of the Torah — which are the aspect of seventy years — and the awakening through the aspect of ancient years — are all encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as explained below in this pamphlet — regarding the teaching "Pasach Rabbi Shimon" — mentioned above.
