And therefore — if a person will be strong in his resolve — and will not allow himself to be cast down — and to weaken his resolve — and to despair entirely, heaven forfend — in any way whatsoever. But rather — nonetheless — he will yearn and long and pine and seek and search and strive after all the matters of holiness — in every way possible to him — and with all his ability. And he will connect himself to the true Tzadikim — who are the essential ones who strive in every generation and generation regarding this matter — to seek and to ask and to expound after the holiness of the princess — and to take her out from the place of her exile and the concealment of her holiness — and to return her in peace to the house of her father. And he will be careful in the guarding of the holy Shabbos — and to honor it — and to delight in it — in every way possible to him — for then is the essential time of the ascent of the Malchus — the aspect of the princess — one will merit to reach the ultimate fullness in particular and in general. And as our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would have been redeemed immediately. And in Midrash Rabbah Beshalach, Parashah 25 — it is explained: had Israel guarded one Shabbos properly — Mashiach ben David would immediately come.

Story Two — Ma'aseh 2 — The Story of the King and the Emperor

We have not heard of this story any allusion. But it is understood by itself: that it speaks of the secret of the sacred connection and unity between Israel and their Father in Heaven. Which is the aspect of the unity of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah. And how many causes and obstacles passed over this.

And nonetheless — the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever — until the aforementioned sacred unity is completed in fullness. And all of this is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — which is the essential bond between Israel and their Father in Heaven. As it is written [Exodus 31:13]: "ki os hu beini u'veineichem l'doroseihem lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — and it is stated [Exodus 31:16]: "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosam — bris olam." And our Sages of blessed memory taught: the Congregation of Israel shall be your partner. And the essential future redemption that will come speedily in our days — when then the aforementioned unity will be completed in fullness — all depends upon the holiness of Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught — and as mentioned above many times.

Story Three — Ma'aseh 3 — The Story of the Lame One

Even though we know nothing — to what extent and to where the secret of these holy stories reaches — for they are very high — and very elevated — and very exalted — and most wondrous — far beyond our understanding — nonetheless — it is understood by itself: that all these matters touch and are truly encompassed in the matter of the holiness of Shabbos. For on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential union between the sun and the moon at their root — as explained in the holy Zohar regarding this in many places. (For this is the aspect of what the sun and the moon gather there together — as explained within.) And likewise — the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of the tree [ilan] that has many branches and fruits and leaves. And every branch and fruit and leaf has a special virtue. For this is propitious for children — and this for livelihood — and this for healing — and so on. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 1:3]: "v'hayah k'eitz shatul al palggei mayim — asher piryo yitein b'ito — v'alehu lo yibol — v'chol asher ya'aseh yatzliach" — and this tree is the aspect of Shabbos — as explained in Tikkun 6, folio 21. And likewise our Sages of blessed memory expounded in the Talmud [Psalms 1:3]: "asher piryo yitein b'ito" — regarding the union from Shabbos to Shabbos. And the holy Shabbos encompasses all the precious virtues — and all the good influences — sons — life — and livelihood. And all the healings in the world — in the aspect of: "Shabbas hu miliz'ok — v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" — and so on — and as mentioned above many times. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — (ilu shomrey Shabbas) — shemesh Tzedakah u'marpe" — and so on. (And one must yet explain further regarding this: what the sun complains before the moon — that when it comes — there is no name for it — for a candle at noon of what use is it? — and so on — but this is not the place.)

And also — on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential subjugation of the demons and the husks — as explained in the holy Zohar. And then they have no sustenance from the legs of holiness — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — and as mentioned above many times in the name of the writings of the holy Ari z"l. And then the holy path [derech kadosh] shines even more — which is the aspect of: the path of the righteous [derech tzaddikim]. And all the corrupted paths are nullified — which are the aspect of: the path of the wicked [derech resha'im] — the aspect of the path of the heretics [apikorsim]. For Shabbos is the foundation of the sacred faith — the aspect of the nullification of heresy.

segments.he: "והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך" 'דא זעיר אנפין' בחינת תפארת, שהוא בחינת כלליות אור האבות, בחינת "ותפארת בנים אבותם" וכנ"ל כמה פעמים.
segments.en:
And also — the path of the mad ones [meshuga'im] is nullified — for Shabbos is the aspect of settled understanding [de'ah meyusheves] — for then the Da'as shines in fullness — as mentioned above many times.

And also — through Shabbos — one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms. And through this — the Tzadikim are saved from the suffering of the ministers and the violent ones — and they dwell in their place in tranquility — and are not displaced. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — stated regarding the holiness of Shabbos. And also — this dust and powder that is scattered beneath the legs of the Tzadikim who are displaced — so that they should have strength in their legs — all of this flows from the holiness of Shabbos — for then is the essential tikkun and strengthening of the sacred legs — as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of the healing that the lame one had for his legs — through the aforementioned father. And also — on the holy Shabbos — then is the essential time for the watering of the holy tree. For if that tree had been watered properly — then nothing of the demons and husks would have remained — as explained within. And perhaps this is likewise the secret of the matter: what the sage commanded before his death — his sons and family — that they should strive to water trees — as explained at the beginning of the telling of this story. And the essential tikkun of this is drawn on Shabbos — for this is the secret of the delight of Shabbos [oneg Shabbas] — which is the initial letters of [Eden — Nahar — Gan]: the aspect of [Genesis 2:10]: "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan" — as explained in the holy Zohar. And therefore in truth our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded one Shabbos properly — Mashiach ben David would immediately come — as mentioned above.

Story Eleven — Ma'aseh 11 — The Story of the Prince and the Maid's Son Who Were Exchanged

The essential root of the grip of the substitutions and the exchanges and the transformations is from the aspect of the six weekdays. For then is the dominion of Metatron — who is the aspect of a servant — as is well-known. And it is stated regarding him [Exodus 23:21]: "al tamor bo" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "al temirani vo [do not exchange Me for him]." And in the chain of descent — the aspect of the transformations descends further and further — until they exchange the son of the slave and the maidservant literally for the son of the king. For this is the aspect of [Proverbs 30:21–23]: "tachas eved ki yimloch — v'shifchah ki sirash gevirtah" — and so on. And the essential root of the intensification of the aspect of the transformations is in the thought. For the son of the slave imagines in his thought that he is truly the son of the king. And moreover — his thought became so confused and so inverted — until — from the fear of the slander of the world — who said that he is the son of the slave — and certainly he himself would also sometimes be in doubt: perhaps the truth is so. And specifically through this he intensified himself — to think thoughts and to cause many evils to the slave — who in truth is his very own father. And moreover — he caused the true prince to be completely banished from his land. And likewise — the prince himself — even though everywhere he was — and even after he was banished — nonetheless — he is truly the prince. Only — upon him too — the exchanges and the transformations intensified in his thought — so that it seemed to him that he is the son of the slave. And moreover — through the fact that he knew: that the world says of him that he is the son of the king — and specifically through this he was banished from his land for nothing. Through this it angered him even more — until he took himself to drinking and intoxication — and went after the stubbornness of his heart. For this is the essential intensification of the evil transformations, heaven forfend. And all these aspects pass over all of Israel — in general and in particular — with each and every one — in every generation and generation — as is understood by itself. And as is explained extensively in Likutay Halachos. And therefore — the essential tikkun for this is through the holiness of Shabbos.

Which is the aspect of the world of thought — and great mental faculties shine in it. And it is the aspect of son [ben] — as explained elsewhere. And then the Sitra Achra and the palaces of the transformations are subdued greatly — as explained in the holy Zohar. And then — the aspect of tranquility and holiness and settled understanding [yishuv haDa'as] is drawn upon each person according to his level. Until even the son of the maidservant himself contemplates within himself — that it was not good that he banished the prince for nothing. And all the more so — for the true prince — certainly thoughts of repentance and settled understanding come to him. And he contemplates within himself: on the contrary — if so — that the Almighty is able to do such a thing — and so on — is it possible — what I am doing? And is it fitting for me to conduct myself so — even if I were truly the son of the slave? And all the more so — since the world says of me that I am the son of the king — and I have royal customs — and in the end I am going after the stubbornness of my heart — and doing such deeds. And then he repents very much over his deeds. And then — even though afterward he returns again to his deeds, heaven forfend — in the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: "keivan sheShabbas vav — avdah nefesh" — nonetheless — the residual impression [reshimu] of the aforementioned thoughts of repentance rises in his heart every time thereafter as well — and reminds him — and arouses him. Until through this he merits to come to complete repentance — until he merits to reach the fullness of his true tikkun — as explained within. And also — one must know: that before one comes to the fullness of one's tikkun — many causes and very many difficult things must pass over one. For this is the aspect of: "mi shedarach b'Erev Shabbas yochal b'Shabbas" — for this is the causes that passed over the true prince — until he reached the fullness of his tikkun and his good ultimate purpose. And then he saw with his own eyes: that all these causes and difficult things were the cause of his true and eternal success — as all of this is explained within.

And also — the entire matter explained within: that the night said to the day — why — when you come — there is no name for me — for a candle at noon of what use is it? — and so on. And regarding the matter of the renewal of the moon [chidushei deSihra] — when then the living creatures bearing the Throne make a melody — in the aspect of [Psalms 96:1]: "Shiru laHashem Shir Chadash" — for this is the song that the cows of Bashan sang when they bore the Ark toward Beit Shemesh. And regarding the matter of the Garden of Eden — from which Adam the first man was expelled — and Shabbos shielded over him. And Shabbos is the aspect of: the king who is the one upon whom peace depends [Melech shehaShalum shelo] — and so on. And regarding the matter of the throne — and the table — the bed — and the menorah — which are the tikkunim of the Shechinah — and so on. All of this is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as explained in Zohar Terumah, folio 138 — and in other places. And also — as explained within — regarding the wondrous garden — that when one wishes to enter it — then immediately they begin to pursue the person who wishes to enter — until they drive him out from the garden.

And the tikkun is: that one should stand near the image of a person who stands there near the garden — and above him there is a sign [tablet] — and written upon it: that this person was a king in whose days there was peace. And the prince mentioned above commanded: to stand this aforementioned person within the garden. And then — all of them entered the garden — and went out from it in peace — without harm. And it is explained afterward in the allusions: that this garden is the aspect of the Garden of Eden — from which Adam the first man was expelled. And Shabbos — which is the aspect of the king in whose days there is peace — shielded over him — as mentioned above.

And also — it is explained there: regarding the throne that the king made — and so on. And before the throne stands a bed — and near the bed stands a table — and upon the table stands a menorah — and so on. And the aforementioned prince completed the matter of the tikkun of the throne and the bed and the table and the menorah — and moved their place somewhat — and so on. And arranged everything in the proper order — and so on. And then they gave him the kingship — and so on. And this is the aspect of: "tzeluta d'me'alei Shabbata — deha ityachdas kursaya yikira kadisha" — and so on — "v'itaknath l'mishreh alah malka kadisha ila'ah" — and so on. And this is the aspect of: "u'vayom hashevi'i nistalah v'yashav al kisse chevodo" — for Shabbos is the aspect of the world of the Throne [olam haKissay] — as is well-known. And this is why one must then have one's lamp lit — and one's table set — and one's bed spread — in the aspect of the lamp and the table and the bed — mentioned above — that stand before the throne. And then on the holy Shabbos — the kingship ascends in fullness — and all the sides of the other side [sitrin achranin] — that intensify through the aspect of the palaces of the transformations — mentioned above — are pushed away and fall. And this is what is elaborated upon in [Psalms 92]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" — regarding the success of the wicked — which is only for a brief moment — and for their destruction forever — but [Psalms 92:13]: "Tzadik katamar yifrach" — and so on. And likewise in [Psalms 93]: "Hashem Malach" — and the sixth [Psalms 93:4]: "miKolos mayim rabbim adirim" — and so on — "adir bamarom Hashem — edosecha ne'emnu me'od" — and so on. For the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever — and You are on high forever, Hashem. For in the end — the substitutions and transformations will be nullified — and the world will stand upon its tikkun and its proper place in fullness — and the first dominion will return to the daughter of Jerusalem — and a redeemer will come to Zion. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would immediately be redeemed. For the essential aforementioned tikkunim flow through the holiness of Shabbos. And this is what is written [Jeremiah 17:24–25]: "v'hayah im shamo'a tishme'u eilai" — and so on — "v'ladesh es yom haShabbas" — and so on — "u'va'u b'sha'arey ha'ir hazos — melachim v'sarim yoshvim el kisse David" — and so on. For the kingship and the dominion will return to the true prince — as mentioned above.

Story Twelve — Ma'aseh 12 — The Story of the Ba'al Tefillah [the Master of Prayer]

Shabbos is the aspect of the ultimate purpose [tachlis] — the aspect of: the ultimate purpose of the act of heaven and earth. And it is the foretaste of the World to Come — which is the aspect of the world of tikkun [olam haTikkun]. And therefore — the essential fullness of the tikkun of all the factions [katvos] explained within — all through the holy Shabbos. For it is already explained in Likutay Halachos and in our words in the pamphlet Zimras ha'Aretz: that every opinion and view of every faction had some grip and root also in holiness. And therefore — the holiness of Shabbos encompasses all the tikkunim of all the aforementioned factions.

The faction that chose for themselves: that the essential ultimate purpose is honor — and they were afterward rectified through the old king himself — who was found sitting in a field — crowned with a crown of kingship. This is encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — for the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of humility and lowliness [anavah v'shefilus] — the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "shevu ish tachtav" — stated regarding Shabbos — and as explained elsewhere. The opposite of the error of the aforementioned faction — who pursued honor. Rather — on the contrary — one must diminish in one's own honor — and increase in the honor of G-d. For this is the aspect of what is explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 250: that the great sages of Israel would personally toil — to prepare something for the sake of Shabbos — in order to honor it. And from them — every person shall learn. And he should not say — I will not diminish my honor. For this itself is his honor — that he honors the Shabbos. See there. For certainly — sacred honor has a great root in the supreme holiness — for everything the Holy One, blessed be He, created — He created only for His honor. And one must be very careful in the honor of one's father and mother and teacher and elder and Torah scholar — and so on. But all of it only for the sake of the honor of Heaven. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'liKdosh Hashem mechubbad v'chibadto" — and so on — stated regarding Shabbos. And this is the aspect of: "me'angeha l'olam kavod yinchalu" — the aspect of [I Samuel 2:30]: "ki mechabbedai achabbed." And this is the aspect of the sanctification of Kaser — which is said on Shabbos — in the aspect of the king who was crowned with the crown of kingship. And also — on the holy Shabbos — one ascends to the Kaser [Crown] — as is well-known.

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is murder — this flows in its root from the fact that even in holiness there are the four judicial death penalties [arba misos beis din] — and it is a commandment to fulfill [Deuteronomy 13:6]: "u'vi'arta hara mikirbecha." And the tikkun for this is likewise through the holiness of Shabbos — which is called "Shabbas Malketa." For this is the aspect of what the aforementioned faction was rectified — through the queen who was found sitting in a sea of blood — and so on — as explained within. For also in the holiness of Shabbos this aspect is found — in the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "mechaleleha mos yumas" — and it is stated [Exodus 31:14–15]: "kol ha'oseh vah melachah yumas." And nonetheless — our Sages of blessed memory taught [Tractate Sanhedrin 35]: murder does not override Shabbos — that is, they do not execute the four judicial death penalties on Shabbos. For on Shabbos: "kol shultenei rogzin u'marei d'dina kulhu arkin" — and so on — "v'chol dinin iskafyan v'la misaarin klal" — and so on. And our Sages of blessed memory learned from several verses: that the preservation of life [pikuach nefesh] overrides Shabbos. And the essential life and length of days flows from the holiness of Shabbos — in the aspect of: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu."

segments.he: וזה בחינת מה שדרשו רז"ל (שבת קיח) 'שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים' כי על ידי זה יכולין לגלות קדושת ארץ ישראל לעולם אפילו כשהיא בגלות תחת יד הסטרא אחרא, בבחינת "ואף גם זאת בהיותם בארץ אויביהם". כי נתבטלין על ידי זה כל מיני מצרים דסטרא אחרא ונתגלה קדושת ארץ ישראל גם עכשיו, שגם זכות אבות בעצמה הוא בבחינת בלי מצרים, בחינת לעולם זכות אבות קימת וכו' וכנ"ל בסימן ל"ז. וזה "כי פי ה' דיבר", היינו שכל זה זוכין על ידי שלימות התפלה של שבת עד שהוא בבחינת דבר ה' בעצמו, שזה בחינת "ואשים דברי בפיך ובצל ידי כסיתיך" וכו', היינו שעל ידי הצל שנעשה על ידי התגלות יד ה' בבחינת "ותאחז במשפט ידי", על ידי זה נתחזקין מאור עיניו של הצדיק וזוכה לשלימות התפלה בבחינת כל התיקונים הנ"ל, שאז התפלה בבחינת דבר ה', מאחר שזוכה לבחינת התפשטות הגשמיות כל כך בשעת התפלה עד שאין מרגיש גם את עצמו, כי כל ישותו נתבטל ואין כאן אלא המלך בעצמו שזה בחינת "ובהיכלו כולו אומר כבוד". אזי כל דבורי תפלתו הם בחינת דבורי המלך בעצמו כביכול, בבחינת "אדני שפתי תפתח" כמובן בפנים. ועל ידי תפלה כתיקונו מתנוצץ אור זכות אבות וזוכה לכל הנ"ל:
segments.en:
The faction that said: one is fit to rule — one who has an abundance of many foods — and is sustained only on refined foods — and so on. The essential tikkun of this is likewise through the holiness of Shabbos — for then there is an abundance of many foods — the aspect of the doubled bounty — for this is the aspect of the double bread [lechem mishneh] of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the showbread [lechem haPanim] — as explained in the holy Zohar, Vayechi, folio 246 [Reish Mem Vav]. For this is the essential aspect of refined foods [mazon dak]. And it is explained in the holy Zohar and in the writings of the holy Ari z"l: for the eating of Shabbos is entirely holy — and the outer forces have no grip in it at all — rather — it is entirely absorbed into the limbs. And it is already explained above: for the eating of Shabbos is the aspect of the manna. And as is also explained in Sefer haKaneh: that one must place the bread between two covers — as a remembrance of the manna — and as also explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim. And the eating of the manna is certainly a very refined and very spiritual food.

The faction that said: one of beautiful countenance [yefas to'ar] is fit to rule — since through this the settlement of the world is increased — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the tikkun of the covenant — and the nullification of this desire — in the aspect of [Proverbs 6:25]: "al tachmod yafyah bilvavecha" — and so on — the aspect of [Proverbs 31:30]: "sheiker haChein v'hevel haYofi — ishah yiras Hashem hi tishalel." For this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of: "ishah" — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: the Congregation of Israel shall be your partner. And it is the aspect of: "ishah yiras Hashem" — the aspect of: "yirey Shabbas." And through sacred awe — this desire is nullified — as explained in the first Likutim, Siman 60. And therefore — the essential time of the holiness of the sacred union is on the holy Shabbos. For then — the union is in great holiness — and through this one merits to beget holy and righteous children and Torah scholars. Which is the essential settlement of the world in truth — for Torah scholars are the builders of the world — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: do not read "banecha [your children]" but rather "bonecha [your builders]."

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is speech — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos. For then — all the languages of the nations are subdued and fall — and the aspect of the sanctity of speech of the holy tongue [lashon haKodesh] is drawn. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos — as understood in Likutay Moharan, Siman 19 in the teaching "Tefilah l'Chavakuk" — and in Likutay Tinyana, Siman 2 in the teaching "Yemei Chanukah" — and as explicitly explained in the holy Zohar [Bereishis folio 32]: "Shabbas ikri dibbur — u'began da — dibbur d'chol — asur b'Shabbas" — and so on.

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is joy — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos. For then is the essential time of sacred joy — and great joy and delight is drawn in all the worlds — as explained in the holy Zohar. And as mentioned above many times: how one must receive the Shabbos with great joy. And this is the aspect of: "yismechu b'malchusecha shomrei Shabbas v'korei oneg" — and so on. And the sacred joy is encompassed and bound with sacred love — in the aspect of [Psalms 5:12]: "v'ya'altzu v'cha ohavei Shimecha" — for this is the aspect of what the aforementioned faction was afterward rectified — through the fact that the faithful friend of the king — who was found sitting within a sea of wine — and so on — ruled over them — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the light — the love — and the will of holiness — that shines on the holy Shabbos. The aspect of: "v'Shabbas Kodshecha b'ahavah u'v'ratzon hinchaltanu" — and it is called: "menuchas ahavah v'nedavah." And this is the aspect of the Kiddush over wine — the aspect of [Song of Songs 1:4]: "nazkira dodecha miyayin — meisharim ahevucha."

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is wisdom — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos — for then shines the light of the sacred wisdom [chochmah d'Kedushah]. For this is the secret of [Exodus 31:14]: "v'shamartem es haShabbas ki Kodesh hu" — "Kodesh hu" is the aspect of wisdom [Chochmah] — as is well-known. And then all the outer wisdoms fall and are nullified — for this is the aspect of what is explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim: it is forbidden to read on Shabbos from books of the study of the outer wisdoms — and as mentioned above many times.

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is to look after the growth of the limbs through eating and drinking — and they were afterward rectified through the warrior of the king — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holiness of Shabbos. For then — eating is in great holiness — and it is a commandment to eat three meals on Shabbos — as it is written [Exodus 16:25]: "ichluhu hayom" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And through the sacred eating of Shabbos — the limbs and the bones are nourished [mitdashnin] with great holiness — in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:11]: "v'atzmosecha yechalitz" — which is juxtaposed to the matter of: "im tashiv miShabbos" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And then one merits great sacred might [gevurah d'Kedushah]. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 19:6]: "v'hu k'chasan yotzei meichupato — yasis k'gibbor lartzo" — and so on — which was expounded in the holy Zohar, Terumah, folio 137 — regarding the matter of the holiness of the holy Shabbos.

The faction that said the essential ultimate purpose is wealth — and they were afterward rectified through the one who was appointed over the treasuries of the king — and so on. The essential tikkun of this through the holy Shabbos — which is the essential aspect of: the one appointed over the treasuries. For all the good influences flow only from the holiness of Shabbos — as understood in the holy Zohar. And then the aspect of sacred wealth is drawn — and the sadness and grief and sighing of the desire for money is nullified. For this is the aspect of [Proverbs 10:22]: "birchas Hashem hi sa'asir — v'lo yosif etzev imah" — which our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding the holiness of Shabbos. And likewise our Sages of blessed memory taught: the wealthy in other lands — because they honor the Shabbos.

And Shabbos is the aspect of the flash of the light of Mashiach — for then the desire for money will be nullified — as it is written [Isaiah 2:20]: "b'yom hahu yashlich ha'adam es elilei kaspo v'es elilei zahavo." And this is the aspect of what on Shabbos it is forbidden to handle money at all — and even if one forgot one's purse upon oneself — one unties one's belt and it falls — and so on — and as explained in Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chayyim, Siman 266. And also — the Shabbos foods have likewise the virtue of those sacred foods explained within — through whose good fragrance one merits to feel the great stench of the desire for money. And afterward — when they ate from them — they loathed their money greatly and threw away from them their silver and their gold — and so on — as explained within. And since the Shabbos foods have this virtue as well — therefore it is impossible that for the sake of the Shabbos foods one should need to depend on creatures — and should fall in one's resolve and be ashamed through this before the wealthy person. For this is entirely the opposite of the virtue of the sanctity of the Shabbos foods — as mentioned above. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: make your Shabbos like a weekday — and do not become dependent on creatures. For all who are dependent on creatures — their face changes color — like a raven [Krum] — and so on. That is — from shame and weakness of resolve that he has before the wealthy person who gives to him. And through this — the desire for money can take hold of him, heaven forfend — since he has such submission and shame before the wealthy person. But the Shabbos foods are the aspect of those sacred foods mentioned above — when one eats from them — one loathes money to the utmost loathing — and the wealthy people are ashamed of their money. And the poor people are also very ashamed — for until now they had been small in their own eyes — and fallen in their resolve before the wealthy people — because they have no money — and so on — as explained within. And since the Shabbos foods have this virtue as well — therefore it is impossible that because of the Shabbos foods one should become dependent on creatures — and fall in one's resolve — and be ashamed through this before the wealthy person. For this is entirely the opposite of the virtue of the sanctity of the Shabbos foods — as mentioned above.

And the essential tikkun of all the aforementioned factions was through the fit Ba'al Tefillah [Master of Prayer] — who ruled over the faction that said: the essential ultimate purpose is only to engage in prayers and songs and praises and confessions — and so on — before the Almighty — and to be lowly of spirit and humble — and so on. And likewise — all that they merited to find and to gather — the entire holy gathering of the king and his people — all was through the merit of the fit Ba'al Tefillah — and through the merit of his holy prayers — and as explained within. For all the tikkunim of all the aforementioned — are all encompassed in the fullness of the sanctity of prayer — as explained in the pamphlet Zimras ha'Aretz. And the essential fullness of the tikkun of prayer — for there is a fullness beyond fullness — also in the matter of the service of prayer itself — as is well-known — and as explained elsewhere. And therefore — the essential fullness of prayer is through the holiness of Shabbos. For then prayer is completed to the ultimate fullness. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — and so on. And our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "lehodos laHashem" — from the language of repentance and verbal confession [teshuvah v'viduy devarim] — which was likewise the matter of the Ba'al Tefillah and his people — mentioned above. And see in the holy Zohar and in the Tikunim — regarding the great fullness of the sanctity of the prayers of the holy Shabbos — and as mentioned above many times.

Story Thirteen — Ma'aseh 13 — The Story of the Seven Beggars [Shivos haKabtzonim]

Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred old age [ziknah d'Kedushah] — the aspect of length of days [arichas yamim]. For then one ascends to the sacred beard [dikna kadisha] — as explained in the writings of the holy Ari z"l. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who make Kiddush over wine on the nights of Shabbos — merit length of days. For Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred memory [zikaron d'Kedushah] of the old man who is blind — who is in the aspect of entirely above time. For this is the aspect of: "u'verachto mikol hayamim — v'kidashto mikol hazmanim." And this is the aspect of [Exodus 20:8]: "zachor es yom haShabbas" — and so on — the aspect of the aforementioned supreme memory. For on Shabbos — the illumination of the light of Ein Sof is renewed in the worlds — as explained in Siddur Kol Yaakov. And one who merits to truly connect oneself to the holiness of Shabbos in fullness — can through this merit to be encompassed and to cleave to the light of Ein Sof — as it were — in the aspect of entirely above the creation — even above — as it were — the aspect of nefesh — ru'ach — neshamah — which is the aspect of nothing [ayin] — as explained within.

segments.he: סימן נו-וביום הביכורים שבת הוא בחינת מלכות בחינת שבת מלכתא כידוע.
segments.en:
And also — through the holiness of the holy Shabbos — one merits good life that has no lack in it. For Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of all the creation — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And it is stated regarding it: "ta'ameha chayyim zachu" — and it is called "tov" — as explained in the holy Zohar. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the Garden of Eden [Gan Eden]. For this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:10–11]: "v'chagan zeru'eha tatzmiyach" — brought in the Tikunim regarding the holy Shabbos. And also — it is the aspect of the Tzadik who is the foundation of the world [Tzadik Yesod Olam] — who is the aspect of the Gardener [gannan d'gintah] — and as explained in Zohar Terumah, folio 166b. And this is the aspect of the delight of Shabbos [oneg Shabbas] — which is the initial letters of Eden — Nahar — Gan — as brought in the Tikunim. For this is the aspect of: "v'nahar yotzei me'Eden l'hashkos es haGan." And in this garden there grow wondrous fruits that have all the tastes and fragrances and appearances in the world. And from them — one lives good life — as explained within. And this is the aspect of the sanctity of the Shabbos foods — that have an excellent taste — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: blessed with delicacies — and so on. And they have a good fragrance — in the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: the food of Shabbos — its fragrance wafts — and so on. And also — the appearance of a person shines even more then — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: blessed with the light of a person's face. And also — the eyes of a person shine even more then — for this is the aspect of Shabbos: "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein." And this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "re'u ki Hashem nasan lachem haShabbas" — and as one can observe concretely in every person — that the Shabbos day differs in its light for the good more than all other days. For this is the aspect of: blessed with light — which our Sages of blessed memory taught regarding the very first Shabbos. And a residual impression [reshimu] of this remains for all generations. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — (ilu shomrey Shabbas) — shemesh Tzedakah" — and so on — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And this is the aspect of what one must have on Shabbos: one's table set — which corresponds to the aspect of taste. And one's lamp lit — which corresponds to the aspect of appearance. And one's bed spread — which corresponds to the aspect of fragrance — as our Sages of blessed memory taught: regarding the bed of Elisha — that a good fragrance wafted from it — because his bed was very whole and holy. For the holiness of Shabbos is the exact opposite of the qualities that ruin taste and fragrance and appearance. For Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of the speech of the holy tongue — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — as mentioned above many times in the name of the holy Zohar. And the speech of the holy tongue is the exact opposite of vulgar language [nibbul peh], heaven have mercy. For on this account it is called the holy tongue — on account of the fact that there is in it no name at all for the reproductive organ — as brought in the name of the early authorities. And this is the aspect of the holy tongue: for everywhere that you find the boundary of sexual immorality — you find holiness. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of true judgment [mishpat emes] — in the aspect of [Ezekiel 20:19–20]: "v'es mishpatai shmoru" — and so on — "v'es Shabsosai kadshu" — and so on. And it is the aspect of truth — as mentioned above many times. And it is the aspect of the light of the eyes — as mentioned above. For this is the opposite of the acceptance of bribes and the distortion of justice in falsehood — regarding which it is stated [Exodus 23:8]: "ki hashochad ye'aver" — and so on. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the holiness of the guarding of the covenant — and the nullification of the desire for sexual immorality — as mentioned above many times. And through all of this — taste and appearance and fragrance are rectified — and they return and find the aspect of the true Tzadik — who is the aspect of the Gardener — who watches over the tikkun of the garden. And through this one merits to live good life — for this is the aspect of: "kulam yisb'u v'yis'angu mituvecha" — and so on — and likewise: "v'sova'nu mituvecha" — which is said in the prayer of the holy Shabbos.

And also — the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the speech that has completeness in it — for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'daber davar" — and as mentioned above many times in the name of the holy Zohar. And this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on. For the essential perfection is in these words — which are praises of the Almighty — and as explained within. And when the holiness of Shabbos arrives — then many songs and riddles and praises and melodies are awakened to the Almighty — as understood in the holy Zohar. And this is likewise the aspect of what Israel increases on Shabbos with songs and melodies and praises to the Almighty. And this is likewise the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem — v'lezamre lishimcha elyon." And this [Psalms 92:3]: "lehagid bavoker chasdecha — v'emunascha baleilos" — and its Targum: "v'kushtach b'leilin" — for this is the aspect of the lovingkindnesses of truth — through which are the essential becoming of the time of all the days — from which come all the riddles and songs — that contain all the wisdoms. And this is "lehagid — davka" — the declaring [haggadah] is a word of wisdom [milah d'chochmata] — as explained in the holy Zohar. And the most excellent of the days is the holy Shabbos — in the aspect of: "u'verachto mikol hayamim — v'kidashto mikol hazmanim." And it is stated [Psalms 139:16]: "yamim yotzaru — v'lo echad bahem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: this is the day of Shabbos. And it itself is the aspect of the light of truth — as mentioned above many times. And great lovingkindnesses are drawn in it. And the holiness of Shabbos itself was given to Israel through the aspect of a lovingkindness of truth [chesed shel emes] — in the aspect of: "matanah tovah yesh li b'veis ginzay — v'Shabbas shemah — va'ani mevakesh l'tena lah l'Yisrael" — and so on. And it is the sacred point of all the days — as brought in the holy Zohar. And therefore — wondrous songs and praises are awakened in it — that are above the aspect of all songs. For this is the aspect of the Song of Songs — which is for the King upon whom peace depends [Melech shehaShalum shelo] — for this is the aspect of the holy Shabbos — as is well-known. And this song is certainly encompassed from all the wisdoms. For the entire creation in all the days was through wisdom — as it is written [Psalms 104:24]: "kulam b'chochmah asisa." And all the days are encompassed in the holy Shabbos — as explained in the holy Zohar. And it is their fullness. And therefore — a wondrous and very supreme wisdom shines in it. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "ki Kodesh hi" — as is well-known.

And also — the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the sanctity of the brain and the lung and the heart — as understood from what is explained in this pamphlet many times — in the name of the holy Zohar and the Tikunim. And their supreme root is the aspect of the spring — and the heart — and the bird that spreads its wings over the heart and shields it — as is well-known. (And one must yet explain further in this.)

And also — the holy Shabbos is the aspect of the fullness of the sacred throat [tzavar d'Kedushah] — which alludes to Binah and to Tiferes — as explained in Pardes. And both are encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times. And then — the aspect of all the sacred vapors and voices are drawn and awakened in fullness. For this is the aspect of the seven voices in [Psalms 29]: "Mizmor l'David" — which are said at the entry of Shabbos — and as understood there in the kavannos. And then — the aspect of the unity between the two sacred birds — mentioned within — shines and flashes. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would immediately be redeemed.

And also — the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of: the few containing the many — to the ultimate fullness. Which is the aspect of the ultimate end of the category of place — entirely. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "al yetzei ish mimekomo" — stated regarding Shabbos. For Shabbos encompasses in it the entire creation — as is well-known.

And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the place of the world [mekomo shel Olam] — as explained in Likutay Tinyana, Siman 83. And therefore — through the holiness of Shabbos — one can come to the holy tree — mentioned within — which is entirely above place — for this is the aspect of what is explained in the holy Zohar: regarding the ascent of the souls on the holy Shabbos — upward and upward entirely — and so on.

And also — the holiness of Shabbos encompasses all the attributes of this tree — which has three roots — which are faith — humility — and awe. And truth is the body of the tree. And all these attributes are encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.

And also — through the holiness of Shabbos — is the essential drawing of the healing for the princess — as explained within. For this is the aspect of: "Shabbas hu miliz'ok — v'refu'ah kerovah lavo" — and as explained in Likutay Moharan, Siman 58. For through the repentance of Shabbos — healing is drawn in the physical and the spiritual. For this is the aspect of [Exodus 21:19]: "rak shivto yitein — v'rapa yirapei" — for through the holiness of Shabbos — the Sitra Achra is subdued — from which come all the arrows that were cast at the princess.

And through the holiness of Shabbos — one can return and extract the arrows from the princess — even after they have already reached her. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: even if one worshipped idolatry like the generation of Enosh — he is forgiven. And likewise — what the angels say regarding him [Isaiah 6:7]: "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar."

And likewise — the essential fullness of charity is through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times. And this is the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — shemesh Tzedakah u'marpe" — and so on. And likewise — the essential ordination of the Sages [semichas Chachamim] is through the holiness of Shabbos. For this is the aspect of what Moshe ordained [samach] Yehoshua on Shabbos — specifically. For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: it was a Shabbos of investiture [Shabbas shel diyuzgi] — as mentioned above many times. For then is the essential shining of the light of wisdom in the world — in the aspect of [Exodus 31:14]: "ki Kodesh hi" — as is well-known. And also — in the holiness of Shabbos are encompassed all ten kinds of melody [asarah minei niggina]. For this is the aspect of [Psalms 92:2]: "tov lehodos" — and so on — "alay asor" — and so on — and as mentioned above many times.

And the melody is the healing of the princess — as explained within.

And it is known: that the healing of the princess is the aspect of the complete redemption — that is destined to come speedily in our days. As it is written [Isaiah 30:26]: "b'yom chavosh Hashem es shever amo — u'machtzo makosam yirpa" — and similar passages — many verses. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — they would immediately be redeemed. And in Midrash Rabbah Beshalach, Parashah 25 — it is explained: had Israel guarded one Shabbos properly — Mashiach ben David would immediately come — and so on. May it be so — speedily in our days.

segments.he: וכל נשמות ישראל מושרשין בקדושת שבת שהוא עולם הנשמות כמו שכתוב "וביום השביעי שבת וינפש" וכמבואר בזוהר הקדוש ובספר הבהיר, על כן 'כל ישראל בני מלכים ויש לכל אחד מישראל בחינת מלכות לפי בחינתו. ובחינת המלכות שבקדושת שבת הוא באתגלייא ובאתכסיא. שזה בחינת מה שאמרו רז"ל מתן שכרה לא עבידא לאגלויי. ושבת ניתן בצינעא. כי אף על פי שרואין קדושת שבת ובחינת המלכות שלה גם באתגליא. כי ישראל נזהרין מאד בכבודה ומאחד בשבת מזכירין את יום השבת ומזמינין ומכינין מה שצריך לכבוד שבת. אף על פי כן עיקר המלכות שלה הוא באתכסיא כי באתגליא היא כביכול בבחינת עניות דלית לי' מגרמי' כלום כי אין עושין בו מלאכה ואין משתכרין בו ואין מרויחין בו וכמו שכתוב בזוהר שמות דף רנ"ה בתרין אילין אוזיף בר נש לקודשא בריך הוא כד חייס ליה למסכנא וכד אפיק בשבתי וזמני וכו' בבחינת מלוה ה' חונן דל ובתיקון כ"א דף נ"ח עני איהו יום השבת וכו'. גם ידוע ששולטין בו מאדים ושבתאי וכו' ובזוהר יתרו פ"ח ויברך אלקים את יום השביעי וכו' כיון דלא משתכחי ביה מזונא מה ברכתא אשתכח ביה. אלא הכי תאני כל ברכאן דלעילא ותתא ביומא שביעאה תליין וכו' עיין שם מובן מזה גם כן כי בחינת המלכות והממשלה של שבת קדש הוא באתכסייא כי עשיר ברשים ימשול (משלי כב) ובשבת מי שלא טרח והכין בערב שבת מה יאכל בשבת אף על פי כן באתכסיא כל השפע והברכה נמשך רק משבת על כל ימות השבוע וכולם תחת ממשלתו ומלכותו וכולם נכנעים וכפופים אליו. ועיין גם בפתיחתא למדרש איכה שיחו בי יושבי שער וכו' שהעכו"ם מלעיגין על ישראל שהם עניים מחמת הוצאות שבת וכו'. אבל באמת הוא להיפוך כי כל הפרנסה והעשירות שהוא בבחינת מלכות נמשך רק מקדושת שבת כנ"ל וכמו שאמרו רז"ל עשירים שבשאר ארצות מפני שמכדין את השבת. כי כל המוסיף מוסיפין לו. וזה שכתוב (ירמיה יז) והיה אם שמוע תשמעון אלי וכו' ולקדש את יום השבת וכו' ובאו בשערי העיר הזאת מלכים ושרים יושבים על כסא דוד וכו' כי עיקר קיום המלכות של ישראל תלוי בשמירת שבת כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Shabbos is the aspect of the letter Heh —
 as brought in the Tikunim in many places —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "ot hi l'olam — ot ha
 [it is a sign forever — the letter Heh]"
 — and likewise regarding the matter of:
 "ha d'hashishi
 [the Heh of the sixth]."
 For Shabbos is the aspect of mochin d'gadlus
 [mental faculties of greatness] —
 that is, the illumination of Da'as
 and the mental faculties
 is drawn upon each and every person of Israel
 from a supremely holy and awesome exalted source —
 which is the aspect of the supernal mental faculties —
 which are the aspects of Kodesh [holiness] —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "u'shemartem es haShabbas ki kodesh hi
 [and you shall guard the Shabbos for it is holy]"
 [Exodus 31:14] — as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "ki ot hi beinai u'veinechem l'doroseichem
 [for it is a sign between Me and between you
 throughout your generations]."
 "ot hi"
 — this is the aspect of the aforementioned letter Heh.
 And this:
 "l'doroseichem
 [throughout your generations]"
 — for from there the birth of children
 and the generations is drawn —
 as explained within.
 And this:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem
 [to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you]."
 That is — for then one merits
 such a perfection of Da'as
 that it is close to knowing G-d, blessed be He,
 as it were —
 and then one's Da'as draws sustenance
 from the Da'as of G-d, blessed be He —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem"
 — Kodesh is the aspect of the mental faculties,
 as mentioned above.
 And therefore the essential time
 for the sacred union —
 to father holy children
 who possess perfect sacred Da'as —
 is on Shabbos — as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "v'shamru Bnay Yisrael es haShabbas
 [and the children of Israel shall guard the Shabbos]"
 — which alludes that one must guard and wait
 with one's union for Shabbos —
 as brought in the writings.
 And this:
 "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosaym
 [to make the Shabbos throughout their generations]"
 — for through this the birth of children
 and the generations
 is drawn in the perfection of the holiness —
 in the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos.
 And this [Isaiah 56:4]:
 "ki choh amar Hashem la'sarisim
 asher yishmeru es Shabsosai
 u'vachartu ba'asher chafatzti
 [for so says Hashem to the sarisim
 who guard My Shabbosim —
 and choose that which I desire]"
 — which likewise alludes to the Shabbos union —
 as brought in Zohar Yisro, folio 89.
 "v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai —
 yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos
 [and I shall give them in My house and within My walls —
 a hand and a name better
 than sons and daughters],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 (And there is more to explain in this.)

segments.he: וצריך כל אחד לבלי להשתמש עם בחינת המלכות שיש לו להנאתו ולצרכו. בכדי שלא לעשות מקודש חול ח"ו. כי המלכות שמקבלין על ידי קדושת שבת הוא קדש ואסור למעול בו וליהנות ממנו למלאות תאוותו ולהשתמש בו להנאתו ולצרכו. רק להשתמש עם בחינת המלכות שיש לכל אחד כפי בחינתו רק בשביל כבוד השם יתברך בבחינת והיתה לה' המלוכה דהיינו להזהיר ולהוכיח את כל אלו האנשים שהם תחת ממשלתו ולקרבם להשם יתברך.
segments.en:
And this [Isaiah 56:6]:
 "u'vnay haneychar hanilavim al Hashem —
 v'chol haggid —
 kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo
 [and the children of the stranger
 who attach themselves to Hashem —
 and so on —
 every Shabbos guardian who does not desecrate it],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 For the perfection of the Da'as
 of the holy Shabbos
 also depends on the drawing close of converts —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "atah u'vanecha v'chol haggid —
 v'gercha asher bishearecha
 [you and your sons — and so on —
 and your stranger who is within your gates]"
 — stated concerning the guarding of the holy Shabbos —
 for the more one engages in
 establishing students [la'amid talmidim]
 and converting converts —
 the more Da'as is perfected —
 as explained within.
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "that on Shabbos it is a mitzvah
 to assemble congregations
 and to expound in words of Torah,"
 and so on —
 for through this one's Da'as
 is further perfected —
 and this is the essential holiness of Shabbos.
 And also — the students themselves
 also have a share in the holiness of Shabbos —
 and through the fact that one teaches them
 and completes their Da'as —
 through this the holiness of Shabbos
 grows even greater —
 and the holiness of Shabbos — the Da'as
 and the mental faculties —
 also shines even more upon the teacher.
 And this is what our Sages expounded:
 "la'asos es haShabbas l'dorosaym"
 — from the language of dwelling [dirah] —
 that is — for the perfection of Da'as
 one merits on Shabbos —
 one also needs fear [yirah] —
 that one's fear should precede one's wisdom —
 and fear is the aspect of a beautiful dwelling —
 as explained within —
 and it too is encompassed
 within the holiness of Shabbos —
 in the aspect of:
 "yira Shabbas
 [one who fears Shabbos]"
 — as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: וזה בחינת ויקהל משה את כל עדת בני ישראל ודרשו רז"ל שכל חכם הדור צריך להקהיל קהלות בכל שבת ושבת ולדרוש להם בדברי תורה. ועיקר הדרשה הוא להורות לעם את חוקי אלקים ותורותיו ולהכניס יראת ה' בלבם כמבואר במגן אברהם בשלחן ערוך אורח חיים סימן ר"צ. וזה מוטל גם על כל אחד לפי בחינתו. כי בכל ימי המעשה הוא טרוד במלאכתו ועסקיו ועל כן בשבת על כל פנים שאז לבו פנוי והוא מיסב ומתוועד עם בני ביתו ואז על כל פנים צריך לדבר על לבם דברי מוסר ויראת ה' ולקרבם לעבודת השם יתברך שזה עיקר קדושת שבת כמו שכתוב כי אות הוא ביני וביניכם לדורותיכם לדעת כי אני ה' מקדשכם. וכשמשתמש עם המלכות רק בשביל השם יתברך אז המלכות בבחינת בן חורין שזה בחינת מר דרור כמבואר בפנים. היינו שאז המלכות שהוא בבחינת שבת הקטן מקבלת הארה מבחינת יובל בחינת בינה שהוא בחינת שבת הגדול כמבואר בתיקונים וכנ"ל כמה פעמים. ושבת הגדול בחינת בינה הוא בחינת עולם הבא כידוע. ועולם הבא הוא יום שכולו ארוך ועל ידי זה ממשיכין אריכת ימים לתוך המלכות.
segments.en:
And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha —
 me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot —
 from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — that is, he should withhold himself
 from walking and wandering with his feet on the roads —
 and likewise from other labors
 done during the weekdays
 for the turmoil of earning a livelihood —
 for all of this is drawn from the aspect of
 a deficiency of Da'as —
 that during the weekdays
 one does not merit to receive
 the perfection of the mental faculties and Da'as —
 and for this reason one wearies oneself
 then for a livelihood —
 in the aspect of:
 "shatu ha'am v'laktu —
 b'shitusa
 [the people went about and gathered —
 in their foolishness]"
 [Numbers 11:8 — and see the Zohar] —
 and as explained in the teaching
 Mishrah d'Sakina, Siman 30 —
 and in the teaching
 U'veyom haBikurim, Siman 56.

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל בפרקי דר' אליעזר פרק י"ח. כל המברך על היין בלילי שבתות מאריכין לו ימיו ושנותיו בעולם הזה וזוכה לחיי עולם הבא. כי היין כלול משני בחינות שבת הנ"ל היינו מבחינת בינה ומלכות כמבואר בפנים לעיל סימן י"ב עיין שם. ועל כן הקידוש של שבת נקרא קריאה כמו שכתוב וקראת לשבת ענג ודרשו רז"ל במקום קריאה שם יהא ענג.
segments.en:
But on Shabbos — which is the aspect of
 the perfection of Da'as —
 then all the labors and weekday deeds are nullified.
 And also:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha,"
 and so on —
 alludes to the perfection of the sacred union
 of Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.
 And also:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha"
 alludes to children —
 in the aspect of:
 "bera kara d'avuha
 [a son is the leg of his father]."
 And likewise — the students are in the aspect of [Exodus 11:8]:
 "v'chol ha'am asher b'raglecha
 [and all the people who are at your feet]."
 And this too is the aspect of:
 "me'asos chafatzecha"
 and so on —
 for the sacred fathering of children —
 and likewise the establishing of students —
 through all of which Da'as
 is further drawn and revealed —
 this is the essential affairs of Heaven —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 42:21]:
 "Hashem chafetz l'ma'an tzidko —
 yagdil Torah v'ya'adir
 [Hashem desired — for the sake of His righteousness —
 to magnify the Torah and to make it glorious]."
 And it is written [Ezekiel 18:23]:
 "hachafetz achphotz —
 v'chol haggid —
 ki im b'shuv rasha
 [do I truly desire —
 and so on —
 except in the repentance of the wicked]"
 and so on —
 which is the aspect of penitents and converts.
 And it is written [Micah 7:18]:
 "ki chafetz chesed hu
 [for He desires lovingkindness]."
 And Chesed is the aspect of the teaching
 one imparts to students —
 which is the aspect of:
 "Toras chesed
 [a Torah of lovingkindness]"
 [Proverbs 31:26] —
 and as explained elsewhere.
 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg —
 liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight —
 the holy one of Hashem, honored]."
 For in the perfection of Da'as
 and the mental faculties —
 there is the essential delight and honor —
 as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: היינו שיהיה קידוש במקום סעודה. כי הוא בבחינת וקרא בו כל ימי חייו כי קורא על ידו את חי החיים להמשיך ממנו חיים ואריכת ימים. כי שבת שמא דקודשא בריך הוא. ועל ידי הקידוש שמקיים בזה זכור את יום השבת הוא קורא בזה את חי החיים בשמו יתברך להמשיך ממנו חיים ואריכת ימים.
segments.en:
And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 "she'lo yifsa'a pis'ayah gasah
 [one should not take large strides]"
 — in the manner of what our Sages expounded
 [on the verse]:
 "al tirgazu badarech
 [do not quarrel on the way]"
 [Genesis 45:24] —
 "al tifsa'u pis'ayah gasah
 [do not take large strides],"
 and so on —
 for the teaching of students —
 for the sake of attaining through it
 the perfection of Da'as —
 must be in the aspect of:
 "Toras chesed
 [a Torah of lovingkindness]"
 — and there should be no grip whatsoever
 of harshness and anger within it —
 in the aspect of:
 "lo hakpadan melameid
 [a short-tempered person cannot teach]."
 As our Sages of blessed memory taught
 regarding the drawing close of converts —
 in the story of Hillel and Shammai —
 and likewise in the story of
 Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua.
 And even though one certainly must
 be very diligent
 to attain the perfection of Da'as
 — nonetheless one must also be deliberate in the matter —
 especially regarding children and students —
 as understood from the words of our Sages.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "hevu mesunim b'din —
 v'ha'amidu talmidim harbeh
 [be deliberate in judgment —
 and raise up many students]"
 [Avos 1:1] —
 and as explained elsewhere.
 And likewise in its plain meaning —
 for the large stride that runs hastily
 to attain one's personal affairs
 comes only from the aspect of a deficiency of Da'as —
 for the person of true Da'as knows
 that everything is in the hands of Heaven —
 and at every time —
 and no person touches what is prepared for another —
 and what is yours — they will give to you.
 And especially because the desires of this world
 are all vanity —
 and why should one pursue and run after them —
 what does it matter if one obtains them or not —
 as is elaborated at length
 in the books of ethics [sifrei mussar].
 And therefore the large stride for one's personal affairs
 is a blemish in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the perfection of Da'as.
 But for a matter of mitzvah —
 it is a mitzvah to run even on Shabbos —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Berachos 6b]:
 "le'olam yarutz adam l'dvar mitzvah
 afilu b'Shabbas
 [a person should always run toward a matter of mitzvah
 even on Shabbos]"
 — for this is the aspect of [Hosea 6:3]:
 "v'neid'ah nirdefa lada'as es Hashem
 [and let us know — let us eagerly pursue
 to know Hashem]."
 For since this large stride
 is for the sake of attaining the perfection of Da'as —
 which itself is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 therefore it is a mitzvah to run.
 And this:
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — he should guard himself
 from speaking any weekday speech
 that has within it the grip of foolishness —
 in the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 10:14]:
 "v'hasachal yarbeh bidvarim
 [and the fool multiplies words]."
 But one should engage only in sacred matters
 and words of Torah —
 which are the aspects of the perfection of Da'as.
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — that is, he will merit to attain
 the very highest mental faculties —
 which are the aspect of Atika Kadisha
 [the Holy Ancient One].

segments.he: וזה בחינת השבעים תיבות שבקידוש בחינת ימי שנותינו בהם שבעים שנה. גם עיקר עסק התורה שהיא שמא דקודשא בריך הוא הוא בשבת. כי אז קורין בציבור בתורה כשרה ומשלימין כל הפרשיות שבתורה שכולם הם שמותיו יתברך כידוע ועל ידי זה ממשיכין אריכת ימים לתוך המלכות מבחינת השלש ראשונות שהם חב"ד ששם מקור החיים בחינת החכמה תחיה שזה בחינת קדושת שבת שהוא עולם המחשבה שהוא עיקר החיות כי עיקר קדושת שבת נמשך מבחינת שלש ראשונות בחינת כי קדש הוא כמבואר בכתבי האריז"ל. אך שם החיות הוא בבחינת ריבוי אור. כי שם הוא בבחינת למעלה מן המדות. ועל כן צריכין להמשיך החיות על ידי התורה דייקא שהוא בחינת עמודא דאמצעיתא שכולל כל המדות ועל ידה דייקא קורין החיות לתוך המדות והימים. ועל ידי זה זוכין לאריכת ימים שממשיכין אריכת ימים לתוך המלכות.
segments.en:
"v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz
 [and I will cause you to ride
 upon the heights of the earth]"
 — the aspect of the nullification
 of the Malchus d'Sitra Achra —
 which is the aspect of foolishness —
 the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 4:13]:
 "melech zaken u'chesil
 [an old and foolish king]"
 — and the holy Malchus shall be exalted —
 whose essential building is through Da'as
 and the mental faculties — as is well-known —
 for this is the aspect of [Proverbs 3:19–20]:
 "Hashem b'chochmah yasad aretz
 [Hashem through wisdom founded the earth],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — for Yaakov merited in its perfection
 to draw the birth of children in holiness —
 for his bed was perfect [mitaso sheleimah].
 And it is stated concerning him [Genesis 21:12]:
 "ki b'Yitzchak yikare lecha zara
 [for through Yitzchak shall your descendants be called]"
 — "v'lo chol Yitzchak
 [and not all of Yitzchak]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 And he merited the most perfect Da'as
 — to such a degree —
 that his Da'as drew sustenance
 from the very Da'as of G-d, blessed be He, as it were —
 for this is the aspect of what our Sages taught:
 that G-d, blessed be He, called Yaakov Kel
 [a divine name].
 For:
 "Kel nehiru d'chochmesah
 [Kel — the illumination of wisdom]."
 And he is the aspect of the totality of the Patriarchs —
 who engaged in this —
 to establish children and students —
 and to convert converts —
 and to draw the perfection of Da'as into the world.
 And also — the three aspects mentioned above —
 which are:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem"
 and so on —
 are themselves the aspects of:
 ע'דן נ'הר ג'ן
 — the initial letters spell עֹנֶג [oneg] —
 for this is the aspect of [Genesis 2:10]:
 "v'nahar yotzei mei'Eden l'hashkos es haGan
 [and a river goes out from Eden to water the garden]."
 And this is the aspect of the drawing of the illumination
 from the upper Heh of Avraham
 to the lower Heh of Sarah —
 through which the birth comes —
 as explained in Zohar Chadash Shir haShirim
 on the verse:
 "navu lechayecha
 [your cheeks are beautiful]"
 [Song of Songs 1:10] —
 see there and you will understand.
 And this is what concluded:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — that is — for on Shabbos
 there is drawn the aspect of the opening of speech
 of the upper Heh — the aspect of Binah —
 the aspect of:
 "pum mmallel rabrevian
 [a mouth that speaks great things]"
 [Daniel 7:8] — as is well-known —
 and the opening of speech
 of the aspect of the lower Heh —
 the aspect of Malchus peh —
 and through this Da'as is opened and revealed —
 in the aspect of:
 "mipiv da'as u'sevunah
 [from His mouth — knowledge and understanding]."
 [Proverbs 2:6]
 And through this the birth is accomplished —
 for this is the aspect of what is explained in the writings:
 that on Shabbos the birth of new souls is drawn.
 And this is likewise the aspect of:
 "v'shamru Bnay Yisrael es haShabbas —
 la'asos es haShabbas"
 — to receive the supernal and lower Shechinah —
 as explained in Tikkun 48.
 And this is what concluded:
 "l'dorosaym
 [throughout their generations]."
 For through this the birth comes —
 as mentioned above.

segments.he: ועל כן צריכין לקרות בתורה בפה דייקא בחינת כי חיים הם למוצאיהם בפה וכו' כמבואר בפנים כי מלכות פה.
segments.en: And behold — it is explained within that prayer with devotion of the heart is the aspect of the olah [burnt offering] — and as also understood in the holy Zohar at the beginning of Parashas Tzav.

segments.he: ועל ידי זה מצמצמים החיות ביותר שיהיה בבחינת מדות וימים כנ"ל ועל כן אמרו רז"ל (ברכות ח') כל המשלים פרשיותיו עם הצבור מאריכין לו מימיו ושנותיו. ועיין זוהר יתרו דף צ"ב תלת דרגין אינון שבת עילאה שבת דיומא שבת דלילא וכלהו חד ואיקרי כלא שבת וכו' עיין שם היינו גם כן הג' בחינות הנ"ל שהם מקור החיות הוא בחינת שבת עילאה. והתורה שהוא כלל המדות והימים היא בחינת שבת דיומא. והמלכות הוא בחינת שבת דלילא כידוע. וזה טועמיה חיים זכו כי זוכין על ידי זה לחיים ואריכת ימים כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Shabbos is the aspect of the World to Come —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Berachos 57b].
 And this is the aspect of [Exodus 20:8]:
 "zachor es yom haShabbas
 [remember the day of Shabbos]"
 — and likewise [Deuteronomy 5:12]:
 "shamor es yom haShabbas
 [guard the day of Shabbos]."
 And our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "zachor v'shamor b'dibbur echad ne'emaru
 [Zachor and Shamor were spoken in one utterance]"
 — that is, one must exceedingly guard the memory
 to cleave one's thought to the World to Come
 [l'adabka machshavta b'alma d'ase].
 For Shabbos is the aspect of the World of Thought —
 as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of [Ezekiel 20:20]:
 "v'es Shabsosai kadshu —
 v'chol haggid —
 lada'as ki ani Hashem Elokeichem
 [and My Shabbosim sanctify —
 and so on —
 to know that I am Hashem your G-d]"
 — for Shabbos is the aspect of the Unity of Hashem —
 "da shiruah d'meheimanusah —
 saliku d'machshavah d'alma d'ase
 [this is the beginning of faith —
 the ascent of thought of the World to Come]"
 — as explained within.
 And this memory has both a general aspect
 and a particular aspect:
 that is — one must deeply engage one's thought
 and expand one's understanding —
 to comprehend the hints [remozim]
 within what G-d, blessed be He,
 brings each person at every time —
 through thought, speech, and deed —
 according to the person,
 the place, and the time —
 and clothed within them are hints
 to draw close to His blessed service.
 And these hints are the aspects of
 the holy legs clothed within this world.
 And through the guarding of the aforementioned memory —
 to cleave one's thought to the World to Come
 also in its particular aspect —
 and to understand all the holy hints
 clothed within all worldly engagements —
 through this one fulfills
 the aspects of the holy legs —
 in the aspect of [Proverbs 30:4]:
 "mi hekim kol afsei aretz
 [who has established all the ends of the earth?]"
 — as explained within.

segments.he: ועיקר החיות הוא השכל והדעת שזוכין לקבל על ידי קדושת שבת בחינת לדעת כי אני ה' מקדשכם.
segments.en:
Fourteen aspects of Shabbos listed: (1) Sevi'ah = breaking lust for eating (Siman 276 cross-reference). (2) Light of the face = "anpaha nehirin" / "barchu b'or panav." (3) Emes = truth (many previous simanim). (4) All harsh judgments subdued (Zohar II 88b). (5) Wealth = "birkas Hashem hi ta'ashir" / "vayevarech." (6) "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad" = opposite of shame = "v'yishbot dein v'kalon" (Siman 34). (7) Miracles and wonders = "ot hi l'olam" (Siman 59). (8) Yaakov = first to guard Shabbos. (9) Tefillin = exempt on Shabbos. (10) Totality of colors = Tiferes = "tiferes atah l'yom hamenuchah."
 Isaiah 58 mapping in Siman 47: "Regel" = money and wealth.

segments.he: וכן (יחזקאל כ) לדעת כי אני ה' אלקיכם. ועל ידי הדעת הזה נתגלין כל ההסתרות ואפילו הסתרה שבתוך הסתרה ועל כן אמרו רז"ל בפרקי דר"א כל השומר שבת מוחלין לו על כל עוונותיו. ואמרו רז"ל שבת קיח: אפילו עבד עבודה זרה כדור אנוש מוחלין לו. כי בדור אנוש גברה ההסתרה מאד עד שנתעלם שם ה' כמו שכתוב אז הוחל לקרוא בשם ה' ותרגומו חלו מלצלאה בשמא דה'. אבל על ידי קדושת שבת שמא דקוב"ה חוזר וקורא בשם ה' ונתגלין כל ההסתרות כולם ונמחלין לו כל עוונותיו. וכבר נתבאר שקידוש היום הוא גם כן בחינת קריאה בשמו יתברך שזה בחינת התגלות ההסתרות ועל כן אמרו רז"ל (ברכות כ) נשים חייבות בקידוש היום דבר תורה וכו' אמר קרא זכור ושמור וכו' והני נשי הואיל ואיתנהו בשמירה איתנהו בזכירה, כי אלו שהן בבחינת ההסתרות הן בחינת נשים בג' בחינות כמבואר בפנים. ואף על פי כן איתנהו בשמירה. כי שמור שהוא מדת המלכות כידוע הוא סוף המדריגות כולם. ושוכנת גם אצל אותם שהם בדיוטא התחתונה מאד בבחינת ומלכותו בכל משלה כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש. ועל כן איתנהו נמי בזכירה. זכור הוא מדת התפארת בחינת התורה. כי על ידי עסק התורה ממשיכין חיות שהוא בחינת חכמה ודעת לתוך המלכות עד שעל ידי זה נתגלין כל ההסתרות (שהם מקבלין חיות רק מבחינת המלכות שזה בחינת שמור כנ"ל) ונתהפכין גם כן לדעת ותורה שהוא בחינת זכור בחינת קידוש. כי המוחין נקראים קדש כידוע. (ומה שהנשים פטורות מתלמוד תורה אין כאן מקום לבאר ויבואר במקום אחר אם ירצה השם על פי מאמר זה עצמו) וזה נשים חייבות בקידוש היום דבר תורה. דבר תורה דייקא כי הקידוש הוא בבחינת עסק התורה שעל ידי זה קוראין וממשיכין החיות לתוך המלכות כנ"ל ועל כן זוכין על ידי זה גם כן לאריכת ימים כנ"ל.
segments.en: "Im tashiv miShabbos" acrostic = emes → wealth = "kushta ka'y." Abundance of Eretz Yisrael from Shabbos (Zohar Vayikra 12). "Eretz haChayyim" = "to'amehah chayyim zachu." Lechem mishneh = abundance of Eretz Yisrael = Isaiah 61:7.

segments.he: ועל כן אמרו רז"ל המתפלל בערב שבת ואומר ויכלו וכו' כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשה בראשית.
segments.en: "V'daber davar" = speech perfected → "imrey shafer" → partner in creation. "Kol ha'omer Vayechulu b'Erev Shabbas ka'ilu na'asah shutaf" = ultimate purpose of creation = "b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei"; Providence hidden in nature → denial; Shabbos miracles = nullification of nature → reveals chidush and Providence = "Vayechulu hashamayim v'ha'aretz." "Me'as

segments.he: כי מאחר שהחיות שנמשך מחי החיים יתברך הוא בבחינת למעלה מהמדות והוא טמיר ונעלם מאד על כן אפשר לכפור בכל ח"ו לומר שאין העולם מקבלים כלל חיות ממנו יתברך. ונמצא בטל כוונת הבריאה שהיתה רק בגין דישתמודעין ליה יתברך. על כן כשאומר ויכלו ומגלה שהשם יתברך ברא את הכל והחיות של כלל הבריאה הוא רק שמו יתברך שהוא בחינת שבת שמא דקודשא בריך הוא שזה בחינת ויכל אלקים ביום השביעי מלאכתו אשר עשה כי הוא קיום כל הבריאה.
segments.en: os chafatzecha" = 39 melachos = 39 curses from eating the Tree of Knowledge = "b'itzavon tochlenah" = shames/disgraces = "kilas Elokim talui" = hiding of the face = grip of falsehood; on Shabbos = emes = "hen emes chafatzta" = Tiferes = "v'hayis ateres tiferes… ki chafetz Hashem bach"; life = "mi ha'ish hechafetz chayyim"; Eretz Yisrael = "eretz chefetz." "Call it delight" = three meals = Eden/Nahar/Gan; eating entirely holy; mitzvah to increase in delicacies.

segments.he: ועל כן כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשה בראשית מאחר שעל ידו נתגלה ההסתרה ונתהפך לדעת שהוא עיקר החיות של מעשה בראשית.
segments.en: "Honored" = Tiferes = "v'asisa vigday kodesh l'Aharon… l'chavod u'letifares"; "livshi bigday tifartecha." "From your ways" = through ways one is humiliated; "k'tiferes adam lasheves beis" = no large strides.

segments.he: ועל כן המלאכים המלוים אותו אומרים עליו וסר עוונך וחטאתך תכופר. כי על ידי התגלות ההסתרות זוכה לתשובה שלימה ונמחלין כל עוונותיו כנ"ל. וזה לכו נא ונוכחה יאמר ה' אם יהיו חטאיכם כשנים כשלג ילבינו וכו' היינו כי עיקר העון הוא עלי ידי התגברות החושך וההסתרה עד שנעשה לו כהיתר או כמישור גמור ח"ו. וזה בחינת על אמרך לא חטאתי. והויכוח הוא בירור הדברים בחינת התגלות ההסתרות ותיכף שנתגלין ההסתרות ויודע בידיעה אמתיית שחטא ופגם מאד ושב ומתחרט על זה באמת ומודה ואומר חטאתי ושוב לא אחטא עוד. אזי תיכף מוחלין לו כמו שמצינו אצל דוד המלך עליו השלום שאמר חטאתי ותיכף אמר לו הנביא גם ה' העביר חטאתיך וכו' וכמו שאמרו רז"ל. וזה בחינת לכו נא ונוכחה וכו' ותיכף שיתברר לכם החטא ותתגלה ההסתרה על ידי הויכוח אזי אם יהיו חטאיכם כשנים כשלג ילבינו וכו'.
segments.en:
And this is the aspect of what our Sages expounded:
 "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas
 [remember it from the first day of the week for Shabbos]"
 — for one must find and elevate
 all the holy sparks clothed also within this world —
 which is the aspect of the six weekdays.
 For this is the aspect of the holy hints
 from the aspect of the holiness of the World to Come —
 clothed within all the engagements of this world —
 which is the aspect of the holy legs.

segments.he: ועל כן מצוה לקדש על היין דווקא. כי שתיית יין מביא שכחה בבחינת פן ישתה וישכח מחוקק וכמבואר בליקותי תנינא סימן כ"ו. וזה בחינת ההסתרה ראשונה בחינת נעשה לו כהיתר שזה בחינת נשים לשון שכחה וכשישתה עוד יותר אזי מתגבר עליו ההסתרה שבתוך הסתרה עד שהכל דומה לו כמישור ח"ו וזה בחינת שנשו וקפצו וכו'. וזה בחינת (משלי כ"ג) אל תרא יין כי יתאדם כי יתן בכוס עינו יתהלך במשרים ופירש רש"י המרבה בשכרות כל העבירות דומות לו כמישור וכן אמרו רז"ל (יומא עד) אבל קידוש על היין הוא בחינת התגלות ההסתרות כמו שכתוב זכור את יום השבת זכריהו על היין וזכרון הוא היפך השכחה וההסתרה. וזה בחינת זכרו כיין לבנון (הושע יד) כי היין דקדושה הוא בחינת התגלות הדעת כמבואר בפנים בסימן כ' ועל ידי זה נתגלין ההסתרות ונתהפכין לדעת שזה בחינת אם יהיו חטאיכם כשנים כשלג ילבינו כנ"ל וזה שתירגם כחמר עתיק וכו' כי הדעת הזה הוא בחינת אריכות ימים שממשיך לתוך המלכות ואריכות ימים הוא בחינת עתיק כמובא לקמן בפנים סימן ס' במאמר פתח ר"ש. ועל ידי הדעת הזה נתגלין ההסתרות ואז התורה בעצמה מוכיחה אותם בבחינת אורייתא מכרזת קמייהו וכו' ומזה נמשך הרהורי תשובה שבאין לכל אחד מישראל על ידי קדושת שבת וכנ"ל כמה פעמים והכל מחמת שזוכין לשמוע אז קול הכרוז והקריאה והתוכחה של התורה הקדושה וזה בחינת הז' קולות שבמזמור לדוד שאומרין בכניסת שבת קודש ואמרו רז"ל שהם כנגד השבעה קולות של מתן תורה. כי בכניסת שבת נשמע לכל אחד כפי בחינתו קול הכרוזים של התורה הקדושה שהם מבחינת הקולות של מתן תורה ועל כן הם זיין קולות כי התורה כלולה משבע מדות. ועל כן עיקר זמן התגלות סתרי תורה הוא בשבת. כי על ידי התגלות ההסתרות שבתוך הסתרות נתגלין סתרי תורה כמובא בפנים.
segments.en: "Your affairs / speaking words" = only "imrey shafer." "Then delight" = perfect rectification of eating = "v'tis'anag b'deshen nafshechem" (Isaiah 55:2); partner in creation = Hakadosh baruch Hu gozer v'tzadik mevatel = Midrash Rabbah Beshalach = "al Hashem"; "given all desires of heart." Zohar II 88b: Atika Kadisha = light of truth = light of face = Atik. "Ki az al Shadai titanag" = Shadai = shidud hamaarachah = nullification of nature. "V'tissa el Elo'ah panecha" = lifting of the face. "Heights of earth" = ascent of Malchus = holiness of Eretz Yisrael = Malchus; plain: higher than all lands; saved from subjugation = shame of hiding of face. "Heritage of Yaakov" = Tiferes = emes = tefillin = aur hapanim; nachalah b'li metzarim: emes = rosh-toch-sof = from Atik down to "emes mei'eretz titzmach"; create new heavens/earth with one's words. "Ki pi Hashem diber" = his words = davar Hashem; "rosh devarcha emes"; rectification of eating = rectification of speech (Siman 62); Tiferes = rectification of speech = "divray pi chacham chein" (Siman 58); tefillin = speech (Rashi end of Bo on "ul'totafot bein einecha" / "hatef el darom").

segments.he: ועל כן הכל מודים שבשבת ניתנה תורה כי אז נתגלין ההסתרות ונעשה מהם תורה שזה בחינת מה שהשיב משה רבינו עליו השלום להמלאכים למצרים ירדתם יצר הרע יש בכם קנאה יש בכם וכו' כי דייקא על ידי התגברות ההסתרות שהתגברו על ישראל בגלות מצרים וכן ברוחניות התגברות היצר הרע וכו' על ידי זה כשבא משה רבינו עליו השלום שהוא בחינת הדעת ונתגלו ההסתרות נעשה מזה תורה. שזה בחינת מה שהתחיל בדיבור ראשון של עשרת הדברות אנכי ה' אלקיך אשר הוצאתיך מארץ מצרים היינו בחינת התגלות ההסתרות והזהיר תיכף על איסור עבודה זרה שעל ידי זה עיקר תוקף התגברות ההסתרות שבתוך הסתרות בחינת ואנכי הסתר אסתיר וכו' כי פנה אל אלקים אחרים והזהיר על שבועת שוא והזכרת שם שמים לבטלה. כי בהזכרת שם שמים קוראין את חי החים בשמו יתברך להמשיך ממנו חיות ועל כן צריכין ליזהר שלא להזכירו לבטלה ח"ו ומכל שכן שלא לישא שם ה' לשוא ח"ו. ואחר כך הזהיר על שבת שהוא שמא דקוב"ה שמצוה לזכרו בחינת זכור את יום השבת לקדשו בכדי להמשיך על ידו חיות דקדושה והתגלות הדעת שעל ידי זה נתגלין ההסתרות וזה בחינת ישמחו במלכותך שומרי שבת וכו' כי על ידי המלכות דקדושה שהוא בחינת קדושת שבת נתגלין ההסתרות ונעשה תורה שנקראת טוב בחינת אין טוב אלא תורה כמבואר בפנים. וזה עם מקדשי שביעי כולם ישבעו ויתענגו מטובך וזה שכתוב בהזהרת שבת אתה ובנך ובתך וכו' וגרך אשר בשעריך. כי קדושת שבת כולל כל המדות כולם כי הוא בחינת סוף מעשה בחינת המלכות שהוא בחינת סוף דבר והוא בחינת מאסף לכל המחנות כמבואר בפנים. וזה בחינת היראה של שבת בחינת מוראה של מלכות וזה בחינת ובני הנכר הנלוים על ה' וכו' כל שומר שבת מחללו וכו' והביאותים אל הר קדשי כי קדושת שבת כולל ומאסף לכל המדריגות כולם אפילו לאותם שהיו בבחינת הסתרה שבתוך הסתרה כנ"ל:
segments.en:
"Aseh Shabbatecha chol v'al titztarech la'briyos" = blemish Tiferes → dependent on others → face changes in many colors from shame; honor/delight of Shabbos = Tiferes = three meals = three Patriarchs = totality of colors; "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas."
 

 Siman 48 — סימן מח
 Al Asher Ma'altem — "Because you acted unfaithfully…"
 [Numbers 27:14]
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 48]

 It is known that Shabbos is likewise the aspect of Binah —
 as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: ומחמת שכנגד מלכות דקדושה יש מלכות הרשעה בחינת מלכות המן עמלק על כן אמרו רז"ל ויצאו מן העם ללקוט וכו' מיד ויבא עמלק. ועל כן היה עינו של המן הרשע רעה מאד בשבתות וימים טובים של ישראל ומסר אותם לפני המלך דדחי לכולא שתא בשבת היום פסח היום וכו' כמו שאמרו רז"ל. כי עיקר הכנעתו על ידי קדושת שבת ויום טוב וכמבואר גם בסימן קל"ה ובסימן ל'. ועל כן התחלת סיפור המגילה מענין הריגת ושתי (שעל ידי זה באתה אסתר לבית המלך ועל ידי זה דייקא היה מפלת המן) היה ביום השבת כמו שכתוב ביום השביעי כטוב לב המלך ביין וכו' ואמרו רז"לשהיה בשבת ונתן המן בעצמו דייקא עצה להרוג את ושתי כי בתוקף ההסתרות יש גם שם חיות אלקותו יתברך בבחינת ומלכותו בכל משלה. ועל ידי זה באתה אסתר לשם ונהרג המן אחר כך ונשברה ההסתרה ואחר כמה דורות נתגלה התורה שהיה מלובש בתוך גוף ההסתרה בעצמה עד שמבני בניו של המן למדו תורה בבני ברק. ובכלל ישראל נתהפכה ההסתרה תיכף לתורה כי דייקא על ידי זה קבלו התורה מחדש כמו שאמרו רז"ל הדר קבלוה בימי אחשורוש. ומחמת שמלכות הרשעה בחינת המן עמלק הוא מאסף ממון. ואחר כך כשמתגבר מרדכי בחינת מלכות דקדושה הוא מוציא בלעו מפיו כי מוציא ממנו כל העשירות בבחינת חיל בלע ויקיאנו. ועל כן על ידי קדושת שבת זוכין לעשירות כנ"ל ונעשה מזה תורה שנקראת אשת חיל כמבואר בפנים. וזה בעצמו בחינת קדושת שבת שהוא בחינת אשת חיל עטרת בעלה וכו' כידוע בחינת כנסת ישראל יהיה בן זוגך וכמבואר לקמן בסימן רע"ז בפנים.
segments.en:
And it is likewise the aspect of Sukkah —
 the aspect of:
 "HaPoreis sukkah shalom
 [Who spreads a canopy of peace],"
 and so on —
 which one recites on Shabbos —
 and then is the essential illumination
 of the twenty-eight letters of the work of creation
 and the ten utterances [asarah ma'amoros] —
 for Shabbos is a remembrance of the work of creation.
 And this is the aspect of the great Chesed
 that shines on Shabbos —
 the aspect of [Psalms 89:3]:
 "ki amarti olam chesed yibbaneh
 [for I said: the world shall be built with lovingkindness]."

 And behold — it is explained in the holy Zohar
 that Shabbos is the aspect of the holy speech —
 as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: ולפי הגדלת הדעת כן הפרנסה בנקל וכן נתרבה הרחמנות והשלום ונתבטל הכעס והאכזריות. ועל כן בשבת אסור לטרוח שום טירחה עבור פרנסה וכמו שכתוב את אשר תאפו אפו וכו' וכתיב היום לא תמצאוהו בשדה רק מי שטרח בערב שבת יאכל בשבת ומשבת נמשך שפע הפרנסה לכל ימות השבוע כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש וכן בשבת נתרבה השלום בחינת שבת שלום ונתרבה הרחמנות בחינת יכולה היא שתרחם וכן שבת הוא מלזעוק וכו' ורחמיו מרובין ושבתו בשלום (שבת יב) כי בשבת עולה הזעיר אנפין על הדיקנא דאריך אנפין שהם תליסר מכילין דרחמי כידוע. ועל כן יש ליזהר בטבילת המקוה לכבוד שבת. כי מקוה הוא בחינת שכל עליון ורחמים גדולים כמבואר בפנים ועל כן אכילת שבת הוא בבחינת מן כמובא שבשביל זה צריכין להניח הלחם בין שתי מפות זכר למן וכן מבואר בהגהת רמ"א סימן רמ"ב שנוהגין לעשות פשטידא זכר למן. כי מן הוא בחינת השכל עליון הנ"ל כמבואר בפנים. גם מ"ן ראשי תיבות מ'אמר נ'אמן בחינת מאמר פתוח נאמן פשוט שנפתח הדיבור ונתגלה הדעת ונתפשט נאמנותו יתברך שהוא יתברך מבטיח ועושה חסד וזה בחינת ודבר דבר הנאמר בשבת וכמבואר בזוהר הקדוש ששבת הוא בחינת הדיבור שזה בחינת מאמר פתוח ועל ידי זה נתפשט נאמנותו וחסדו יתברך שזה בחינת החסד עליון שנמשך ונתגלה בשבת כידוע.
segments.en:
And likewise it is explained in the holy Zohar
 that on Shabbos the aspect of holy spirit
 [ruach hakodesh]
 is drawn upon each and every person of Israel —
 and therefore it is very good to pray then —
 and to put all one's strength into prayer —
 for the words of prayer are then
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 51:16]:
 "v'asim devarai b'ficha —
 u'vetzal yadi kisisicha
 [and I shall place My words in your mouth —
 and in the shadow of My hand I have covered you]"
 — the aspect of the embrace
 [chibbuk] — as explained within —
 for then is the time of the revelation
 of the closeness and the love
