 Tzadik and Keneses Yisrael —
 for then the union is made automatically
 and in the ultimate perfection
 through the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]:
 "vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Yisrael
 [and Moshe gathered the entire congregation of Israel],"
 and so on —
 and warned them then
 about the work of the Mishkan
 and about the holiness of Shabbos —
 that the work of the Mishkan
 does not override Shabbos —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 Moshe and the entire congregation of Israel —
 they are the aspects of
 Tzadik and Keneses Yisrael —
 and their union is also made
 through buying and selling with faith
 and with great holiness —
 until it is in the aspect of
 the work of the Mishkan —
 as mentioned above and as explained elsewhere.
 But nonetheless it does not override Shabbos —
 for the holiness of Shabbos is very exalted —
 and then the union of Tzadik and Keneses Yisrael
 is made in great perfection.
 And likewise the essential perfect ascent
 of the prayers of all the weekdays
 is also on Shabbos — as is well-known.

 And likewise the holy sparks
 and the clarifications that are clarified
 during the weekdays
 through the engagements and the commerce of the weekdays —
 all of it ascends to its perfection
 through the holiness of Shabbos — as is well-known.
 And likewise Shabbos is the aspect of tov ayin [a good eye] —
 for it is called tov [good] —
 as it is written:
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos — tov
 [a psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos — good],"
 and so on —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar,
 vol. I, folio 60.
 And likewise Shabbos is the aspect of
 the three colors of the eye
 and the pupil —
 as explained in Tikkun Shivi'in
 [the Seventieth Tikkun].
 And this is the aspect of [Genesis 2:3]:
 "vayevarech Elokim es yom hashevi'i
 [and G-d blessed the seventh day]"
 — the aspect of [Proverbs 22:9]:
 "tov ayin hu yevorach
 [a good eye — he shall be blessed]."
 And the blessings are the aspects of truth —
 and through this one merits
 clinging [devekus] —
 as explained within.

 And this is the aspect of the light of truth
 that shines on Shabbos —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and then is the essential time
 for perfect clinging to G-d, blessed be He.
 And this itself is the aspect of the holy vitality
 drawn into the heart of each and every person of Israel
 on Shabbos —
 the aspect of:
 "to'amehah chayyim zachu
 [those who taste it have merited life]"
 — the aspect of the light of truth —
 which is the sign of life [simana d'chayyay] —
 and as explained in Siman 23 —
 and the aspect of the holy clinging —
 which is the essential vitality —
 as it is written:
 "v'atem hadevekim —
 v'chol haggid —
 chayyim kulchem
 [and you who cling —
 and so on —
 all of you are alive]"
 [Deuteronomy 4:4] —
 and it is written [Deuteronomy 30:20]:
 "u'ledavkah vo ki hu chayyecha
 [and to cleave to Him — for He is your life],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And the essential clinging is in the heart —
 as understood within in Siman 22.
 And there is the essential vitality —
 as it is written [Proverbs 4:23]:
 "ki mimenu totzaos chayyim
 [for from it go forth the sources of life]."
 And it is written [Psalms 22:27]:
 "yichi levavechem la'ad
 [may your heart live forever]."
 And Shabbos itself is likewise the aspect of the heart —
 as explained in the Tikunim.
 And it is likewise the aspect of eyes —
 as mentioned above —
 for:
 "shuryano d'eina b'liba talya
 [the cord of the eye depends on the heart]"
 — as explained within.
 And therefore also regarding the desecration of Shabbos,
 heaven forfend — it is stated [Ezekiel 20:16]:
 "v'es Shabsosai chilellu —
 ki acharay gilluleihem libam holech
 [and My Shabbosim they desecrated —
 for after their idols their heart goes],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And there afterward it states [Ezekiel 20:24]:
 "v'es Shabsosai chilellu —
 v'acharay gillulei avosam hayu eineihem
 [and My Shabbosim they desecrated —
 and after the idols of their fathers
 were their eyes]"
 — the aspect of the blemish of the heart and the eyes
 mentioned above.

 And because the kingdom of David —
 the aspect of Mashiach —
 is the aspect of:
 "tov ayin
 [a good eye]"
 — as brought within —
 therefore it is stated [Jeremiah 17:24–25]:
 "v'hayah im shamo'a —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'likaddesh es yom haShabbas —
 v'chol haggid —
 u'va'u v'sha'aray ha'ir hazos —
 melachim v'sarim yoshvim al kisei David
 [and it shall be — if you hearken —
 and so on —
 and sanctify the day of Shabbos —
 and so on —
 and there shall come through the gates of this city —
 kings and princes sitting on the throne of David],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And the root of the kingdom of Mashiach
 is in the aspect of the knot of tefillin
 of G-d, blessed be He —
 as brought within.
 And as also understood in the holy Zohar,
 Lech Lecha, folio 89.
 And this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of:
 "tefillin d'marei alma
 [the tefillin of the Master of the world]"
 — as explained in Zohar Chadash Shir haShirim.
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the rectification
 of the medameh [the faculty of imagination] —
 which is the aspect of the power of animality —
 as brought within.
 For on Shabbos Nogah is encompassed
 within holiness —
 and the evil within it —
 and all the more so the completely impure husks —
 fall and are repelled below.
 And this is the aspect of
 the rectification of the animal soul in a person —
 drawn from the aspect of Nogah — as is well-known —
 and then the evil within it —
 that is, the lusts and the evil loves —
 which are the aspects of the animal loves —
 fall and are nullified from the souls of Israel —
 and then one merits to receive
 the light of holy love —
 the aspect of:
 "v'Shabbas kodshecha b'ahavah u'vratzson hinchaltanu —
 bechinas menucha ahavah
 [and Your holy Shabbos in love and in will
 You granted us as our heritage —
 the aspect of rest of love],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And then even the physical pleasures are very holy —
 for the light of holy love —
 the love of G-d, blessed be He —
 shines within them —
 the aspect of [Song of Songs 7:7]:
 "mah yafit u'mah na'amt —
 ahavah b'ta'anugim
 [how beautiful and how pleasant you are —
 love with delights]."
 For on Shabbos
 the illumination of the sacred Da'as
 is drawn upon each and every person of Israel
 according to his aspect —
 in the aspect of:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem
 [to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you]"
 — through which the medameh is rectified —
 and the animality is subdued —
 and one merits the love of G-d, blessed be He.
 And because through the evil tongue [lashon hara]
 and the blemish of speech
 one falls into the aspect of foolishness —
 the aspect of animality —
 which is the opposite of the holiness of Shabbos —
 of which it is stated:
 "v'daber davar
 [and speaking words]"
 — for it is the aspect of the holiness of speech —
 as mentioned above many times
 in the name of the Zohar —
 therefore it is stated [Ezekiel 22:9]:
 "v'es Shabsosai chilellas —
 anshey rachil hayu vach
 [and My Shabbosim you desecrated —
 slanderers were among you],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 For the desecration of Shabbos and evil speech
 are from one aspect.

 For through these one blemishes Da'as
 and falls into foolishness
 and evil lusts —
 the animal loves.
 Which is the aspect of the blemishes and sins
 enumerated there —
 and see within —
 explained there in the name of the holy Zohar —
 that this medameh
 was created on Erev Shabbos at twilight —
 and the day became holy upon it —
 and no body was created for it, and so on —
 and from this it is also explained
 that the subduing of the medameh
 is through the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן פה-פוסעים בו
segments.en: And in this one can understand what our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — and so on — for on the first Shabbos not every person merits to receive the inner dimension of its holiness in fullness. Only through the fact that after the Shabbos — his heart aches greatly that the Shabbos passed in such smallness [katnus]. And this is the aspect of: "keivan she'shavas — vav — avdah nefesh" — for this aspect encompasses everything — even one who is at a very small level — and does not merit on Shabbos itself to delight and take pleasure in the fullness of the holiness of the extra soul of Shabbos — nonetheless after the Shabbos he feels the pain of the departure of his extra soul that he merited to receive on Shabbos — which is the aspect of: "vav — avdah nefesh."

segments.he: ממילא מובן כי ענין זה נאמר לענין קדושת שבת שאז היחוד בשלימות פנים בפנים כמבואר בכתבים:
segments.en:
And therefore the essential time
 for the perfection of Torah novellae [chidushay Torah]
 is on Shabbos —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 for then one merits true Torah novellae —
 and the evil within the power
 of the medameh has no share in them.
 And this is the aspect of the joy of Shabbos —
 for then the medameh is nullified —
 which is the aspect of sadness of spirit —
 an evil spirit —
 a spirit of foolishness [ruach shetus] —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 14:3]:
 "b'yom hani'ach Hashem Elokecha lecha
 mei'itzevonecha u'mirogzecha
 [on the day Hashem your G-d gives you rest —
 from your suffering and your anger],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And upon each and every person of Israel
 is drawn joy and a noble spirit —
 a good spirit —
 which is the aspect of a spirit of prophecy —
 the holy spirit —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.

 And this is the aspect of the zemiros
 and melodies sung on Shabbos —
 in the aspect of:
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos"
 — and in the Temple they would make music
 with musical instruments —
 in the aspect of:
 "alay asor v'alay navel —
 alay higayon b'chinor —
 ki simachtani Hashem b'fo'olecha —
 b'ma'aseh yadecha aranen
 [upon a ten-stringed instrument —
 and upon a lyre —
 upon the higgayon with the harp —
 for You have gladdened me, Hashem, through Your work —
 in the works of Your hands I shall shout for joy]."
 For through this
 the good spirit is perfectly clarified
 from the evil spirit —
 in the aspect of [I Samuel 16:23]:
 "v'nigen b'yado v'tov lecha
 [and he would play with his hand — and it was good for you]"
 — and the medameh is subdued —
 and one merits the aforementioned memory —
 the aspect of:
 "l'adabka machshavta b'alma d'ase
 [to cleave one's thought to the World to Come]"
 — and to understand all the hints
 of the aspect of the World to Come
 clothed within this world.

 For this is the aspect of:
 "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem —
 me'od amku machshevosecha —
 v'chol haggid —
 ki hineh oyvecha yove'du —
 yitparedu kol po'aley aven
 [how great are Your works, Hashem —
 how very deep are Your thoughts —
 and so on —
 for behold — Your enemies shall perish —
 all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered]"
 (who are the aspects of the husks and the medameh)
 "vatarom kir'eim karni —
 balossi b'shemen ra'anan
 [and You raised my horn like a wild ox —
 I am anointed with fresh oil]"
 (the aspect of the kingdom of Mashiach —
 who is called by this name —
 for he is anointed with oil).
 And this:
 "vatabet eyni b'shurai
 [and my eye has looked upon my enemies]"
 — the aspect of the subduing of the evil eye.
 "tzadik k'samar yifrach
 [the righteous shall flourish like a palm tree],"
 and so on —
 and our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 "mah tamar v'erez —
 libam mechuvvanin l'ma'alah —
 af tzadikim libam mechuvvan l'ma'alah
 laKadosh baruch Hu
 [just as the date palm and the cedar —
 their hearts are directed upward —
 so too the righteous —
 their hearts are directed upward
 to the Holy One, blessed be He]"
 — that is, all their words and deeds
 are not plain —
 and all their deeds are for the sake of Heaven —
 and there are great secrets within them.
 "mah tamar v'erez yesh lahem ta'avah —
 af tzadikim —
 v'chol haggid —
 u'mah hi ta'avosam —
 haKadosh baruch Hu
 [just as the date palm and the cedar have desire —
 so too the righteous —
 and so on —
 and what is their desire? —
 the Holy One, blessed be He]"
 and so on —
 that is, they merit the love of G-d, blessed be He.
 "mah tamarah zu ein bah pesolet
 [just as this date palm has no waste],"
 and so on —
 that is, they merit to understand
 the holy hints clothed within every matter —
 even the engagements of this world.
 And this:
 "k'erez baLevanon yisgeh
 [he shall grow tall like a cedar in Lebanon]."
 And the Zohar expounded [Vayikra, folio 16]:
 "Levanon — hu bechinas ayin lo ra'asah
 [Lebanon — it is the aspect of:
 'no eye has seen'],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — that is, the aspect of the World to Come —
 which is the aspect of:
 "ayin lo ra'asah
 [no eye has seen]"
 — as our Sages expounded.
 And this:
 "shesulim b'veit Hashem
 [planted in the house of Hashem]"
 — (which is the aspect of inwardness)
 — that is, their thought is always cleaving
 to the World to Come in general.
 "b'chatzros Elokeinu yifrachu
 [in the courtyards of our G-d they shall flourish]"
 — (the courtyard is the aspect of externality —
 as also explained within in Siman 56)
 — "yifrachu
 [they shall flourish]"
 — that is, they merit to produce fruit and flourish
 even from the external matters
 of the engagements of this world —
 through the fact that they merit
 to deepen their thought
 to understand the hints within them —
 and to cleave their thought
 even through them to the World to Come —
 as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of the sacred union of Shabbos —
 for the union comes through the aspect of spirit —
 as it is written [Joshua 2:11]:
 "v'lo kamah od ruach b'ish
 [and there arose no more spirit in a person]."
 And during the weekdays
 there is a grip on the union
 from the aspect of the power
 of the medameh —
 the power of animality —
 which is the aspect of the evil spirit —
 the spirit of foolishness.
 Until sometimes it is the aspect of [Hosea 4:12]:
 "ruach zenutim
 [a spirit of immorality]"
 — and as our Sages expounded
 on the verse:
 "ki sisteh ishto
 [when his wife strays]."
 [Numbers 5:12]
 But on Shabbos —
 then the union is in the aspect of
 a holy spirit — a good spirit.
 And as explained in Zohar Terumah,
 folio 136 —
 on the matter of the holiness of the Shabbos union:
 "u'va'ay l'inon chachmim —
 l'meimar chad pesuka d'is'arus d'ha'i rucha ila'ah kadisha
 d'is'atara b'Shabbas —
 k'gon:
 'ruach Hashem Elokim alai —
 v'chol haggid —
 b'lechtam yeleichu —
 v'chol haggid —
 el asher yihyeh shamah haruach laleches yeleichu' —
 v'chol haggid —
 b'gin d'mis'atrin b'ha'i rucha —
 b'is'arus d'lehon —
 b'chedva d'shimmusha —
 v'yihavei neguido d'ha'i rucha ila'ah d'Shabbas
 b'ha'i shimmusa d'mitzvah
 [and it is necessary for the wise men —
 to recite one verse
 to arouse this holy supernal spirit
 that crowns itself on Shabbos —
 such as:
 'the spirit of the L-rd G-d is upon me —
 and so on —
 wherever they walk they shall go —
 and so on —
 wherever the spirit shall go — they shall go' —
 and so on —
 so that they should be crowned with this spirit —
 with their awakening —
 with the joy of the union —
 and the drawing of this supernal Shabbos spirit
 shall be through this union of mitzvah]."
 And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:4]:
 "ki choh amar Hashem la'sarisim
 asher yishmeru es Shabsosai —
 u'vachartu ba'asher chafatzti
 [for so says Hashem to the sarisim —
 who guard My Shabbosim —
 and choose that which I desire]"
 — and the Zohar expounded — Zohar Yisro, folio 89 —
 on the matter of the holiness of the union
 of Torah scholars from Shabbos to Shabbos.

 And this is what concluded:
 "v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai —
 yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos
 [and I shall give them in My house and within My walls —
 a hand and a name better
 than sons and daughters],"
 and so on —
 that is, they merit the aspect of
 the holy hand — as explained within —
 through which comes the essential
 subduing of the medameh
 and the clarification of the good spirit
 from the evil spirit.
 And the clarification of the medameh
 is the aspect of a good name [shem tov].
 For the names of all things
 exist only through the power of imagination —
 which assigns its own name to each and every thing —
 in order to picture it well
 through the power of imagination —
 and also so that it is inscribed through this
 in the power of memory.
 For the memory of every thing is its name —
 as explained elsewhere —
 and the power of memory
 is also through the power of the medameh —
 the power of imagination —
 as explained in the teaching
 Tefillah l'Chavakuk, Siman 19.
 And therefore when one merits to clarify
 the medameh in its perfection —
 until it is only in the aspect of
 the good spirit — the spirit of prophecy —
 the aspect of the aforementioned memory —
 which one merits through the aspect of
 the hand of Hashem —
 in the aspect of [Hosea 12:11]:
 "u'veyad hanevi'im adammeh
 [and through the hand of the prophets I make Myself known]"
 — as explained within —
 through this one also merits:
 "shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos —
 shem olam etein lo — asher lo yikaret
 [a good name better than sons and daughters —
 an eternal name I shall give him —
 that shall not be cut off]"
 — for his name and good memory endure
 for generations of the world —
 since he merited through the holiness of Shabbos
 to the aspect of the clarification of the medameh
 and the perfect guarding of the memory —
 to cleave one's thought to the World to Come in its perfection.
 Therefore also his good name:
 "l'zecher olam yihyeh tzadik
 [the memory of the righteous is for eternity]"
 [Psalms 112:6] —
 and as also understood within.

segments.he: סימן פו-פוסעים בו
segments.en: Likewise — regarding Shabbos — one merits through this to receive the holiness of Shabbos in fullness — and then the redemption will come. And in this one can also explain the matter of: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — that is, to prepare one's thought for the holiness of Shabbos throughout all the days of the week — and likewise also in deed — in the aspect of: "mei'chad b'Shabbis l'Shabbasa." For perhaps one does not hold in the fullness of trust — through which one makes a vessel for the bounty — that it should come in its time — and then perhaps the bounty of Shabbos can come to him after Shabbos — or it may not come to him until after a long time. Therefore one must hasten to prepare for Shabbos immediately on the first day of the week. And this was the trait of Shammai — who was from the aspect of judgment — from where comes the grip of mochin d'katnus — the aspect of "achar hadevarim." But Hillel — who was from the attribute of lovingkindness — the aspect of mochin d'gadlus — from which comes the aspect of complete trust — and therefore he would say: "baruch Hashem yom yom [blessed be Hashem day by day]" [Psalms 68:20] — and his trust was firm that the bounty of Shabbos would come in its time. But nonetheless — Hillel also agrees that it is better to do as Shammai taught — as explained in the words of the commentators and the later authorities, of blessed memory, in Siman 242 — for not every person and not in every time does one merit to such clear mental faculties and such strong trust. And this is what they stated there regarding Hillel: there was another trait in him — that all his actions were for the sake of Heaven — that is, the inner dimension of the holiness of his thought was always connected in all his actions — for the sake of Heaven — without any labor and effort whatsoever — for he merited to clear mental faculties. And therefore his trust was also very firm — and he would say: "baruch Hashem yom yom" — and so on — as mentioned above.

segments.he: מבואר בפנים כי בימי החול הוא שליטת החיצונים ועיקר השליטה שלהן הוא בבחינת רגלין היינו שאין מניחין להאדם לילך בדרכי השם יתברך וכד אתקדש יומא של שבת קדש כדין יתפרדו כל פועלי און ואז אין להן שליטה כלל ואז חוזר להרגלין כח ההליכה שזה בחינת אם תשיב משבת רגלך. אך אף על פי כן צריך עוד סעד לתמכו והסעד הזה הוא בחינת אמת. ושבת בעצמו הוא בחינת אמת כמבואר בפנים (וזה שמובא בכתבים אם תשיב משבת ראשי תיבות אמת היינו כנ"ל. וזה רגלך כי אז עולין הרגלין כנ"ל והאמת הוא סעד לתומכם כנ"ל) אך עדין צריכין ליתן כח בהם כדי שיוכלו לילך היטב וזה על ידי צדקה של שבת היינו שנותנין לענים על שבת או שמאכסן עני על שלחנו בשבת. והצדקה של שבת הוא בחינת אור השמש העתידה להתחדש לעתיד לבא שתהיה כאור שבעת הימים ועל ידי זה הוא נותן כח לבחינת הרגלין שיוכלו לילך היטב בדרכי השם יתברך כמבואר בפנים:
segments.en:
And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — that one should raise up the holy legs
 clothed in this world as well.
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — that is, through the fact that
 you do all your affairs and engagements of this world
 also in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the World to Come —
 that is, that you merit to understand
 all the holy hints clothed
 also within the engagements of this world —
 through which one raises the holy legs
 to their source and root —
 in the aspect of:
 "mi hekim kol afsei aretz
 [who has established all the ends of the earth?]"
 — as mentioned above.

 And yet — on the holy Shabbos itself —
 one must also refrain from this —
 in the aspect of:
 "ein meleches haMishkan docheh Shabbas
 [the work of the Mishkan does not override Shabbos]"
 — for then one must engage
 in supremely holy sacred services —
 as mentioned above —
 and specifically through this
 one receives the power and intellect
 to clarify the holiness
 and to raise it also through
 the worldly engagements
 one engages in during the weekdays.
 And likewise the essential completion
 of the perfect ascent
 of all the clarifications
 clarified during the weekdays
 is only through the holiness of the holy Shabbos.
 And even during the weekdays themselves —
 one must each time draw
 the holiness of the holy Shabbos —
 through the aspect of the contentment —
 of minimizing the weekday deeds —
 to only what is necessary —
 in the aspect of:
 "hevay mema'et b'esek v'esok b'Torah
 [minimize your engagement in business
 and engage in Torah]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this:
 א'ם ת'שיב מ'שבת
 — initial letters: אֶמֶת [emes] —
 as brought —
 for through truth one merits to this —
 for the World to Come is called:
 "alma d'kushta
 [the world of truth]."
 And therefore on Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the World to Come —
 the light of truth shines —
 as mentioned above.
 And likewise the holy legs are called:
 "yarchey kushta
 [thighs of truth]"
 — as is well-known.
 And therefore — through binding oneself to truth
 at all levels —
 that is, even in the engagements of this world —
 for truth is:
 "rosh — toch — sof
 [head — middle — end]"
 — through this one can raise the holy legs
 and understand the holy hints —
 and cleave through them also
 one's thought to the World to Come —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "emes yesh lo raglayim — kushta ka'y
 [truth has legs — truth endures]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 And also — for through truth
 one merits clinging — as mentioned above —
 and as explained within —
 and through this one merits
 to cleave one's thought to the World to Come
 in its perfection —
 both in general and in particular.
 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg —
 liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight —
 the holy one of Hashem, honored]."
 "Oneg"
 — the initial letters of:
 "Eden — Nahar — Gan"
 — the aspect of the World to Come — the aspect of Shabbos —
 for there is the essential delight and honor —
 for this world is full of shames and deficiencies —
 and there is no true delight in it whatsoever —
 and all its pleasures are only affliction and disgrace —
 as is well-known.

 And also — it alludes to the contraction of the mind —
 through which comes the essential delight in attainment —
 for without contraction
 it is impossible to delight at all —
 since one is always looking
 above one's own level —
 as explained elsewhere.
 And also — it alludes to the traits of contentment —
 through which comes the essential delight —
 in the aspect of:
 "eizehu ashir — hasamei'ach b'chelko
 [who is wealthy? — one who is content with his portion]."
 And this is the aspect of:
 "ki az al Shadai titanag
 [for then you shall delight in Shadai]"
 [Job 22:26] —
 "Shadai"
 is the aspect of contraction
 and the aspect of contentment —
 as mentioned above.
 And also — it alludes that one should guard oneself
 from the trait of an evil eye.
 For when one knows that the essential delight and honor
 are only in the World to Come —
 which is the aspect of Shabbos —
 through this one has no evil eye
 toward anything in this world —
 and through this itself one merits
 to guard the memory —
 to cleave one's thought to the World to Come.
 And also — it alludes that one should guard oneself
 from the strengthening
 of the medameh —
 which is the aspect of foolishness —
 which is the opposite of delight and honor —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And the strengthening of the medameh
 and foolishness comes through evil speech —
 and this is the aspect of [Isaiah 57:4]:
 "al mi tis'angeu —
 al mi tarchivhu peh —
 ta'arichu lashon
 [against whom do you delight —
 against whom do you open wide the mouth —
 do you stretch out the tongue?]"
 And likewise the medameh —
 which is the aspects of the husks and evil loves —
 is the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 2:8]:
 "v'ta'anugos bnay ha'adam —
 shadah v'shados
 [and the delights of human beings —
 a field and fields]"
 — and as also brought above in Siman 28.
 For this is the aspect of oneg
 of the Sitra Achra —
 which is the aspect of nega [affliction] —
 for those mentioned above are called
 [II Samuel 7:14]:
 "nigay bnay ha'adam
 [afflictions of human beings]"
 — heaven forfend — as is well-known —
 and they are the opposite of honor —
 the aspect of affliction and disgrace.
 But Shabbos is the holy oneg —
 the aspect of love with delights —
 as mentioned above.
 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 "she'lo yifsa'a pis'ayah gasah —
 ki pis'ayah gasah noteles achas mi'Tameh Mei'or einav shel adam
 [one should not take large strides —
 for large strides take away
 one five-hundredth of the light of a person's eyes]."
 And this is a blemish in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of eyes —
 upon which depends the perfection
 of the aforementioned memory —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'lazikaron bein einecha
 [and for a remembrance between your eyes]"
 [Exodus 13:9] —
 as explained within.
 And therefore for a matter of mitzvah
 it is permitted to run —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 for on the contrary:
 "mitzvas Hashem barah meiras einayim
 [the commandment of Hashem is pure —
 illuminating the eyes]."
 [Psalms 19:9]
 And also — it alludes not only
 that one should not go beyond the Shabbos boundary —
 that is, that one should not completely forget
 the World to Come, heaven forfend —
 especially at the time of one's engagement
 in the matters of this world —
 and likewise that one needs to contract one's mind
 so as not to go beyond one's level —
 as mentioned above —
 but even within the Shabbos boundary —
 that is, even when one merits
 to bind one's thought even then to the World to Come —
 and to understand the hints of holiness —
 and through the aspect of the aforementioned
 contraction-rectification —
 nonetheless one must have the aspect of contentment —
 to be deliberate in them —
 so as not to take large strides —
 for through this one gives power
 to the external forces
 to draw sustenance from the holy legs, heaven forfend.

 And therefore for a matter of mitzvah
 it is permitted to run —
 for there the external forces have no sustenance —
 as also understood within.
 And this:
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — that is, one should not pray
 for one's personal needs on Shabbos —
 for they are the aspects of chayyay sha'ah —
 and on Shabbos one must engage
 in the supremely holy sacred services —
 as mentioned above.
 And also:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — "she'lo yifsa'a pis'ayah gasah
 [one should not take large strides]"
 — so as not to blemish through this
 the aspect of the light of the eyes.
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar"
 — so as not to blemish through this
 the holiness of speech —
 for through this one blemishes
 the aforementioned memory —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן פז-תתן אמת ליעקב
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the Name Yud-Heh of Shabbos — as explained in the writings. And therefore then is the essential perfection of Torah and prayer — as mentioned above many times. And through this the kingship of G-d, blessed be He, is revealed — which is the aspect of Shabbas Malketa. And this is the aspect of [Zechariah 14:9]: "v'hayah Hashem l'Melech al kol ha'aretz — b'yom hahu yihyeh Hashem echad — u'shemo echad [and Hashem will be King over all the earth — on that day Hashem will be One — and His Name will be One]" — and this is understood in the holy Zohar in the passage "k'gavna" stated at the entry of Shabbos — that this aspect is drawn through the holiness of Shabbos.

segments.he: עיקר שלימות היראה הוא בשבת בבחינת ירא שבת כנ"ל כמה פעמים ומחמת שהיראה שהוא בחינת צדק משם התעוררות הדינים ח"ו. מזה בא מה שלפעמים בתחילת כניסת שבת בא לו להאדם יראה גדולה שקורין פרום אבל הוא בלא שמחה כי קשה לו לשמוח מחמת שבחול יש אחיזה להחיצונים לפעמים בבחינת היראה הזאת שהוא בחינת יראת העונש בחינת צדק בחינת רגלין שזה בחינת רגליה יורדות מות רחמנא ליצלן. ועל כן אף על פי שבשבת עולין הרגלין בבחינת אם תשיב משבת רגלך וכנ"ל כמה פעמים. אף על פי כן מחמת שזה סמוך שעלתה היראה משם על כן קשה לו עדיין שתהיה היראה בשמחה שזה עיקר השלימות כי בשבת צריכין לשמוח מאד ולקבל שבת בשמחה ובלב טוב ועל ידי זה דייקא עיקר שלימות היראה כמבואר בליקוטי תנינא סימן יז ועל כן עיקר שלימות עליית הרגלין שעולין בשבת הוא על ידי אור האמת שמאיר בשבת כנ"ל כמה פעמים וצדק כד אתחבר בה אמת אתקריאת אמונה ואמונה הוא בחינת יראת הרוממות שאין בה שום אחיזת הדין כלל אדרבא על ידה נתבטלין כל יראות חיצונית ונמתקין כל הדינים ואז היראה בשלימות היינו עם אהבה ושמחה. ועל כן נקרא שבת נחלת יעקב בחינת תתן אמת ליעקב וזה אם תשיב משבת ראשי תיבות אמ"ת כמובא וזה רגלך כי על ידי זה עיקר שלימות הרגלין כנ"ל. ועל כן נקרא שבת מנוחת אהבה ונדבה מנוחת אמת ואמונה:
segments.en:
And this:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — "da Atika Kadisha
 [this is the Holy Ancient One]"
 — that is, one merits to cleave
 one's thought to the World to Come
 at a supremely exalted level —
 until an illumination is drawn upon him
 from the supremely exalted levels —
 which are the aspects of Atik.
 "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz
 [and I will cause you to ride
 upon the heights of the earth]"
 — "da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [this is the Holy Apple Orchard]"
 — that is, one merits to understand
 also all the hints of holiness
 clothed within this world —
 for this is the aspect of
 Malchus nested in Asiyah
 [Malchus mekunenes b'Asiyah] —
 as is well-known —
 and to raise also this holiness
 from level to level
 to the aspects of Neh"y —
 and afterward to the aspects of Chab"d —
 which is the aspect of Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 — as is well-known.
 And our Sages expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 that is, that the aspect of foolishness —
 which is the aspect of
 the Malchus d'Sitra Achra —
 the aspect of:
 "melech zaken u'chesil
 [an old and foolish king]"
 — which strengthens itself
 to conceal the light of the intellect —
 and so that one should not deepen
 one's thought and understanding
 to comprehend the holy hints —
 in the aspect of:
 "lo yachphotz chesil b'sevunah
 [a fool does not desire understanding]"
 and so on —
 is nullified.
 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — "da Ze'ir Anpin
 [this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — which is the aspect of:
 "nachalah b'li metzarim
 [an inheritance without limits]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 For Yaakov our Patriarch
 chose the World to Come as his portion —
 and he is in the aspect of truth:
 "rosh — toch — sof"
 — the aspect of [Micah 7:20]:
 "titen emes l'Yaakov
 [give truth to Yaakov]"
 — for he ascends in his thought
 to the highest levels —
 which is the aspect of the supremely exalted level
 within the World to Come —
 which is the aspect of Atik mentioned above —
 and draws from there a great illumination
 down to the very lowest levels —
 to understand all the holy hints
 of the aspect of the World to Come
 clothed also within this world —
 which is the aspect of the lowest levels —
 and there is where the essential grip
 of the Sitra Achra is —
 which are the aspects of Egypt [Mitzrayim] —
 the aspect of [Psalms 49:6]:
 "avon akevai yesoviveni
 [the iniquity of my heels surrounds me]"
 — and as understood within.
 But through the holiness of Shabbos
 one merits that all these constraints are nullified —
 and through this one has the power
 to engage during the weekdays
 in the weekday deeds —
 and to raise also all the holy sparks
 clothed within them —
 as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — for on Shabbos the aspect of [Proverbs 15:23]:
 "simchah la'ish b'ma'aneh fiv
 [joy comes to a person through the answer of his mouth]"
 — "zeh haKadosh baruch Hu
 [this refers to the Holy One, blessed be He]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded —
 is drawn —
 and it is the aspect of the good spirit —
 the spirit of prophecy —
 which is the aspect of:
 "dvar Hashem — zeh nevuah
 [the word of Hashem — this is prophecy]"
 — through which the medameh
 falls and is nullified —
 and one merits true Torah novellae —
 encompassing all the aspects
 of the aforementioned holy levels —
 until through them new heavens and new earth are created —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 51:16]:
 "v'la'amor l'Tziyon ami atah
 [and to say to Zion: you are My people],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — as explained within —
 and then his speech is in the aspect of:
 "dvar Hashem
 [the word of Hashem]"
 — in the aspect of:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]."

 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "kol chatimey berachos she'hayu baMikdash —
 hayu omrim: min ha'olam —
 mishekilkelu haminim v'amru ein olam ela echad —
 hitzkinu she'yihyu omrim: min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam
 [all the closing seals of blessings
 that were in the Temple —
 they would say: from the world —
 when the heretics corrupted and said:
 there is only one world —
 they enacted that they should say:
 from the world and until the world],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And see there in Rashi
 [Tractate Berachos 63]
 in the name of the Tosefta:
 "to declare that this world
 before the World to Come
 is like an entrance hall before the banquet hall,"
 and so on. [וכו']
 That is — for in the Temple
 the light of the memory of the World to Come
 shone even more —
 and therefore they would mention there
 the Name of Hashem as it is written —
 for this is the aspect of the World to Come:
 "k'sheim she'ani nichtav —
 ani nikra
 [as I am written — so I am read]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 And therefore they would say simply:
 "min ha'olam
 [from the world]"
 — for the essential [world] is the World to Come —
 and even all the engagements of this world
 are the aspects of holy hints
 from the aspect of the World to Come.
 But when the heretics corrupted
 and declared:
 "there is only one world"
 — that is, they denied the World to Come
 completely, heaven forfend —
 they enacted that they should say:
 "min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam
 [from the world and until the world]"
 — to declare that the essential [world] is the World to Come —
 and this world is only like an entrance hall
 before the banquet hall.
 And therefore in all the engagements of this world
 too —
 one must deepen one's thought
 and expand one's understanding —
 to understand the hints of the World to Come
 within them —
 as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "v'hitzkinu she'yihyeh adam sho'el
 bishlom chaveiro b'shem —
 shene'emar v'hineh Boaz —
 v'chol haggid —
 vayomer lakotzrim:
 Hashem imachem
 [and they enacted that a person should greet
 the peace of his fellow with the Name —
 as it is stated: and behold — Boaz —
 and so on —
 and he said to the reapers:
 Hashem be with you]"
 — that is, he informed them —
 to take to heart —
 that even though they engage
 in the matters of this world —
 they should know that there too
 is His blessed G-dliness.
 And this:
 "v'yomru lo: yevarechecha Hashem
 [and they said to him: Hashem shall bless you]"
 — the aspect of:
 "b'chol makom asher azkir es shemi —
 avo eilecha u'verachticha
 [in every place where I cause My Name to be mentioned —
 I shall come to you and bless you]."
 [Exodus 20:24]
 For since Boaz merited
 the aforementioned memory —
 certainly he is:
 "tov ayin — v'tov ayin hu yevorach
 [a good eye — and a good eye — he shall be blessed]."
 And this:
 "v'omer lo: Hashem imcha gibor hechayil
 [and he said to him: Hashem is with you —
 mighty man of valor]"
 [Judges 6:12] —
 and this was at the time when
 Gideon was threshing wheat in a vat —
 which is likewise from the engagements of this world.
 "v'omer: al tavuz ki zeknah imecha
 [and it is said: do not despise her because your mother is old]"
 [Proverbs 23:22]
 — that is, do not despise
 the enactments of the Sages —
 for all their words and deeds are not plain —
 and there are great secrets within them —
 as explained elsewhere.
 For since they merited
 to understand the holy hints
 within the matters of this world —
 therefore certainly there are great secrets
 within all their enactment matters —
 even if it is not so understandable
 to the plain human mind.
 And this:
 "v'omer: es la'asos laHashem —
 heferu Torasecha —
 Rabbi Nasan omer:
 heferu Torasecha —
 mishum: es la'asos laHashem
 [and it is said: it is time to act for Hashem —
 they have made void Your Torah —
 Rabbi Nasan says:
 they have made void Your Torah —
 because: it is time to act for Hashem]"
 [Psalms 119:126; Tractate Berachos 63]
 — that is, sometimes one nullifies the words of Torah
 in order to act for Hashem —
 such as Eliyahu who brought offerings
 on Mount Carmel —
 and as our Sages taught —
 and therefore one should not wonder
 at the enactments of the Sages —
 for certainly all their actions are for the sake of Heaven —
 and they know best
 how to be careful about His blessed honor.
 For in truth —
 the fact that they originally said only:
 "min ha'olam"
 is because this is a simple matter —
 that the essential is the World to Come —
 as mentioned above.
 And yet —
 since in this world we do not have
 such attainment of the aspect of the World to Come —
 which is the aspect of:
 "ayin lo ra'asah
 [no eye has seen]"
 — and it is hidden and concealed —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 31:20]:
 "mah rav tuvcha asher tzafanta
 [how great is Your goodness
 that You have hidden away],"
 and so on —
 for it is the aspect of:
 "alma d'iskasya
 [the world that is concealed]"
 — therefore they obscured the matter somewhat —
 out of the greatness of its holiness —
 and said only:
 "min ha'olam."
 But when the concealment strengthened so much
 that the heretics corrupted, and so on —
 they enacted on the contrary!
 that they should not conceal the matter
 of the World to Come at all —
 but on the contrary:
 they should say explicitly in every blessing in the Temple:
 "min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam"
 — to know that the essential is the World to Come —
 and this world is only like an entrance hall —
 as mentioned above.
 And likewise — even though it is forbidden
 to mention the Name of Heaven in vain —
 [Proverbs 25:2]:
 "kevod Elokim haster davar
 [the glory of G-d is to conceal a matter]"
 — nonetheless because the concealment
 strengthens so much
 that one can completely forget His blessed Name —
 therefore they enacted
 that when one person meets another
 and asks after his welfare —
 one should remember His blessed Name for him.

 And the principle is:
 for whenever the concealment strengthens even more —
 then the Sages of Israel are compelled
 to publicize even more
 the holiness of the light of His blessed G-dliness —
 and they ascend to very great levels —
 and draw from there great illuminations
 all the way to the very lowest levels —
 in order to declare to all
 that:
 "melo chol ha'aretz kevodo —
 u'malchuso b'chol mashalah
 [the whole earth is full of His glory —
 and His kingdom rules over all]."
 And this is the aspect of:
 "es la'asos laHashem —
 heferu Torasecha"
 — that one must deepen one's thought
 to understand the hints
 that G-d, blessed be He, alludes to him —
 to draw close to His blessed service —
 in every thought, speech, and deed —
 even of the matters of this world —
 for then one is detached from the words of Torah —
 and therefore in any case in general
 one must bind one's thought
 to His blessed G-dliness —
 even at the time when one is detached
 from the words of Torah
 and engaged in the matters of this world.
 And the great Sages sometimes need to do a thing
 that appears to be in the aspect of:
 "heferu Torasecha
 [they have made void Your Torah]"
 — and it is all for the sake of:
 "es la'asos laHashem
 [it is time to act for Hashem]"
 — for specifically through this
 they draw the knowledge of His blessed G-dliness —
 and draw the fulfillment of all the Torah —
 as in the matter of Eliyahu on Mount Carmel —
 and the like — many times over.
 And this matter is relevant to many matters —
 such as the matter of the great ones having agreed
 to print the books of Kabbalah
 and to publicize them among Israel to such a degree —
 in the footsteps of the Mashiach —
 and all of it for the sake of:
 "es la'asos laHashem."
 Especially given the nature of the present time —
 the knowledge of the aforementioned matter
 is very necessary —
 for all the sharp looks and gnashing of teeth
 of the worthless ones
 against the whole of the holiness of Israel —
 and its matters and customs
 of the holy people of Israel —
 and their way in most cases
 is to bring support for their views
 from some verse or saying of our Sages.
 But one must know that serpent venom
 is between their teeth —
 for their entire wicked intention is
 to bring through this specifically
 to complete denial, heaven forfend,
 of the entire Torah —
 both the Written and the Oral —
 as can be observed concretely.
 Therefore one must strengthen oneself greatly
 in the faith in the Sages
 and the truly righteous ones —
 for all their actions are for the sake of Heaven —
 and even when they do a thing
 that is in the aspect of:
 "heferu Torasecha"
 — it is all for the sake of the fulfillment of the Torah —
 in the aspect of:
 "es la'asos laHashem"
 — as mentioned above.

 And see Tractate Yoma 69 —
 and Tractate Gittin 60 —
 and likewise in many other places
 in the words of our Sages —
 where sometimes the Sages permitted a thing
 that was not according to the Torah —
 and all of it for the sake of:
 "es la'asos laHashem."
 And this is likewise included
 in what our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Menachos 99a]:
 "pe'amim bitulan shel Torah —
 zehu yesodah
 [sometimes the nullification of the Torah —
 that is its foundation]."

segments.he: סימן פט-ותחסרהו מעט וכו'
segments.en: And through this they sacrifice their souls for them — and go down to where they go down — to raise from there the souls of Israel of the living and the dead — through the power and the merit of the holy Shabbos. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught: all who guard the Shabbos — and so on — even if one worshipped idolatry — and so on — he is forgiven. For through the holiness of Shabbos — true thoughts of repentance certainly reach him — and his repentance also has a complete ascent — as mentioned above — and therefore he is forgiven. And this is the aspect of the delight of Shabbos — the aspect of [Job 27:10]: "ki az al Shadai yis'anag [for then one will delight in the Almighty]," and so on — for the complete repentance of Shabbos is the aspect of Shadai — as explained within. And this is the aspect of [Psalms 37:3]: "betach b'Hashem v'aseh tov [trust in Hashem and do good]," and so on — as explained within. And this [Psalms 37:4]: "v'his'anag al Hashem" — the aspect of the delight of Shabbos — as mentioned above.

segments.he: אמרו רז"ל לא ישאל אדם על צרכיו בשבת בכדי שלא יזכור שיש לו חולה בתוך ביתו ויצטער. ולכאורה אינו מובן כי גם אם לא יתפלל על צרכיו יוכל גם כן לזכור בהחולה שיש לו בתוך ביתו ויצטער אדרבא לכאורה אם אינו רשאי להתפלל עליו על ידי זה הוא מצטער ביותר אמנם לפי המבואר בפנים מובן קצת. כי עיקר התפלה שמתפלל בחול על צרכיו צריך להיות גם כן רק על חסרון השכינה כביכול וזה יהיה עיקר צערו כמובא בספרים קדושים. ועל כן גם בשבת אם יהיה רשאי להתפלל על צרכיו יזכור שיש לו חולה בתוך ביתו ויצטער. היינו שיצטער גם כן העיקר רק על חסרון השכינה אך אף על פי כן על ידי זה לא יכול לעבוד את השם יתברך בשמחה שלימה כל כך ובאמת רצון השם יתברך שבשבת יהיו כל ישראל בשמחה גדולה כמו שכתוב בים הניח ה' לך מעצבך ומרגזך וכו' וכמובא בזוהר הקדוש. ועל כן גם אם יזכור בצערו רק שיזכור גם בזה שהצער הוא העיקר אל המלך היינו אל השכינה כביכול רק שאף על פי כן מגודל קדושת שבת בא המלך בשמחה גדולה כל כך ורוצה להשתעשע עם בניו הנעימים באהבה ורצון ובשמחה כל כך עד שאינו רוצה שיזכרו כלל בצערו בכדי שלא לבלבל את השמחה. ואז כשזוכרין בזה באין על ידי זה בעצמו גם כן לשמחה גדולה ונתעטרין במוחין חדשים שזה עיקר קדושת שבת כנ"ל כמה פעמים ועל ידי זה בעצמו נמתק הצער ונתמלא החסרון וזה בחינת מה שאמרו רז"ל שבת הוא מלזעוק ורפואה קרובה לבא.
segments.en: The matter of how on Shabbos one merits the perfection of prayer and the revelation of Torah secrets — is explained somewhat above in Siman 15. And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the perfection of sacred speech — in the aspect of: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos. And it is also the aspect of the world of thought. And it is also the aspect of the Tzadik. And these three aspects are the aspects of the vessel called "Ani [I]" — as explained within — and all the influences descend through this vessel — in the aspect of [Numbers 6:27]: "va'ani avarchem [and I shall bless them]." And therefore Shabbos is the source of blessing — for then one merits to pray with concentration — to connect the thought to the words of prayer in a strong bond — through which the aforementioned vessel is made — which is the source of blessing. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:13]: "v'es Shabsosai tishmoru — Ani Hashem [and My Shabbosim you shall guard — I am Hashem]." And likewise [Exodus 31:13]: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "matanah tovah yesh li b'veys genzai — v'Shabbas shemah" — and so on — and it concludes there: "matan scharah lo avida l'galeyyei" — that is, the inner dimension of the holiness of Shabbos is not made to be revealed. But only through receiving the holiness of Shabbos simply — and meriting the holiness of speech and thought — which is the aspect of: "es Shabsosai tishmoru" — two Shabbosim — through this the vessel called Ani is completed — and through this one merits to receive the blessings and the good influences of Shabbos — and through this G-d, blessed be He, receives great pleasure from them. For "chefetz chesed hu [He desires lovingkindness]" — which is the aspect of "ishah rei'ach nichoa'ch laHashem [a fire-offering of pleasing fragrance to Hashem]" — in the aspect of what G-d, blessed be He, said to Shabbos: "Keneses Yisrael yihyeh ben zugcha" — specifically. And through this — the inner dimension of the holiness of Shabbos will be revealed to them — which is the aspect of "Kodesh" — as explained in the aforementioned Siman 15. And this: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — and this is the aspect of: "vayevarech vayekadesh [and He blessed and He sanctified]."

segments.he: כי דייקא על ידי זה בעצמו שאין רשאין בשבת לזעוק ולצעוק על הצער כנ"ל על ידי זה יהיה בטוח שבוודאי רפואה קרובה לבא:
segments.en:
Shabbos = World to Come / "Zachor v'Shamor" = guard the memory / cleave thought to olam d'ase: Shabbos = World to Come (Berachos 57b). "Zachor es yom haShabbas / shamor es yom haShabbas" — "zachor v'shamor b'dibbur echad ne'emaru" = must exceedingly guard the memory to cleave thought to the World to Come = "l'adabka machshavta b'alma d'ase." Shabbos = World of Thought. Ezekiel 20:20: "v'es Shabsosai kadshu… lada'as ki ani Hashem Elokeichem" = Shabbos = Unity of Hashem = "da shiruah d'meheimanusah — saliku d'machshavah d'alma d'ase." Memory has both a general and a particular aspect: deepening one's thought to understand the hints G-d sends in every thought/speech/deed = "according to the person, the place, the time." These hints = holy legs clothed in this world. "Zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" = find and elevate all the holy sparks clothed within this world's six weekdays = holy hints of the World to Come clothed within the engagements of this world = holy legs.
 "Im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" / Shadai = contraction / contentment / Mishkan does not override Shabbos: "Raglecha" = even all of one's worldly affairs must be bound to Shabbos holiness = aspect of the World to Come. Expansion of mind to understand hints = must be in measure and contraction = "al yetzei ish mimekomo" = Shadai of Shabbos = "she'yesh day b'elokuso l'chol beriyah" (LM Tinyana 5, Tik'u Emunah). Shabbos = contentment = even one who merits to understand hints within worldly engagements must content himself with minimal amount = only necessities. "Shadai amar l'olamo day" = contentment. Must completely rest from labor on Shabbos = even work of the Mishkan does not override Shabbos = on Shabbos only sacred services higher than weekday labors. Contentment = complete light = "barchu b'orah." Charity from contentment = union of Tzadik and Keneses Yisrael. "Shemesh b'Shabbas tzedakah l'ani'im" = essential union of Tzadik and Keneses Yisrael = on Shabbos = therefore essential time for sacred union (Zohar). Shabbos sleep = also cleaving thought to olam d'ase (soul ascends there) = holy delight = custom to delay prayer time on Shabbos (Mordechai; SA OC 281). Tefillin = expansion of mind = needed on weekdays; Shabbos itself = mochin d'gadlus = no tefillin. Tzitzis = contraction = also needed on Shabbos. Torah = contentment = its essential time = Shabbos = "lo nitnetu Shabbasos ela l'divray Torah" (especially the general public on Shabbos; SA OC 290; all agree Torah given on Shabbos, Shabbos 88a). "Ein sho'alin al tzorchav b'Shabbas" = petitions = chayyay sha'ah = holy legs clothed in this world; Shabbos = higher sacred services. No buying and selling = for union of Tzadik and Keneses Yisrael = on Shabbos accomplished automatically in perfection. "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Yisrael" = Moshe + Keneses Yisrael = Tzadik + Keneses Yisrael; union also through commerce with faith = work of the Mishkan; but does not override Shabbos. Perfect ascent of weekday prayers on Shabbos. Holy sparks/clarifications of weekdays all ascend through Shabbos holiness.
 Shabbos = tov ayin / three colors of the eye / "tyov ayin hu yevorach" / clinging / heart and eyes: Shabbos = tov ayin = called "tov" = "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas tov" (Zohar I 60). Tikkun Shivi'in: three colors of the eye and the pupil. "Vayevarech Elokim es yom hashevi'i" = "tov ayin hu yevorach" (Proverbs 22:9). Blessings = truth → clinging (as explained within). Light of truth shines on Shabbos = essential time for perfect clinging to G-d. Holy vitality drawn into every Jew's heart on Shabbos = "to'amehah chayyim zachu" = light of truth = simana d'chayyay (Siman 23) + holy clinging = "v'atem hadevekim… chayyim kulchem" / "u'ledavkah vo ki hu chayyech" / "ki mimenu totzaos chayyim" / "yichi levavechem la'ad." Shabbos = lev (Tikunim) + eyes. "Shuryano d'eina b'liba talya." Ezekiel 20:16: "libam holech" = blemish of heart; Ezekiel 20:24: "eineihem" = blemish of eyes.
 Malchus David / Mashiach / tefillin d'marei alma / medameh / subduing of animality / love of G-d / lashon hara = desecrating Shabbos: Kingdom of David/Mashiach = tov ayin (as brought within). Jeremiah 17:24–25: Shabbos → kings on the throne of David. Root of kingdom of Mashiach = knot of G-d's tefillin (as brought; Zohar Lech Lecha 89). Shabbos = "tefillin d'marei alma" (Zohar Chadash Shir haShirim). Shabbos = rectification of the medameh (faculty of imagination) = animal power. On Shabbos: Nogah encompassed in holiness; evil within it and the completely impure husks fall. Rectification of the animal soul (drawn from Nogah): evil lusts and animal loves fall and are nullified; Israel merits the light of holy love = "v'Shabbas kodshecha b'ahavah u'vratzson hinchaltanu — menucha ahavah." Physical pleasures very holy = "mah yafit u'mah na'amt — ahavah b'ta'anugim." Illumination of sacred Da'as drawn upon each Jew = "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem" → medameh rectified → animality subdued → love of G-d. Lashon hara + blemish of speech → falls into foolishness/animality = opposite of Shabbos = "v'daber davar" = holy speech; therefore Ezekiel 22:9: "v'es Shabsosai chilellas — anshey rachil hayu vach" = desecration of Shabbos and evil speech are from one aspect. Blemish in Da'as → foolishness → evil lusts → animal loves. Medameh: created Erev Shabbos bein hashmashos; no body was created for it (Zohar); subduing of medameh = through Shabbos holiness. Essential time for true Torah novellae = on Shabbos (Zohar) = evil within medameh has no share in them. Shabbos = joy = medameh nullified = "b'yom hani'ach Hashem Elokecha lei mei'itzevonecha u'mirogzecha" = noble spirit / good spirit / ruach hakodesh / ruach hanevuah (Zohar). Zemiros and melodies on Shabbos = "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" + Temple music = "alay asor v'alay navel… ki simachtani Hashem b'fo'olecha" = good spirit clarified from evil spirit = "v'nigen b'yado v'tov lecha" (I Samuel 16:23) → medameh subdued → memory / cleaving to olam d'ase / understanding the hints of the World to Come.
 Psalm 92 mapped through the lens of olam d'ase and the medameh: "Mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem — me'od amku machshevosecha" = husks and medameh shall perish = "yitparedu kol po'aley aven." "Vatarom kir'eim karni balossi b'shemen ra'anan" = kingdom of Mashiach. "Vatabet eyni b'shurai" = subduing of evil eye. Sages on palm and cedar: "libam mechuvvanin l'ma'alah" = all their deeds for sake of Heaven with great secrets; "mah tamar v'erez yesh lahem ta'avah — u'mah hi ta'avosam — haKadosh baruch Hu" = love of G-d; "mah tamarah zu ein bah pesolet" = understand hints in every matter. "K'erez baLevanon yisgeh" = Zohar Vayikra 16: Levanon = "ayin lo ra'asah" = World to Come. "Shesulim b'veit Hashem" = inwardness = thought always cleaving to olam d'ase in general. "B'chatzros Elokeinu yifrachu" = externality (Siman 56) = produce fruit even from worldly external matters through understanding hints + cleaving thought. Shabbos union = through spirit; on weekdays: grip of medameh/animality on union = evil spirit/ruach shetus = "ruach zenutim" (Hosea 4:12 / "ki sisteh ishto"). On Shabbos: union in holy spirit. Zohar Terumah 136 cited in full: "u'va'ay l'inon chachmim l'meimar chad pesuka d'is'arus d'ha'i rucha ila'ah kadisha d'is'atara b'Shabbas… b'gin d'mis'atrin b'ha'i rucha b'is'arus d'lehon b'chedva d'shimmush… v'yihavei neguido d'ha'i rucha ila'ah d'Shabbas." Isaiah 56:4 + Zohar Yisro 89: Torah scholars guard union from Shabbos to Shabbos. "Yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos" = merit the holy hand → subdue medameh + clarify good spirit from evil spirit. Clarification of medameh = shem tov: names exist through the power of imagination = pictures things in imagination = inscribes them in the power of memory; memory = through the power of medameh/imagination (Siman 19). When medameh fully clarified = only the good spirit/ruach nevuah/memory; merits through "yad Hashem" = "u'veyad hanevi'im adammeh"; then: "shem tov — shem olam — l'zecher olam yihyeh tzadik."
 "Im tashiv" (first layer) and full Isaiah 58 synthesis through olam d'ase: "Raglecha" = raise up holy legs clothed in this world. "Me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" = do ALL worldly affairs also in the holiness of Shabbos = understand all the holy hints clothed in worldly engagements = raise holy legs to their source = "mi hekim kol afsei aretz." But on Shabbos itself: also refrain = "Mishkan does not override Shabbos" = engage in supremely holy sacred services = thereby receive power to clarify holiness during the weekdays. Weekdays: draw Shabbos holiness through contentment = "hevay mema'et b'esek v'esok b'Torah." "Im tashiv miShabbos" acrostic = emes; World to Come = "alma d'kushta"; Shabbos = light of truth; holy legs = "yarchey kushta"; truth = rosh-toch-sof → can raise holy legs + understand hints + cleave through them to olam d'ase = "emes yesh lo raglayim / kushta ka'y"; through truth → clinging → cleave to olam d'ase in general and particular. "Call it delight / Eden-Nahar-Gan" = World to Come = Shabbos = essential delight/honor (this world = shames and deficiencies; all pleasures = affliction and disgrace). Also: contraction of mind → essential delight in attainment = "eizehu ashir hasamei'ach b'chelko" = "ki az al Shadai titanag" (Shadai = contraction + contentment). Also: guard from evil eye = knows that true delight/honor = World to Come = no evil eye on anything in this world = guards the memory. Also: guard from strengthening of medameh = foolishness = opposite of delight/honor = comes through lashon hara = "al mi tis'angeu… ta'arichu lashon"; medameh = "ta'anugos bnay ha'adam shadah v'shados" (Siman 28) = "oneg d'Sitra Achra" = nega = "nigay bnay ha'adam"; Shabbos = holy oneg = "ahavah b'ta'anugim." "Honor it / from your ways / no large strides" = "noteles achas miTameh me'or einav" = blemish eyes of Shabbos = blemish the memory = "v'lazikaron bein einecha"; but for mitzvah: "mitzvas Hashem barah meiras einayim." Also: don't go beyond Shabbos boundary = don't completely forget the World to Come; don't go beyond one's level; even within the boundary: be deliberate = no large strides = gives power to external forces to draw from holy legs; but for mitzvah = no sustenance for external forces. "Your affairs / speaking words" = no personal petitions on Shabbos (= chayyay sha'ah); no blemish to holy speech → blemish the memory. "Then delight" = Atika Kadisha = cleave to olam d'ase at supremely exalted level. "Heights of earth" = Chakla Tupichin = understand hints clothed in this world = Malchus nested in Asiyah → raise from level to level → Neh"y → Chab"d; saved from subjugation = foolishness nullified = "melech zaken u'chesil / lo yachphotz chesil b'sevunah." "Heritage of Yaakov" = Ze'ir Anpin = nachalah b'li metzarim; Yaakov chose World to Come = emes rosh-toch-sof = "titen emes l'Yaakov" = ascends to Atik = draws down to understand hints in the lowest levels = "avon akevai yesoviveni" (Mitzrayim); through Shabbos = all constraints nullified = power to engage in weekday deeds and raise all the holy sparks. "Ki pi Hashem diber" = "simchah la'ish b'ma'aneh fiv — zeh haKadosh baruch Hu" (Sages) = good spirit = ruach nevuah = "dvar Hashem — zeh nevuah" → medameh nullified → true Torah novellae encompassing all holy levels → create new heavens and earth → "v'la'amor l'Tziyon ami atah" (Isaiah 51:16) → speech = "dvar Hashem" = "ki pi Hashem diber."
 Temple blessings "min ha'olam" / "min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam" / Boaz / Gideon / "es la'asos laHashem heferu Torasecha" / publishing Kabbalah / serpent venom: Temple: blessings closed with "min ha'olam" = Temple = light of memory of World to Come shining strongly → mentioned the Name as written (= olam ha'ba; "k'sheim she'ani nichtav ani nikra"). Said simply "min ha'olam" = the essential is the World to Come; even all worldly engagements = holy hints from olam d'ase. When heretics said "there is only one world" = denied olam ha'ba completely → enacted: "min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam" = to declare that the essential is olam ha'ba and this world is only a prozdor (Rashi Berachos 63, Tosefta). Therefore even in worldly engagements = deepen thought to understand hints of olam d'ase. Enacted to greet with the Name = "v'hineh Boaz… vayomer lakotzrim: Hashem imachem / v'yomru lo: yevarechecha Hashem" = inform even during worldly engagements that G-dliness is there too = "b'chol makom asher azkir es shemi avo eilecha u'verachticha." Since Boaz merited the memory = "tov ayin / tov ayin hu yevorach." "Hashem imcha gibor hechayil" (Judges 6:12) = to Gideon threshing in a vat = worldly engagement. "Al tavuz ki zeknah imecha" = do not despise the Sages' enactments = great secrets within all their matters. "Es la'asos laHashem heferu Torasecha / Rabbi Nasan: heferu Torasecha mishum es la'asos laHashem" = sometimes nullify Torah for the sake of G-d (like Eliyahu on Mount Carmel); don't wonder at Sages' enactments; they know how to guard G-d's honor. Why "min ha'olam" originally? = simple matter = World to Come is the essential; yet in this world no great attainment of olam d'ase = "ayin lo ra'asah / alma d'iskasya / mah rav tuvcha asher tzafanta" → therefore obscured somewhat and said simply "min ha'olam." When heretics corrupted → enacted "min ha'olam v'ad ha'olam." Likewise: even though forbidden to mention G-d's Name in vain = "kevod Elokim haster davar" → but when concealment is so strong that one could forget His Name entirely → enacted to greet with the Name. Principle: when concealment strengthens, Sages must publicize G-dliness even more = ascend to great levels = draw illuminations down to the lowest levels = "melo chol ha'aretz kevodo u'malchuso b'chol mashalah." "Es la'asos laHashem" = deepen thought to understand the hints in every thought/speech/deed even of worldly matters = when detached from Torah, still bind one's thought to G-d. Great Sages sometimes do things that appear as "heferu Torasecha" = all for "es la'asos laHashem" (like Eliyahu on Mount Carmel). This applies to the decision of the great ones to print and publicize the books of Kabbalah among Israel "in the footsteps of the Mashiach." Given the nature of the present time: the worthless ones with their sharp looks and gnashing of teeth against all of the holiness of Israel — they use verses and Sages' sayings to support themselves — but serpent venom is between their teeth — their entire intention is to bring to complete denial of the entire Torah (written and oral) — as can be seen concretely. Therefore: strengthen greatly in faith in the Sages and the true Tzadikim — all their actions for the sake of Heaven — even "heferu Torasecha" is for the sake of the fulfillment of the Torah = "es la'asos laHashem." Yoma 69; Gittin 60; and many places where the Sages permitted things not according to Torah — all for "es la'asos laHashem." Menachos 99a: "pe'amim bitulan shel Torah — zehu yesodah."
 

 Siman 55 onward continues in the next installment.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

Yikara DiShabsa — Simanim 55 and 56

 Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Part One — Simanim 55 and 56

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Siman 55 — סימן נה
 Abba Shaul Omer — "Abba Shaul says…"
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 55]

 The holiness of the Land of Israel flows from Shabbos.
 And likewise the extra soul of Shabbos
 is the aspect of the Land of Israel —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and especially in Siman 37 —
 see there.
 For on Shabbos the prayer is in its perfection —
 in the aspect of the sparkling of the light of the Patriarchs —
 as explained in the holy Zohar,
 Bereishis, folio 23:
 that during the weekdays the prayers are received
 through the aspects of ox, lion, and eagle.
 But on Shabbos —
 the Holy One, blessed be He, descends
 with the three Patriarchs
 to receive with them His only daughter —
 and this is the aspect of:
 "Shin bas"
 — שַׁבָּת —
 and so on.
 And likewise it is in the Tikunim:
 "u'v'atar d'avhan — taman Shechinah — taman
 [and in the place of the Patriarchs —
 there is the Shechinah — there]"
 — which is the aspect of the holiness of the Land of Israel —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'zacharti es brisi Yaakov —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'ha'aretz ezkor
 [and I shall remember My covenant with Yaakov —
 and so on —
 and the Land I shall remember]"
 [Leviticus 26:42] —
 which itself is likewise the aspect of Shabbos —
 שַׁבָּת — שִׁין בַּת —
 that is, the Patriarchs with the Shechinah —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And through all of this
 one merits to see the downfall of the wicked —
 for this is the aspect of what in
 Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos
 it elaborates at length
 on the matter of the downfall of the wicked —
 as it is written:
 "ki hineh oyvecha Hashem —
 ki hineh oyvecha yove'du —
 v'chol haggid —
 vatabet eyni b'shurai
 [for behold — Your enemies, O Hashem —
 for behold — Your enemies shall perish —
 and so on —
 and my eye has looked upon my enemies],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the three colors
 of the eye and the pupil —
 and then all of Israel merits
 the aspect of the rectification of sight —
 in the aspect of:
 "re'u ki Hashem natan lachem haShabbas
 [see — for Hashem has given you the Shabbos]"
 [Exodus 16:29] —
 and one merits to see far
 and to attain the righteousness of the Holy One,
 blessed be He —
 that even what He causes to succeed for the wicked
 and favors them in judgment in this world —
 that too is only for the sake of their downfall —
 and for the sake of saving
 the Tzadik through this
 from the venom of the eyes of the wicked —
 as explained within.
 For this too is what it elaborates
 in explaining in:
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos —
 tov l'hodos laHashem —
 v'lezammer l'shimcha elyon."
 "tov l'hodos laHashem
 [it is good to give thanks to Hashem]"
 — this is the aspect of the perfection of prayer
 one merits through seeing and attaining
 the righteousness of the judgments of G-d, blessed be He —
 "ki lo atzadik rasha
 [for I will not acquit the wicked]"
 [Exodus 23:7] —
 which is the aspect of:
 "Elyon
 [Most High]"
 — as it is written [Lamentations 3:35–36]:
 "l'hatos mishpat gever —
 neged pnay Elyon —
 l'avot adam b'rivo —
 Hashem lo ra'ah
 [to pervert the judgment of a man —
 before the face of the Most High —
 to wrong a person in his case —
 Hashem does not see?]"
 — and likewise [Psalms 7]:
 which also speaks of the righteousness
 of His blessed judgments
 and the downfall of the wicked —
 as it is written:
 "Elokim shofet tzadik
 [G-d is a righteous judge],"
 and so on —
 and it concluded:
 "odeh Hashem k'tzidko —
 v'azamrah shem Hashem Elyon
 [I will give thanks to Hashem for His righteousness —
 and I will sing to the Name of Hashem Most High]."
 [Psalms 7:18]
 And [Psalms 9:2–5]:
 "azamrah shimcha Elyon —
 b'shuv oyevay achor —
 v'chol haggid —
 ki asisa mishpati v'dini —
 yashavta l'chisei shofet tzedek
 [I will sing to Your Name, Most High —
 when my enemies turn back —
 and so on —
 for You carried out my judgment and my cause —
 You sat on the throne
 as a righteous judge],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this:
 "l'haggid baboker chasdecha
 [to declare Your kindness in the morning]"
 — that is, at the time when one actually sees
 the downfall of the wicked —
 which is the aspect of morning —
 as it is written [Psalms 101:8]:
 "labekarim atzamit kol rish'ay aretz
 [every morning I shall annihilate
 all the wicked of the earth]"
 — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 then one must certainly declare His blessed lovingkindness —
 which He does with the Tzadikim —
 and subdues the wicked before them.
 "v'emunascha ballaylos
 [and Your faithfulness in the nights]"
 — that even at the time of darkness and exile
 and the success of the wicked —
 nonetheless one must believe greatly in G-d,
 blessed be He —
 that His judgments are upright —
 and certainly everything is only for the good of Israel.
 And this:
 "ish ba'ar lo yeda —
 v'chol haggid —
 bifroach resha'im k'mo esev —
 v'chol haggid —
 l'hishmaedam adey ad
 [a boorish person does not know —
 and so on —
 when the wicked flourish like grass —
 and so on —
 it is for their eternal destruction],"
 and so on —
 and it concluded:
 "l'haggid ki yashar Hashem —
 tzuri —
 v'lo avlasah vo
 [to declare that Hashem is upright —
 my Rock —
 and there is no wrongdoing in Him]"
 — for certainly He is righteous and upright.

 And therefore also at Minchah of Shabbos
 one says:
 "tzidkascha k'harerei El
 [Your righteousness is like the mountains of G-d]"
 [Psalms 36:7]
 — even though:
 "mishpatecha tehom rabbah
 [Your judgments are a great deep]"
 — as explained within.
 And through all of this
 the heart is straightened from its crookedness —
 and one merits straightness of heart
 and complete faith [emunah sheleimah] —
 through which one merits
 the perfection of prayer —
 as explained within.
 And the perfection of prayer
 is the aspect of the red heifer [parah adummah] —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "Shabbas v'dinim v'parah —
 b'Marah nitztavu
 [Shabbos and laws of judgment
 and the red heifer —
 were commanded at Marah]"
 — for through the holiness of Shabbos
 one merits to see the righteousness
 of His judgments and decrees —
 for He loves just law and true judgment —
 and through this one merits
 the perfection of prayer —
 which is the aspect of the red heifer.
 And specifically at Marah —
 for there they saw this aspect —
 as it is written [Exodus 15:23–25]:
 "v'lo yachlu lishsos mayim miMarah —
 v'chol haggid —
 vayorehu Hashem etz —
 v'chol haggid —
 vayimteku hamayim
 [and they were unable to drink
 the water from Marah —
 and so on —
 and Hashem showed him a tree —
 and so on —
 and the waters were sweetened]"
 — and our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "that tree was the oleander"
 — which is bitter —
 and Hashem showed them
 that He sweetens the bitter with the bitter —
 that is, specifically through the fact
 that Israel endures the bitterness
 of the exile and the subjugation
 through the success of the wicked —
 this itself is the perfection
 of the goodness and the success of Israel —
 and the downfall of the wicked —
 as mentioned above.
 And also — on Shabbos
 the Sitra Achra is greatly subdued —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 and through this the evil is subdued
 both in general and in particular —
 which is the aspect of the dust [afar] in prayer —
 as explained within.
 And therefore also:
 "malach ra b'al korcho oneh amen
 [an evil angel reluctantly answers amen]"
 — for even the evil becomes a throne for the holiness —
 as explained within.

segments.he: סימן צא-ויהי ידיו אמונה
segments.en: And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the Vav — as is well-known. The aspect of [Genesis 37:2]: "eileh toldos Yaakov — Yosef [these are the generations of Yaakov — Yosef]" — for Yaakov and Yosef go as one — which are the aspect of the peace that unites the two opposites.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחינת שלימות האמונה כנ"ל כמה פעמים.
segments.en:
And therefore on Shabbos
 it is easier to pray
 in the aspect of the casting off of corporeality [hispashtus hagashmiyus].
 For through the holiness of Shabbos
 the totality of the corporeality and the materiality
 is automatically subdued —
 for Shabbos is the world of souls
 and not the world of the body —
 as mentioned above many times
 in the name of the holy Zohar.

 And also — then is especially propitious
 to bind oneself
 with the nefashos, ruchos, and neshamos
 of those who dwell in the dust —
 through the holiness of the extra soul [neshamah yeseirah]
 that each person merits on Shabbos.
 And sometimes a person merits to receive then
 the portions of nefesh, ruach, and neshamah
 of his own that have already been perfectly rectified
 in previous incarnations.
 And sometimes one merits to receive also
 the portions of nefesh, ruach, and neshamah
 of ancient Tzadikim.
 And also — Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
 together with several other Tzadikim —
 descend on every Erev Shabbos
 to engage in the rectification of the souls
 of the living and the dead —
 as all of this is explained
 in the writings of the holy Ari z"l.
 And therefore on Shabbos
 one must especially bind oneself —
 and especially during the time of prayer —
 with the nefashos, ruchos, and neshamos
 of those who dwell in the dust —
 both in particular and in general —
 for this is the aspect of the dust [afar]
 in prayer — as explained within.
 And also — the aspect of the seven-seven
 stated concerning the red heifer —
 which likewise alludes to the perfection of prayer —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 119:164]:
 "sheva bayom hilalticha
 [seven times a day I have praised You]"
 — as explained within —
 this is the aspect of the seven blessings
 in the Shabbos prayer.

 And also — the essential rectification
 of the three voices
 is through the holiness of Shabbos —
 for on Shabbos the aspect of Da'as
 and great mental faculties
 is drawn to each person according to his aspect —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and through this all forms of false beliefs
 are nullified —
 which are complete foolishness —
 in the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 5:2]:
 "kol kesil b'rov devarim
 [the voice of a fool is in the multitude of words]."
 And also — the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect
 of the holiness of the sacred speech —
 and therefore one must minimize speech then —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'daber davar
 [and speaking words]"
 — stated regarding Shabbos.
 And through this the aspect of:
 "kol kesil b'rov devarim"
 is nullified.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "all who guard the Shabbos —
 even one who worshipped idolatry
 as in the generation of Enosh —
 he is forgiven"
 — for through Shabbos there is drawn
 the nullification of idolatry
 and false beliefs —
 and one merits complete and upright faith.
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the heart —
 as explained in the Tikunim —
 and through this the aspect of
 the strengthening of the heart
 is drawn to each and every person of Israel —
 that he should have the power in his heart
 to contain his intellect and wisdom —
 for our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "Shabbos is equal in weight
 to the entire Torah and the commandments."
 It follows that through the holiness of Shabbos itself
 it is as if one fulfilled the entire Torah —
 the commandments —
 and good deeds —
 and through this one merits
 the aspect of the strengthening of the heart —
 which is essential through good deeds —
 and then one is not in the aspect of:
 "chochmaso merubah mima'asav
 [one whose wisdom exceeds one's deeds]"
 — and one merits a good and pure heart —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'taher libenu l'avdecha be'emes —
 v'hanchilenu b'ahavah u'vratzson —
 Shabbas kodshecha
 [and purify our heart to serve You in truth —
 and grant us in love and in will —
 Your holy Shabbos]."
 And through this the aspect of:
 "kol anus
 [the voice of oppression],"
 and so on —
 is subdued —
 that is, the voice of the heretics
 and the philosophers
 who cause the most grievous sin
 through their evil wisdom —
 as explained within.

 And also — through the holiness of Shabbos
 all the shames and disgraces
 that a person has from enemies are nullified —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 44:16–17]:
 "kol hayom kelimasi negdi —
 v'chol haggid —
 mikol mecharef u'megadef —
 mipnay oyev u'misnakeim
 [all the day my shame is before me —
 and so on —
 from the voice of the reviler and the blasphemer —
 from the face of the enemy and the avenger]."
 For Shabbos has the virtue
 of silencing the enemy and the avenger —
 as explained below in Siman 57 within.
 And through this all the shames and disgraces
 are nullified —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'hishbit katzin cherpaso
 [and he caused the officer's insult to cease]."
 [Daniel 11:18]
 And this is the aspect of:
 שַׁבָּת — בֹּשֶׁת [boshes] —
 for through the holiness of Shabbos
 one is saved from shames and disgraces —
 and the aspect of the voice of the reviler
 and the blasphemer mentioned above is nullified.
 And this is the aspect of the seven voices
 recited at the entry of Shabbos —
 in the psalm Mizmor l'David [Psalms 29] —
 which correspond to Chag"t Neh"ym —
 as explained in the holy Zohar and in the kavannos.

 And this:
 "kol Hashem al hamayim
 [the voice of Hashem is upon the waters]"
 [Psalms 29:3] —
 corresponding to the aspect of Chesed —
 whose root is in Chochmah — as is well-known —
 for there is the root of the holy faith —
 as it is written:
 "Hashem b'chochmah yasad aretz
 [Hashem through wisdom founded the earth]"
 [Proverbs 3:19] —
 the aspect of:
 "Abba yasad berta
 [the Father founded the daughter]"
 — as is well-known.
 And therefore Chochmah is called
 the father of faith —
 as explained in the introduction to the Tikunim —
 and through this
 all false beliefs are nullified.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "l'haggid baboker chasdecha v'emunascha
 [to declare Your kindness in the morning
 and Your faithfulness],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 "Kol Hashem b'koach
 [the voice of Hashem is in power]"
 [Psalms 29:4] —
 corresponding to Gevurah —
 whose root is in Binah libah —
 that is, the aspect of the strengthening of the holy heart
 (for there is the essential power and strength —
 as explained elsewhere)
 — through which the philosophy and the heresy
 are nullified —
 as mentioned above.
 "Kol Hashem b'hadar
 [the voice of Hashem is in glory]"
 [Psalms 29:4] —
 corresponding to the aspect of Tiferes —
 the aspect of:
 "pe'er v'kavod
 [glory and honor]"
 — the aspect of [Psalms 8:6]:
 "v'chavod v'hadar ta'aterehu
 [and with honor and glory You have crowned him]"
 — the opposite of the aspect of the shames
 and disgraces mentioned above —
 and the Tanna elaborates on this.
 For since the essential grip
 of the Sitra Achra and its sustenance
 is from the aspect of legs — as is well-known —
 therefore here it elaborates more
 on the aspect of the subduing of the voices
 of the Sitra Achra
 through the holy voice.

 And this:
 "Kol Hashem shover arazim
 [the voice of Hashem breaks the cedars]"
 [Psalms 29:5] —
 that is, the nullification of:
 "kol kesil b'rov devarim"
 and the false beliefs —
 which are the aspect of the cedar —
 as explained within.
 "Kol Hashem chotzev lahavos eish
 [the voice of Hashem hews out flames of fire]"
 [Psalms 29:7] —
 that is, the strengthening of the holy heart —
 so that it can contain the words of wisdom within it —
 for the intellect is like fire
 held within the heart —
 as explained within.
 "Kol Hashem yachil midbar
 [the voice of Hashem causes the wilderness to tremble]"
 [Psalms 29:8]
 — and so on —
 "midbar
 [wilderness]"
 is the aspect of humility —
 the aspect of:
 "u'midbar matanah
 [and from the wilderness — a gift]"
 [Numbers 21:18] —
 as our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 [Tractate Eruvin 54a] —
 that is, the aspect of:
 "v'anochi tola'as v'lo ish —
 cherpas adam
 [and I am a worm and not a man —
 the shame of a person],"
 and so on [Psalms 22:7] —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "midbar lo adam vo
 [a wilderness — no person is in it]"
 [Job 38:26] —
 which is the aspect of the nullification of
 the voice of the reviler and the blasphemer —
 the aspect of [Proverbs 21:19]:
 "tov shevet b'eretz midbar —
 mei'eshet midyanim v'cha'as
 [better to dwell in a desolate land —
 than with a quarrelsome and vexing woman]."
 And this is likewise [Psalms 29:9]:
 "Kol Hashem yecholel ayalos
 [the voice of Hashem makes the hinds to calve]"
 — corresponding to the aspect of Malchus —
 the aspect of prayer.
 And this is what is explained in the kavannos:
 to intend in this voice
 the Name:
 שק"ו צי"ת
 — which is the aspect of the accepted prayer —
 the aspect of:
 "shu'asenu kabel v'shema —
 tza'akaseinu
