 [receive our cry and hear —
 our outcry],"
 and so on —
 and this Name equals in gematria:
 "tola'as
 [worm]"
 — as explained in the kavannos
 on Parashas haTamid —
 and as mentioned above in Siman 28 —
 that is, the aspect of:
 "anochi tola'as v'lo ish
 [I am a worm and not a man],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is what it concluded [Psalms 29:9]:
 "u'v'heichalo kulo omer kavod
 [and in His temple — everything says glory]"
 — which is the aspect of the perfect nullification
 of the aforementioned voice of the reviler —
 through the fact that in the time of prayer
 one stands in the palace of the King —
 and there all the disgraces are transformed
 into combinations of honor —
 as explained within.
 And because through this
 the holiness of the Land of Israel is revealed —
 which is the aspect of:
 "gam zos
 [this too]"
 — the aspect of the measurement of challah —
 as explained within —
 therefore it is explained in
 Shulchan Aruch,
 Orach Chayyim, Siman 242 —
 that the custom is to knead
 the measurement of challah
 from which to break bread [livtzo'a]
 in honor of Shabbos, and so on.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — that is, through the holiness of Shabbos
 one merits the perfection of prayer —
 which is the aspect of regel [foot] —
 as explained within —
 and the prayer will be so perfect
 that through it
 the light of the merit of the Patriarchs
 will sparkle —
 who are the aspects of the legs of the throne —
 as explained within.
 And also — it alludes to the ascent
 of the holy legs from the grip
 of the Sitra Achra —
 which is the aspect of the rectification
 of the three voices mentioned above.
 And this:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — he should guard himself
 from pursuing his affairs
 that have within them the grip of foolishness —
 the aspect of [Numbers 11:8]:
 "shatu ha'am v'laktu —
 b'shitusa
 [the people went about and gathered —
 in their foolishness]"
 — which is the aspect of:
 "ki ein chefetz biksilim —
 kol kesil b'rov devarim —
 lo yachphotz chesil b'sevunah
 [for there is no desire in fools —
 the voice of a fool is in the multitude of words —
 a fool does not desire understanding]."
 But on Shabbos one must engage
 only in the affairs of Heaven —
 which are the aspects of the holy wisdom and intellect —
 and the nullification of all forms of false beliefs —
 which are complete foolishness.
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight]"
 — this is the aspect of the strengthening of the heart —
 so that it can contain the wisdom
 and the holy intellect within it —
 which is the essential delight —
 as mentioned above many times.
 For the essential delight is in the heart —
 as explained elsewhere —
 and the philosophers, and so on, mentioned above —
 are utterly distant from the holy delight —
 and all their days are filled with anger
 and sorrows — as explained elsewhere.
 And this is [Proverbs 19:10]:
 "lo na'avah l'chesil ta'anug
 [delight is not fitting for a fool]"
 — all the more so those concerning whom it is stated
 [Proverbs 26:12]:
 "ra'isa ish chacham b'einav —
 tikvah l'chesil mimenu
 [you saw a person wise in his own eyes —
 there is more hope for a fool than for him]"
 — for they are even worse than fools.
 And this:
 "no'ef ishah chasar lev
 [one who commits adultery with a woman
 lacks heart/understanding]"
 [Proverbs 6:32] —
 which refers to these mentioned above —
 as explained within.
 And this:
 "nega v'kalon yimtza
 [affliction and disgrace shall he find]"
 [Proverbs 6:33] —
 for delight and honor are transformed
 for them into affliction and disgrace.
 And this:
 "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [the holy one of Hashem, honored]"
 — the aspect of the nullification
 of the shames and disgraces —
 which are the opposite of honor.

 And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 "she'lo yifsa'a pis'ayah gasah —
 ki pis'ayah gasah noteles achas mi'chamesh me'os
 mi'maor einav shel adam
 [one should not take large strides —
 for large strides take away
 one five-hundredth
 of the light of a person's eyes]."
 And this is a blemish in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the strengthening of sight
 to see far —
 the righteousness of the judgments of G-d,
 blessed be He —
 as mentioned above —
 through which one merits
 the perfection of prayer —
 which is called derech [way] —
 as explained within.
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — he should not petition for his personal needs —
 for then the prayer is in its perfection
 in the aspect of:
 "sheva bayom hilalticha
 [seven times a day I have praised You]"
 — and one does not petition even for one's physical needs
 out of the honor of Shabbos —
 so as not to be reminded of one's sorrow —
 and so as not to question
 the uprightness of His blessed judgments —
 which are likewise the aspect of desire [chefetz] —
 as it is written [Ecclesiastes 8:6]:
 "ki l'chol chefetz yesh es u'mishpat
 [for every desire has a time and judgment],"
 and so on —
 see Rashi there.
 And this [Ecclesiastes 5:7]:
 "im oshek rash v'gezal mishpat v'tzedek
 tire'h b'medinah —
 al titameh al hachefetz
 [if you see the oppression of the poor
 and the perversion of justice and righteousness
 in the province —
 do not wonder at the desire],"
 and so on —
 see Rashi there.
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — "da Atika Kadisha
 [this is the Holy Ancient One]"
 — for through all the above
 one merits to see the downfall of the wicked —
 and through this
 the face of Hashem is revealed
 to those who do good —
 as explained within —
 and in the aspect of Atik
 there is the essential light of the face —
 as is well-known.
 "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz —
 v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will cause you to ride upon the heights of the earth —
 and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — this is the aspect of the inheritance
 of the Land of Israel —
 which is higher than all lands —
 and is called the heritage of Yaakov —
 as the commentators explained.
 And in the holy Zohar they expounded:
 "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz —
 da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [and I will cause you to ride upon the heights of the earth —
 this is the Holy Apple Orchard]"
 — that is, the aspect of the perfect ascent of Malchus —
 which is itself the aspect of faith —
 the aspect of prayer —
 the aspect of the holiness of the Land of Israel —
 as is well-known.
 And our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 as it is written:
 "v'atah al bamoseimo tidrock
 [and you shall tread upon their heights],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — that is, one sees the downfall of the wicked —
 and they are subdued beneath him.

 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — "da Ze'ir Anpin
 [this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — the aspect of Tiferes —
 which is the totality of the light of the Patriarchs —
 the aspect of:
 "v'tiferes banim avosam
 [and the glory of children is their fathers]"
 — as mentioned above many times.

 And this is the aspect of what our Sages expounded
 [Tractate Shabbos 118]:
 that one merits an inheritance without limits —
 for through this one can reveal
 the holiness of the Land of Israel to the world —
 even when it is in exile
 under the hand of the Sitra Achra —
 in the aspect of [Leviticus 26:44]:
 "v'af gam zos b'heyosam b'eretz oyveihem
 [and yet even this — when they are in the land of their enemies]."
 For through this all the constraints
 of the Sitra Achra are nullified —
 and the holiness of the Land of Israel
 is revealed even now —
 for the merit of the Patriarchs itself
 is likewise the aspect of without limits —
 the aspect of: the merit of the Patriarchs
 endures forever —
 and so on —
 as mentioned above in Siman 37.
 And this:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — that is, all of this one merits
 through the perfection of the Shabbos prayer —
 until it is in the aspect of
 the word of Hashem Himself —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'asim devarai b'ficha —
 u'vetzal yadi kisisicha
 [and I shall place My words in your mouth —
 and in the shadow of My hand I have covered you]"
 [Isaiah 51:16]
 — that is, through the shadow made
 through the revelation
 of the hand of Hashem —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'tochaz b'mishpat yadi
 [and My hand takes hold of judgment]"
 [Deuteronomy 32:41] —
 through this the light of the eyes of the Tzadik
 is strengthened —
 and he merits the perfection of prayer
 in the aspect of all the aforementioned rectifications —
 for then the prayer is in the aspect of
 the word of Hashem —
 since one merits the aspect of the casting off of corporeality
 so fully during prayer —
 until one does not even feel one's own existence —
 for all one's being is nullified —
 and there is nothing here but the King Himself —
 which is the aspect of:
 "u'v'heichalo kulo omer kavod
 [and in His temple — everything says glory]."
 Then all the words of one's prayer
 are in the aspect of the words of the King Himself,
 as it were —
 in the aspect of:
 "Adonai sefasai tiftach
 [O L-rd — open my lips]"
 — as understood within.
 And through properly rectified prayer
 the light of the merit of the Patriarchs sparkles —
 and one merits all the above.

segments.he: ועל ידי שלימות האמונה באים אל השכל ואז נשלם האמונה ביותר ועל ידי זה בא לשכל עליון ביותר. וזה בחינת העליות הקדושות של שבת שתחלת העליה הוא במלכות הוא בחינת אמונה והמלכות עולה בבחינת נה"י חג"ת חב"ד שזה סוד חקל תפוחין קדישין כידוע. היינו שנשלמת האמונה בכל פעם ביותר עד שעולה אל שכל שהוא חב"ד ואחר כך עולין עוד ביותר זה בחינת ושמרתם את השבת כי קדש הוא עיין בכתבי האריז"ל ותבין וזה בחינת וזרחה לכם יראי שמי (אלו שומרי שבת כמו שדרשו רז"ל) יראה הוא בחינת מלכות בחינת אמונה שנשלמת על ידי קדושת שבת כנ"ל. וזה שמש צדקה נייו שזוכין על ידי זה לבא לאור השכל שהוא בחינת שמש כמבואר בפנים. וזה בחינת שמש צדקה כי זה שזוכין לבא אל השכל הוא רק צדקה וחסד מאתו יתברך כי האמונה תולה בבחירתו של האדם להתחזק באמונה שלימה. אבל חכמה ושכל הוא רק ממנו יתברך בבחינת כי ה' יתן חכמה וכו' בחינת אתה חונן לאדם דעת. וזה שאמרו רז"ל שמש בשבת צדקה לעניים. היינו כי אין עני אלא מן הדעת ועל כן מה שהשם יתברך משפיע להאדם חכמה ומוחין על ידי קדושת שבת שזה בחינת שמש בשבת הוא רק בתורת צדקה לעניים. היינו כי אין עני אלא מן הדעת ועל כן מה שהשם יתברך משפיע להאדם חכמה ומוחין על ידי קדושת שבת שזה בחינת שמש בשבת הוא רק בתורת צדקה וחסד בחינת צדקה לעניים. וזה בחינת מתנה טובה יש לי בבית גנזיי ואמרו שם מתן שכרה לא עבידא לאגלויי היינו פנימיית קדושת שבת בחינת המוחין שזוכין לקבל בשבת. וזה בעצמו בחינת הנשמה יתרה בחינת ונשמת שדי תבינם. וזה בחינת אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות וכו' כי שמירת שבת הראשון הוא רק על ידי אמונה ועל ידי זה זוכין לשכל ואז זוכין לאמונה יותר גדולה ולשכל יותר גדול שזה בחינת שבת השני. ועל כן למדו זאת מדכתיב אשר ישמרו את שבתותי וסמיך ליה והביאותים אל הר קדשי ושימחתים בית תפלתי. הר הוא בחינת מלכות בחינת אמונה. וזה בחינת תשורי מראש אמנה פירש רש"י מראשית האמונה שהאמנת בי וכו' דבר אחר הר הוא וכו' ושמו אמנה. בית זה בחינת חכמה ושכל בחינת בחכמה יבנה בית. ועל כן אברהם שהיה ראש למאמינם קראו הר ויעקב שהוא בחינת שמש בחינת השכל כמבואר במקום אחר שקראו בית היינו כנ"ל ומחמת שבשבת נשלמת האמונה כל כך עד שנתפשטת בכל האיברים. על כן מצוה לענג אז את הגוף גם כן.
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of the perfection of the soul — in the aspect of: "Shabbas vayinafash."

segments.he: וענג שבת הוא כולו קודש כמבואר במקום אחר. וזה בחינת שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה והתענג על ה' שזה בחינת ענג שבת כמו שדרשו רז"ל וזה בודאי מדריגה גדולה כשזוכה האדם לאמונה שלימה כל כך עד שמתפשטת על כל איברי הגוף ועל כל תענוגי הגוף שזה בחינת ורעה אמונה שאוכל וניזון מאמונה ואחר כך בא על ידי זה אל השכל והשכל הוא כביכול חלק אלוק ממעל כמובן במאמר אשרי זרקע סימן לה. ואז הוא ניזון כביכול מהשכל ממש בבחינת החכמה תחיה את בעליה וזה בחינת ויחזרו את אלקים ויאכלו וישתו כמובא. וגם בזה יש מדריגה למעלה ממדריגה כי לא כל מדריגות האמונה שוות וכן במדרגות השכל כידוע:
segments.en:
Shabbos = holiness of Eretz Yisrael / sparkling of the light of the Patriarchs / prayer in its perfection: Kedushah of Eretz Yisrael from Shabbos; extra soul = Eretz Yisrael (Siman 37). On Shabbos prayer is in its perfection = sparkling of light of the Patriarchs. Zohar Bereishis 23: weekday prayers received through ox/lion/eagle; on Shabbos: G-d descends with the three Patriarchs to receive "His only daughter" = "Shin bas" = Shabbas. Tikunim: "u'v'atar d'avhan taman Shechinah taman" = holiness of Eretz Yisrael = "v'zacharti es brisi Yaakov… v'ha'aretz ezkor." Shabbas = Shin-bas = Patriarchs + Shechinah (Zohar). Through all this: merit to see the downfall of the wicked = "ki hineh oyvecha yove'du… vatabet eyni b'shurai" (Psalm 92). Shabbos = three colors of the eye and the pupil = merit rectification of sight = "re'u ki Hashem natan lachem haShabbas" = see far = attain righteousness of G-d's judgments = even the success of the wicked is for their downfall + to save the Tzadik from the venom of the eyes of the wicked.
 Psalm 92 mapped through prayer / seeing G-d's righteousness / downfall of the wicked: "Tov l'hodos laHashem" = perfection of prayer through seeing righteousness of G-d's judgments = "ki lo atzadik rasha" = "Elyon" = Lamentations 3:35–36; Psalms 7: "Elokim shofet tzadik" concluding "odeh Hashem k'tzidko v'azamrah shem Hashem Elyon" (7:18); Psalms 9:2–5: "azamrah shimcha Elyon… ki asisa mishpati v'dini — yashavta l'chisei shofet tzedek." "L'haggid baboker chasdecha" = at the time of seeing the downfall of the wicked = "labekarim atzamit kol rish'ay aretz" (Psalms 101:8). "V'emunascha ballaylos" = during darkness/exile/success of wicked: believe in G-d = His judgments are upright = everything for Israel's good. "Ish ba'ar lo yeda… bifroach resha'im… l'hishmaedam adey ad… l'haggid ki yashar Hashem tzuri." Also at Minchah of Shabbos: "tzidkascha k'harerei El / mishpatecha tehom rabbah" = heart straightened from crookedness = straight heart + complete faith = perfection of prayer = parah adummah. "Shabbas v'dinim v'parah b'Marah nitztavu" = through Shabbos: see righteousness of G-d's judgments → perfection of prayer = parah. At Marah: G-d shows "sweetens the bitter with the bitter" = the very bitterness of exile through the success of the wicked IS the perfection of Israel's goodness and the downfall of the wicked. "Malach ra b'al korcho oneh amen" = evil becomes a throne for holiness. On Shabbos easier to pray with casting off of corporeality = Shabbos = world of souls (Zohar).
 Binding to souls of those who dwell in the dust / Moshe and Tzadikim descend on Erev Shabbos / seven blessings: On Shabbos: bind with nefashos/ruchos/neshamos of those in the dust = through neshamah yeseirah. Sometimes: receive one's own portions of nefesh/ruach/neshamah perfected in previous gilgulim. Sometimes: receive portions of ancient Tzadikim. Moshe + other Tzadikim descend every Erev Shabbos to rectify souls of the living and the dead (Ari z"l). Must bind to the souls of those in the dust especially during prayer = "afar" aspect of prayer. "Sheva-sheva" in parah alluding to perfection of prayer = "sheva bayom hilalticha" (Psalms 119:164) = seven blessings in the Shabbos prayer.
 Rectification of the three voices / seven voices of Psalm 29 / the seven Sefiros: Essential rectification of the three voices through Shabbos = Da'as and mochin drawn to each Jew → nullify false beliefs = "kol kesil b'rov devarim." Shabbos = holiness of speech = minimize speech = "v'daber davar" → nullifies "kol kesil." "Afilu avad avodah zarah k'dor Enosh mochalin lo" = Shabbos draws nullification of idolatry + false beliefs = complete upright faith. Shabbos = heart (Tikunim) = strengthening of heart = power to contain one's intellect; "shekuah shabbas k'chol haTorah v'hamitzvos" = as if fulfilled entire Torah = "chochmaso merubah mima'asav" nullified = pure heart = "v'taher libenu… Shabbas kodshecha" = nullifies "kol anus" = voice of heretics and philosophers. Shabbos = Boshes = saved from all shames and disgraces = "kol mecharef u'megadef" nullified = "v'hishbit katzin cherpaso." Seven voices of Psalm 29 at entry of Shabbos = Chag"t Neh"ym (Zohar and kavannos): (1) "Kol Hashem al hamayim" = Chesed (root in Chochmah = root of holy faith = "Abba yasad berta" = Father of faith = nullifies false beliefs) = "l'haggid baboker chasdecha v'emunascha"; (2) "Kol Hashem b'koach" = Gevurah (root in Binah libah = strengthening of holy heart = nullifies philosophy and heresy); (3) "Kol Hashem b'hadar" = Tiferes = glory and honor = opposite of shames and disgraces = Tanna elaborates here since Sitra Achra's grip is from the legs; (4) "Kol Hashem shover arazim" = Netzach = nullify "kol kesil b'rov devarim" and false beliefs = cedar; (5) "Kol Hashem chotzev lahavos eish" = Hod = strengthening of the heart to contain wisdom = intellect like fire in the heart; (6) "Kol Hashem yachil midbar" = Yesod = humility = "u'midbar matanah" (Eruvin 54a) = "v'anochi tola'as v'lo ish" = "midbar lo adam vo" (Job 38:26) = nullifies voice of reviler/blasphemer = "tov sheves b'eretz midbar"; (7) "Kol Hashem yecholel ayalos" = Malchus = prayer → kavannah: Shem Shakov-Tzait = "shu'asenu kabel v'shema tza'akaseinu" = gematria = "tola'as" (kavannos of haTamid; Siman 28). "U'v'heichalo kulo omer kavod" = perfect nullification of reviler's voice = one stands in the palace of the King = all disgraces transformed into combinations of honor. "Gam zos" = kedushah of Eretz Yisrael = measurement of challah. SA OC 242: knead challah for Shabbos.
 Isaiah 58 — Siman 55: "Raglecha" = perfection of prayer (= regel) → light of merit of Patriarchs (= legs of the throne); also: ascent of holy legs from Sitra Achra = rectification of the three voices. "Me'asos chafatzecha" = guard from foolishness = "shatu ha'am v'laktu b'shitusa" = "kol kesil b'rov devarim / lo yachphotz chesil"; on Shabbos = holy wisdom/intellect + nullification of false beliefs. "Call it delight" = strengthening of heart to contain wisdom = essential delight; the philosophers have no true delight = "lo na'avah l'chesil ta'anug"; "ra'isa ish chacham b'einav tikvah l'chesil mimenu"; "no'ef ishah chasar lev" = refers to them; "nega v'kalon yimtza" = their delight and honor become affliction and disgrace. "Honored" = nullification of shames and disgraces. "Honor it / from your ways / no large strides" = blemish in Shabbos = weakening sight that must see far to see G-d's righteousness; prayer is called "derech." "Your affairs / speaking words" = no petitioning for personal needs = prayer = "sheva bayom hilalticha" = "kol chefetz yesh es u'mishpat" (Ecclesiastes 8:6; Rashi); "im oshek rash… al titameh al hachefetz" (Ecclesiastes 5:7; Rashi). "Then delight" = Atika Kadisha = see downfall of wicked = face of Hashem revealed to those who do good = light of the face in Atik. "Heights of earth" + "Heritage of Yaakov" = inheritance of Eretz Yisrael = higher than all lands; Zohar: Chakla Tupichin = perfect ascent of Malchus = faith + prayer + holiness of Eretz Yisrael; saved from subjugation = "v'atah al bamoseimo tidrock" = see downfall of wicked. Ze'ir Anpin = Tiferes = totality of light of the Patriarchs = "v'tiferes banim avosam"; nachalah b'li metzarim = reveal kedushah of Eretz Yisrael even in exile = "v'af gam zos b'heyosam b'eretz oyveihem"; merit of Patriarchs endures forever (Siman 37). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = perfection of Shabbos prayer = "v'asim devarai b'ficha u'vetzal yadi kisisicha" (Isaiah 51:16) = shadow of the hand of Hashem = "v'tochaz b'mishpat yadi" = light of Tzadik's eyes strengthened → perfect prayer in all rectifications → casting off of corporeality → all one's being nullified → "u'v'heichalo kulo omer kavod" → words of prayer = words of the King Himself = "Adonai sefasai tiftach" → light of merit of the Patriarchs sparkles.
 

 Siman 56 — סימן נו
 U'veyom haBikurim — "And on the day of the first fruits…"
 [Numbers 28:26]
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 56]

 Shabbos is the aspect of Malchus —
 the aspect of Shabbas Malkesah —
 as is well-known.

segments.he: !!!a!!!סימן צב !!!0!!! על ידי מה שהאדם נע ונד אפילו בתוך ביתו יכול לשכך את האש שהוא בחינת דינים ויכול להחיות מתים שיהיו חיים וכו' כמבואר הענין בפנים ובזה מבואר קצת מה שאמר השם יתברך לקין נע ונד תהיה בארץ וכו' כי מאחר שגברו עליו הדינין מאד על ידי שהמית את הבל ונאחז בו סטרא דמותא רחמא ליצלן. על כן היה תיקונו על ידי שיהיה נע ונד. שזה בחינת גלות מכפרת כי על ידי זה נמתקין הדינים ונתבטל סטרא דמותא כנ"ל. (ועל כן יש דורשין וישם ה' לקין אות וכו' הזריח לו גלגל חמה היינו בחינת הזריח להם השמש שיבואר לקמן) ועל כן גם אצל ההורג בשוגג נאמר שצריך להיות נע ונד. לטלטל עצמו ממקומו ולנוס לעיר מקלטו ועל ידי זה ניצול ממיתה היינו כנ"ל. ועל כן נאמר בו שצריך לישב דייקא בעיר מקלטו ואם יצא מחוץ לגבול עיר מקלטו היינו חוץ לתחום העיר ומצא אותו גואל הדם ורצח אותו אין לו דם כי מאחר שנמתקו הדינים כבר מעליו וניצול מסטרא דמותא על ידי שהיה נע ונד ונס לעיר מקלטו על כן יכול להיות על ידי שיהיה עוד נע ונד ויצא מחוץ לעיר מקלטו יהיה נאחז בו סטרא דמותא ביותר בפרט כפי המבואר בפנים שבחינת הנע ונד הוא בבחינת כנפי ריאה דנשבי על לבא שעל ידי זה ממזג את האש שבלב שיהיה במדה כי אלמלא כנפי ריאה דנשבי על לבא הוה לבא אוקיד כל גופא. וזה ידוע שאם הרוח מנשב באש יותר מהמדה אזי או שמכבה האש לגמרי או שמבעיר האש ביותר מהמדה וכמבואר במקום אחר. על כן אם יצא מחוץ לעיר מקלטו אף אם לא ישוב לביתו אף על פי כן יוכל להיות שיתגברו הדינים שהן בחינת תבערת האש ביותר ותתאחז בו סטרא דמותא באחד משני אופנים הנ"ל. ועל כן בשבת שנמתקין הדינים ממילא על ידי קדושת שבת כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש וזה בחינת טועמיה חיים זכו בחינת תחיית המתים כי נכנע בחינת סטרא דמותא. על כן שבת הגין על אדם הראשון שנאמר לו ביום אכלך ממנו מות תמות וכמו שאמרו רז"ל וזה בחינת לא תבערו אש וכו' כי נמתק אז האש.
segments.en:
And all the souls of Israel are rooted
 in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the world of souls —
 as it is written:
 "u'veyom hashevi'i shavas vayinafash
 [and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed]"
 [Exodus 31:17] —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar
 and in the Sefer haBahir.
 Therefore:
 "kol Yisrael bnay melachim —
 v'yesh l'chol echad miYisrael
 bechinah malchus l'fi bechinaso
 [all Israel are children of kings —
 and each and every person of Israel has
 the aspect of Malchus
 according to his aspect]."
 And the aspect of the Malchus
 in the holiness of Shabbos
 is in the aspect of revelation [b'is'galyah]
 and in the aspect of concealment [b'is'kasya].
 For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "matan sechara lo avida l'igaluya
 [the reward of the mitzvah
 is not made apparent]."
 And Shabbos was given in privacy —
 for even though the holiness of Shabbos
 and the aspect of its Malchus
 is also visible in the aspect of revelation [b'is'galyah] —
 for Israel are very careful about its honor —
 and from the first day of the week
 they mention the day of Shabbos
 and invite and prepare what is needed
 for the honor of Shabbos —
 nonetheless the essential Malchus
 is in the aspect of concealment [b'is'kasya] —
 for in the aspect of revelation —
 it is, as it were,
 in the aspect of poverty —
 "dalis lei migarmei klum
 [she has nothing of her own]"
 — for one does not perform labor on it —
 and one does not earn money on it —
 and one does not make a profit on it.
 And as it is written in Zohar Shemos, folio 255:
 "in these two
 a person lends to the Holy One, blessed be He —
 when he has mercy on the poor —
 and when he goes out on Shabbosim and festivals,"
 and so on —
 in the aspect of:
 "malveh Hashem chonen dal
 [one who lends to Hashem has mercy on the poor]"
 [Proverbs 19:17].
 And in Tikkun 21, folio 58:
 "ani ihu yom haShabbas
 [the poor one is the day of Shabbos],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And also — it is known that
 on it Mars and Saturn have dominion, and so on —
 and in Zohar Yisro, folio 88:
 "vayevarech Elokim es yom hashevi'i
 [and G-d blessed the seventh day],"
 and so on —
 "keivan d'lo mishtakchey bei mezonah —
 mah birchasa ishtakach bei?
 Ella hachi tana: kol birkan d'eila v'tata —
 b'yoma shevi'ah talyan
 [since food is not found on it —
 what blessing is found on it?
 Rather — thus we have taught:
 all the blessings of above and below —
 depend on the seventh day],"
 and so on —
 see there.
 From this it is likewise understood
 that the aspect of the Malchus
 and the dominion of the holy Shabbos
 is in the aspect of concealment —
 for:
 "ashir b'rashim yimshol
 [a rich man rules over the poor]"
 [Proverbs 22:7] —
 and on Shabbos —
 one who has not labored and prepared on Erev Shabbos —
 what will he eat on Shabbos?
 And yet — in the aspect of concealment —
 all the abundance and blessing
 flows only from Shabbos —
 to all the days of the week —
 and all of them are under its dominion and kingship —
 and all of them are subdued and bowed before it.
 And see also in the Petichta
 [introduction] to Midrash Eichah:
 "sichu bi yoshvey sha'ar
 [those who sit at the gate speak about me],"
 and so on —
 where the nations mock Israel —
 saying they are poor
 because of the expenditures of Shabbos, and so on.
 But in truth it is the opposite —
 for all the livelihood and wealth —
 which is the aspect of Malchus
 — flows only from the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above —
 and as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "the wealthy among the other lands
 come from those who honor the Shabbos"
 — for all who add [to the honor of Shabbos] —
 it is added to them.
 And this is what is written [Jeremiah 17:24–25]:
 "v'hayah im shamo'a tishme'un eli —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'likaddesh es yom haShabbas —
 v'chol haggid —
 u'va'u v'sha'aray ha'ir hazos —
 melachim v'sarim yoshvim al kisei David
 [and it shall be — if you hearken diligently to Me —
 and so on —
 and sanctify the Shabbos day —
 and so on —
 and there shall come through the gates of this city
 kings and princes sitting on the throne of David],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 for the essential continuity of the kingdom of Israel
 depends on the observance of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.

 And every person must not use
 the aspect of the Malchus he possesses
 for his own benefit and needs —
 so as not to make the sacred into the profane,
 heaven forfend.
 For the Malchus
 one receives through the holiness of Shabbos
 is holy —
 and it is forbidden to misappropriate it [lim'ol bo]
 and derive benefit from it —
 to fill one's lust
 and to use it for one's own benefit and needs.
 But one should use the aspect of Malchus
 that each person possesses according to his aspect —
 only for the sake of the honor of G-d, blessed be He —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'hayasah laHashem haMeluchah
 [and the kingdom shall be to Hashem]"
 [Obadiah 1:21] —
 that is, to warn and rebuke
 all those people who are under his dominion —
 and to draw them close to G-d, blessed be He.

 And this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:1]:
 "vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael
 [and Moshe gathered the entire congregation
 of the children of Israel]"
 — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 that every Sage of the generation
 must assemble congregations
 on every Shabbos
 and expound to them in words of Torah.
 And the essential expounding
 is to teach the people
 the statutes of G-d and His Torah —
 and to instill the fear of Hashem
 in their hearts —
 as explained in Magen Avraham
 in Shulchan Aruch,
 Orach Chayyim, Siman 290.
 And this is also incumbent upon every person
 according to his own aspect.
 For during all the weekdays
 he is occupied with his labor and affairs —
 and therefore on Shabbos —
 when at the very least
 his heart is free and open —
 and he reclines and gathers together
 with his household —
 then at the very least
 one must speak to their hearts
 words of ethical teaching
 and the fear of Hashem —
 and draw them close to the service of G-d, blessed be He —
 which is the essential holiness of Shabbos —
 as it is written:
 "ki ot hi beinai u'veinechem l'doroseichem —
 lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem
 [for it is a sign between Me and between you
 throughout your generations —
 to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you]."
 And when one uses the Malchus
 only for the sake of G-d, blessed be He —
 then the Malchus
 is in the aspect of a free person [ben chorin] —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "mor deror
 [flowing myrrh]"
 [Exodus 30:23] —
 as explained within.
 That is — then the Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the Small Shabbos —
 receives illumination from the aspect of Yovel —
 the aspect of Binah —
 which is the aspect of the Great Shabbos —
 as explained in the Tikunim —
 and as mentioned above many times.
 And the Great Shabbos — the aspect of Binah —
 is the aspect of the World to Come — as is well-known.
 And the World to Come
 is the day that is entirely long —
 and through this
 length of days is drawn into the Malchus.

segments.he: וכן להיפוך על חילול שבת ח"ו נאמר והצתי אש בשעריה כנ"ל כמה פעמים וכן מחלליה מות יומת כי על ידי זה גובר האש וסטרא דמותא רחמנא ליצלן.
segments.en:
And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer, chapter 18:
 "kol hamevareych al haYayin
 b'leiley Shabbasos —
 ma'arichin lo yamav v'shanosav b'olam hazeh —
 v'zocheh l'chayay olam haba
 [all who bless over wine
 on the nights of Shabbos —
 their days and years in this world are lengthened —
 and they merit the life of the World to Come]."
 For wine encompasses
 both aspects of Shabbos mentioned above —
 that is, the aspects of Binah and Malchus —
 as explained within in the previous Siman 12 —
 see there.
 And therefore the Kiddush of Shabbos
 is called a keri'ah [calling/reading] —
 as it is written:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight]"
 — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 "b'makom keri'ah sham yihyeh oneg
 [in the place of the calling —
 there shall be the delight]."
 That is — Kiddush must be in the place of the meal.
 For it is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 17:19]:
 "v'kara vo kol yemay chayyav
 [and he shall read from it all the days of his life]"
 — for through it one calls to
 the Living of all life [Chay haChayim] —
 to draw from Him life and length of days.
 For:
 "Shabbas shema d'Kudsha Brich Hu
 [Shabbos is the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He]."
 And through the Kiddush —
 through which one fulfills:
 "zachor es yom haShabbas
 [remember the day of Shabbos]"
 — one calls out in this
 the Name of the Living of all life —
 to draw from Him life and length of days.

 And this is the aspect of the seventy words
 in the Kiddush —
 the aspect of:
 "yemay shenoseynu vahem shiv'im shanah
 [the days of our years — in them are seventy years]."
 [Psalms 90:10]
 And also — the essential engagement in Torah —
 which is the Name of the Holy One,
 blessed be He —
 is on Shabbos.
 For then they publicly read
 from the valid [kesherah] Torah scroll —
 and complete all the portions of the Torah —
 which are all His blessed Names —
 as is well-known —
 and through this they draw length of days
 into the Malchus —
 from the aspect of the three Rishonim
 [first three Sefiros] —
 which are Chab"d —
 for there is the source of life —
 the aspect of:
 "haChochmah techayeh
 [wisdom gives life]"
 [Ecclesiastes 7:12] —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the World of Thought —
 which is the essential vitality —
 for the essential holiness of Shabbos
 is drawn from the aspect of the three Rishonim —
 the aspect of:
 "ki kodesh hu
 [for it is holy]"
 — as explained in the writings of the holy Ari z"l.
 But there the vitality is in the aspect of
 an abundance of light —
 for there is the aspect of above the traits.
 And therefore one needs to draw the vitality
 specifically through the Torah —
 which is the aspect of the central column [amuda d'emtza'isa] —
 that encompasses all the traits —
 and specifically through it
 one calls the vitality into the traits and the days.
 And through this one merits length of days —
 drawing length of days into the Malchus.

 And therefore one must read the Torah
 with one's mouth specifically —
 the aspect of:
 "ki chayyim heim l'motze'eihem —
 b'feh
 [for they are life to those who find them —
 with the mouth]"
 [Proverbs 4:22]
 and so on —
 as explained within —
 for Malchus peh.

segments.he: ועל כן נאמר בשבת שבו איש תחתיו אל יצא איש ממקומו. כי אין צריכין לעורר אז תיקון זה של בחינת נע ונד. רק אף על פי כן בתוך התחום מותר לילך.
segments.en:
And through this the vitality is even more contracted —
 so that it can be in the aspect of traits and days —
 as mentioned above.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Berachos 8a]:
 "kol hamashlem parashiyosav im hatzibur —
 ma'arichin lo yamav v'shanosav
 [all who complete their Torah portions with the community —
 their days and years are lengthened]."
 And see Zohar Yisro, folio 92:
 "tlas dargin inon —
 Shabbas ila'ah —
 Shabbas d'yoma —
 Shabbas d'leila —
 v'chulan chad v'ikarun kula Shabbas
 [there are three levels —
 Supernal Shabbos —
 Shabbos of the day —
 Shabbos of the night —
 and all of them are one
 and all are called Shabbos],"
 and so on —
 see there —
 that is, likewise the three aspects mentioned above:
 the source of vitality
 is the aspect of Supernal Shabbos.
 And the Torah —
 which is the totality of the traits and the days —
 is the aspect of Shabbos of the day.
 And Malchus is the aspect of Shabbos of the night —
 as is well-known.
 And this:
 "to'amehah chayyim zachu
 [those who taste it have merited life]"
 — for one merits through this
 life and length of days —
 as mentioned above.

 And the essential vitality
 is the intellect and the Da'as
 one merits to receive
 through the holiness of Shabbos —
 the aspect of:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem."
 And likewise [Ezekiel 20:20]:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem Elokeichem
 [to know that I am Hashem your G-d]."
 And through this Da'as
 all the concealments are revealed —
 even the concealment within concealment.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer:
 "kol hashomer Shabbas —
 mochalin lo al kol avonosaym
 [all who guard the Shabbos —
 they are forgiven for all their sins]."
 And our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Shabbos 118]:
 "afilu avad avodah zarah k'dor Enosh —
 mochalin lo
 [even one who worshipped idolatry
 as in the generation of Enosh —
 he is forgiven]"
 — for in the generation of Enosh
 the concealment strengthened greatly —
 until the Name of Hashem was concealed —
 as it is written:
 "az huchal likro b'shem Hashem
 [then it became profane to call out
 in the Name of Hashem]"
 [Genesis 4:26] —
 and the Targum renders it:
 "chalu miltzalya b'shema d'Hashem
 [they ceased to call out in the Name of Hashem]."
 But through the holiness of Shabbos —
 the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
 calls out again —
 and one calls out in the Name of Hashem —
 and all the concealments are revealed —
 and all one's sins are forgiven.
 And it has already been explained
 that the Kiddush of the day
 is likewise the aspect of the calling in His blessed Name —
 which is the aspect of the revelation of the concealments —
 and therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Berachos 20a]:
 "nashim chayavos b'Kiddush hayom d'oraissa —
 v'chol haggid —
 amar kra: zachor v'shamor —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'hani nashim ho'il v'isnehun b'shmirah —
 isnehun b'zchirah
 [women are obligated in Kiddush hayom
 by Torah law —
 and so on —
 as the verse states: remember and guard —
 and so on —
 and these women — since they are included
 in the [obligation of] guarding —
 they are [also] included in the remembering]"
 — for those who are in the aspect of the concealments
 are in the aspect of women —
 in three aspects —
 as explained within.
 And yet —
 they are included in the [obligation of] guarding.
 For Shamor —
 which is the trait of Malchus — as is well-known —
 is the end of all the levels.
 And it dwells even with those
 who are at the very lowest level —
 in the aspect of:
 "u'malchuso b'chol mashalah
 [and His kingdom rules over all]"
 — as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And therefore they are also included in the remembering.
 Zachor is the trait of Tiferes —
 the aspect of the Torah —
 for through the engagement in Torah
 one draws vitality —
 which is the aspects of Chochmah and Da'as —
 into the Malchus —
 until through this
 all the concealments are revealed.
 (And regarding why women
 are exempt from Torah study —
 this is not the place to explain it —
 and it will be explained elsewhere
 if G-d wills it —
 based on this teaching itself.)
 And this:
 "nashim chayavos b'Kiddush hayom d'oraissa
 [women are obligated in Kiddush hayom
 by Torah law]"
 — "d'oraissa
 [by Torah law]"
 — specifically [davka] —
 for the Kiddush is the aspect of
 the engagement in Torah —
 through which one calls and draws the vitality
 into the Malchus —
 as mentioned above —
 and through this one also merits
 length of days — as mentioned above.

 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 all who pray on Erev Shabbas
 and say Vayechulu —
 and so on —
 it is as if one became a partner
 with the Holy One, blessed be He,
 in the work of creation.
 For since the vitality drawn
 from the Living of all life, blessed be He,
 is in the aspect of above the traits —
 and is very hidden and concealed —
 therefore it is possible to deny everything,
 heaven forfend —
 saying that the worlds do not receive any vitality
 from Him at all, blessed be He.
 And thus the intention of creation is nullified —
 which was only:
 "b'gin d'yishtamodu'in lei
 [so that they should know Him]."
 Therefore — when one says Vayechulu
 and reveals
 that the Holy One, blessed be He,
 created everything —
 and the vitality of all of creation
 is only His blessed Name —
 which is the aspect of Shabbos —
 the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i
 melachto asher asah
 [and G-d completed on the seventh day
 His work that He had done]"
 [Genesis 2:2] —
 for He is the sustainer of all of creation —
 therefore it is as if one became a partner
 with the Holy One, blessed be He,
 in the work of creation —
 since through him the concealment was revealed —
 and it was transformed into Da'as —
 which is the essential vitality of the work of creation.

 And therefore the ministering angels
 who accompany him say to him:
 "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar
 [and your iniquity is removed —
 and your sin is atoned]."
 [Isaiah 6:7]
 For through the revelation of the concealments
 one merits complete repentance —
 and all one's sins are forgiven —
 as mentioned above.
 And this [Isaiah 1:18]:
 "leku na v'invachah yomar Hashem —
 im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim —
 kasheleig yalvinu
 [come now and let us reason together —
 says Hashem —
 if your sins are like crimson —
 they shall become white as snow],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — for the essential sin comes
 through the strengthening of the darkness and the concealment —
 until it seems permitted
 or completely straightforward, heaven forfend.
 And this is the aspect of [Jeremiah 2:35]:
 "al amarecha lo chatasi
 [on your saying: I have not sinned]."
 And the disputation [viku'ach] is
 the clarification of the matters —
 the aspect of the revelation of the concealments —
 and the moment the concealments are revealed —
 and one knows with true knowledge
 that one has sinned and blemished greatly —
 and one repents and regrets this in truth —
 and acknowledges and says:
 "chatasi v'shuv lo echeta od
 [I have sinned — and I will not sin again]"
 — then immediately one is forgiven —
 as we find with King David, peace be upon him —
 who said:
 "chatasi
 [I have sinned]"
 — and immediately the prophet said to him:
 "gam Hashem he'evir chata'ascha
 [Hashem has also removed your sin],"
 and so on [II Samuel 12:13] —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "leku na v'invachah"
 — and the moment the sin is clarified to you —
 and the concealment is revealed through the disputation —
 then immediately:
 "im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim —
 kasheleig yalvinu."

segments.he: אבל מחוץ לתחום יש בו איסור גם כן וילפי לה רז"ל (עירובין נא) מרוצח שנס לעיר מקלטו הנ"ל כמו שאמרו שם למדנו מקום ממקום ומקום מניסה וניסה מניסה וניסה מגבול וגבול מגבול וגבול מחוץ וחוץ מחוץ וכו' עיין רש"י שם והיינו כנ"ל. ועיין (מכות יא) דרשו רז"ל מנין לדברי תורה שקולטין וכו' ומסיק מאי קולטין קולטין ממלאך המות היינו כנ"ל. כי התורה הוא בחינת כנפי הריאה שעל ידה ניצולין מסטרא דמותא ועיין שם עוד מאי דכתיב אז יבדיל משה שלש ערים מעבר לירדן מזרחה שמש אמר הקב"ה למשה הזרח שמש וכו'. וזה בחינת וזרחה לכם יראי שמי (אלו שומרי שבת כנ"ל כמה פעמים) שמש צדקה (כי צדקה הוא גם כן בחינת הרוח שמשכך חימום האש שבלב בחינת רוחא נחית לשכך חמימא דלבא וכמבואר במאמר אשרי העם סימן י"ג.). וזה ומרפא בכנפיה בחינת כנפי ריאה הנ"ל. ועל כן כשחזר יעקב מהגלות שנס וגלה ללבן וניצול משרו של עשו סטרא דמותא נאמר אז ויזרח לו השמש ואחר כך נאמר ויבא יעקב (שהוא בחינת כנפי ריאה כמבואר בפנים) שלם עיר שכם וכו' ושכם הוא עיר מקלט כידוע. וזה ויחן את פני העיר ודרשו רז"ל מזה ששמר את השבת וקבע תחומין וכו' היינו כנ"ל ואחר כך נאמר וישב יעקב בארץ מגורי אביו וכו' ודרשו רז"ל ביקש יעקב לישב בשלוה כי סבר שכבר נמתקו כל הדינים ואין צורך עוד להיות נע ונד קפץ עליו רוגזו של יוסף כפשוטו. כי על ידי שמכרו את יוסף ויוסף הוא בחינת לב כמבואר בפנים נתעורר האש והדינים עוד עד שהוכרח לגלות למצרים ועל כן מבואר בזוהר הקדוש שהתיקון על מכירת יוסף היה על ידי שנצטוו ישראל על קדושת שבת היינו כנ"ל. ועל כן יעקב ויוסף הם הראשונים שמבואר בהם ששמרו את השבת כי הם בחינת ריאה ולבא שזה סוד שמירת שבת כנ"ל וכמובן בתיקונים:
segments.en:
And therefore it is a mitzvah
 to make Kiddush over wine specifically.
 For drinking wine brings forgetfulness —
 in the aspect of:
 "pen yishteh v'yishkach mechokek
 [lest he drink and forget what was decreed]"
 [Proverbs 31:5] —
 and as explained in
 Likutay Moharan Tinyana, Siman 26.
 And this is the aspect of
 the first concealment —
 the aspect of
 "na'aseh lo k'heter
 [it seems permitted to him]"
 — which is the aspect of women —
 the language of forgetfulness [lashon shichechah].
 And when one drinks even more —
 the concealment within concealment strengthens over him —
 until everything seems completely straightforward
 to him, heaven forfend —
 and this is the aspect of:
 "nashnu v'kafzu
 [they forgot and they leapt],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is the aspect of [Proverbs 23:31–32]:
 "al tere yayin ki yis'adam —
 ki yitein b'kos eino —
 yithalech b'meisharim
 [do not look upon wine when it is red —
 for it gives its sparkle in the cup —
 it walks in straightness]"
 — and Rashi explained:
 "hamarbeh b'shikaros —
 kol ha'aveiros domim lo k'meishor
 [one who multiplies in drunkenness —
 all the transgressions seem to him like straightness]."
 And likewise our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Yoma 74].
 But Kiddush over wine is the aspect of
 the revelation of the concealments —
 as it is written:
 "zachor es yom haShabbas —
 zachrehu al haYayin
 [remember the day of Shabbos —
 remember it over wine]"
 — and memory [zikaron]
 is the opposite of forgetfulness and concealment.
 And this is the aspect of [Hosea 14:8]:
 "zicho k'yayin Levanon
 [its remembrance is like the wine of Lebanon]"
 — for the wine of holiness
 is the aspect of the revelation of sacred Da'as —
 as explained within in Siman 20 —
 and through this the concealments are revealed —
 and they are transformed into Da'as —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim —
 kasheleig yalvinu"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this is what the Targum renders:
 "k'chamar atik
 [like aged wine]"
 and so on —
 for this Da'as is the aspect of length of days —
 which is drawn into the Malchus —
 and length of days is the aspect of Atik —
 as brought below within in Siman 60
 in the teaching Pasach Rabbi Shimon.
 And through this Da'as
 the concealments are revealed —
 and then the Torah itself
 proclaims before them —
 in the aspect of:
 "oraissa machrezas kameihu
 [the Torah proclaims before them]"
 and so on —
 and from this flow the thoughts of repentance
 that come to each and every person of Israel
 through the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and all of this because one merits to hear then
 the voice of the herald and the calling
 and the rebuke of the holy Torah.
 And this is the aspect of
 the seven voices in Mizmor l'David —
 which are recited at the entry of the holy Shabbos —
 and our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 that they correspond to
 the seven voices of the giving of the Torah.
 For at the entry of Shabbos —
 the voice of the heralds of the holy Torah —
 which are from the aspect of
 the voices of the giving of the Torah —
 is heard by each person according to his aspect.
 And therefore there are seven voices —
 for the Torah encompasses the seven traits.
 And therefore the essential time
 for the revelation of the secrets of the Torah
 is on Shabbos —
 for through the revelation
 of the concealments within concealments —
 the secrets of the Torah are revealed —
 as brought within.

 And therefore all agree
 that on Shabbos the Torah was given —
 for then the concealments are revealed —
 and they become Torah —
 for this is the aspect of
 what Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
 replied to the angels:
 "l'Mitzrayim yaradetem —
 yetzer hara yesh bachem —
 kin'ah yesh bachem
 [did you go down to Egypt? —
 do you have an evil inclination? —
 do you have jealousy?],"
 and so on — [וכו']
 — for specifically through the fact that
 the concealments strengthened upon Israel
 in the exile of Egypt —
 and likewise spiritually —
 the strengthening of the evil inclination, and so on —
 through this — when Moshe Rabbeinu,
 peace be upon him, came —
 who is the aspect of Da'as —
 and the concealments were revealed —
 Torah was made from this.
 For this is the aspect of what
 the first of the Ten Commandments began with:
 "anochi Hashem Elokecha —
 asher hotzesticha mei'eretz Mitzrayim
 [I am Hashem your G-d —
 Who brought you out of the land of Egypt]"
 [Exodus 20:2] —
 that is, the aspect of the revelation of the concealments.
 And He immediately warned them
 about the prohibition of idolatry —
 for through this comes the essential force
 of the strengthening of the concealments
 within concealments —
 the aspect of:
 "v'anochi haseter astir
 [and I will utterly conceal],"
 and so on [Deuteronomy 31:18] —
 for he turned to other gods.
 And He warned about vain oaths
 and the utterance of the Name of Heaven in vain.
 For in the utterance of the Name of Heaven
 one calls to the Living of all life —
 to draw from Him vitality —
 and therefore one must be careful
 not to mention Him in vain, heaven forfend —
 and all the more so
 not to take the Name of Hashem in vain [l'shav],
 heaven forfend.
 And afterward He warned about Shabbos —
 which is the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He —
 and it is a mitzvah to remember it —
 in the aspect of:
 "zachor es yom haShabbas l'kadsho
 [remember the day of Shabbos to sanctify it]"
 — in order to draw through it
 the holy vitality —
 and the revelation of Da'as —
 through which the concealments are revealed.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "yismechu b'malchuscha shomrey Shabbas
 [the guardians of Shabbos rejoice in Your kingdom],"
 and so on —
 for through the holy Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 the concealments are revealed —
 and Torah is made from them —
 which is called:
 "tov
 [good]"
 — the aspect of:
 "ain tov ela Torah
 [there is no good except Torah]"
 — as explained within.
 And this:
 "am mekadeshey shevi'i —
 kulam yisbe'u v'yis'angeu mituvacha
 [the people who sanctify the seventh day —
 all of them shall be satisfied
 and shall delight from Your goodness]."
 And this is what is written
 in the warning of Shabbos [Deuteronomy 5:14]:
 "atah u'vincha u'vitecha —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'gercha asher bishearecha
 [you and your son and your daughter —
 and so on —
 and your stranger who is within your gates]."
 For the holiness of Shabbos
 encompasses all the traits entirely —
 for it is the aspect of:
 "sof ma'aseh
 [the end of action]"
 — the aspect of Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the final word —
 and it is the aspect of the gatherer
 of all the camps [me'asef l'chol hamachanot] —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of the fear of Shabbos —
 the aspect of the awe of the kingdom [mora malchus].
 And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:6]:
 "u'vnay haneychar hanilavim el Hashem —
 v'chol haggid —
 kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'hevi'osim el har kodshi
 [and the children of the stranger
 who attach themselves to Hashem —
 and so on —
 every Shabbos guardian who does not desecrate it —
 and so on —
 and I shall bring them to My holy mountain]"
 — for the holiness of Shabbos
 encompasses and gathers all the levels —
 even those who were in the aspect of
 the concealment within concealment —
 as mentioned above.

 And because corresponding to the holy Malchus
 there is the wicked kingdom —
 the aspect of the kingdom of Haman-Amalek —
 therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "vayetz'u min ha'am lilkot
 [and the people went out to gather],"
 and so on —
 "immediately — Vayavo Amalek
 [and Amalek came]."
 And therefore the wicked Haman's eye
 was very evil toward the Shabbosim
 and the Yom Tovim of Israel —
 and he cast the lots before the king —
 "d'dachay l'chula shata —
 b'Shabbas hayom — Pesach hayom
 [driving away for the entire year —
 today is Shabbos — today is Pesach],"
 and so on —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 For the essential subduing of Haman
 comes through the holiness of Shabbos
 and Yom Tov —
 as also explained in Siman 135 and Siman 30.
 And therefore the beginning of the story of the Megillah
 — regarding the killing of Vashti —
 (through which Esther came
 to the king's palace —
 and through this specifically
 came the downfall of Haman)
 — was on Shabbos —
 as it is written:
 "b'yom hashevi'i —
 k'tov lev haMelech b'yayin
 [on the seventh day —
 when the heart of the King was merry with wine],"
 and so on —
 and our Sages of blessed memory taught
 that this was on Shabbos.
 And Haman himself specifically gave the advice
 to kill Vashti —
 for within the intense concealments
 there is also the G-dly vitality
 in the aspect of:
 "u'malchuso b'chol mashalah
 [and His kingdom rules over all]."
 And through this Esther came there —
 and Haman was killed afterward —
 and the concealment was broken —
 and after many generations
 the Torah was revealed —
 which had been clothed within
 the very body of the concealment itself —
 until from the descendants of Haman
 Torah was studied in Bnei Brak.
 And among Israel in general —
 the concealment was immediately
 transformed into Torah —
 for specifically through this
 they received the Torah anew —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "hadar kibluha bimey Achashverosh
 [they re-accepted it in the days of Achashverosh]."
 And because the wicked kingdom —
 the aspect of Haman-Amalek —
 accumulates money —
 and afterward —
 when Mordechai —
 the aspect of the holy Malchus —
 strengthens —
 he causes him to disgorge his swallowed wealth —
 for he extracts from him all his riches —
 in the aspect of:
 "chayil bala vayaki'enu
 [he swallowed wealth and shall vomit it up]."
 [Job 20:15]
 And therefore through the holiness of Shabbos
 one merits wealth —
 as mentioned above —
 and from it Torah is made —
 which is called eshes chayil [a woman of valor] —
 as explained within.
 And this itself is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of:
 "eshes chayil ateres ba'alah
 [a woman of valor is the crown of her husband],"
 and so on —
 as is well-known —
 the aspect of:
 "Keneses Yisrael yihyeh ben zugcha
 [the Congregation of Israel shall be your mate]"
 — and as explained below in Siman 277 within.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת רגליך שלא יהלך חוץ לתחום שבת כנ"ל עשות חפצך ביום קדשי שלא לפגום בקדושת שבת רק אדרבא וקראת לשבת ענג וכו'. וזה וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך ודרשו רז"ל שלא יפסיע פסיעה גסה שהוא בחינת רוגז כנ"ל כמה פעמים ועל ידי זה מעורר ח"ו האש הנ"ל. גם כפי הנ"ל שעל ידי שהאדם הולך אחת הנה ואחת הנה זה בחינת כנפי ריאה דנשבי על לבא. על כן צריכין גם בחול שלא לפסוע פסיעה גסה בכדי שלא לפגום על ידי זה בהרוח שבכנפי ריאה שיהיה בבחינת רוח סערה ח"ו ועל ידי זה יבעיר האש ביותר כנ"ל. וזה שאמרו רז"ל שפסיעה גסה נוטלת אחת מת"ק ממאור עיניו של אדם היינו שפוגם בכנפי ריאה שאמרו רז"ל למה נקראת שמה ריאה שמאירה את העינים. וגם פוגם בהלב שאמרו רז"ל שוריינא דעינא בלבא תליין. ועל כן כשהתוודע יוסף לאחיו אמר להם אל תרגזו בדרך ודרשו רז"ל אל תפסיעו פסיעה גסה היינו כנ"ל. ובשבת צריכין ליזהר בזה ביותר כי פוגם על ידי זה בכבוד שבת כנ"ל.
segments.en:
And according to the greatness of one's Da'as —
 so is the livelihood easily [come by] —
 and likewise compassion and peace multiply —
 and anger and cruelty are nullified.
 And therefore on Shabbos
 it is forbidden to toil with any effort
 for the purpose of earning a livelihood —
 as it is written:
 "es asher toffu efu
 [what you must bake — bake],"
 and so on [Exodus 16:23] —
 and it is written:
 "hayom lo timtze'uhu basadeh
 [today you shall not find it in the field]"
 [Exodus 16:25] —
 and: only one who labored on Erev Shabbos
 shall eat on Shabbos.
 And from Shabbos flows the abundance and livelihood
 to all the days of the week —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And likewise on Shabbos
 peace multiplies —
 the aspect of Shabbas Shalom —
 and compassion multiplies —
 the aspect of:
 "yecholah hi she'terachem
 [she can have compassion]."
 And likewise:
 "Shabbas hu mi'liz'ok —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'rachamav merubin —
 v'shavsah b'shalom
 [it is Shabbos and one must not cry out —
 and so on —
 and His mercies are many —
 and may it subside in peace]"
 [Tractate Shabbos 12a] —
 for on Shabbos Ze'ir Anpin
 ascends to the beard of Arich Anpin
 — which are the thirteen attributes of mercy —
 as is well-known.
 And therefore one must be careful
 about immersing in the mikvah
 in honor of Shabbos —
 for the mikvah is the aspect of the supreme intellect
 and great mercies —
 as explained within.
 And therefore the eating of Shabbos
 is the aspect of Manna —
 as brought —
 and for this reason one must place the bread
 between two coverings —
 in memory of the Manna.
 And likewise it is explained in the gloss of the Rema,
 Siman 242 —
 that the custom is to make a meat pastry [pashtidah]
 in memory of the Manna.
 For the Manna is the aspect of the supreme intellect
 mentioned above —
 as explained within.
 And also — מָן [man]
 is the initial letters of:
 "ma'amar na'aman
 [a faithful utterance]"
 — the aspect of an open, faithful, simple utterance —
 that speech has opened —
 and Da'as has been revealed —
 and His blessed faithfulness has been spread —
 that He, blessed be He,
 promises and performs acts of lovingkindness.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "v'daber davar
 [and speaking words]"
 — stated regarding Shabbos —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar:
 that Shabbos is the aspect of speech —
 for this is the aspect of the open utterance —
 and through this His blessed faithfulness
 and lovingkindness are spread —
 which is the aspect of the supreme Chesed
 that is drawn and revealed on Shabbos —
 as is well-known.

 And this:
 "Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos —
 tov l'hodos laHashem —
 v'lezammer l'shimcha elyon"
 — for in the holy Name —
 the vitality from the Living of all life
 is bounded, as it were —
 as explained within.
 And the vitality is the intellect.
 And on Shabbos
 there is drawn and revealed
 supremely exalted vitality and intellect —
 which is the aspect of:
 "l'shimcha elyon
 [to Your Name, Most High]."
 And this intellect is revealed
 through the speech of Shabbos.
 Therefore it is good then
 to give thanks and to sing:
 "l'shimcha elyon."
 "l'haggid baboker chasdecha —
 v'emunascha ballaylos
 [to declare Your kindness in the morning —
 and Your faithfulness in the nights]"
 — that is, the spreading of His blessed
 faithfulness and lovingkindness —
 as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem
 [how great are Your works, Hashem]"
 — the aspect of the revelation of Malchus
 which is nested in Asiyah.
 "me'od amku machshevosecha
 [how very deep are Your thoughts]"
 — for then the vitality is drawn into the Malchus —
 and the vitality is the aspect of thought —
 as mentioned above.
 "ish ba'ar lo yeda —
 v'chesil lo yavin es zos —
 bifroach resha'im v'chol haggid
 [a boorish person does not know —
 and a fool does not understand this —
 when the wicked flourish — and so on]"
 — that is, at the time of the strengthening
 of the concealment —
 when the wicked succeed —
 and the sacred Da'as
 is very concealed then.
 But in truth:
 "l'hishmaedam adey ad —
 v'atah marom l'olam Hashem
 [it is for their eternal destruction —
 and You are exalted forever, Hashem]"
 — for within the concealment itself
 there is the G-dly vitality —
 and all the success of the wicked
 is only for their downfall.
 And this:
 "ki hineh oyvecha Hashem —
 ki hineh oyvecha yove'du
 [for behold — Your enemies, O Hashem —
 for behold — Your enemies shall perish],"
 and so on —
 for when the concealment is revealed —
 then the downfall of the wicked
 and the success of the Tzadikim is drawn —
 and then one sees retrospectively
 that all the success of the wicked
 was the ultimate perfection of their downfall —
 as mentioned above.
 And because on Shabbos peace is drawn —
 as mentioned above —
 through this healing is drawn —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "Shabbas hu mi'liz'ok —
 v'refu'ah krovah lavo —
 v'rachamav merubin —
 v'shavsah b'shalom
 [it is Shabbos and one must not cry out —
 and healing is near to come —
 and His mercies are many —
 and may it subside in peace]"
 — for peace is healing —
 as brought within.

 And also — on Shabbos
 the pollution of the serpent —
 the thirty-nine melachos —
 the sadness of spirit —
 is repelled —
 the aspect of [Isaiah 14:3]:
 "b'yom hani'ach Hashem lecha
 mei'itzevonecha u'mirogzecha —
 u'min ha'avodah hakasheh asher uvad bach
 [on the day Hashem gives you rest —
 from your suffering and your anger —
 and from the hard work that was placed on you]"
 — as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And then the pulsing spirit [ruach hadofek]
 in the heart is even more strengthened —
 which is the aspect of the holy spirit —
 as explained within —
 and it goes and pulses and blows
 through all the limbs —
 and strength and health
 and new vitality are drawn upon
 all the limbs of the person —
 through the holy pulsing of the spirit breathing through them —
 which is the aspect of the holy spirit —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 from the secret of the holy spirit
 that is drawn upon each and every person of Israel on Shabbos.
 And this is the aspect of the extra soul
 a person merits on Shabbos —
 the aspect of:
 "nishmas ruach chayyim
 [the breath of the spirit of life]."
 [Genesis 7:22]
 And because the aforementioned pulsing spirit
 is weakened
 through the strengthening
 of the pollution of the serpent —
 the thirty-nine melachos —
 the sadness of spirit —
 during all the weekdays —
 through which the limbs become heavy —
 and through this the pulsing spirit
 is weakened even more —
 until the sacred soul and vitality
 nearly completely leaves the person —
 but through the fact that in the meanwhile
 the holiness of Shabbos arrives —
 and through this
 the pollution of the serpent, and so on,
 is subdued —
 as mentioned above —
 through this
 the pulsing spirit returns
 and is made healthy and revitalized —
 through a sigh [anachah] —
 as explained within.
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "keivan she'shavas — vav —
 avdah nefesh
 [since it rested — vav [woe] —
 the soul was lost]"
 — for if there had been no holiness of Shabbos —
 then the soul would have been completely lost,
 heaven forfend.
 And no person takes it to heart
 and notices at all
 the loss of the soul, heaven forfend —
 due to the great strengthening
 of the pollution of the serpent —
 the sadness of spirit.
 But because —
 through the entry of the holy Shabbos —
 the Sitra Achra is subdued —
 through this every person
 is reminded of the loss of his soul
 during the weekdays —
 and he sighs and groans greatly over this —
 and cries out from the depths of his heart:
 "vav — avdah nefesh
 [vav — the soul was lost]"
 — which is the aspect of the aforementioned sigh —
 in the aspect of:
 "vayamos Melech Mitzrayim
 [and the King of Egypt died]"
 [Exodus 2:23]
 — the aspect of the subduing of the Sitra Achra —
 then specifically:
 "vaye'anchu Bnay Yisrael
 [and the children of Israel sighed],"
 and so on —
 and as explained similarly in Zohar Shemos.
 And the sigh is the aspect of:
 "tosif rucham
 [their spirit is added]"
 [Psalms 104:29] —
 as explained below within in Siman 109
 in the teaching Yesh Hevel, and so on —
 and through this
 the sadness of spirit is completely repelled and severed from him —
 and he merits to receive an additional spirit of holiness —
 through the fact that the aforementioned holy pulsing spirit
 returns and is made healthy and revitalized.
 And through this itself
 one merits the extra soul —
 and new vitality —
 the aspect of the holy spirit —
 which is the aspect of the spirit
 that comes from the holy place [ruach haba miKodesh] —
 as is well-known —
 for this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of Kodesh — as is well-known.

segments.he: וזה ממצוא חפציך ודבר דבר היינו כמו שמבואר בתיקון י"ג ובההוא רוחא הוה בטיש בחמש נימין דכינור דאינון חמש כנפי ריאה ובקנה סליק קול ללבא ואיהו אש אוכלה מאודנא ימינא דלבא דאיהו כלפי כבד ומניה נפיק דיבור ההוא הא דכתיב הלא כה דברי כאש. ואי לאו כנפי ריאה דנשבין על לבא הוה אוקיד כל גופא וכו'. ועל כן צריכין ליזהר מדיבור של חול בשבת שלא לעורר בו האש ח"ו על ידי שיפגום בקדושת שבת. וזה אז תתענג על ה' ודרש בזוהר הקדוש דא עתיקא קדישא כי על ידי שלימות הכנפי ריאה דנשבי על לבא על ידי זה דולק השכל ומאיר באור גדול וכמבואר במקום אחר עד שזוכה למוחין עליונים שהם מבחינת עתיק. וגם משם שורש המתקת כל הדינים ושורש תחיית המתים כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש ובגמרא דרשו רז"ל שנותנין לו כל משאלות לבו. כי מאחר שנמתק האש שבלב בשלימות כראוי על כן בודאי צריכין ליתן לו כל משאלות לבו.
segments.en:
And this [Exodus 31:17]:
 "u'veyom hashevi'i shavas vayinafash
 [and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed]"
 — and Rashi explained:
 "v'chol lashon nofesh hu lashon nefesh —
 she'meshiv nafsho v'nishmaso —
 b'harg'i'o mitorach hamelachah
 [and every language of nofesh
 is the language of nefesh [soul] —
 that one restores one's soul and spirit —
 by resting from the toil of the labor],"
 and so on —
 that is, as mentioned above —
 for through the toil of the labor
 one's spirit and soul are shortened —
 which is the aspect of the weakening
 of the pulsing spirit
 through the sadness of spirit of the toil of labor —
 and through the holiness of Shabbos
 the pulsing spirit returns and is strengthened —
 as mentioned above —
 which is the aspect of:
 "vayinafash
 [and was refreshed]"
 — the language of:
 "nofesh"
 — and as it were
 He inscribed rest for Himself —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught.
 And through all of this
 the heavens are refined and beautified —
 the aspect of [Job 26:13]:
 "b'rucho shamayim shifra
 [through His spirit the heavens were beautified]"
 — and this is the aspect of:
 "hashamayim mesaprim
 [the heavens declare],"
 and so on —
 which one says on Shabbos —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar,
 Terumah, folio 136:
 "b'gin d'b'ha'i yoma —
 mis'atran shamayim —
 v'salkin b'shema kadisha —
 yatir mishear yomin.
 V'sham: mai mesaprim —
 v'chol haggid —
 ella d'neharin —
 v'natzatzin b'natzatzu d'nukdata ila'ah —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'neharin b'nehiru shalim —
 v'natzatzey b'natzatzu shalim
 [for on this day —
 the heavens are crowned —
 and ascend in the holy Name —
 more than all other days.
 And there: what does 'they declare' mean? —
 and so on —
 rather that they shine —
 and sparkle in the sparkling of the supernal point —
 and so on —
 and they shine with complete radiance —
 and they sparkle with complete sparkling],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And there on folio 137:
 "v'al da b'yoma da —
 itos'af nehiru b'chulah —
 k'de'amran —
 shamayim natal mimekora d'chayey b'kadmita
 [and for this reason on this day —
 the radiance is added to all —
 as we said —
 the heavens drew from the source of life
 at first],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And then the great Tzadikim
 more easily merit to receive words
 from Heaven.
 For this is the aspect of what among Israel in general
 our Sages of blessed memory also taught:
 all agree that on Shabbos the Torah was given —
 and it was stated regarding this [Exodus 20:22]:
 "atem re'isem ki min hashamayim dibbarti imachem
 [you yourselves saw that from Heaven
 I spoke with you],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And through this —
 holiness is also drawn onto the six weekdays —
 which are the aspects of separation and dispute —
 so that they should be in the aspect of
 a dispute for the sake of Heaven —
 which in truth is great love and peace —
 the aspect of:
 "es vahav b'sufah
 [love and war together at the end]"
 [Numbers 21:14] —
 which is the aspect of the dispute of the Tanna'im
 in the six orders of the Mishnah —
 which correspond to the six weekdays —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 and they are the aspect of:
 "eilu v'eilu divray Elokim chayyim
 [both these and these are the words of the living G-d]."
 For all their words are from Heaven —
 and one should not disparage the opinion that is not
 accepted as halachah.
 And this is what they concluded
 in the six orders of the Mishnah:
 "atid haKadosh baruch Hu —
 l'hanchil l'chol tzadik v'tzadik
 sh'losh me'os v'asara olamos
 [the Holy One, blessed be He,
 is destined to grant to each and every Tzadik
 three hundred and ten worlds]"
 — that is, even that Tzadik
 whose opinion is not accepted as halachah.
 And this is what was stated:
 "l'hanchil ohavai yesh
 [to bequeath to those who love Me what exists]."
 [Proverbs 8:21]
 For all their disputes are
 a dispute of love —
 and therefore at the end there is love and peace.
 And as explained in the holy Zohar,
 Bereishis, folio 17.
 And this is what was concluded afterward:
 "lo matza haKadosh baruch Hu
 keli machzik berachah l'Yisrael —
 ela haShalom
 [the Holy One, blessed be He,
 found no vessel to hold blessing for Israel —
 except peace],"
 and so on —
 for through the engagement in Torah —
 Da'as is revealed —
 and blessing and peace are drawn —
 as mentioned above —
 and even the dispute within the Torah
 is also great love and peace.
 And see Tosafos Yom Tov
 who also explained it in this manner.
 And therefore the end of the six days of action
 is Shabbas Shalom —
 as explained in Zohar Korach, folio 176.
 And this is the aspect of havdalah —
 made at the end of the holy Shabbos —
 through which one sweetens the aspect of the dispute
 of the six weekdays —
 so that it should be for the sake of Heaven —
 and as understood in Zohar Bereishis,
 folio 17, mentioned above.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — that is, through the holiness of Shabbos
 those who are at lower levels shall also return and rise —
 those in the aspect of
 the strengthening of the concealments —
 for they are in the aspect of legs —
 of which it is stated:
 "raglehah yordos maves
 [her legs descend to death]"
 — as is well-known.
 And this:
 א'ם ת'שיב מ'שבת
 — initial letters: אֶמֶת [emes] —
 the aspect of the engagement in Torah —
 which is called emes [truth] —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 for through the engagement in Torah
 the concealments are revealed —
 and they are transformed into Da'as —
 for:
 "oraissa shema d'Kub"H —
 she'chasamo emes
 [the Torah is the Name of the Holy One,
 blessed be He —
 whose seal is truth]"
 — and through this one calls to the Living of all life —
 to receive from Him life and length of days —
 for:
 "emes simana d'chayyay
 [truth is the sign of life]"
 — as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 and:
 "shkulah Shabbas k'chol haTorah —
 ki ihi gam ken shema d'Kub"H —
 u'vechinah d'emes
 [Shabbos is equal in weight to the entire Torah —
 for it too is the Name of the Holy One,
 blessed be He —
 and the aspect of truth]"
 — as mentioned above many times —
 and through it one receives life —
 the aspect of:
 "to'amehah chayyim zachu"
 — and the essential vitality is wisdom and intellect —
 through which the concealments are revealed —
 and through this livelihood is also drawn.
 And livelihood is the aspect of legs —
 as explained elsewhere.
 And this:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — he should guard himself
 from pursuing his weekday affairs
 which are the thirty-nine melachos —
 the sadness of spirit.
 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg —
 liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight —
 the holy one of Hashem, honored]."
 For the revelation of Da'as
 is the essential delight and honor —
 as mentioned above many times.

 And this is likewise the aspect of the Shabbos meals —
 which are the aspects of Manna —
 the aspects of Da'as —
 and they are the essential delight of Shabbos —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "b'makom oneg Shabbas yihyeh keri'ah
 [in the place of the delight of Shabbos
 there shall be the calling]"
 — that is, Kiddush in the place of the meal —
 as mentioned above.
 And also — the peace drawn through Da'as
 is likewise the aspects of delight and honor —
 as it is written [Psalms 37:11]:
 "v'hisangeu al rov shalom
 [and they shall delight in the abundance of peace]."
 And it is written [Proverbs 20:3]:
 "kavod la'ish sheves meiriv
 [it is honorable for a person to desist from dispute]."
 And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 "she'lo yifsa'a pis'ayah gasah —
 she'hu bechinah rogez u'machalyokes
 [one should not take large strides —
 for it is the aspect of anger and dispute]"
 — as it is written:
 "al tirgazu badarech
 [do not quarrel on the way]"
 [Genesis 45:24] —
 and our Sages expounded:
 "she'lo yifsa'u pis'ayah gasah
 [they should not take large strides]."
 And also — large strides confuse the thought
 from contemplating —
 as explained in Sefer haMidos.
 And this is the aspect of a blemish in Da'as.

segments.he: והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ דא חקל תפוחין קדישין היינו עליית המלכות אל המוחין. המלכות הוא בחינת הרוח שבלב כמבואר בתיקון י"ג הנ"ל ערקין דלבא אינון כחיילין בתר מלכיהון וכו' הכי מתנהגין ערקין דלבא לגבי רוחא וכו' היינו שהרוח שבלב מקושר אל המוחין שמשם שורש ההמתקה. ועל כן דרשו רז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות שהם סטרא דמותא שיונקין ח"ו מתגבורות הדינים והאש הנ"ל שהוא בצד ימין שבלב כלפי כבד שהוא מלא דם ומשם יניקת שרו של עשו אדמוני כמבואר בפנים במאמר שאלו את ריב"ק סימן נ"ז.
segments.en:
"mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — he should not speak any speech
 about the performance of weekday affairs.
 For Shabbos is the aspect of the perfection
 of the holy speech —
 the aspect of Malchus peh —
 through which one calls to the Living of all life —
 in the aspect of:
 "ki chayyim heim l'motze'eihem b'feh
 [for they are life to those who find them — with the mouth]."
 [Proverbs 4:22]
 For the essential revelation of Da'as
 is through speech —
 as mentioned above.
 And also — because the words of Shabbos
 are the aspects of words from Heaven —
 drawn only through the repelling
 of the pollution of the serpent —
 the sadness of spirit —
 which is attached to the weekday deeds.
 And therefore even simple people
 who did not merit —
 even on Shabbos —
 to receive words from Heaven —
 nonetheless they must at the very least
 be careful to speak only the affairs of Heaven —
 so as not to blemish at the very least
 the aspect of the Shabbos words.
 And this:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — "da Atika Kadisha
 [this is the Holy Ancient One]"
 — that is, one merits the secrets of Torah —
 which are the aspects of Atik — as is well-known —
 and they are drawn specifically
 through the revelation of the concealments —
 as mentioned above.

 "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz
 [and I will cause you to ride
 upon the heights of the earth]"
 — "da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [this is the Holy Apple Orchard]"
 — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus
 until Chab"d —
 which are the three Rishonim —
 which is the aspect of the life
 and length of days
 drawn into the Malchus.
 And our Sages expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 as it is stated:
 "v'atah al bamoseimo tidrock
 [and you shall tread upon their heights]"
 — that is,
 the wicked kingdom falls and is nullified —
 the kingdom of Haman-Amalek —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 that Mordechai said to Haman:
 "but regarding the nations it is written:
 'and you shall tread upon their heights'."
 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — "da Ze'ir Anpin
 [this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — the aspect of the engagement in Torah —
 which is the central column [amuda d'emtza'isa] —
 through which one draws the vitality
 into the days and the traits —
 until one draws through this
 length of days into the Malchus —
 as mentioned above.

 And our Sages expounded:
 that one merits an inheritance without limits —
 that is, the revelation of the concealments
 to such a degree —
 until the G-dly vitality
 clothed within all the levels
 is revealed —
 and all the concealments within concealments
 are transformed into Da'as —
 in the aspect of [Zephaniah 3:9]:
 "ki az ehpoch el ha'amim —
 safah verurah —
 likro chulam b'shem Hashem
 [for then I shall turn to the peoples —
 a pure tongue —
 to call them all in the Name of Hashem]."
 And it is written [Isaiah 11:9]:
 "ki mal'ah ha'aretz de'ah
 [for the earth shall be full of Da'as],"
 and so on —
 which is the aspect of
 an inheritance without limits.
 And also — the aspect of the revelation of Da'as
 through the dispute for the sake of Heaven
 is the aspect of an inheritance without limits —
 for it is above the aspects of borders and limits.
 For even though this one forbids
 and this one permits —
 nonetheless:
 "eilu v'eilu divray Elokim chayyim"
 — as is well-known.
 And therefore the Holy One, blessed be He,
 is destined to grant
 to each and every Tzadik three hundred and ten worlds —
 and they are likewise the aspects of
 an inheritance without limits —
 as explained in Tosafos Yom Tov there.
 And this:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — for all of this is drawn
 from the aspect of the opening
 of the holy speech at its root —
 which is drawn on Shabbos.
 Through which Da'as is revealed —
 in the aspect of:
 "mipiv da'as u'sevunah
 [from His mouth — knowledge and understanding]"
 [Proverbs 2:6] —
 and the concealments are revealed —
 and Chesed and love and peace are drawn.
 Until even the dispute
 is likewise love and peace —
 for it is a dispute for the sake of Heaven —
 for one merits to receive words from Heaven —
 for this too is the aspect of:
 "ki pi Hashem diber."

segments.he: וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא בחינת התורה בחינת תורת אמת שהוא בחינת הכנפי ריאה דמנשבין על לבא. וזה כי פי ה' דיבר היינו כי שבת הוא בחינת הדיבור דקדושה שכלול משניהם מבחינת הכנפי ריאה והלב כמובן בתיקון הנ"ל ובמקומות הרבה ועל כן על ידו עיקר ההמתקה כנ"ל. ועל כן גם לענין דברי תורה שהם בחינת כנפי ריאה הנ"ל שעל ידם המתקת הדינים ובחינת תחיית המתים כנ"ל. ונאמר בהם כי חיים הם למוצאיהם ודרשו רז"ל למוציאהם בפה דייקא היינו כנ"ל. וזהו שאמר יוסף אל אחיו כשנתרצה עמהם ורצה להודיע להם שאין בלבו שנאה עליהם.
segments.en: Shabbos is the day of souls and not the day of bodies — as explained in the holy Zohar — for Shabbos is the aspect of awe — in the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — ilu shomrey Shabbas [and it shall shine for you who fear My Name — these are the guardians of Shabbos]." And this is the aspect of: "yirey Shabbas [one who fears Shabbos]" — and as explained elsewhere. And therefore the body [guf] is subdued then — in the aspect of: "guf kasheh — pachad shavro [a hard body — fear breaks it]." And then one also merits the perfection of speech — in the aspect of: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos. And then the body is nullified relative to the sacred speech — in the aspect of [Genesis 2:24]: "v'hayu l'vasar echad [and they shall be one flesh]" — as explained within. And therefore one merits then to pray in the aspect of: "kol atzmosei tomarnah [all my bones shall declare]," and so on. And through this — all the blood in a person is clarified and purified — and encompassed within the sacred words of Torah and prayer that go forth from the soul. And this is the aspect of Shalem [wholeness/peace] — for all the sparks of the letters of the breaking [shevirah] that were clothed within the blood — and were in the aspect of fragments and strife — are now completed and united together — and peace [shalom] is made between them — through their being encompassed within the sacred words of Torah and prayer — as explained within. And this is the aspect of Shabbas Shalom. And this is the aspect of the perfection of the soul merited on Shabbos — for blood is the soul. And this is the aspect of the ascent of the sacred legs that ascend on Shabbos — in the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha." For the aforementioned holy sparks are the aspect of legs. And likewise — the words of Torah and prayer are also the aspect of legs — as explained within.

segments.he: והנה עיניכם רואות ועיני אחי בנימין ופירש רש"י כשם שאין בלבי שנאה על בנימין אחי וכו' כך אין בלבי שנאה עליכם. וזה כי פי המדבר אליכם. היינו שעל ידי הדיבור פה נמתק גם הלב וזה שנאמר בו גם כן וינחם אותם וידבר על לבם היינו כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Shabbos = Malchus / all Israel = children of kings / revealed and concealed Malchus: Shabbos = Malchus = Shabbas Malkesah. All souls of Israel rooted in Shabbos = world of souls (Exodus 31:17; Zohar; Sefer haBahir). "Kol Yisrael bnay melachim" = each Jew has the aspect of Malchus according to his level. Malchus of Shabbos = revealed (b'is'galyah) AND concealed (b'is'kasya). "Matan sechara lo avida l'igaluya." Shabbos was given in privacy. In the aspect of revelation: Shabbos = poverty = "dalis lei migarmei klum" = no labor / no earnings. Zohar Shemos 255: lending to G-d = mercy on the poor + going out on Shabbosim and festivals = "malveh Hashem chonen dal." Tikkun 21 folio 58: "ani ihu yom haShabbas." Also: Mars and Saturn have dominion on it. Zohar Yisro 88: "keivan d'lo mishtakchey bei mezonah mah birchasa ishtakach bei? Alla kol birkan d'eila v'tata b'yoma shevi'ah talyan." In the aspect of concealment: all blessing flows only from Shabbos to all the days of the week; all subdued under its dominion. Midrash Eichah Petichta: nations mock Israel's poverty from Shabbos expenses; but in truth all livelihood from Shabbos. Sages: "wealthy in other lands come from those who honor Shabbos." Jeremiah 17:24–25: Shabbos → kings on the throne of David. Essential continuity of Israel's kingdom depends on Shabbos.
 Not misusing one's Malchus / use only for G-d's honor / "Vayakhel Moshe" / warn the household / Mor Deror / Yovel drawn into Malchus / length of days: Must not use one's Malchus for personal benefit = "lim'ol bo" = making sacred into profane. The Malchus received through Shabbos is holy. Use only for "v'hayasah laHashem haMeluchah" = warn/rebuke those under one's dominion = draw them close to G-d. "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" = Sages: every Sage of the generation must assemble congregations every Shabbos and expound in Torah = teach the people statutes and laws + instill yir'as Hashem (Magen Avraham, SA OC 290).
