Incumbent upon every person according to his level. During weekdays: occupied with labor; on Shabbos at minimum: speak to one's household in ethics and yir'as Hashem = essential holiness of Shabbos = "ki ot hi beinai u'veinechem… lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem." When using Malchus only for G-d: Malchus = ben chorin = "mor deror" = Small Shabbos receives illumination from Yovel = Binah = Great Shabbos = World to Come = day that is entirely long = draw length of days into the Malchus. Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer ch. 18: "kol hamevareych al haYayin b'leiley Shabbasos — ma'arichin lo yamav v'shanosav b'olam hazeh — v'zocheh l'chayay olam haba." Wine = Binah + Malchus (Siman 12).
 Kiddush = keri'ah / calling to Chay haChayim / 70 words / Torah reading = length of days / three Shabbosim of Zohar Yisro 92: Kiddush = keri'ah = "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg / b'makom keri'ah sham yihyeh oneg." Kiddush must be at the place of the meal. "V'kara vo kol yemay chayyav" = calls to Chay haChayim = draws from Him life and length of days. "Shabbas shema d'Kub'H." Kiddush = zachor = calls out the Name of the Living of all life = draws life and length of days. Seventy words in Kiddush = "yemay shenoseynu vahem shiv'im shanah" (Psalms 90:10). Torah reading on Shabbos = all the portions = all His Names = draws length of days into Malchus from the three Rishonim = Chab"d = source of life = "haChochmah techayeh" = World of Thought = essential vitality = "ki kodesh hu" (Ari z"l). Torah = amuda d'emtza'isa = calls vitality into the traits and the days. Must read Torah with the mouth specifically = "ki chayyim heim l'motze'eihem b'feh" = Malchus peh. Berachos 8a: "kol hamashlem parashiyosav im hatzibur ma'arichin lo yamav v'shanosav." Zohar Yisro 92: three levels = Supernal Shabbos (source of vitality = Chab"d) / Shabbos of the day (Torah = totality of traits and days) / Shabbos of the night (Malchus) = all are called Shabbos = all one. "To'amehah chayyim zachu" = life and length of days. Essential vitality = intellect and Da'as = "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadish'chem" + Ezekiel 20:20.
 All concealments revealed through Shabbos / Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer / dor Enosh / "mochalin lo" / Kiddush = revelation of concealments / women obligated / Torah = Zachor / Zachor v'Shamor: Through Da'as all concealments revealed — even concealment within concealment. Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer: "kol hashomer Shabbas mochalin lo al kol avonosaym." Shabbos 118: "afilu avad avodah zarah k'dor Enosh mochalin lo." In dor Enosh: concealment intensified greatly = "az huchal likro b'shem Hashem" / Targum: "chalu miltzalya b'shema d'Hashem." Through Shabbos holiness: Shabbas shema d'Kub'H calls out again → all concealments revealed → all sins forgiven. Kiddush also = keri'ah = calling in His Name = revelation of concealments. Berachos 20a: "nashim chayavos b'Kiddush hayom d'oraissa" — "zachor v'shamor — nashim ho'il v'isnehun b'shmirah — isnehun b'zchirah." Those in the aspect of concealments = aspect of women = three aspects (explained within). Yet included in Shamor. Shamor = trait of Malchus = end of all levels = "u'malchuso b'chol mashalah" (Zohar). Therefore included in Zachor. Zachor = Tiferes = Torah = through Torah: draws vitality (Chochmah + Da'as) into Malchus → all concealments revealed. Women exempt from Torah study (to be explained elsewhere based on this teaching). "Nashim chayavos b'Kiddush hayom d'oraissa" — d'oraissa specifically = Kiddush = engagement in Torah = draw vitality into Malchus → length of days.
 "Kol hamispallel b'Erev Shabbas v'omer Vayechulu… shutaf" / revelation of concealments = teshuvah / Kiddush on wine = revelation of Da'as / "im yihyu chataseichem" / seven voices of Psalm 29 = voices of Matan Torah: "Kol hamispallel b'Erev Shabbas v'omer Vayechulu… ka'ilu na'asah shutaf" = vitality from Chay haChayim = above the traits = very hidden → possible to deny completely; but saying Vayechulu = reveals that G-d created everything + vitality of all creation = His Name = Shabbos = "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i… ki hu kiyum kol haberiyah" → as if partner in creation = through him the concealment was revealed and transformed into Da'as = essential vitality of creation. Therefore: ministering angels say "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar" = through revelation of concealments → complete teshuvah → all sins forgiven. Isaiah 1:18: "leku na v'invachah… im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim kasheleig yalvinu" = essential sin = through strengthening of darkness/concealment = "na'asah lo k'heter / k'meishor" = "al amarecha lo chatasi" (Jeremiah 2:35). The disputation (viku'ach) = clarification = revelation of concealments → know one has sinned → repent → "chatasi v'shuv lo echeta od" → immediately forgiven (like King David — "gam Hashem he'evir chata'ascha," II Samuel 12:13). "Leku na v'invachah → kasheleig yalvinu." Mitzvah to make Kiddush on wine: wine = forgetfulness = "pen yishteh v'yishkach mechokek" (Proverbs 31:5; LM Tinyana 26). First concealment = "na'asah lo k'heter" = aspect of women (language of shichechah). Drinking more = concealment within concealment = "nashnu v'kafzu." Proverbs 23:31–32 + Rashi: "hamarbeh b'shikaros kol ha'aveiros domim lo k'meishor." Yoma 74. But Kiddush on wine = revelation of concealments = opposite of forgetfulness = "zachrehu al haYayin" (memory = opposite of forgetfulness and concealment). Hosea 14:8: "zicho k'yayin Levanon" = holy wine = revelation of sacred Da'as (Siman 20) → concealments revealed → transformed into Da'as = "im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim kasheleig yalvinu." Targum: "k'chamar atik" = Da'as = length of days drawn into Malchus = length of days = Atik (Siman 60, teaching of Pasach Rabbi Shimon). Through this Da'as: Torah proclaims = "oraissa machrezas kameihu" → thoughts of teshuvah come to every Jew on Shabbos → merits to hear the voice of the herald/calling/rebuke of the holy Torah. Seven voices of "Mizmor l'David" at entry of Shabbos = Sages: correspond to seven voices of Matan Torah = at entry of Shabbos each Jew hears (according to his level) the voice of the heralds of the holy Torah = from the aspect of the voices of Matan Torah. Seven voices = Torah encompasses seven traits. Therefore: essential time for revelation of secrets of Torah on Shabbos = through revelation of concealments within concealments. All agree Torah was given on Shabbos: concealments revealed → Torah made from them = Moshe's reply to the angels ("l'Mitzrayim yaradetem yetzer hara yesh bachem…") = specifically through the strengthening of concealments over Israel in Egyptian exile + spiritually = when Moshe (= Da'as) came → concealments revealed → Torah made. First commandment: "anochi Hashem Elokecha asher hotzesticha mei'eretz Mitzrayim" = revelation of concealments → immediately warned about idolatry (= source of force of concealment within concealment = "v'anochi haseter astir"). Warned about vain oaths = utterance of G-d's Name = calling to Chay haChayim → be careful not to mention in vain. Then warned about Shabbos = Name of G-d = mitzvah to remember = draw holy vitality + reveal Da'as → concealments revealed. "Yismechu b'malchuscha shomrey Shabbas… am mekadeshey shevi'i kulam yisbe'u v'yis'angeu mituvacha." Shabbos warning: "atah u'vincha u'vitecha… v'gercha asher bishearecha" = Shabbos encompasses all traits = "sof ma'aseh" = Malchus = "me'asef l'chol hamachanot" = fear of Shabbos = mora malchus. Isaiah 56:6: "u'vnay haneychar…kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo… v'hevi'osim el har kodshi" = encompasses and gathers all levels = even those in concealment within concealment.
 Kingdom of Haman-Amalek / Shabbos subdues Haman / killing of Vashti was on Shabbos / descendants of Haman studied Torah in Bnei Brak / "hadar kibluha" / Mordechai = Malchus / "chayil bala vayaki'enu" / wealth / eshes chayil: Corresponding to holy Malchus = wicked kingdom = Haman-Amalek. "Vayetz'u min ha'am lilkot" → "vayavo Amalek." Haman's evil eye against Shabbosim and Yamim Tovim of Israel = cast lots = "d'dachay l'chula shata b'Shabbas hayom Pesach hayom." Subduing of Haman = through Shabbos and Yom Tov (Siman 135; Siman 30). Beginning of the Megillah — killing of Vashti — was on Shabbos = "b'yom hashevi'i k'tov lev haMelech b'yayin" (Sages). Haman himself gave the advice to kill Vashti = within intense concealments there is G-dly vitality = "u'malchuso b'chol mashalah" → Esther came → Haman killed → concealment broken → after many generations: Torah was revealed clothed within the body of the concealment itself → from descendants of Haman: Torah studied in Bnei Brak. Among Israel in general: concealment immediately transformed into Torah = "hadar kibluha bimey Achashverosh." Wicked kingdom accumulates money. Mordechai (= holy Malchus) strengthens → disgorges the swallowed wealth = "chayil bala vayaki'enu" (Job 20:15). Through Shabbos = wealth; from it Torah is made = "eshes chayil" (as explained within). Shabbos = "eshes chayil ateres ba'alah" = "Keneses Yisrael yihyeh ben zugcha" (Siman 277). According to Da'as: livelihood easy; compassion and peace multiply; anger and cruelty nullified. On Shabbos: forbidden to toil for a livelihood = "es asher toffu efu / hayom lo timtze'uhu basadeh / mi she'tarach b'Erev Shabbas yochal b'Shabbas." From Shabbos: abundance flows to all days of the week (Zohar). Shabbos: peace = Shabbas Shalom; compassion = "yecholah hi she'terachem"; "Shabbas hu mi'liz'ok… v'rachamav merubin" (Shabbos 12a) = Ze'ir Anpin ascends to the beard of Arich Anpin = thirteen attributes of mercy. Immersion in the mikvah for Shabbos honor = mikvah = supreme intellect + great mercies. Shabbos meals = Manna = "maan" = "ma'amar na'aman" (faithful utterance) = speech opened + Da'as revealed + faithfulness spread = "v'daber davar" (Zohar: Shabbos = speech = open utterance = spread of G-d's faithfulness and lovingkindness). Rema SA 242: pashtidah in memory of Manna.
 Psalm 92 mapped through Siman 56 / the heavens refined on Shabbos (Zohar Terumah 136–137) / Torah on Shabbos / six orders of the Mishnah = six weekdays / "eilu v'eilu" / "lo matza haKadosh baruch Hu keli" / havdalah / Isaiah 58 full synthesis: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas tov l'hodos l'shimcha elyon" = in the holy Name the vitality is bounded = vitality = intellect; on Shabbos = supremely exalted vitality and intellect = "l'shimcha elyon" revealed through Shabbos speech. "L'haggid baboker chasdecha v'emunascha ballaylos" = spreading of G-d's faithfulness and lovingkindness (= "maan = ma'amar na'aman"). "Mah gadlu ma'asecha" = revelation of Malchus nested in Asiyah. "Me'od amku machshevosecha" = vitality drawn into Malchus = vitality = thought. "Ish ba'ar lo yeda… bifroach resha'im… l'hishmaedam adey ad" = time of strengthening of concealment = wicked succeed = sacred Da'as concealed; but within the concealment itself there is G-dly vitality = "ki hineh oyvecha yove'du" = when concealment is revealed → downfall of wicked → success of Tzadikim; retrospectively see that the success of the wicked was their ultimate downfall. On Shabbos peace = healing (Shabbos 12a). On Shabbos: repelled = pollution of the serpent + 39 melachos + sadness of spirit = "b'yom hani'ach Hashem lei mei'itzevonecha u'mirogzecha u'min ha'avodah hakasheh" (Isaiah 14:3; Zohar) → pulsing spirit strengthened = holy spirit → blows through all the limbs → strength + health + new vitality on all the limbs. Extra soul = "nishmas ruach chayyim." Pulsing spirit weakened on weekdays through pollution of the serpent/39 melachos/sadness of spirit → limbs become heavy → weakened even more → soul nearly completely leaves; but Shabbos holiness arrives → Sitra Achra subdued → pulsing spirit revitalized through a sigh. "Keivan she'shavas — vav — avdah nefesh" = if no Shabbos holiness: soul would have been completely lost (people don't notice the loss); entry of Shabbos → Sitra Achra subdued → each person reminded of loss of soul during weekdays → sighs and groans from the depths = "vayamos Melech Mitzrayim / vaye'anchu Bnay Yisrael" (Exodus 2:23; Zohar Shemos). Sigh = "tosif rucham" (Psalms 104:29; Siman 109). Sadness of spirit completely repelled → additional holy spirit received → pulsing spirit revitalized → extra soul + new vitality = holy spirit = "ruach haba miKodesh." Exodus 31:17: "shavas vayinafash" + Rashi: "meshiv nafsho v'nishmaso b'harg'i'o mitorach hamelachah" = as G-d inscribed rest for Himself (Sages). Through all this: heavens refined and beautified = "b'rucho shamayim shifra" (Job 26:13) = "hashamayim mesaprim" said on Shabbos. Zohar Terumah 136 cited: "b'gin d'b'ha'i yoma mis'atran shamayim v'salkin b'shema kadisha yatir mishear yomin… mai mesaprim… ella d'neharin v'natzatzin b'natzatzu d'nukdata ila'ah… v'neharin b'nehiru shalim." Zohar Terumah 137 cited: "v'al da b'yoma da itos'af nehiru b'chulah… shamayim natal mimekora d'chayey b'kadmita." Great Tzadikim receive words from Heaven more easily on Shabbos. All agree Torah was given on Shabbos = "atem re'isem ki min hashamayim dibbarti imachem" (Exodus 20:22). Through this: holiness drawn onto the six weekdays = aspects of separation and dispute → dispute for the sake of Heaven = great love and peace = "es vahav b'sufah" = dispute of the Tanna'im in the six orders of the Mishnah (= six weekdays, Zohar) = "eilu v'eilu divray Elokim chayyim." Don't disparage the non-accepted opinion. Conclusion of the Mishnah: "atid haKadosh baruch Hu l'hanchil l'chol tzadik v'tzadik sh'losh me'os v'asara olamos — l'hanchil ohavai yesh" = all disputes are disputes of love. Zohar Bereishis 17. "Lo matza haKadosh baruch Hu keli machzik berachah l'Yisrael ela haShalom" = through Torah: Da'as revealed + blessing and peace drawn = even dispute = love and peace. Tosafos Yom Tov. "Sof ששת ימי המעשה is Shabbas Shalom" (Zohar Korach 176). Havdalah at the end of Shabbos = sweetens the aspect of the dispute of the six weekdays so that it should be for the sake of Heaven (Zohar Bereishis 17). Isaiah 58 final synthesis: "Im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = those at lower levels (= concealments = legs = "raglehah yordos maves") shall also return and rise through Shabbos. Acrostic = emes = engagement in Torah = called emes (Sages); "oraissa shema d'Kub'H she'chasamo emes" = calls to Chay haChayim = "emes simana d'chayyay"; "shkulah Shabbas k'chol haTorah ki ihi gam ken shema d'Kub'H u'vechinah d'emes" = through it receive life = "to'amehah chayyim zachu" = essential vitality = wisdom/intellect = reveals concealments = draws livelihood (= legs). "Me'asos chafatzecha" = guard from 39 melachos = sadness of spirit. "Call it delight/honored" = revelation of Da'as = essential delight and honor; Shabbos meals = Manna = Da'as = essential delight of Shabbos = "b'makom oneg Shabbas yihyeh keri'ah"; peace through Da'as = delight and honor = "v'hisangeu al rov shalom" / "kavod la'ish sheves meiriv." "Honor it / from your ways / no large strides" = aspect of anger and dispute = "al tirgazu badarech she'lo yifsa'u pis'ayah gasah"; also: large strides confuse thought = blemish of Da'as. "From your affairs / speaking words" = no weekday speech; Shabbos = Malchus peh = calls to Chay haChayim = "ki chayyim heim l'motze'eihem b'feh"; essential revelation of Da'as through speech; Shabbos words = from Heaven; even simple people: speak only affairs of Heaven. "Then delight" = Atika Kadisha = secrets of Torah = Atik = drawn through revelation of concealments. "Heights of earth" = Chakla Tupichin = ascent of Malchus until Chab"d = three Rishonim = life and length of days drawn into Malchus; saved from subjugation = kingdom of Haman-Amalek falls = Mordechai's words to Haman: "v'atah al bamoseimo tidrock." "Heritage of Yaakov" = Ze'ir Anpin = engagement in Torah = amuda d'emtza'isa = draws vitality into the traits and the days → length of days into the Malchus; nachalah b'li metzarim = concealments revealed to the degree that G-dly vitality in ALL levels revealed → "ki az ehpoch el ha'amim safah verurah" / "ki mal'ah ha'aretz de'ah"; also: revelation of Da'as through dispute for the sake of Heaven = nachalah b'li metzarim = above all limits; "eilu v'eilu"; Tosafos Yom Tov: 310 worlds = nachalah b'li metzarim. "Ki pi Hashem diber" = opening of holy speech at its root on Shabbos = "mipiv da'as u'sevunah" = concealments revealed = Chesed/love/peace drawn; even the dispute = love and peace = dispute for the sake of Heaven = "ki pi Hashem diber."
 

 Siman 57 onward continues in the next installment.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

Yikara DiShabsa — Siman 59: Heichal haKodesh

 Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Siman 59 — Heichal haKodesh

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Siman 59 — סימן נט
 Heichal haKodesh — "The Holy Palace…"
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 59]

segments.he: סימן צג-כל העושה וכו'
segments.en: It is explained within that during the weekdays the outer forces dominate — and their essential dominion is over the aspect of the legs — that is, they do not allow the person to walk in the ways of Hashem, blessed be He. And when the holy Shabbos is sanctified — then: "yispardu kol po'aley aven [all the workers of iniquity are scattered]" [Psalms 92:10] — and then they have no dominion at all — and the legs regain the power of walking — which is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha." But nonetheless — one still needs support to strengthen them. And this support is the aspect of truth [emes]. And Shabbos itself is the aspect of truth — as explained within — (and this is what is brought in the writings: א'ם ת'שיב מ'שבת — initial letters of אמ"ת [emes] — as mentioned above. And this: "raglecha" — for then the legs ascend — as mentioned above — and truth is the support to strengthen them — as mentioned above). But they still need force to be given to them so they can walk properly. And this is through the charity of Shabbos — that is, one gives to the poor for Shabbos — or one hosts a poor person at one's table on Shabbos. And the charity of Shabbos is the aspect of the sun of the future that is destined to be renewed in the time to come — to be like the light of the seven days. And through this it gives force to the aspect of the legs — so that they can walk properly in the ways of Hashem, blessed be He — as explained within.

segments.he: אמרו רז"ל שקולה שבת ככל התורה והמצות כנ"ל כמה פעמים גם מבואר בזוהר הקדוש שהקב"ה אומר על השומר שבת כראוי ישראל אשר בך אתפאר וישראל עלה במחשבה שזה בעצמו בחינת קדושת שבת שהוא עולם המחשבה ומחשבה הוא בחינת למעלה מהזמן. וזה בחינת ימים יוצרו ולו אחד בהם. כי שבת הוא בחינת אחד בחינת למעלה מהזמן. וזה וברכתו מכל הימים וקדשתו מכל הזמנים. גם שבת הוא בחינת מוחין דגדלות ושכל צח כנ"ל כמה פעמים ועל כן טוב ויפה מאד אז להתפלל בכוונה וכמובן גפ בפנים. וזה מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' ולזמר לשמך עליון. היינו כי תפלה הוא דבר העומד ברומו של עולם בחינת למעלה מזמן וזה בחינת עליון. וזה בחינת ששת ימים תעשה מלאכה היינו מלאכת המשכן שזה בחינת משא ומתן באמונה כמבואר בפנים במאמר אני ה' סימן י"א. ועל ידי שעושין משא ומתן באמונה נמשכין גם כן בחינת התיקונים הנ"ל כמבואר בפנים (אך) וביום השביעי יהיה לכם קדש שבת שבתון לה' כי אז נמשכין כל התיקונים הנ"ל ביתר שאת על ידי קדושת שבת בעצמו כנ"ל. וזה אז תתענג על ה' שיזכה למוחין דגדלות בתכלית המדריגה העליונה עד בחינת עתיק.
segments.en:
Translator's note: The source manuscript contains no labeled Simanim 57 or 58 between the end of Siman 56 and the beginning of Siman 59. Siman 59 contains an embedded Siman 60 toward its end, labeled internally as "17 Siman 60 — Pasach Rabbi Shimon," which is translated separately in the following installment. The source then continues from Siman 61 onward.

 One who strives to make souls
 and to draw human beings
 close to the service of G-d, blessed be He —
 in the aspect of [Genesis 12:5]:
 "v'es hanefesh asher asu b'Charan
 [and the souls they made in Charan]"
 — is building through this
 the aspect of the Holy Palace [Heichal haKodesh] —
 as explained within.
 And behold — all the labors and occupations
 performed during the weekdays
 are all the aspects of clarifications [birurim] —
 for this is the aspect of the drawing close
 of souls to the service of G-d —
 who elevate the good within them
 from out of the grip of the evil —
 as also understood within.
 And Shabbos is a foretaste of the World to Come —
 which is the aspect of the complete nullification of evil —
 and then the Shechinah rests [shavevis],
 as it were —
 and there are no clarifications then —
 as also brought within.
 But nonetheless —
 the essential power to clarify holy clarifications
 during the weekdays
 comes only from the power of the holiness of Shabbos —
 in the aspect of:
 "kulhu b'machshavah itberiru
 [all of them are clarified through thought]."
 And Shabbos is the World of Thought —
 as is well-known —
 and then all the aforementioned clarifications
 ascend to their rest
 and to the ultimate perfection —
 as is well-known.

 And behold — from the aforementioned clarifications
 the aspect of the Holy Palace —
 the aspect of the Mishkan — is built.
 And yet — the work of the Mishkan
 does not override Shabbos.

 For on the contrary —
 the essential clarifications
 and the building of the Holy Palace
 come only from the power of the holiness of Shabbos.
 And therefore one must draw
 the holiness of Shabbos onto the six weekdays —
 in the aspect of:
 "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas
 [remember it from the first day for Shabbos]"
 — so that through this
 one should have the power to clarify clarifications.
 And behold — because this Holy Palace
 draws itself to its root —
 that is, to the heart of the one who builds it —
 and dwells and clothes itself
 upon the vital spirit [ruach chayyuni] in the heart
 (for this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the heart —
 as explained in the Tikunim —
 and there the vital spirit dwells —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'nasati lachem lev chadash v'ruach chadashah
 [and I shall give you a new heart and a new spirit],"
 and so on [Ezekiel 36:26] —
 all of which a person merits on Shabbos —
 as explained in the holy Zohar
 on the matter of the new spirit —
 the holy spirit —
 that a person merits on Shabbos)
 — and the essential clothing of it
 is onto the legs of the spirit —
 as explained within.
 (And this is the aspect of:
 Malchus clothes Neh"y.)
 And because the aforementioned clarifications
 had been so deeply sunken
 for so long a time
 within the grip of the evil —
 which is the completely impure husks —
 heaven forfend —

 Therefore — on Erev Shabbos —
 when the aforementioned clarifications and souls
 wish to ascend to holiness —
 for this is the aspect of
 what the good within Nogah
 also ascends then to holiness —
 and then the three completely impure husks —
 which are pure evil —
 also wish to ascend with them —
 and to attach themselves as well, heaven forfend —
 and to draw sustenance from the holiness of Shabbos —
 then a flame of fire [shalhava d'asha]
 descends upon the heads
 of the aforementioned husks —
 and scorches them
 so that they cannot ascend.
 And then the evil falls completely below —
 and the good ascends to the ultimate perfection —
 as all of this is understood
 in the writings of the holy Ari z"l.

 And this is the aspect of the counsel
 explained within —
 that one should summon the angels of one's heart —
 which is the aspect of the blazing of the heart, and so on —
 and this fire scorches them.
 And this fire is made
 from the aspect of judgment [mishpat] —
 that the person judges himself —
 and then judgment goes forth into the light.
 For the heart blazes —
 and sits upon the throne —
 which is the aspect of honor —
 the aspect of the Holy Palace mentioned above —
 as all of this is explained within.
 [And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Shabbos 119]:
 "Rabbi Avahu would sit on the ivory throne
 on the bench of the royal gate"
 — corresponding to the aforementioned throne —
 "and he would fan the fire"
 — corresponding to the aforementioned fire.]
 And this is the aspect of [Psalms 97:2–5]:
 "anan v'arafel sevivav —
 tzedek u'mishpat mchon kis'o —
 eish lefanav telech —
 v'salhet saviv tzarav —
 v'chol haggid —
 harim k'donag namshu
 [clouds and thick darkness surround Him —
 righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne —
 fire goes before Him —
 and burns round about His enemies —
 and so on —
 mountains melt like wax],"
 and so on —
 and all the psalm is understood accordingly.
 And this is likewise the aspect of:
 "tzalutha d'ma'alay Shabbata —
 d'ha'i as'yachad curs'aya yekira
 [the prayer of Erev Shabbos —
 that then the precious throne is united],"
 and so on —
 the aspect of the Throne of Glory —
 which is the aspect of Malchus —
 the aspect of the Holy Palace mentioned above —
 as explained within —
 "v'issekna l'masrey ala malka kadisha ila'ah —
 kad ayil Shabbata ihi is'achad v'is'perashas
 misistra achra
 [and it is made ready for the holy supernal King
 to dwell upon it —
 when Shabbos enters — it is united —
 and separates from the Sitra Achra],"
 and so on —
 all as mentioned above.

 And therefore it is explained in the holy books
 that on Erev Shabbos
 a person must examine himself thoroughly
 regarding his deeds —
 and set his heart upon his ways —
 and reflect carefully
 upon all that passed over him
 during all the days of the week —
 and regret greatly with great shame —
 and repent — and so on —
 for all of this is the aspect of judgment —
 that the person judges
 and sentences himself —
 and from the aforementioned judgment
 the blazing of the heart is made —
 the aspect of the aforementioned fire —
 which scorches them.
 And this [Song of Songs 8:6]:
 "simeni k'chotam al libecha
 [set me as a seal upon your heart],"
 and so on —
 that is, one need not fear
 that evil will grip the heart itself, heaven forfend —
 as mentioned above —
 for:
 "reshafehah rishpey eish shalheves Yah
 [its sparks are sparks of fire —
 a flame of G-d]"
 [Song of Songs 8:6] —
 which is the aspect of the aforementioned flame of fire —
 that casts the evil below
 and utterly subdues it —
 as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 56:6]:
 "u'vnay haneychar hanilavim al Hashem —
 v'chol haggid —
 kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'hevi'osim el har kodshi
 [and the children of the stranger
 who attach themselves to Hashem —
 and so on —
 every Shabbos guardian who does not desecrate it —
 and so on —
 and I shall bring them to My holy mountain]"
 — for through the power
 of the holiness of guarding the holy Shabbos —
 these souls draw close
 and become converts.
 And this is what is written [Ezekiel 20:11, 13]:
 "v'es mishpatai hoda'ti osam —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'gam es Shabsosai nasati lahem —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'es mishpatai shamru —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'es Shabsosai kidshu
 [and My judgments I made known to them —
 and so on —
 and also My Shabbosim I gave to them —
 and so on —
 and My judgments they observed —
 and so on —
 and My Shabbosim they sanctified],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is what is written [Jeremiah 17:24]:
 "v'hayah im shamo'a tishme'un eli —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'likaddesh es yom haShabbas
 [and it shall be —
 if you hearken diligently to Me —
 and so on —
 and to sanctify the day of Shabbos],"
 and so on —
 "shemi'ah b'liba talya
 [hearing depends on the heart]"
 — that is, the aspect of the rectification of the heart —
 for there is the source of judgment —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of [I Kings 3:9]:
 "v'nasata l'avdecha lev shomea lishpot
 [and give Your servant a listening heart to judge],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 7:12]:
 "v'hayah ekev tishme'un es hamishpatim ha'eileh
 [and it shall be — as a consequence
 of your hearkening to these judgments],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And this:
 "v'likaddesh es yom haShabbas —
 v'chol haggid —
 u'va'u v'sha'aray ha'ir hazos —
 melachim v'sarim yoshvim al kisei David
 [and to sanctify the day of Shabbos —
 and so on —
 and there shall come through the gates of this city —
 kings and princes sitting on the throne of David],"
 and so on —
 that is, the aspect of the Throne of Glory mentioned above —
 the aspect of:
 "v'es melachim l'chisei
 [and to kings upon thrones]."
 And [Jeremiah 17:27]:
 "v'im lo tishme'un elai l'kaddesh es yom haShabbas —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'hitzasi eish bishearehah
 [and if you do not hearken to Me
 to sanctify the Shabbos day —
 and so on —
 then I shall kindle a fire in its gates],"
 and so on —
 that is, the aforementioned fire
 shall take revenge upon them themselves,
 heaven forfend.
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "ein hadlikas eish metzuyah —
 ela b'makom sheyesh chilul Shabbas
 [fire is found only in a place
 where there is desecration of Shabbos]"
 — that is, as mentioned above.

 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "almilai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos —
 miyad nigalin
 [were Israel to observe two Shabbosim —
 they would be redeemed immediately]"
 — that is, the aspect of Shabbas d'leila
 [Shabbos of the night] —
 which is the aspect of the Holy Palace mentioned above —
 the aspect of Malchus —
 which is the attribute of the night —
 as is well-known.

segments.he: והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ בחינת עליית המלכות (שהוא בחינת התפלה כידוע) אל המוחין שיזכה להתפלל בשכל צח וניצול משיעבוד מלכיות שמהם בחינת המחשבות זרות המבלבלין כוונת התפלה. והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא בחינת כלל התורה והמצוות. ועל כן אצל יעקב מבואר שעשה משא ומתן באמונה בחינת וענתה בי צדקתי ביום מחר וכמבואר בפרשה ויחר ליעקב וירב בלבן. וגם מבואר בו ששמר את השבת היינו כנ"ל. ועל כן זכה יעקב לנחלה בלי מצרים בחינת למעלה מהמקום למעלה מהזמן. כי בחינת הזמן והמקום מקושרים זה בזה כמובן במקום אחר והוא העיקר שנאמר עליו ישראל אשר בך אתפאר בחינת תפארת ישראל והוא בבחינת ישראל עלה במחשבה:
segments.en:
And Shabbas d'yoma
 [Shabbos of the day] —
 which is the aspect of Tiferes —
 the aspect of judgment —
 the central column [amuda d'emtza'isa] —
 which is the attribute of the day —
 as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "dinu laboker mishpat
 [render judgment in the morning]"
 [Jeremiah 21:12] —
 and likewise:
 "u'mishpatecha or yetzei
 [and Your judgments shall go forth as light]."
 [Hosea 6:5]
 And through all of this
 the clarification of the holy sparks
 would be completed in its perfection —
 for this is the aspect of the drawing close of converts —
 and they would be redeemed immediately.
 And therefore this teaching was derived
 from the fact that it is written:
 "asher yishmeru es Shabsosai
 [who guard My Shabbosim]"
 — and it is written immediately after:
 "v'hevi'osim el har kodshi
 [and I shall bring them to My holy mountain],"
 and so on —
 and this was written concerning the converts
 (who are the aspects of the aforementioned clarifications)
 — as it is written:
 "u'vnay haneychar hanilavim al Hashem —
 v'chol haggid —
 kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'hevi'osim el har kodshi."
 And this is the aspect of [Leviticus 19:30]:
 "es Shabsosai tishmoru —
 da igula v'ribua d'lagu —
 bechinah shtay Shabbasos
 [My Shabbosim shall you observe —
 this is the igul and ribua from within —
 the aspect of the two Shabbosim mentioned above]."
 And perhaps this is the secret of the angels
 who accompany a person on Erev Shabbos —
 and so on —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 that is, the aspects of the angels of his heart —
 as mentioned above.
 (And there is more to explain in this.)
 And see within further:
 "v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai —
 yad v'shem tov
 [and I shall give them in My house and within My walls —
 a hand and a good name],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 "veisi
 [My house]"
 — from there goes out the spring of wisdom —
 as it is written:
 "u'meayan mibeis Hashem yetze
 [and a spring shall go forth from the house of Hashem]."
 [Joel 4:18]
 "chomah
 [wall]"
 — this is the aspect of the suppression of anger
 and wealth.
 And:
 "yad
 [hand]"
 — this is the aspect of judgment —
 for through the fact that one regulates
 one's words with judgment —
 through this one can establish worthy students —
 and draw through them the spirit of wisdom.
 And:
 "shem
 [name]"
 — this is the aspect of the Throne of Glory —
 the aspect of the Holy Palace —
 that is, because one engages in this —
 to magnify His blessed honor —
 through the fact that one draws souls close
 to G-d, blessed be He —
 through this one's own soul and name are magnified —
 until all the souls desire
 to be rooted in his name and soul.
 And this is one aspect with the aspect
 of the chomah [wall] —
 of the suppression of anger and wealth —
 and through this
 one's name and soul are magnified even further —
 until all the souls desire
 to be encompassed in his soul.
 And this is the aspect of [Proverbs 19:14]:
 "bayis v'hon nachalas avos
 [house and wealth are the heritage of fathers],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And know that there are wicked people
 who are in the aspect of the Erev Rav
 — the mixed multitude —
 whom it is forbidden to draw close —
 for the aforementioned judgment
 has no power to subdue their evil —
 and so on —
 as all of this is explained within.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory
 warned strongly
 not to become angry on Shabbos — at the very least —
 as explained in Tikkun 48 —
 for then one blemishes even more
 through the anger, heaven forfend.
 And likewise our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 that through the honor of Shabbos
 one merits wealth —
 as mentioned above many times.

 And as our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 "birchas Hashem hi sa'ashir — zeh Shabbas
 [the blessing of Hashem — it enriches — this is Shabbos]"
 [Proverbs 10:22].

 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory
 also taught:
 that it is a mitzvah to assemble congregations on Shabbos
 and to expound to them in words of Torah —
 for then it is most propitious
 to establish worthy students —
 and to draw through them the spirit of wisdom.

 And therefore also —
 the ordination of Moshe for Yehoshua
 (for this is the aspect of:
 "viYehoshua ven Nun maleh ru'ach chochmah
 ki samach Moshe es yadav alav
 [and Yehoshua the son of Nun was filled
 with the spirit of wisdom —
 for Moshe laid his hands upon him]"
 [Deuteronomy 34:9] —
 as explained within)
 — which Rashi explained in Parashas Pinchas
 [Numbers 27:18]:
 "v'samachta es yadcha alav —
 ten lo turgeiman she'yidrosh b'chayyecha
 [and you shall lay your hand upon him —
 give him an interpreter who will expound in your lifetime],"
 and so on —
 and this was on Shabbos —
 as Rashi explained in Parashas Ha'azinu
 [Deuteronomy 31:28]:
 "vayavo Moshe vayedaber —
 v'chol haggid —
 hu v'Hoshea ven Nun
 [and Moshe came and spoke —
 and so on —
 he and Hoshea the son of Nun]"
 — and Rashi explained:
 "Shabbas shel diyuzgey hayah —
 he'emid lo Moshe turgeiman l'Yehoshua
 she'yihyeh doresh b'chayyav
 [it was a Shabbos of public [address] —
 Moshe established an interpreter for Yehoshua
 who would expound in his lifetime],"
 and so on —
 that is, as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of the excellence
 of the holiness of the Shabbos union.
 For it is known and explained in the holy Zohar
 how great are the holy clarifications
 made through the holiness of the union of the Tzadikim —
 and Avraham our Patriarch and Sarah —
 even though they were barren —
 nonetheless through their union —
 even then —
 the souls of the converts were made —
 as brought in Likutay Moharan Tinyana, Siman 72.
 It follows that through the sacred union
 the aspect of the Holy Palace is also built —
 and the essential thing is
 when one merits through this
 to father worthy children.
 For the children of Israel
 are the aspect of the palace of Hashem —
 as it is written [Jeremiah 7:4]:
 "Heichal Hashem heimah
 [they are the palace of Hashem]."
 But because evil wishes very much
 to attach itself, heaven forfend,
 to the Holy Palace —
 even to those who strive in this —
 and the rectification for this
 is through the aspect of judgment —
 as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of what
 the Sanhedrin would sit
 in the place of judgment
 adjacent to the place of the Temple.
 And this is what the prophet said
 [Jeremiah 7:4]:
 "al tivtechu lachem al divrey hasheker —
 lemor: Heichal Hashem —
 Heichal Hashem —
 Heichal Hashem heimah
 [do not trust in the words of falsehood —
 saying: the palace of Hashem —
 the palace of Hashem —
 the palace of Hashem are they]"
 (and see Rashi and Targum)
 "ki im heitiv teitu es darkeichem —
 v'es ma'alalleichem —
 im aso ta'asu mishpat
 [but if you thoroughly improve your ways —
 and your deeds —
 if you truly execute judgment],"
 and so on —
 for the essential rectification
 of the Holy Palace
 is through judgment —
 as mentioned above.
 And therefore —
 the moment one brings the infant for circumcision —
 when that is the beginning of his entry
 into the holiness of Israel —
 the congregation says then:
 "ashrey tivchar v'tekarev —
 v'chol haggid —
 kadosh Heichalecha
 [happy is the one You choose and bring near —
 and so on —
 holy is Your palace]."
 [Psalms 65:5]
 And because the evil wishes greatly
 to attach itself to this —
 as mentioned above —
 from which flows the great trial
 that a person has
 in the holiness of the union —
 therefore the essential time propitious for this
 is on Shabbos.
 For then the aspect of igul and ribua
 mentioned above is drawn —
 the aspect of the complete nullification of evil —
 and then the union is in holiness —
 and one merits to draw holy souls
 to one's children —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "ki choh amar Hashem la'sarisim
 asher yishmeru es Shabsosai
 [for so says Hashem to the sarisim
 who guard My Shabbosim],"
 and so on —
 and the Zohar expounded —
 on the holiness of the Shabbos union.
 "v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai —
 yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos
 [and I shall give them in My house and within My walls —
 a hand and a good name
 better than sons and daughters]"
 — that is, as mentioned above — and as explained within.

 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 when the angels who accompany a person
 come on Erev Shabbos
 and find in his home:
 a kindled lamp — and his table set — and his bed made —
 the good angel says:
 "yehi ratzon she'yihyeh l'Shabbas ha'acheres kach
 [may it be His will that it should be so
 for the next Shabbos],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 The kindled lamp
 is the aspect of the Menorah to the south —
 the aspect of:
 "harotzeh l'hachkim yadrim
 [one who wishes to gain wisdom
 should face southward]."
 That is — corresponding to the aspect
 of the spirit of wisdom
 drawn on Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of yad [hand] —
 drawn through the aspect of judgment.
 And the set table
 — the aspect of the table to the north:
 "harotzeh l'ha'ashir yatzpin
 [one who wishes to become wealthy
 should face northward]"
 — the aspect of wealth —
 and the magnification of the Name and the soul —
 drawn through the aspect of shem [name] —
 the aspect of the Holy Palace mentioned above.

 And the made bed —
 this is the aspect that one's bed
 should be positioned between north and south.
 For through the aforementioned aspects
 of north and south —
 one merits worthy children —
 and the aspect of:
 "yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos"
 — as mentioned above.
 And therefore they say:
 "yehi ratzon she'yihyeh l'Shabbas ha'acheres kach"
 — so that there should be the holiness of two Shabbosim —
 the aspect of:
 "es Shabsosai"
 — mentioned above —
 through which one is redeemed —
 as mentioned above.
 And this [Isaiah 56:3]:
 "v'al yomar ben haneychar hanilvaah al Hashem —
 havdel yavdileni Hashem mei'al amo
 [and let not the son of the stranger
 who has joined himself to Hashem say:
 Hashem shall surely separate me from His people]"
 — since there are wicked people
 who are the aspects of the Erev Rav
 whom it is forbidden to draw close.
 And [Isaiah 56:3]:
 "v'al yomar hasaris —
 hen ani etz yavesh
 [and let not the saris say:
 behold — I am a dry tree]"
 — since he does not merit children —
 who are the aspects of the building of the Holy Palace —
 as mentioned above.
 For:
 "ki choh amar Hashem la'sarisim —
 asher yishmeru es Shabsosai —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomasai —
 yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos"
 — literally —
 for through the perfect guarding of Shabbos
 there is drawn the aspect of the rectification
 of igul and ribua —
 through which one merits a hand and a good name —
 and so on —
 as mentioned above.
 And:
 "u'vnay haneychar —
 v'chol haggid —
 kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo —
 v'chol haggid —
 v'hevi'osim el har kodshi —
 v'chol haggid —
 ki veisi beis tefillah yikara l'chol ha'amim —
 ne'um Hashem mekabetz nidchey Yisrael —
 od akabetz alav l'nikbatzav
 [and the children of the stranger —
 and so on —
 every Shabbos guardian who does not desecrate it —
 and so on —
 and I shall bring them to My holy mountain —
 and so on —
 for My house shall be called
 a house of prayer for all the peoples —
 the utterance of Hashem
 Who gathers the dispersed of Israel —
 I shall further gather upon him
 [those who are gathered] to his gathered ones]"
 — and Rashi explained:
 these are the converts —
 for true converts
 are also encompassed
 within the Holy Palace —
 since they merited
 to guard the Shabbos in its perfection —
 they are certainly not
 in the category of the Erev Rav, heaven forfend —
 who are forbidden to draw close —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar
 on the matter of:
 "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael
 [and Moshe gathered the entire congregation
 of the children of Israel]"
 — that he separated them from the Erev Rav
 and commanded them regarding the work of the Mishkan —
 for the Erev Rav has no share
 in the Holy Palace —
 the aspect of the work of the Mishkan.
 Therefore He also warned them then
 about the guarding of Shabbos.
 And see Zohar Yisro, folio 88:
 "b'seudasi ilin ishtamud'in Yisrael —
 d'inun bnay Malka —
 d'inun meHeikhala d'Malka —
 d'inun bnay meheimanuta.
 U'man d'fagam chad seudah minaihu —
 achzey pegimuta l'eila —
 v'achzey garmeih d'lav mibney Malka ila'ah hu —
 d'lav mibney Heikhala d'Malka hu —
 d'lav mizara kadisha d'Yisrael hu
 — v'sham —
 d'inun seudasi meheimanuta shelimta
 d'zara kadisha d'Yisrael
 [through these Shabbos meals —
 Israel declare themselves —
 that they are children of the King —
 that they are from the palace of the King —
 that they are children of faith.
 And one who blemishes one meal from them —
 shows a blemish above —
 and shows that he is not
 of the children of the supernal King —
 that he is not of the children of the palace of the King —
 that he is not of the holy seed of Israel —
 and there —
 for these are my meals of complete faith
 of the holy seed of Israel],"
 and so on —
 and for this reason he stated:
 "beini u'vein Bnay Yisrael
 [between Me and the children of Israel]"
 — that is, as mentioned above.
 And therefore one recites
 at Minchah of Shabbos:
 "u'mi k'amcha Yisrael goy echad ba'aretz
 [and who is like Your people Israel —
 one nation in the land]"
 — in the manner of what is written
 in the Zohar, folio 237:
 "d'lo itkariyu kehilah v'chibur —
 ad d'ita'avar minehon erev rav —
 kivyachol b'zimna d'misarvin beinaihu —
 k'ilu lo hayu goy echad
 [that they were not called a congregation
 and a community —
 until the mixed multitude was removed from them —
 as it were — at the time when they mixed among them —
 it was as if they were not one nation],"
 and so on —
 see there.
 (And through this
 the matter of Vayakhel Moshe
 mentioned above will also be understood.)
 (And see in Parashas Ki Seitzei, folio 279.)

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]."
 For these souls that drew close
 are the aspects of legs —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'chol ha'am asher b'raglecha
 [and all the people who are at your feet]."
 [Exodus 11:8]
 And also — the essential awakening
 to draw them close
 flows from the aspect of the legs
 of the vital spirit in the heart —
 and therefore they clothe them —
 as explained within.
 And therefore:
 א'ם ת'שיב מ'שבת
 — initial letters: אֶמֶת [emes] —
 as brought.
 For the essential rectification
 to elevate the aspect of the legs mentioned above
 from the grip of evil —
 that is, from the aspect of:
 "raglehah yordos maves
 [her legs descend to death]"
 — is through the aspect of judgment —
 as mentioned above —
 and judgment is the central column —
 the aspect of truth —
 as it is written:
 "emes u'mishpat v'shalom shiftu b'sha'areichem
 [truth and justice and peace — judge in your gates]"
 [Zechariah 8:16] —
 and it is written:
 "mishpetay Hashem emes
 [the judgments of Hashem are truth]."
 [Psalms 19:10]
 And this is what Jeremiah said to them:
 "al tivtechu lachem el divrey hasheker —
 lemor — v'chol haggid —
 Heichal Hashem heimah
 [do not trust in the words of falsehood —
 saying — and so on —
 they are the palace of Hashem],"
 and so on —
 for the essential rectification
 of the palace of Hashem —
 which is the aspect of legs —
 in the aspect of [Isaiah 6:1]:
 "v'shulav mele'im es haHeichal
 [and His hems fill the palace]"
 — see Rashi there —
 is through judgment —
 which is the aspect of truth —
 the aspect of:
 "kushta ka'ay
 [truth endures]"
 — the opposite of the aspect of falsehood
 which has no legs.
 And also:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha"
 — that is, one should not go
 beyond the Shabbos boundary —
 and the Shabbos boundary is two thousand cubits —
 which is likewise the aspect of
 igul and ribua from within —
 for igul is the aspect of Malchus —
 which is the aspect of aleph
 — from the language of:
 "aluf omer
 [the master of speech],"
 and so on —
 the aspect of:
 "alufim la'rosh
 [thousands at the head]."
 And the judgment —
 which is the aspect of Torah —
 the aspect of:
 "mishpetay Hashem emes"
 — is likewise the aspect of aleph —
 as it is written [Psalms 105:8]:
 "davar tzivvah l'elef dor
 [the word He commanded — for a thousand generations]."
 And this is the aspect of:
 "hacharash v'hamasger aleph
 [the craftsmen and the smiths — a thousand]"
 [II Kings 24:16] —
 for they were the elders of Israel
 and their judges —
 and through judgment
 one can draw the spirit of wisdom to one's students —
 and teach them one's wisdom —
 as explained within —
 and this is the aspect of:
 "va'aalfecha chochmah
 [and I shall teach you wisdom]."
 [Job 33:33]

segments.he: סימן צד-זכר חסדו
segments.en: ✦ Translator's Summary — Simanim 72–87

segments.he: כל העולמות לא נבראו אלא בשביל ישראל כדי להשפיע להם רב טוב. ועיקר ההשפעה הוא על ידי הדיבור ושבת הוא בחינת הדיבור בחינת ודבר דבר וכנ"ל כמה פעמים בשם הזוהר הקדוש על כן עיקר ההשפעה הוא על ידי קדושת שבת כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש גם עיקר עליית הניצוצות הקדושים (שהם ניצוצי אותיות הדיבור) בשלימות הוא גם כן רק על ידי קדושת שבת כידוע. וזה בחינת עולת שבת בשבתו על עולת התמיד וכו'. כי אז עיקר שלימות עלייתן לשרשן ומנוחתם. כי עיקר עליית הניצוצות הוא על ידי אמונה וחכמה כמבואר בפנים. ושבת הוא בחינת שלימות האמונה ושלימות החכמה והשכל כנ"ל כמה פעמים כי שבת הוא בחינת זיין בחינת כי ששת ימים עשה ה' וכו' וינח ביום השביעי שכולם כלולין בו. וזה בחינת וכל מעשהו באמונה שהוא בחינת קדושת שבת ועל כן הוא בחינת זיין. והוא גם כן בחינת יוד בחינת מחשבה בחינת חכמה כי שבת הוא בחינת עולם המחשבה בחינת חכמה כמו שכתוב כי קדש הוא. ואז עולה האמונה שהוא בחינת מלכות אל החכמה כמבואר בכתבים. ועל כן שבת הוא בחינת עין בחינת תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין. וזה בחינת העין תיבין שיש בקידוש. וזה שאמרו רז"ל ומהדר ליה בקידושא דבי שמשא ועל ידי זה מעלין ניצוצי אותיות הדיבור שיש בכל דבר ונעשה מהם דיבורים ועל ידי זה משפיע השם יתברך רב טוב לישראל. וזה בחינת אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות היינו בחינת אמונה וחכמה מיד נגאלין כי על ידי זה ונגלה כבוד ה' וכו' כמבואר בפנים. וזה גם כן בחינת תחום שבת אלפים אמה היינו גם כן כנגד אמונה וחכמה כנ"ל כמה פעמים. וזה כל המתפלל בערב שבת ואומר ויכולו כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשה בראשית שנאמר ויכולו אל תקרי ויכולו אלא ויכלו. ותיכף אחר זה מנין שהדיבור כמעשה שנאמר בדבר ה' שמים נעשו. היינו מאחר שהבריאה היתה על ידי הדיבור ויש ניצוצי אותיות שנפלו על כן עיקר שלימות הבריאה שלימות מעשה בראשית הוא על ידי עליית הניצוצות הנ"ל וגם כי על ידי זה משפיע רב טוב לישראל שבשביל זה היתה כל הבריאה. ועליית הניצוצות נעשה על ידי קדושת שבת ומתחיל מתפלת ערב שבת שאז עולין העולמות. ועל כן על ידי הדיבורי אמונה שאומרין ישראל בפרשת ויכולו וגם בפרשה זו מרומז ל"ב נתיבות החכמה כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש ובכתבים. וזה בעצמו בחינת ויכל אלקים ביום השביעי וכו' היינו בחינת האמונה שמאיר בשבת בשלימות שזה בחינת וכל מעשהו באמונה. וישבות ביום השביעי וכו' זה בחינת מחשבה ששם עיקר השביתה ומנוחה בחינת שבות ממחשבת עבודה. וכן ויברך הוא בחינת אמונה בחינת איש אמונות רב ברכות ויקדש הוא בחינת מחשבה חכמה הוא בחינת קדש. ועל ידי שני בחינת אלו עיקר עליית הניצוצות ושלימות מעשה בראשית ועל כן כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשה בראשית.
segments.en:
And because — through judgment —
 the Holy Palace as well
 (which is the aspect of Malchus —
 the aspect of Jerusalem)
 receives the power of fire —
 and burns away the husks
 from attaching themselves to it —
 in the aspect of:
 "u'chevod Hashem k'eish ocheles
 [and the glory of Hashem is like a consuming fire],"
 and so on —
 as brought within —
 and this is what is written [Zechariah 12:6]:
 "b'yom hahu asim es alfey Yehudah —
 k'kiyor eish ba'etzim —
 ufeirush Rashi: k'meduras eish gedolah —
 v'challapid eish ba'amir —
 v'achlu al yamin v'al smol
 es kol ha'amim saviv —
 v'yashvah Yerushalayim od tachliyah b'Yerushalayim
 [on that day I shall make the clans of Judah —
 like a firepot among logs of wood —
 and Rashi explained: like a great bonfire —
 and like a torch of fire among sheaves —
 and they shall devour
 on the right and on the left
 all the peoples round about —
 and Jerusalem shall still be inhabited
 in its own place in Jerusalem]."
 And this:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — he should withhold himself
 from pursuing his weekday affairs
 that have within them the grip of the Sitra Achra —
 and the essential rectification of them
 is only through the fact that one draws
 the holiness of Shabbos
 also onto the six weekdays —
 in the aspect of:
 "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas"
 — as mentioned above —
 for this too is the aspect of:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi"
 — as explained above within
 in the teaching Merkavos Phar'oh, Siman 38.
 But on Shabbos even this is forbidden —
 for then the Shechinah rests, as it were —
 and the evil is repelled and completely nullified —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 5:5]:
 "ki lo El chafetz rasha Atah —
 lo yegurcha ra
 [for You are not a G-d Who desires wickedness —
 evil shall not sojourn with You]."

 And then the essential perfection
 of the drawing close of souls —
 which is the aspect of the building
 of the Holy Palace mentioned above —
 for their evil falls and is nullified —
 and the good ascends and is encompassed in holiness —
 for this comes through the aspect of judgment —
 which is the aspect of desire [chefetz] —
 as it is written:
 "ki l'chol chefetz yesh es u'mishpat
 [for every desire has a time and judgment]"
 [Ecclesiastes 8:6] —
 and it is written [Isaiah 61:8]:
 "ani Hashem ohev mishpat
 [I — Hashem — love judgment]."
 And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of repentance —
 as mentioned above many times —
 for this is the aspect of the affairs of Heaven —
 the aspect of:
 "hachafetz achphotz —
 v'chol haggid —
 ki im b'shuvo midrachav v'chayah
 [do I truly desire —
 and so on —
 except in his repentance from his ways — that he should live?]."
 [Ezekiel 18:23]
 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg —
 liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight —
 the holy one of Hashem, honored]"
 — likewise corresponding to the aspect of
 igul and ribua mentioned above —
 for the spirit of wisdom
 drawn through the aspect of judgment —
 there is the essential delight and honor —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And this:
 "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad"
 — this is the aspect of the perfection
 of the Holy Palace —
 which is the aspect of honor —
 as it is written:
 "u'v'heichalo kulo omer kavod
 [and in His palace — everything says glory]"
 — and it is the aspect of:
 "kadosh yei'amer lo
 [holy shall he be called]"
 — as explained within.
 And also — the delight of Shabbos —
 which is the Shabbos meals —
 is the rectification of the heart
 (for there is the source of judgment — as mentioned above)
 — for:
 "pita se'ada d'liba
 [bread is the sustenance of the heart]"
 — and as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "ad she'ha'adam ochel —
 yesh lo shtay levavos —
 v'achar she'ochel — ein lo ela lev echad
 [before a person eats —
 he has two hearts —
 and after he eats — he has only one heart]."

 And the honor of Shabbos
 consists of the garments —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 and the garments are from the aspect of Malchus —
 the aspect of the Holy Palace —
 which clothes the spirit in the heart —
 as explained within.
 And therefore the writings of the holy Ari z"l
 were particular
 that the Shabbos table
 should have four legs —
 for it is the aspect of the ribua mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 9:6]:
 "v'lis'adah b'mishpat
 [to support it with judgment]."
 And this:
 "oseh mishpat la'ashukkim —
 nosein lechem lare'evim
 [He executes justice for the oppressed —
 He gives bread to the hungry]."
 [Psalms 146:7]
 And therefore also regarding the blemish of judgment —
 which is the aspect of fire —
 it is stated [Hosea 7:7]:
 "kulam yechemu k'sannur —
 v'achlu es shofteihem —
 kol malkeichem nafalu
 [all of them burn like an oven —
 and they devour their judges —
 all their kings have fallen],"
 and so on [וכו']
 (for through this
 the Malchus falls, heaven forfend).
 And in a playful manner one can say
 that this is the aspect of what our Sages expounded
 on [Exodus 21:1]:
 "v'eileh hamishpatim asher tasim lifneihem —
 erkam lifneihem k'shulchan aruch
 [and these are the ordinances
 that you shall set before them —
 arrange them before them
 like a set table]."
 For judgment is the aspect of
 the perfection of the table —
 as mentioned above.
 And also — the rectification of judgment
 is the aspect of Shadai
 (which is the aspect of Shabbos — as is well-known)
 — the aspect of [Job 34:12]:
 "v'Shadai lo ye'aves mishpat
 [and Shadai does not pervert judgment]."
 And this is the aspect of [Job 22:26]:
 "ki az al Shadai tis'anag
 [for then you shall delight in Shadai]."
 And this is the aspect of:
 "v'hisanag al Hashem —
 v'yiten lecha mishalos libecha
 [and delight in Hashem —
 and He will give you the desires of your heart]"
 [Psalms 37:4] —
 and our Sages expounded this
 concerning the delight of Shabbos —
 and it is the aspect of the rectification of the heart —
 as mentioned above —
 therefore they give him all the desires of his heart —
 for there is the source of judgment —
 as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 "she'lo yifsa'a pis'ayah gasah —
 she'noteleth achas mi'chamesh me'os
 mi'maor einav shel adam
 [one should not take large strides —
 for it takes away one five-hundredth
 of the light of a person's eyes]"
 — for the large stride
 is the aspect of anger and wrath —
 as our Sages expounded:
 "al tirgazu badarech —
 al tifsa'u pis'ayah gasah
 [do not quarrel on the way —
 do not take large strides]."
 And anger and wrath
 is a blemish of the eyes —
 the aspect of [Psalms 6:8]:
 "asheshah mika'as eyni
 [my eye has grown dim from anger]"
 — which is a blemish in the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of the three colors of the eye
 and the pupil —
 as explained within.
 And also — it alludes
 that there are wicked people
 who are the aspects of the Erev Rav
 whom it is forbidden to draw close —
 for through this one blemishes in all the above —
 as explained within.

 And the drawing close of souls
 is from the aspect of legs —
 as mentioned above —
 and therefore one must be deliberate in the matter —
 and not take large strides —
 so as not to draw close
 those souls who must not be drawn close.
 And this is the aspect of [Proverbs 19:2]:
 "gam b'lo da'as nefesh lo tov —
 v'atz b'raglayim choteh
 [also — without knowledge the soul is not good —
 and one who rushes with his feet — sins]"
 — for the souls of Israel
 are rooted in the sacred Da'as —
 as is well-known —
 and the souls of the Erev Rav
 are rooted in the Da'as of the husks —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "Erev Rav — gimatria — Da'as
 [Erev Rav — in gematria — equals Da'as]"
 — as brought in the writings —
 and they are utterly distant
 from the sacred Da'as —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "gam b'lo da'as nefesh lo tov —
 v'atz b'raglayim choteh"
 — that is, one who is not deliberate in the matter —
 and draws close even those ones — sins.
 For through this one descends from one's level —
 as explained within.
 And this:
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — he should not speak any weekday speech —
 so as not to blemish through this
 the holy speech of Shabbos —
 for then the speech is in its perfection —
 in the aspect of:
 "yechalkel devarav b'mishpat
 [he regulates his words with judgment]"
 — and therefore then
 is the essential time
 to draw the spirit of wisdom to one's students —
 as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — "da Atika Kadisha
 [this is the Holy Ancient One]"
 — for one merits to draw the spirit of wisdom
 from its supernal root —
 which is the aspect of Atik —
 and from there is the root
 of the rectification of judgment —
 until the heart blazes —
 and sits upon the throne —
 in the aspect of:
 "konein l'mishpat kis'o
 [He establishes His throne for judgment]"
 [Psalms 9:8] —
 as will be explained below.
 And our Sages expounded:
 they give him all the desires of his heart —
 that is, as mentioned above —
 through the fact that he merits
 in its perfection
 the rectification of the heart.
 And therefore our Sages expounded —
 in Midrash Rabbah, Parashas Beshalach, section 25:
 that he decrees a decree
 and the Holy One, blessed be He, fulfills it.
 For he merits to draw souls
 close to G-d, blessed be He, in its perfection —
 and then he is the aspect of:
 "im totzei yakar mizolel —
 k'fi tihyeh
 [if you bring forth the precious from the vile —
 you shall be as My mouth]"
 [Jeremiah 15:19] —
 and as our Sages expounded
 [Tractate Bava Metzi'a 85a].
 "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz —
 da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [and I will cause you to ride upon the heights of the earth —
 this is the Holy Apple Orchard]"
 — the aspect of the perfect ascent of Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the Holy Palace mentioned above.
 And our Sages expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 that is, one merits to utterly subdue the evil —
 which is the aspect of the Malchus d'Sitra Achra.

 "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha —
 da Ze'ir Anpin
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father —
 this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — which is the aspect of judgment —
 the central column.
 And this is the aspect of [Obadiah 1:18]:
 "v'hayah beis Yaakov eish
 [and the house of Yaakov shall be fire]"
 — the aspect of the fire of judgment mentioned above.

 And this is the aspect of:
 "vayishlach Yaakov malachim
 [and Yaakov sent angels]"
 [Genesis 32:4] —
 the aspect of the aforementioned angels.
 And our Sages expounded:
 one merits an inheritance without limits —
 for through judgment —
 which is the aspect of fire —
 one burns away all the adversaries
 who surround the holiness —
 in the aspect of:
 "eish lefanav telech v'salhet saviv tzarav
 [fire goes before Him —
 and burns round about His enemies]"
 [Psalms 97:3] —
 and the evil is completely nullified —
 until it is fulfilled:
 "ki az ehpoch el ha'amim —
 safah verurah —
 likro chulam b'shem Hashem
 [for then I shall turn to the peoples —
 a pure tongue —
 to call them all in the Name of Hashem],"
 and so on —
 which is the aspect of an inheritance without limits —
 in the aspect of:
 "ki veisi beis tefillah yikara l'chol ha'amim
 [for My house shall be called
 a house of prayer for all the peoples]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — for the aspect of the Holy Palace —
 which is the aspect of Malchus peh —
 was rectified through the aspect of judgment —
 which is the aspect of:
 "u'mishpetay pihu
 [and the judgments of His mouth]"
 [Psalms 105:5] —
 and it is written:
 "bisfasai siparti kol mishpetay picha
 [with my lips I have declared
 all the judgments of Your mouth]."
 [Psalms 119:13]
 And this is the aspect of [Proverbs 31:9]:
 "petach picha shifat tzedek
 [open your mouth — judge righteously]."
 And this is the aspect of:
 "yechalkel devarav b'mishpat
 [he regulates his words with judgment]."
 [Psalms 112:5]
 And it is written:
 "u'leshono tedaber mishpat
 [and his tongue speaks judgment]."
 [Psalms 37:30]
 And this is the aspect of [Psalms 18:9]:
 "v'eish mipiv tochal
 [and fire from His mouth consumes]"
 — for judgment is the aspect of fire —
 as mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of [Jeremiah 5:14]:
 "hineni nosein devarai b'ficha l'eish
 [behold — I am placing My words in your mouth as fire]."
 And through this —
 the aspect of the spirit of wisdom
 is drawn to his students —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "piha paschah b'chochmah
 [she opens her mouth with wisdom]"
 [Proverbs 31:26] —
 and it is written:
 "pi yedaber chochmos
 [my mouth shall speak wisdoms]"
 [Psalms 49:4] —
 and it is written:
 "pi tzadik yehgeh chochmah —
 u'leshono tedaber mishpat
 [the mouth of the righteous meditates wisdom —
 and his tongue speaks judgment]."
 [Psalms 37:30]
 And this [Psalms 37:31]:
 "Toras Elokav b'libo
 [the Torah of his G-d is in his heart]"
 — the aspect of the rectification of the heart
 mentioned above —
 "lo timad ashurav
 [his steps do not falter]"
 — the aspect of the legs mentioned above.
 And also — the soul itself
 is the understanding of mouth and speech —
 the aspect of:
 "l'nefesh chayyah —
 l'ruach memalela
 [to a living soul —
 to a speaking spirit]."
 [Targum on Genesis 2:7]
 And through all of this
 he merits that his speech is sustained —
 like the word of Hashem, as it were —
 in the aspect of:
 "k'fi tihyeh
 [you shall be as My mouth]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "ki pi Hashem diber."
 And see [Daniel 7:9–14]:
 "chazey havit —
 ad di churs'avon remiv —
 ufeirush Rashi: kis'os hutlu v'nitkannu l'yoshev b'mishpat —
 echad l'din v'echad l'tzedakah l'Yisrael —
 v'Atik Yomin yesiv —
 ufeirush Rashi: haKadosh baruch Hu yoshev l'mishpat —
 levushei k'selag chuvar —
 l'laben avonos amo —
 v'se'ar reishei k'amar neka
 — menakeh atzmo mizechiuyos she'yesh l'aku'm lefanav
 u'meshallem lahem kol secharam b'olam hazeh —
 kurs'ei shevivim d'nur —
 v'chol haggid —
 nehar dinur nagid v'nafik —
 v'chol haggid —
 alef alfin yeshamshunieh —
 v'chol haggid —
 dina yesiv v'sifrin pesichin —
 v'chol haggid —
 ad di kesalas cheyusa —
 v'uvid gushma —
 v'yahas likedas asha —
 v'chol haggid —
 ufeirush Rashi: livhas aish —
 hu asho shel Yaakov —
 v'hayah beis Yaakov eish —
 v'chol haggid —
 chazeh havit —
 v'chol haggid —
 k'var enash asa —
 ufeirush Rashi: hu Melech haMashiach —
 v'ad Atik Yomin mata —
 v'chol haggid —
 ufeirush Rashi: she'hayah yoshev b'mishpat —
 v'dan es ha'aku'm
 [I looked —
 until thrones were set up —
 and Rashi explained: thrones were set up and prepared
 to sit in judgment —
 one for judgment and one for righteousness for Israel —
 and the Ancient of Days sat —
 and Rashi explained: the Holy One, blessed be He,
 sits in judgment —
 His garment was white as snow —
 to whiten the sins of His people —
 and the hair of His head was like pure wool
 — clearing Himself of the merits
 that the nations have before Him —
 and paying them all their reward in this world —
 His throne was flaming fire —
 and so on —
 and a river of fire flowed and went forth —
 and so on —
 a thousand thousands serve Him —
 and so on —
 judgment sat and books were opened —
 and so on —
 until the beast was slain —
 and its body was destroyed —
 and given to the burning fire —
 and so on —
 and Rashi explained:
 to the flame of fire —
 which is the fire of Yaakov —
 'and the house of Yaakov shall be fire' —
 and so on —
 I saw —
 and so on —
 like a son of man he came —
 and Rashi explained: this is the King Mashiach —
 and he reached the Ancient of Days —
 and so on —
 and Rashi explained: he was sitting in judgment —
 and was judging the nations],"
 see there further —
 behold — all the aforementioned matter is explained.
 For the root of the aspect of judgment
 flows from the aspect of Atik —
 Who sits upon the throne of judgment —
 until the throne also receives
 the power of fire —
 the aspect of:
 "kurs'ei shevivim d'nur
 [His throne — flaming fire],"
 and so on —
 "alef alfim yeshamshunieh
 [a thousand thousands serve Him]"
 — that is, the aspect of the aforementioned angels.

 And Yaakov —
 who is the aspect of judgment —
 the central column —
 ascends to the aspect of Atik
 in the aspect of:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem"
 — as mentioned above —
 and draws from there
 an illumination to the aspect of Malchus —
 the aspect of the Holy Palace —
 which is the aspect of the Throne of Glory —
 until through this the evil falls
 and is completely nullified —
 and the good ascends
 and is encompassed in the holiness
 of the Holy Palace mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of the two thrones:
 one for judgment —
 through which comes the downfall of the nations —
 and even all their success
 is for evil to them —
 in order to repay them
 for their merits —
 and their measure is completed —
 as mentioned above —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "bifroach resha'im k'mo esev —
 v'chol haggid —
 l'hishmaedam adey ad
 [when the wicked flourish like grass —
 and so on —
 it is for their eternal destruction],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And one throne for righteousness [tzedakah] —
 for Israel —
 to judge them favorably
 and draw them close to G-d, blessed be He.
 And this is what our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Chagigah 14a]:
 "achas lo v'achas l'David
 [one for Him and one for David]"
 — and as Rashi explained.
 And:
 "v'ad Atik Yomin mata
 [and he reached the Ancient of Days]"
 — that even the King Mashiach
 will sit in judgment.
 And likewise our Sages expounded:
 "Hashem b'mishpat yavo im ziknay amo v'sarav
 [Hashem will come in judgment
 with the elders of His people and their princes]"
 [Isaiah 3:14] —
 that even the great ones of Israel
 will sit with the Holy One, blessed be He —
 and judge the nations —
 as mentioned above.
 For they too receive the power of judgment
 from its supernal root —
 until they cast the evil down completely —
 and the throne is completed —
 which is the aspect of the throne of David.
 And this is what is written [Isaiah 9:6]:
 "al kisei David —
 v'al mamlachwu —
 l'hachin osah —
 v'lis'adah b'mishpat u'vitzedakah
 [on the throne of David —
 and upon his kingdom —
 to establish it —
 and to support it with judgment and righteousness],"
 and so on —
 the aspects of judgment and righteousness mentioned above.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "mishpat u'tzedakah b'Yaakov
 [judgment and righteousness in Yaakov],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 [Psalms 99:4]
 And this:
 "levushei k'selag chuvar —
 l'laben avonos Yisrael
 [His garment was white as snow —
 to whiten the sins of Israel]."
 For this is the aspect of:
 "leku na v'invachah yomar Hashem
 [come now and let us reason together —
 says Hashem]"
 — for the disputation
 is the clarification of matters —
 which is likewise the aspect of judgment —
 as Rashi z"l explained —
 and through judgment
 the evil immediately falls and is nullified —
 for all the evil comes only
 from the attachment of the nations —
 in the aspect of:
 "vayisarvu vagoyim
 [and they mingled among the nations],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 [Psalms 106:35]
 But when the evil falls below —
 then Israel immediately return in great repentance —
 acknowledge and abandon —
 and then:
 "im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim —
 kasheleig yalvinu
 [if your sins are like crimson —
 they shall become white as snow]."

 And therefore also —
 the angels who accompany a person on Erev Shabbos
 (who are the aspects of the aforementioned angels)
 lay their hands upon his head
 and say to him:
 "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar
 [and your iniquity is removed —
 and your sin is atoned]."
 [Isaiah 6:7]
 And likewise our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "hashomer Shabbas —
 v'chol haggid —
 mochalin lo al kol avonosaym
 [one who guards the Shabbos —
 and so on —
 he is forgiven for all his sins]."
 And this too is the aspect of
 an inheritance without limits —
 for all the constraints are nullified —
 which are in the aspect of:
 "tzivvah Hashem l'Yaakov —
 savivav tzarav
 [Hashem has commanded regarding Yaakov —
 his adversaries surround him]"
 [Lamentations 1:17] —
 for their essential attack
 comes through sins, heaven forfend.
 But through the holiness of Shabbos —
 which encompasses all the above —
 through this the sins are atoned —
 and all the constraints are nullified.
 For from the letters of:
 מְצָ"ר [metzar — constraint] —
 צֶמֶ"ר [tzemer — wool] is made —
 the aspect of:
 "v'se'ar reishei k'amar neka
 [and the hair of His head was like pure wool]"
 — as mentioned above —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "im yadu'imu k'sola'as —
 k'tzemer yiyu
 [if they be red as crimson —
 they shall become as wool]"
 [Isaiah 1:18] —
 and as explained elsewhere.

segments.he: וזה מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' וכו' היינו לדבר דיבורים קדושים שעל ידי זה משפיע רב טוב וחסד לבית ישראל על ידי קדושת שבת כנ"ל. וזה להגיד בבוקר חסדך בחינת השפעת החסדים הנ"ל.
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of teshuvah me'ahavah [repentance from love] — as explained above within in Siman 58 in the teaching tlas nafkin mechad. And through teshuvah me'ahavah one merits mochin d'gadlus [expanded consciousness]. And this is the aspect of the mental faculties of Shabbos. And therefore then it is very good and beautiful to pray — for one has pure intellect — and one can pray without toil [b'li iyyun] — as explained within. And this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught: when Adam haRishon did repentance — he recited: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem." And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the power of strong sight [koach hare'iyah hechazak] — in the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "re'u ki Hashem nasan lachem haShabbas [see that Hashem has given you the Shabbos]" — for Shabbos is: "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" — and as explained elsewhere. And therefore all the livelihood of all the days of the week flows from Shabbos. For through the sight one makes a boundary and time — that the bounty shall descend in its proper time. And this is the aspect of [Leviticus 26:4]: "v'nasati gishmeichem b'itam [and I shall give your rains in their time]" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: on Shabbos nights. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "al kein hu nosen lachem b'yom hashishi lechem yomayim [therefore He gives you on the sixth day bread for two days]." For during all the days of the week — they had to focus with strong trust each day before the manna descended — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. But on the holy Shabbos — from which is the root of all the influences — and also through it is the essential strengthening of sight and trust. For through the holiness of Shabbos — one receives great and new mental faculties — to strengthen oneself constantly in trust in Him, blessed be He. Therefore there is no need then to test Israel whether they will be firm in their trust — and lift their eyes to Him, blessed be He, regarding their livelihood. And all the more so — that they should not then make any effort whatsoever for their livelihood — to go out into the field and gather the manna. Rather — the manna descended to them on Erev Shabbos — also for the need of Shabbos. And on Shabbos — all Israel should look and focus only on the spiritual bounty — which is the aspect of the bounty of the holy mental faculties.

segments.he: ואמונתך בלילות היינו על ידי אמונה עם חכמה שזה בחינת להגיד לשון מלה דחכמתא כידוע. על ידי זה ממשיכין חסדים על ידי עליית אותיות הדיבור וזה עלי עשור הוא בחינת היוד שהוא בחינת חכמה ועלי נבל ראשי תיבות ל"ב נתיבות החכמה כמבואר במקום אחר עלי הגיון בכנור שהוא גם כן בחינת חכמה ואינה מלאכה כמו שאמרו רז"ל וזה בחינת זמרו משכיל וכמבואר במקום אחר וזה כי שמחתני ה' בפעליך במעשה ידיך ארנן זה בחינת עליית הניצוצות של אותיות מעשה בראשית שעולין על ידי קדושת שבת בשמחה גדולה בבחינת כי בשמחה תצאו וכמבואר במקם אחר. וזה בחינת שתעלינו בשמחה לארצנו וזה ושמחינו בישועתך כי זה ישועתו יתברך כמבואר בפנים.
segments.en: And the power of strong sight drawn on Shabbos upon each person of Israel — according to his level. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:13]: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — the aspect of the bounty of mental faculties and Da'as — which are the aspect of Kodesh — as is well-known.

segments.he: וזה מה גדלו מעשיך ה' זה בחינת אור האמונה בחינת וכל מעשהו באמונה. מאד עמקו מחשבותיך בחינת מחשבה וחכמה שעל ידי זה יכולין להוציא ולהעלות אפילו הניצוצות שנפלו בסטרא דמותא שזה בחינת מאד כידוע וזה איש בער לא ידע וכסיל לא יבין את זאת היינו שאין לו בחינת חכמה וגם אמונה שהוא בחינה זאת כידוע. וזה בחינת בפרוח רשעים וכו' להשמדם עדי עד כי עלייתם הוא תכלית ירידתם ומפלתם בבחינת ומשלם לשונאיו אל פניו להאבידו. כי על ידי זה יוצא מהם כל חיותם שהם הניצוצות הקדושים שנפלו במקומן ואז הם כלים ואובדין לגמרי. וזה ואתה מרום לעולם ה' בחינת עליית ניצוצי אותיות הדיבור שהם בחינת את"ה כידוע ומובן בפנים גם כן. וזה כי הנה אויבך ה' כי הנה אויבך יאבדו וכו' ותרם כראם קרני בלותי בשמן רענן. וזה ותבט עיני בשורי היינו על ידי בחינת עין הנ"ל שעל ידי זה מעלין הניצוצות הקדושים על ידי זה ממשיכין גם כן מפלת הרשעים בבחינת רק בעיניך תביט ושלומת רשעים תראה בחינת נתן עיניו בו ונעשה גל של עצמות. כי על ידי הסתכלות והבטת עיניו לבד מוציא ניצוצות הקדושים שנפלו במקומו שזה כל חיותו. ועל ידי זה נעשה אפס לגמרי כמבואר גם בפנים וכמובא גם בסימן י"ב על ושמעית מלכותא וקטליה. וזה בקמים עלי מרעים תשמענה אזני צדיק כתמר יפרח כי הצדיקים שהם אחדות אחד עם הניצוצות הקדושים על כן על ידי המחלוקת ורדיפות שעובר עליהם הם פורחין וגדילים ביותר וזה שתולים בבית ה' (בחינת חכמה כמבואר בפנים) ובחצרות אלקינו (בחינת אמונה) יפריחו. וזה עוד ינובון בשיבה כי כל זה מן שמזקינים דעתן מתיישבת עליהן וזה להגיד כי ישר ה' צורי וכו' כי ישר דבר ה' וכל מעשהו באמונה והכל נעשה בשביל עליית הניצוצות הקדושים שהם בחינת דבר ה' כנ"ל:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of: blessed with manna that descended on Erev Shabbos — and so on — and sanctified with the manna that did not descend at all on it — in order to know that then the bounty does not descend only for that day alone. Rather — all the bounty of all the days flows from that day. And although on that day itself one also needs material bounty — and on the contrary — then the essential commandment of eating and drinking and delighting the Shabbos applies — for the meals of the weekday are optional meals and those of Shabbos are obligatory commanded meals. But nonetheless — due to the immense holiness of Shabbos — it is not appropriate to engage in any act or doing for this purpose — and even to think merely a bare thought.

segments.he: וזה אם תשיב משבת רגלך. היינו בחינת עליית רגלי הקדושה עם הניצוצות הקדושים שעולין על ידי קדושת שבת וזה עשות חפציך ביום קדשי כי גם עשיית חפציו בחול כשעושה אותם בקדושה כראוי הוא גם כן בחינת עליית ניצוצות הקדושים כמבואר במקום אחר.
segments.en: For then one must be connected with a complete and strong bond — in deed — speech — and thought — only to the spiritual bounty of the holiness of Shabbos — which is a foretaste of the World to Come — as our Sages of blessed memory taught. And because in sight there is or yashar [direct light] and or chozer [returning light] — as explained within.

segments.he: אך בשבת אסור לעשות שום מלאכה כי אז עיקר שלימות עליית הניצוצות הקדושים על ידי קדושת שבת בעצמה כנ"ל. וזה וקראת לשבת ענג בחינת חכמה ולקדוש ה' מכובד בחינת אמונה וכנ"ל כמה פעמים. גם על ידי זה נמשך בחינת ונגלה כבוד ה' כמבואר בפנים.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:13]: "es Shabsosai tishmoru" — "Shabsosai" — specifically — two Shabbosim — for Shabbos is the aspect of the power of sight — the aspect of: "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein" — as mentioned above. That is — on Shabbos — as it were — the Holy One, blessed be He, gazes upon the entire creation — (and primarily upon Israel — for whom everything was created) — with love and great will — in the aspect of [Genesis 2:1–2]: "vayechulu hashamayim v'ha'aretz — v'chol haggid — vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i melachto asher asah" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: from the language of love and longing. And this is the aspect of or yashar. And through Israel guarding the Shabbos and connecting themselves to its holiness with all their heart — through this the gaze of Hashem, blessed be He, as it were, connects even more to the creation — in the aspect of a strike and a connection literally. And through this is drawn, as it were, the aspect of or chozer — that the sight returns to His knowledge and awareness, blessed be He, as it were. And then Israel are connected to His Da'as and awareness, blessed be He, in fullness — and He draws upon them complete Providence — and grants them all good in its time and proper moment. And this [Exodus 31:17]: "ki os hi beyni u'veineichem l'dorosechem — lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem."

segments.he: וזה בחינת כבוד שבת גם כן. וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך שלא יפסיע פסיעה גסה שנוטלת אחת מת"ק ממאור עיניו של אדם נמצא שעל ידי זה פוגם בבחינת העינים הנ"ל שהם בחינת קדושת שבת. וזה ממצוא חפצך ודבר דבר בכדי שלא יפגום בבחינת אותיות הדיבור שעולין על ידי קדושת שבת. וזה אז תתענג על ה' כי על ידי זה משפיע השם יתברך רב טוב לישראל שזה עיקר תענוגו כמבואר בפנים. ועל כן גם הוא יזכה להתענג על ה'. וזה שכן ארץ בחינת חכמה כי אוירא דארץ ישראל מחכים ורעה אמונה (על ידי זה) והתענג על ה' ויתן לך משאלות לבך כי נמשכין על ידי זה כל ההשפעות טובות. וזה שדרשו רז"ל שנותנין לו כל משאלות לבו היינו כנ"ל. וזה שדרש בזוהר הקדוש דא עתיקא קדישא היינו שיזכה למוחין העליונים מאד שהן מבחינת עתיק.
segments.en: "Lada'as [to know]" — specifically. For through the holiness of Shabbos — Israel are connected to His Da'as, blessed be He, as it were — as mentioned above. And likewise — the holiness of the illumination of His divinity, blessed be He, that shines on Shabbos — connects properly to the Da'as and awareness of Israel — in the aspect of: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — and likewise [Exodus 6:7]: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem Elokeichem."

segments.he: וזה והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ בחינת עליית המלכות אל המוחין היינו שלימות האמונה שהוא בחינת מלכות כשמאירין בה המוחין שהן בחינת חכמה. וזה שדרשו רז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות היינו שהניצוצות עולין מבחינת הגלות. וזה והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך דא ז"א שהוא הבחינה המחברת החכמה עם האמונה שזה בחינת התורה הקדושה כידוע וזה בחינת נחלת יעקב אביך. ועל כן עיקר תיקון הבריאה על ידי יעקב כמו שאמרו רז"ל עולמי מי בראך יעקב בראך וכנ"ל כמה פעמים שזה בחינת בשבילי נברא העולם המבואר בפנים. וזה בחינת נחלה בלי מצרים כי יכול לכבוש את כל העולם ולהעלותו אל שלימות הקדושה על ידי הסתכלות בעיניו לבד וזה בחינת וישכון ישראל בטח בדד עין יעקב עין דייקא וזה כי פי ה' דבר כי כל זה נעשה על ידי קדושת שבת שאז עולין הניצוצות הקדושים שהן אותיות הדיבור ונתייחדין עם השם יתברך כביכול שזה בחינת כי פי ה' דבר כמבואר בפנים:
segments.en: And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "matanah tovah yesh li b'veys genzai — v'Shabbas shemah — v'ani rotzeh litnah l'Yisrael" — this is the aspect of the or yashar of the holiness of Shabbos.
