And this: "lech v'hodiyam" — so that they should prepare themselves to receive the light of this gift — and then the light will shine upon them in the aspect of a strike and a connection — and through this is also made the aspect of or chozer — which is the aspect of the fullness of the holiness of Shabbos. And this is the aspect of: "matan scharah lo avida l'galeyyei" — for the plainness of the holiness of Shabbos that G-d, blessed be He, gave us the Shabbos — which is the aspect of or yashar — this is made to be revealed. But its reward — that is, what we must connect ourselves to its holiness — and through this the sight returns to His knowledge, blessed be He, as it were — as mentioned above — and through this one merits to receive the illumination of the upper Shabbos at its root in fullness — this is not made to be revealed. And therefore G-d, blessed be He, Himself had to make known to us all of this. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory also taught: Shabbos was given in privacy — for just as when one wishes to look at some thing from afar — one must focus and concentrate the sight — and not look at anything from the side — but only at that thing one wishes to see and gaze upon properly — and all of this so that the direct light of the power of sight should reach it with great force. And then — through the strike that it strikes strongly upon the visible thing — through this the thing will return and be depicted in one's eye — in the aspect of or chozer — and as explained elsewhere. Likewise — G-d, blessed be He, did not wish to publicize the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of the power of sight — and to give it publicly — so that it should not scatter somewhat from the side as well — as it were. And therefore He gave it in privacy — and made it known only to Israel alone — and in privacy — so that the matter should be in its fullness — as mentioned above. And this is what they said: "matan scharah lo aodiyinhu" — as mentioned above. For G-d, blessed be He, wishes that only the holy Israel should be connected to His Da'as and awareness in fullness through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above — and no one else. "Ai nami neshamah yetairah lo aodiyinhu" — for the illumination of the extra soul is from the aspect of the strike — as it were — that the direct light of the holiness of Shabbos — which flows from above from Him, blessed be He, alone — strikes and hits the holiness of the souls of Israel — and through this each person feels in his soul some flash of the illumination of the supernal holiness — which is the aspect of the extra soul. And this itself is the aspect of the notification — that besides the fact that G-d, blessed be He, has mercy upon us and shines upon us the illumination of the holiness of Shabbos through awakening from above alone — for the holiness of Shabbos is established and enduring — as our Sages of blessed memory taught — He also notifies us (through the extra soul — as mentioned above) that the holiness of Shabbos has already flowed upon us — so that we should see to connect ourselves properly to its holiness — and through this the aspect of or chozer is also completed — as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן צה-כשפרנסי הדור וכו'
segments.en: And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — which is the aspect of prayer — as is well-known — to the mental faculties — that one merits to pray with clear intellect. And one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — from which comes the aspect of alien thoughts that disrupt the concentration of prayer. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which is the aspect of the entirety of the Torah and the commandments. And therefore it is explained regarding Yaakov that he engaged in commerce in faith — in the aspect of [Genesis 30:33]: "v'anetah bi tzidkasi b'yom machar" — and as explained in the passage Vayichar l'Yaakov — vayarev b'Lavan. And also — it is explained regarding him that he guarded the Shabbos — as mentioned above. And therefore Yaakov merited an inheritance without limits — the aspect of above place — above time. For the aspects of time and place are connected to each other — as understood elsewhere. And he is the essential one about whom it is said: "Yisrael asher b'cha espa'ar" — the aspect of Tiferes Yisrael. And he is the aspect of: "Yisrael alah b'machashavah [Israel arose in thought]."

segments.he: וזהו שאמר משה ונחנו מה כי תלינו עלינו היינו מאחר שלא הסרנו בחינת מה שעל ידי זה נשאר פה ובאים מחלוקות ובזיונות. אבל מאחר שאנחנו מחזיקים עצמינו בבחינת 'מה'-אם כן למה תלונו עלינו. ועל כן אחר כך כשנאמר ויקצוף עליהם משה על שהותירו מן המן אמרו רז"ל במדרש רבא בשלח שעל ידי שבא אז לכלל כעס שכח להזהירם על שבת ובשביל זה נאמר לו אחר כך עד אנה מאנתם וכלל אף אותו עמהם היינו כנ"ל כי שבת הוא בחינת עולם המחשבה. ומובא בשערי ציון ובכתבים שלטהר המחשבה צריך לכוון חמשה פעמים שם מ"ה באחורים וכו' וזה מחשבה חשב מה עיין שם. ועל כן על ידי הכעס שהוא כביכול בחינת תסור מ"ה על ידי זה שכח להזהירם על שבת ונשאר פה שנאמר לו עד אנה כנ"ל. וה בחינת שבו איש תחתיו שנאמר אחר כך בשבת שמרמז על שפלות כמבואר במקום אחר שזה בחינת 'מה' הנ"ל. וזה ראו כי ה' נתן לכם השבת ראו דייקא כי עי"ן גימטריא ק"ל היינו שם 'מה' באחורים הנ"ל כמובא בכתבים וזה כי ה' נתן לכם השבת שהוא בחינת עולם המחשבה על כן הוא נותן לכם לחם יומים בכדי שלא תהא המחשבה טרודה בפרנסה רק תהא קשורה בקדושת שבת. וזה שבו איש תחתיו בחינת שפלות בחינת מה שבזה תלוי עיקר קדושת המחשבה והחכמה כמו שכתוב והחכמה מאין תמצא וכמבואר במקום אחר. וזה חכמה אותיות כח מה כנ"ל וזה אל יצא איש ממקומו שעל ידי זה לא יצא ממקומו ומדריגתו ולא יבא לידי בזיונות ח"ו כנ"ל:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of [Exodus 20:8]: "zachor es yom haShabbas l'kadsho" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — and they said: "mei'chad b'Shabbis l'Shabbasa." For since the holiness of Shabbos is very spiritual — therefore one must prepare oneself for this throughout all the days of the week — and remember the holiness of Shabbos each day — which is the aspect of the sight — that one watches and focuses and anticipates and prepares oneself for the holiness of Shabbos. And this is the aspect of the or yashar from the side of the holy Israel — that is, they focus throughout all the days of the week with great concentration on the holiness of Shabbos. And through this their sight reaches the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos in the aspect of a strike — and the sight returns to them in the aspect of or chozer — and they merit to receive the holiness of Shabbos in its fullness. And this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 5:12]: "v'shamru vnay Yisrael es haShabbas" — and likewise: "shamor es yom haShabbas" — and so on — from the language of waiting and anticipation — for one must wait and anticipate the holiness of Shabbos — which is the aspect of sight. And through this one draws upon himself the holiness of Shabbos in its fullness.

segments.he: סימן צו-זומם רשע לצדיק
segments.en: And this [Psalms 92:2–3]: "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas — tov lehodos laHashem" — and so on — that is, to speak holy words — through which He grants abundant good and lovingkindness to the house of Israel through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And this [Psalms 92:3]: "lehagid baboker chasdecha" — the aspect of drawing down the lovingkindnesses mentioned above.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחינת עולם המחשבה ואז עיקר זמן עליית הניצוצות בשלימות כי כולהו במחשבה אתברירו.
segments.en: And behold — "shamor" is the attribute of night — the aspect of Malchus — which is the aspect of or chozer. For in its particularity — as it were — there is by Him, blessed be He, the aspect of or yashar and or chozer in the matter of the holiness of Shabbos — and likewise by Israel — as mentioned above. And in its generality: the illumination of the holiness of Shabbos that G-d, blessed be He, grants from above — this is the aspect of or yashar.

segments.he: ועל כן אז טוב ויפה מאד להתפלל בלי מחשבות זרות ואפילו אם מגיע לו איזה מחשבה זרה בנקל אז ביותר להעלותה. וזה מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' וכו' וזה כי שמחתני ה' בפעלך במעשה ידך ארנן כי אין שמחה כהתרת הספיקות (וכמובן בט"ז אורח חיים סימן תקנ"ד) ועל כן אף על פי שתמיד ידוע לכל כי מלא כל הארץ כבודו ובוודאי יש ניצוצות קדושים בכל מחשבה זרה גם כן. אף על פי כן מאחר שקשה לו להעלותה יש לו צער, אמנם בשבת בנקל לו להעלותה ויש לו שמחה מאחר שהכל פועל ידיו יתברך וכל פעל ה' למענהו. אך כל זה כשבאה לו מחשבה זרה כפי המדה שאוחז בה וכפי חלקו שיש לו בקדושת שבת אמנם לפעמים באה לו מחשבה זרה שהוא מבחינת למעלה ממדרגתו ואז קשה לו להעלותה. אך אף על פי כן בכח הרצון שרוצה לשברה ולהעלותה משבר בזה כח הרשעים ובעלי מחלוקת שחולקין על איזה צדיק (שמשם באה לו המחשבה זרה זאת) כמבואר בפנים. וזה מה גדלו מעשיך ה' מאד עמקו מחשבותיך. כי לפעמים באה מחשבה זרה גם בשבת שקשה לתקנה ולהעלותה כי יש כמה בחינות ומדריגות בזה והמחשבה זרה הוא למעלה ממדריגתו. וזה איש בער לא ידע וכסיל לא יבין את זאת כי למה באה לו מחשבה זרה זו מאחר שאינה ממדריגתו. אך על ידי זה נמשך מפלת הרשעים ובעלי מחלוקת שחולקין על צדיקים וזה בפרוח רשעים וכו' להשמדם עדי עד וכו' יתפרדו כל פועלי און ותרם כראם קרני וכו' ותבט עיני בשורי בקמים עלי מרעים תשמענה אזני צדיק כתמר יפרח וכו' או אפשר שיש בזה עוד מדריגות. כי יש מחשבות זרות שבאים מבחינת נגה שהוא מעורב טוב ורע וצריך להעלות הטוב שבהם. אבל יש מחשבות שהם מבחינת השלש קליפות טמאות שצריכין לבטלם לגמרי ולדחותם בדיחוי גמור. וזה גם בחול ובערב שבת שאז זמן עליית העולמות והניצוצות ונתעלה גם הטוב שבנגה ואז רוצין גם הקליפות טמאות הנ"ל לעלות ולינק מהקדושה ואז יורד שלהובא דאשא ומכוה אותם ומפילם וכו' כמבואר בכתבים היינו שאלו המחשבות אי אפשר להעלותם רק לעורר עליהם כח האש דקדושה על ידי התלהבות שבתפלה ואז הם ממילא כלים והולכין בבחינת אש לפניו תלך ותלהט סביב צריו בחינת כהמס דונג מפני אש יאבדו רשעים וכו'. וזה גם כן בכלל בפרוח רשעים כמו עשב וכו' היינו שרוצים גם כן לעלות אבל הוא להשמדם עדי עד יתפרדו כל פועלי און ותרם כראם קרני הוא הרמת הקדושה כמבואר כל זה בכוונות:
segments.en: And that Israel receive its holiness — and anticipate it and prepare themselves for it — this is the aspect of or chozer.

segments.he: סימן צו-אלהים אל דמי לך
segments.en: And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" — that is, the aspect of the ascent of the sacred legs together with the holy sparks — that ascend through the holiness of Shabbos. And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" — for even the doing of one's pursuits on a weekday — when done properly in holiness — is likewise the aspect of the ascent of the holy sparks — as explained elsewhere.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחינת ענוה ושפלות והוא גם כן בחינת יראה ובחינת מלכות ותיקון המחשבות זרות כנ"ל כמה פעמים. ועל כן אז יש להתפלה שלימות וזוכין לבחינת צדיק מושל על ידי התפלה כמבואר במדרש רבא פרשה בשלח שמי ששומר ומענג את השבת זוכה לבחינת ותגזור אומר ויקם לך וממלאין לו כל משאלות לבו. וזה בחינת כי אז על שדי תתענג וכו' תעתיר אליו וישמעך וכו' ותגזור אומר ויקם לך וכו' (איוב כ"ב) כי זה בעצמו תענוגו יתברך כשיש צדיקים שמתפללין באופן זה ובשביל זה היתה כל הבריאה כולה ובשבילם השם יתברך מחדש גם עכשיו מעשה בראשית ומשנה הטבע ועושה פלאות על ידי תפלתם כמובן בפנים. וכל זה נמשך בשבת בשלימות כי שבת הוא תכלית מעשה שמים וארץ וסוף מעשה במחשבה תחלה ואז מאירין ביותר כל העשרה מאמרות שעל ידם היתה כל הבריאה כמו שכתוב ויכל אלקים ביום השביעי וכו' ועשרה מאמרות הנ"ל הם בחינת חסד וזה בחינת החסדים הגדולים שנמשכין בשבת.ועל ידי זה נעשה מהדלת הא שתיקון זה נעשה בשלימות על ידי קדושת שבת כמבואר בתיקונים ועל ידי זה נמשך השפע. כי שבת הוא שורש כל ההשפעות כידוע. וזה בחינת אז תתענג על ה' היינו שיזכה לכנוס כביכול בבחינת תענוגיו יתברך שמתענג מזה שיש צדיקים מושלים בתפלתם כמבואר בפנים. ועל כן דרשו רז"ל מזה שגם הוא זוכה לזה וממלאין לו כל משאלות לבו כנ"ל. והרכבתיך על במותי ארץ בחינת עליית המלכות שהוא התפלה ועל כן דרשו רז"ל שניצול משיעבוד מלכיות היינו שניצול על ידי קדושת שבת מגיאות ומחשבות זרות שהן בחינת שיעבוד מלכיות והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב אביך הוא בחינת ענוה ויראה בחינת עקב ענוה יראת ה' (וכמבואר במקום אחר) שעל ידי זה נשלמת התפלה עד שמושל בתפלתו ויוכל לשנות הטבע שזה בחינת שזוכה לנחלה בלי מצרים ובשביל זה נברא העולם כנ"ל. וזה עולמי עולמי מי בראך יעקב בראך. וזה כי פי ה' דבר כי זוכה שדיבורו הוא בחינת דבר ה' ויוכל על ידי זה להמשיך חידוש מעשה בראשית שנאמר על זה בדבר ה' שמים נעשו ונמשכים חסדים גדולים ונשפע שפע רב בבחינת ויברך אתכם כאשר דבר לכם:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem — da Atika Kadisha" — the aspect of the light of the holiness of Shabbos at its supernal root — which is the aspect of or yashar. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz — da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — which is the aspect of the light of Malchus — which is the aspect of or chozer. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha — da Ze'ir Anpin" — which encompasses both aspects together. And therefore the image of Yaakov is engraved upon the Throne of Honor — which is the aspect of or chozer — for G-d, blessed be He, gazes upon him in the aspect of or yashar — for the entire creation was only for his sake — as mentioned above. Until the sight returns to Him, blessed be He, in the aspect of or chozer. And he is the first of whom it is written that he guarded the Shabbos — and established the Shabbos boundary — and so on. The Shabbos boundary of two thousand cubits [techum Shabbas alpayim amah] — likewise corresponds to the aspect of the two lights mentioned above. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — which is the aspect of [Isaiah 55:11]: "ken yihyeh devari asher yetzei mipi — lo yashuv eilai reikam [so shall be My word that goes forth from My mouth — it shall not return to Me empty]," and so on — the aspect of or yashar and or chozer. And one must still elaborate on this — but due to the subtlety of the aforementioned matters it is not possible to expand the speech so much.

segments.he: סימן צח-גל של עצמות
segments.en: And this is likewise the aspect of the honor of Shabbos. And [Isaiah 58:13]: "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha" — not to take large strides — which removes one five-hundredth of the light of one's eyes — it follows that through this one blemishes the aspect of the aforementioned eyes — which are the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos. And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar" — so as not to blemish the aspect of the letters of speech that ascend through the holiness of Shabbos. And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — for through this G-d, blessed be He, grants abundant good to Israel — which is the essential delight — as explained within. And therefore also he merits to delight in Hashem. And this [Psalms 37:3]: "shechen eretz u're'eh emunah" — through this — "v'his'anag al Hashem" — and He will give you the desires of your heart — for all the good influences are drawn through this. And this is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: they give him all the desires of his heart — as mentioned above. And this is what the holy Zohar expounded: "da Atika Kadisha" — that is, one merits very supernal mental faculties — the aspect of Atik.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחינת הצדיק כמבואר בזוהר הקדוש וכל ישראל על ידי ששומרין את השבת הם נקראים צדיקים. ועל כן שבת הוא בחינת עינים בחינת תלת גוונין דעינא ובת עין כי זה בחינת עיני ה' אל צדיקים.
segments.en: And see within — it is understood that complete trust — the aspect of the strong power of sacred sight — is the aspect of mochin d'gadlus — the aspect of lovingkindness and mercy. And there it is explained regarding one whose mind is clear and pure — in the aspect of mochin d'gadlus — that he can pray without toil [b'li iyyun] — for his thought connects at once to the words of prayer without any labor and effort at all. And one who is not in this aspect — must raise up his thought before he speaks — for if not — the speech will be without thought — and so on. And behold — for the most part — a person is aroused to this through the fact that he remembers after the prayer that he prayed without concentration — and he is very grieved in his heart from this — and therefore he is afterward careful to toil himself to concentrate in his prayer. And because his mind is not so clear and swift — therefore he almost must concentrate in his thought before he speaks — as mentioned above.

segments.he: וזה בחינת ראו כי ה' נתן לכם את השבת ראו דייקא (וכמבואר במקום אחר) ועל כן אז מסוגל ביותר להאדם לפשפש במעשיו ולהתבונן על דרכיו כי אז נפתחין עיניו ורואה מה שהיה נסתר ממנו מקודם ורואה עד היכן כל פגם ופגם מגיע ועושה תשובה. ועל כן שבת הוא בחינת תשובה כמבואר במקום אחר. ואפשר שזה גם כן בכלל אמרם ז"ל כיון ששבת וי אבדה נפש כי אז רואה ומתבונן על עוצם אבדן נפשו בחול ושב בתשובה ועל ידי זה זוכה לנפש יתרה. וזה תועלת גדול אליו כי מאחר שנפתחין עיניו ורואה עוצם קלקוליו ח"ו על ידי זה בעצמו היה מתבלבל אצלו קדושת שבת ח"ו כי צריכין לקבל שבת בשמחה ובלב טוב וכמבואר במקום אחר. אך על ידי שזוכה תיכף לנפש יתרה ונשמה חדשה בבחינת וכולהון מתעטרין בנשמתין חדתין כדין הוא שירותא דצלותא לברכא לה בחדוה בנהירו דאנפין. כי על ידי קדושת שבת נעשה האדם כבריה חדשה ממש וכמו שאמרו רז"ל אפילו עבד עבודה זרה וכו' מוחלין לו. ועל ידי זה יוכל להתפלל ולקבל קדושת שבת בשמחה.
segments.en: And in this one can understand what our Sages of blessed memory taught: had Israel guarded two Shabbosim — and so on — for on the first Shabbos not every person merits to receive the inner dimension of its holiness in fullness. Only through the fact that after the Shabbos — his heart aches greatly that the Shabbos passed in such smallness [katnus]. And this is the aspect of: "keivan she'shavas — vav — avdah nefesh" — for this aspect encompasses everything — even one who is at a very small level — and does not merit on Shabbos itself to delight and take pleasure in the fullness of the holiness of the extra soul of Shabbos — nonetheless after the Shabbos he feels the pain of the departure of his extra soul that he merited to receive on Shabbos — which is the aspect of: "vav — avdah nefesh."

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל כל המתפלל בערב שבת ואומר ויכולו כאלו נעשה שותף להקב"ה במעשה בראשית כי נמשך עליו על ידי זה בחינת קדושת הצדיקים שנאמר עליהם המה היוצרים. יושבי נטעים עם המלך במלאכתו וכמו שדרשו רז"ל ואז עיניו בבחינת עיני ה' אל צדיקים ורואה היטב עד היכן כל דבר מגיע ויוכל לבלבל אותו משמחת שבת ח"ו. ועל כן אמר אחר כך שהמלאכים המלוין לו מניחים ידיהם על ראשו ואומרים לו וסר עווניך וחטאתך תכופר היינו כנ"ל וזה וזרחה לכם יראי שמי (אלו שומרי שבת) שמש צדקה. היינו שנפתח להם אור גדול ורואין הכל כמו לאור השמש.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of "achar hadevarim [after the words]" — that his good thought comes to him after the speech. Likewise — the feeling of the holiness of Shabbos comes to him at least at the lowest level — close to the going out of Shabbos — and as also seen in actual experience. And then — through this — he afterward prepares himself throughout all the days of the week to receive the holiness of the second Shabbos in its fullness. And this is the aspect of: one who thinks before he speaks — and then the speech comes with thought.

segments.he: אך לפעמים זה עצמו לעונש גדול כשרואה האדם פתאום עוצם פגמיו ועוונותיו וכמבואר בפנים ועל כן באמת אמרו רז"ל שרשעים נידונין בה. וזה שסיים ומרפא בכנפיה בחינת צדיקים מתרפאין בה. כי על ידי קדושת שבת עצמו נתכפר הכל שזה בחינת רפואה כמו שכתוב הסולח לכל עווניכי הרופא לכל תחלואיכי וכמו שאמרו רז"ל וכמו שכתוב ה' אלקים שוועתי אליך ותרפאני ופירש רש"י סליחת עוונות כמו שכתוב ושב ורפא לו. כי הצדיקים והכשרים שומרי שבת כראוי אינם מתבלבלים ח"ו על ידי גודל האור שנפתח להם על ידי קדושת שבת עד שרואין את הכל כנ"ל רק נתעוררין על ידי זה בתשובה שלימה ובכח התשובה ובזכות קדושת שבת נתכפר להם הכל ונתרפאין רפואה שלימה שזה בחינת ומרפא בכנפיה כנ"ל:
segments.en: Likewise — regarding Shabbos — one merits through this to receive the holiness of Shabbos in fullness — and then the redemption will come. And in this one can also explain the matter of: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" — that is, to prepare one's thought for the holiness of Shabbos throughout all the days of the week — and likewise also in deed — in the aspect of: "mei'chad b'Shabbis l'Shabbasa." For perhaps one does not hold in the fullness of trust — through which one makes a vessel for the bounty — that it should come in its time — and then perhaps the bounty of Shabbos can come to him after Shabbos — or it may not come to him until after a long time. Therefore one must hasten to prepare for Shabbos immediately on the first day of the week. And this was the trait of Shammai — who was from the aspect of judgment — from where comes the grip of mochin d'katnus — the aspect of "achar hadevarim." But Hillel — who was from the attribute of lovingkindness — the aspect of mochin d'gadlus — from which comes the aspect of complete trust — and therefore he would say: "baruch Hashem yom yom [blessed be Hashem day by day]" [Psalms 68:20] — and his trust was firm that the bounty of Shabbos would come in its time. But nonetheless — Hillel also agrees that it is better to do as Shammai taught — as explained in the words of the commentators and the later authorities, of blessed memory, in Siman 242 — for not every person and not in every time does one merit to such clear mental faculties and such strong trust. And this is what they stated there regarding Hillel: there was another trait in him — that all his actions were for the sake of Heaven — that is, the inner dimension of the holiness of his thought was always connected in all his actions — for the sake of Heaven — without any labor and effort whatsoever — for he merited to clear mental faculties. And therefore his trust was also very firm — and he would say: "baruch Hashem yom yom" — and so on — as mentioned above.

segments.he: סימן צט-ואתחנן
segments.en: Shabbos is the aspect of humility and lowliness — and it is likewise the aspect of awe and the aspect of Malchus — and the rectification of alien thoughts — as mentioned above many times. And therefore then prayer has its fullness — and one merits the aspect of: a Tzadik who rules through his prayer — as explained in Midrash Rabbah, Parashas Beshalach: one who guards and delights the Shabbos merits the aspect of [Job 22:28]: "v'tigzor omer v'yakum lach [and you shall decree a word and it shall be established for you]" — and they give him all the desires of his heart. And this is the aspect of [Job 22:26]: "ki az al Shadai tis'anag" — and so on — "ta'atir eilav v'yishma'echa" — and so on — "v'tigzor omer v'yakum lach" — and so on [Job 22:26–28] — for this itself is His delight, blessed be He — when there are Tzadikim who pray in this manner. And for their sake was the entire creation — and because of them G-d, blessed be He, also now renews the act of creation and changes nature and performs wonders through their prayer — as understood within. And all of this flows on Shabbos in its fullness — for Shabbos is the ultimate purpose of the work of heaven and earth — and the end of deed is in the beginning of thought. And then the ten utterances [asarah ma'amaros] through which the entire creation came about — shine even more — as it is written [Genesis 2:2]: "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i" — and so on — and the ten utterances mentioned above are the aspect of lovingkindness. And this is the aspect of the great lovingkindnesses drawn on Shabbos. And through this — the Dalet [ד] becomes Heh [ה] — and this rectification is completed in its fullness through the holiness of Shabbos — as explained in the Tikunim. And through this the bounty flows — for Shabbos is the root of all the influences — as is well-known. And this is the aspect of [Isaiah 58:14]: "az tis'anag al Hashem" — that is, one merits to enter, as it were, into the aspect of His delight, blessed be He — Who takes delight from the fact that there are Tzadikim who rule through their prayer — as explained within. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded from this: he too merits this — and they give him all the desires of his heart — as mentioned above. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz" — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — which is prayer. And therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded: one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms — that is, one is saved through the holiness of Shabbos from arrogance and alien thoughts — which are the aspect of the subjugation of kingdoms. And [Isaiah 58:14]: "v'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha" — this is the aspect of humility and awe — the aspect of [Proverbs 22:4]: "ekev anavah yiras Hashem [the reward of humility is the fear of Hashem]" — (and as explained elsewhere) — through which prayer is completed — until one rules through one's prayer — and can change nature. For this is the aspect of: one merits an inheritance without limits. And for this sake the world was created — as mentioned above. And this [Psalms 8:1]: "olami olami — v'chol haggid — mi vera'acha — v'chol haggid — Yaakov vera'acha." And this [Isaiah 58:14]: "ki pi Hashem diber" — for one merits that his speech is the aspect of the word of Hashem — and one can through this draw the renewal of the act of Bereishis — for it is stated about this: "b'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu" — and great lovingkindnesses are drawn — and abundant bounty flows — in the aspect of [Deuteronomy 15:6]: "vayevarech eschem ka'asher diber lachem."

segments.he: בשבת בנקל יותר להתפלל בדביקות גדול כנ"ל כמה פעמים. וזה בחינת מזמור שיר ליום השבת טוב להודות לה' ולזמר לשמך עליון היינו בדביקות נפלא ועליון מאד ועל כן אפילו בחול שאז לפעמים קשה לו להתפלל בדביקות. אף על פי כן צריכין להכריח את עצמו בכל הכחות להתפלל על כל פנים בכוונה פשוטה כראוי ולהאמין כי על ידי קדושת שבת יתעלו גם התפלות הללו וכמבואר בזוהר הקדוש ואדרבא אם לא יכריח עצמו בחול להתפלל בכוונה אזי אפשר שגם בשבת לא יזכה להתפלל בדביקות ועל ידי שמכריח עצמו בחול להתפלל בכוונה אז זוכה על ידי זה בשבת להתפלל בדביקות ואז עולין גם כל התפלות של חול.
segments.en: And it is the aspect of the sweetening of the judgments — as explained in the holy Zohar. And it is the aspect of speech with knowledge [dibur b'da'as] — in the aspect of: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos. And it is written [Exodus 31:13]: "lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem." And it is the aspect of Yaakov — for he is the first of whom it is stated that he guarded the Shabbos. And it is the aspect of the Torah — for all agree that on Shabbos the Torah was given. And this is the aspect of: Shabbos is the time of cessation from crying out — and healing is close to come — the aspect of the healing of the soul — in the aspect of [Malachi 3:20]: "shemesh tzedakah u'marpe b'chenafehah [a sun of righteousness with healing in its wings]" — as explained within. And therefore this verse is stated regarding the guardians of Shabbos — as it is written [Malachi 3:20]: "v'zarachah lachem yirey shmi — (elu shomrey Shabbas) — shemesh tzedakah u'marpe" — and so on — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded: "shemesh b'Shabbas — Tzedakah" — and so on.

segments.he: וזה בחינת זכרהו מאחד בשבת. וגם בשבת עצמו אם אינו זוכה להתפלל בדביקות בשלימות וזה מסתמא מחמת שלא הכין את עצמו בחול לקבל קדושת שבת כראוי כי שבת בעי הכנה כמו שאמרו רז"ל אף על פי כן יכריח עצמו להתפלל בכל הכחות ולהמשיך קדושת השבת גם על ששת ימי החול שיתפלל גם אז בכוונה ועל ידי זה יזכה על כל פנים לקבל קדושת שבת השני בשלימות ויזכה להתפלל אז על כל פנים בדביקות אמתי. וזה בחינת אלמלי שמרו ישראל שתי שבתות מיד נגאלין שנאמר אשר ישמרו את שבתותי וסמיך ליה והביאותים אל הר קדשי ושימחתים בבית תפלתי כי על ידי זה נשלמת התפלה וזה שסיים נאום ה' מקבץ נדחי ישראל היינו שאפילו התפלות הנדחות ח"ו יתעלו גם כן על ידי קדושת שבת עוד אקבץ עליו לנקבציו אלו הגרים שאפילו תפלות הגרים יתעלו גם כן בבחינת כי ביתי בית תפלה יקרא לכל העמים.
segments.en: The essential perfection of the voice and speech — which are the aspect of Vav-Heh [ו"ה] — is on Shabbos — for this is the aspect of: "v'daber davar" — stated regarding Shabbos — and as mentioned above many times. And likewise — the essential perfection of love and awe — which are the aspect of Yud-Heh [י"ה] — is also on Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.

segments.he: ועל כן הכל צריכין להכריח עצמן להתפלל בכוונה ובדביקות תמיד בפרט בשבת קודש עצמו כי בעת שתושלם התפלה בדביקות אמתי כראוי שזה בחינת קדושת שבת אז יתעלו כל התפלות על ידי זה כנ"ל.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the Name Yud-Heh of Shabbos — as explained in the writings. And therefore then is the essential perfection of Torah and prayer — as mentioned above many times. And through this the kingship of G-d, blessed be He, is revealed — which is the aspect of Shabbas Malketa. And this is the aspect of [Zechariah 14:9]: "v'hayah Hashem l'Melech al kol ha'aretz — b'yom hahu yihyeh Hashem echad — u'shemo echad [and Hashem will be King over all the earth — on that day Hashem will be One — and His Name will be One]" — and this is understood in the holy Zohar in the passage "k'gavna" stated at the entry of Shabbos — that this aspect is drawn through the holiness of Shabbos.

segments.he: וזה אפשר לכוון גם בדברי רז"ל (שבת סט:) תרי קראי כתיבי ושמרו בני ישראל את השבת וכתיב את שבתותי תשמרו. ושמרו בני ישראל את השבת שמירה אחת לכל שבת ושבת. את שבתותי תשמרו שמירה אחת לשבתות הרבה. כי יש מי שזוכה לקיים בשלימות ובדביקות גדול שמירה מעולה לכל שבת ושבת. ויש מי שצריך לשמור שבתות הרבה עד שיזכה בכללן לשמירת שבת אחת בקדושה ובדביקות אמתי כראוי ועל ידי זה נתעלה ונשלם גם השמירות של כל השבתות שלא היו בדביקות שלם כראוי ובלבד ששמר אותם כראוי בפשיטות על כל פנים על פי מצוות התורה וזה בחינת כה אמר ה' שמרו משפט ועשו צדקה כי קרובה ישועתי לבא וצדקתי להגלות. היינו אף על פי שלעת עתה אין אתם רואים עדיין על ידי זה שום צמיחת קרן ישועה אל תאמרו שאין המשפט וצדקה שלכם עושה רושם מחמת שאינו בשלימות הגמור כראוי. רק תדעו כי קרובה ישועתי לבא וצדקתי להגלות. כי זה קרוב יתראה ויתגלה ישועה אמתית שנמשכת על ידי המשפט וצדקה שלכם. וזה אשרי אנוש יעשה זאת וכו' ופירש רש"י שומר שבת וכו' ובן אדם יחזיק בה יחזיק דייקא כאדם המחזיק בדבר ואינו עוזב אותו בשום אופן כמו כן צריכין להחזיק בקדושת שבת וכן בכל הדברים שבקדושה ולא יעזוב אתם בשום אופן אף על פי שנראה לו שאין בהם שלימות עדיין סוף כל סוף יתעלו כולם לשלימותם עד שתצמח הישועה שלימה על ידם. וזה שומר שבת מחללו. כי העיקר שישמור לעת עתה את השבת כפשוטו שלא יחללו ח"ו. וזה ושומר ידו מעשות כל רע היינו וכן לענין כלל קדושת עבודת ישראל צריכין גם כן העיקר ליזהר שלא לעשות רע ושלא לעבור על שום מצוה ח"ו. וכמבואר שיחה זאת במקום אחר בשם רבינו ז"ל שאמר וויא מע טיט טיט מין אביא מע טיט קיין שלעכטס ניט היינו כנ"ל. ואז כשיהיה חזק בזה אז סוף כל סוף יזכה לקבל קדושת שבת בדביקות אמתי כראוי וכן כל המצוות והעבודות יעשה בשלימות אמתי כראוי ואז יתעלה הכל ויבא לשלימותו.
segments.en: But on Shabbos — the soul ascends to its supernal root — in the aspect of: "meshivas nefesh [restoring the soul]." And this [Isaiah 58:13]: "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi" — not to engage in labor and weekday pursuits — which the person's soul desires — and sometimes the Sitra Achra has a grip upon them — in the aspect of [Ezekiel 20:8]: "u'v'shikutzeihem nafsham chafetzah [and in their abominations their soul delighted]." But on Shabbos — one must engage only in the affairs of Heaven — in the aspect of [Isaiah 56:4]: "asher yishmeru es Shabsosai — u'vachartu ba'asher chafatzti" — in the aspect of [I Chronicles 28:9]: "da es Elokei avicha v'avdehu b'lev shalem u'v'nefesh chefetzah [know the G-d of your father and serve Him with a whole heart and a desiring soul]."

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רז"ל עתיד הקב"ה לעשות צל וחופה לבעלי מצוות אצל עמלי תורה מה טעם כי בצל החכמה צל הכסף וכתיב אשרי אנוש יעשה זאת ובן אדם יחזיק בה וכו' היינו שהודיעו לנו רז"ל איך השם יתברך עוסק בתיקונו ועלייתו של העבודה של כל אחד הן על ידי העבודה של עצמו כשזוכה לאיזה שלימות כנ"ל ולא עוד אלא שגם האחד מתעלה לשלימותו על ידי העבודה של חבירו שזה בחינת מה שהבעלי מצוות וצדקה יהיו להם צל וחופה אצל עמלי תורה ויתעלו על ידם לשלימותם בעבור שהחזיקו אותם ותמכו את ידם לעסוק בתורה. וזה ואל יאמר בן הנכר וכו' הבדל יבדילני ה' מעל עמו והוא רחוק מקדושת עבודת ישראל ועל ידי מי יתעלה עבודתו גם כן. וכן ואל יאמר הסריס הן אני עץ יבש. כי לפעמים מתעלה האדם על ידי בניו בבחינת ברא מזכה אבא. ומי לנו גדול מאברהם נאמר בו כה אמר ה' אל בית יעקב אשר פדה את אברהם וכמו שדרשו רז"ל על זה ועל כן יוכל הסריס ליפול בדעתו ולומר מאחר שהוא עץ יבש ואין לו בנים אם כן על ידי מי יהיה גמר תיקונו ושלימות עלייתו. כי כה אמר ה' לסריסים אשר ישמרו את שבתותי היינו בחינת שתי שבתות הנ"ל בחינת שמירה אחת לשבתות הרבה היינו שיהיו חזקים תמיד בענין שמירת שבת איך שהוא ואיך שהוא כנ"ל. וזה ובחרו באשר חפצתי היינו שעל כל פנים לא יניחו ולא יעזבו את רצונם ובחירתם הטובה ויבחרו תמיד באשר חפצתי. וזה ומחזיקים בבריתי.
segments.en: It is explained within that Shabbos is the aspect of complete repentance [teshuvah sheleimah] — until it pushes away and the evil is completely nullified — and one has complete rest from everything — and it is transformed from evil to complete good — and one becomes entirely good. This is the aspect of "Moshe Mashiach" [the Moses of the Messiah]. And through this — one can see one's own lowliness — which is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "re'u ki Hashem nasan lachem haShabbas — re'u davka [see that Hashem has given you the Shabbos — see — specifically]" — for Shabbos is the aspect of: "tlas guvnin d'eina u'vat ein." And this is the aspect of [Exodus 16:29]: "shvu ish tachtav [let each person remain in his place]" — stated regarding Shabbos — that is, he should regard himself as lower than his level. And also — he knows and recognizes the importance and greatness of Israel — and can sacrifice himself for them. This is the aspect of Moshe our teacher — the Faithful Shepherd — who sacrificed his soul for Israel. And this is the aspect of what is brought in the kavannos: "M'zmor Sh'ir l'Yom haSh'abas" — initial letters — "l'Moshe" — that Moshe our teacher — peace be upon him — together with other Tzadikim who are of his aspect — descend at every entry of Shabbos to elevate the souls of the living and the dead who fell to the depths of the husks — heaven have mercy. And this for them is literally self-sacrifice [mesiyas nefesh mamash] for the souls of Israel — since they must lower themselves from their very high and wondrous level into such low and base levels as the depths of the husks — to raise from there the souls of Israel who fell there. And we find that our Sages of blessed memory taught — even regarding the Holy One, blessed be He, Himself — as it were — as it is stated regarding Him: "v'avarti b'eretz Mitzrayim" — and so on — a parable of a priest who went down into a cemetery — and so on. And this [Psalms 92:2]: "tov lehodos laHashem" — the aspect of repentance through the verbal confession [viduy devarim] — as mentioned above in the name of the Midrash. And this [Psalms 92:2]: "v'lezamre lishimcha elyon" — the aspect of the supernal repentance — complete repentance — that one becomes entirely good — which is above, as it were, the aspect of Metatron — who is from the side of life and from the side of death — which is the aspect of the repentance of the six weekdays — and as explained within. And see in Megillas Amukos, Ofan 110 — there it is explained that the shi'ur komah [supernal measure] — as it were — is 236,000 parasangs — and He gave a vision [ayin] of 1000 parasangs to Metatron — and so on — and 166,000 parasangs — He, blessed be He, is above him — "elyon [Most High]" — the gematria of "elyon" is 166 — and so on — see there — it is explained for our matters. And then when the holiness of Shabbos comes — which is the aspect of complete repentance — then there is also an ascent, as it were, even for the aspect of Metatron — as understood within. And then those incomplete thoughts of repentance that have not yet reached full completion — for they are only in the aspect of the repentance of the six weekdays — are also encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos — and they also ascend to their rest. And through this — the aforementioned souls also ascend — through the power of the thoughts of repentance that they had — and as understood in the holy Zohar. And this is the aspect of what is explained in Zohar Chadash, Parashas Bereishis — that the ascent that even the wicked among Israel have — to have a portion in the World to Come — through some of their good deeds — is only through the holiness of Shabbos — as mentioned above. And all of this through the power of Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him, and other Tzadikim who are of his aspect — through whom — through the holiness of Shabbos — the attribute of humility and lowliness within them is aroused even more — and they also see even more the importance and greatness of Israel. And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:17]: "ki os hi beyni u'veineichem l'dorosechem — lada'as ki Ani Hashem mekadshechem" — and likewise [Exodus 31:17]: "beyni u'vein Bnay Yisrael os hi l'olam" — and so on.

segments.he: היינו בחינת ובן אדם יחזיק בה הנ"ל שיחזיק בה תמיד ולא יעזביהו כנ"ל ונתתי להם בביתי ובחומותי יד ושם טוב מבנים ובנות וכו' היינו שיזכו גם כן לתכלית השלימות על ידי עבודתם של עצמן וכן ובני הנכר וכו' כל שומר שבת מחללו ומחזיקים בבריתי היינו גם כן כנ"ל והביאותים אל הר קדשי וכו' עוד אקבץ עליו לנקבציו היינו שיזכו גם כן להתקבץ אל הקדושה ושתעלה עבודתם לתכלית השלימות על ידי שיוכללו בתוך כלל ישראל וכשיתקבצו כל נדחי ישראל היינו גם העבודות והתפלות הנדחות ויעלו אז לשלימותן אז יתעלו גם כל בחינת התפלות והעבודות שלהם לתכלית השלימות כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Building the Holy Palace through drawing souls close / weekday clarifications = Mishkan / Shabbos = World of Thought = their rest: One who draws people close to G-d's service = "v'es hanefesh asher asu b'Charan" = builds the Heichal haKodesh. All weekday labors and occupations = clarifications (birurim) = elevating good from within the grip of evil. Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come = complete nullification of evil = Shechinah rests = no birurim then. But: essential power to clarify birurim = only from Shabbos holiness = "kulhu b'machshavah itberiru"; Shabbos = World of Thought = birurim ascend to their rest and perfection. From the birurim = the Heichal haKodesh is built = aspect of the Mishkan. Yet: Mishkan does not override Shabbos = on the contrary: essential birurim and building of the Heichal haKodesh come only from Shabbos. Therefore: "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas." Heichal haKodesh draws to its root = heart of the one who builds it = clothes the vital spirit (ruach chayyuni) in the heart (Shabbos = heart, Tikunim; "v'nasati lachem lev chadash v'ruach chadashah" Ezekiel 36:26; Zohar: new spirit / holy spirit on Shabbos). Clothing primarily upon the legs of the spirit = "Malchus clothes Neh"y." The birurim were sunken within the husks.
 Erev Shabbos: flame of fire descends on the husks / three impure husks / Nogah ascending / self-judgment = blazing of the heart: On Erev Shabbos: birurim and souls wish to ascend → good in Nogah ascends → three completely impure husks also wish to ascend and attach, heaven forfend → shalhava d'asha descends on heads of the husks → scorches them so they cannot ascend → evil falls below → good ascends to perfection (Ari z"l). "Summon the angels of one's heart" = blazing of the heart = this fire scorches them. Fire is made from mishpat = person judges himself → heart blazes → sits upon the throne = honor = Heichal haKodesh. [Shabbos 119: "R. Avahu would sit on the ivory bench and fan the fire" = throne + fire.] Psalms 97:2–5: "anan v'arafel savivav — tzedek u'mishpat mchon kis'o — eish lefanav telech — v'salhet saviv tzarav — harim k'donag namshu" = entire psalm understood accordingly. "Tzalutha d'ma'alay Shabbata d'ha'i as'yachad curs'aya yekira" = precious throne united = Malchus = Heichal haKodesh; "v'issekna l'masrey ala malka kadisha ila'ah — kad ayil Shabbata ihi is'achad v'is'perashas misistra achra." Holy books: on Erev Shabbos must examine one's deeds, reflect on the week, regret with great shame, repent = this = mishpat = person judges and sentences himself → blazing of the heart → scorches the husks. Song of Songs 8:6: "simeni k'chotam al libecha — reshafehah rishpey eish shalheves Yah" = shalhava d'asha casts evil below.
 Sons of the stranger / converts / Isaiah 56 / Ezekiel 20 / Jeremiah 17 / "almilai shamru" / two Shabbosim = Shabbas d'leila + Shabbas d'yoma / redemption: Isaiah 56:6: "u'vnay haneychar… kol shomer Shabbas mechalelo… v'hevi'osim el har kodshi" = through power of Shabbos holiness: souls draw close and become converts. Ezekiel 20:11, 13: "v'es mishpatai… v'gam es Shabsosai" = judgments and Shabbosim together. Jeremiah 17:24: "shemi'ah b'liba talya" = rectification of the heart = source of judgment (I Kings 3:9; Deuteronomy 7:12); "melachim v'sarim yoshvim al kisei David" = Throne of Glory; "v'hitzasi eish bishearehah" = fire takes revenge if Shabbos is desecrated; "ein hadlikas eish metzuyah ela b'makom sheyesh chilul Shabbas." "Almilai shamru shtay Shabbasos miyad nigalin": Shabbas d'leila = Heichal haKodesh = Malchus = attribute of night; Shabbas d'yoma = Tiferes = mishpat = amuda d'emtza'isa = attribute of day = "dinu laboker mishpat / u'mishpatecha or yetzei." Through both: perfect clarification of holy sparks = drawing close of converts → immediate redemption. Derived from: "asher yishmeru es Shabsosai" immediately followed by "v'hevi'osim el har kodshi" (written about converts = birurim). "Es Shabsosai tishmoru = da igula v'ribua d'lagu = two Shabbosim." Erev Shabbos angels = the angels of one's heart (Sages). "Yad v'shem tov": "veisi" = spring of wisdom goes forth; "chomah" = suppression of anger and wealth; "yad" = mishpat → worthy students → spirit of wisdom; "shem" = Throne of Glory / Heichal haKodesh = through drawing souls close → one's own soul and name magnified → all souls desire to be rooted in him (= "beis v'hon nachalas avos"). Warning: there are Erev Rav whom it is forbidden to draw close = mishpat has no power over them. Tikkun 48: must not be angry on Shabbos. "Birchas Hashem hi sa'ashir — zeh Shabbas." Mitzvah to assemble congregations on Shabbos and expound in Torah = most propitious to establish worthy students and draw spirit of wisdom.
 Moshe's ordination of Yehoshua on Shabbos / sacred Shabbos union / "yad v'shem tov" / Heichal haKodesh = worthy children / Sanhedrin adjacent to the Temple / Jeremiah 7 / circumcision / table north-south / angels finding candle/table/bed: Moshe's ordination of Yehoshua ("viYehoshua maleh ru'ach chochmah ki samach Moshe es yadav alav") = on Shabbos (Rashi on Parashas Pinchas: "ten lo turgeiman she'yidrosh b'chayyecha"; Rashi on Parashas Ha'azinu: "Shabbas shel diyuzgey hayah"). Sacred Shabbos union: Zohar — great holy clarifications through Tzadikim's union; even Avraham and Sarah (barren) made souls of converts through their union (LM Tinyana 72). Through sacred union: Heichal haKodesh is built; essential = worthy children = "Heichal Hashem heimah" (Jeremiah 7:4). Evil wishes to attach to the Heichal → rectification = mishpat. Sanhedrin sat adjacent to the Temple = same reason. Jeremiah 7:4: "al tivtechu… Heichal Hashem… ki im… ta'asu mishpat" = essential rectification of Heichal = through mishpat. At circumcision: congregation says "ashrey tivchar… kadosh Heichalecha" (Psalms 65:5). Essential time for sacred union = Shabbos = igul v'ribua = complete nullification of evil = union in holiness = draw holy souls to one's children (Zohar). Isaiah 56:4 + Zohar: on Shabbos union. "V'nasati lahem yad v'shem tov mibbanim u'mibbanos" = as explained. Angels finding candle (= Menorah to the south = spirit of wisdom drawn through mishpat = yad) + set table (= table to the north = wealth + magnification of Name = shem = Heichal haKodesh) + made bed (= north to south = merit worthy children = yad v'shem tov). "Yehi ratzon she'yihyeh l'Shabbas ha'acheres kach" = holiness of two Shabbosim = "es Shabsosai" = redemption. "Ben haneychar" warning and "saris" consolation (Isaiah 56:3); Isaiah 56 fully cited; "ki veisi beis tefillah yikara l'chol ha'amim"; Rashi: "converts" are included in the Heichal haKodesh = they are not Erev Rav. Zohar on "Vayakhel Moshe" = separated from Erev Rav → commanded on Mishkan → warned also about Shabbos. Zohar Yisro 88 cited in full: "b'seudasi ilin ishtamud'in Yisrael d'inun bnay Malka… u'man d'fagam chad seudah minaihu achzey pegimuta l'eila… dinun seudasi meheimanuta shelimta d'zara kadisha d'Yisrael… v'al da amar beini u'vein Bnay Yisrael." "U'mi k'amcha Yisrael goy echad" at Minchah of Shabbos. Zohar 237: "d'lo itkariyu kehilah v'chibur ad d'ita'avar minehon erev rav… k'ilu lo hayu goy echad."
 Isaiah 58 mapped through Heichal haKodesh / mishpat / igul v'ribua / Daniel 7 cited in full / "ki pi Hashem diber": "Raglecha" = souls that drew close = aspect of legs = "v'chol ha'am asher b'raglecha"; also: awakening to draw them close flows from the legs of the vital spirit in the heart → they clothe them. "Im tashiv miShabbos" acrostic = emes = essential rectification to elevate legs from grip of evil = through mishpat = amuda d'emtza'isa = emes = "emes u'mishpat v'shalom shiftu" / "mishpetay Hashem emes." Jeremiah 7:4 cited; Isaiah 6:1: "v'shulav mele'im es haHeichal" (Rashi); "kushta ka'ay" = opposite of "sheker ein lo raglayim." "Al tetzei chutz l'techum Shabbas" = two thousand cubits = igul v'ribua d'lagu = igul = Malchus = aleph = "aluf omer / alufim la'rosh"; mishpat = Torah = also aleph = "davar tzivvah l'elef dor" = "hacharash v'hamasger aleph" = elders of Israel and their judges → draw spirit of wisdom to students → "va'aalfecha chochmah." Through mishpat: Heichal haKodesh (= Malchus = Jerusalem) receives the power of fire → burns away husks = "u'chevod Hashem k'eish ocheles." Zechariah 12:6: "asim es alfey Yehudah k'kiyor eish ba'etzim (Rashi: k'meduras eish gedolah) v'challapid eish ba'amir v'achlu es kol ha'amim saviv v'yashvah Yerushalayim." "Me'asos chafatzecha" = guard from weekday affairs with grip of Sitra Achra = essential rectification through "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbas" (Siman 38). On Shabbos itself: even this is forbidden = "lo El chafetz rasha — lo yegurcha ra." Then: perfect drawing close of souls = building Heichal haKodesh = evil falls → good ascends → through mishpat = chefetz = "l'chol chefetz yesh es u'mishpat" / "ani Hashem ohev mishpat." Shabbos = teshuvah = chaftzei shamayim = "hachafetz achphotz ki im b'shuvo midrachav v'chayah." "Delight / honored" = corresponding to igul v'ribua = spirit of wisdom drawn through mishpat = essential delight and honor; "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad" = Heichal haKodesh = "u'v'heichalo kulo omer kavod / kadosh yei'amer lo." Shabbos meals = tikkun halev (source of mishpat) = "pita se'ada d'liba" = "ad she'ha'adam ochel yesh lo shtay levavos v'achar she'ochel ein lo ela lev echad." Shabbos honor = garments = Malchus = Heichal haKodesh = clothes the ruach in the heart. Ari z"l: table with four legs = ribua. "V'lis'adah b'mishpat" (Isaiah 9:6) = "oseh mishpat la'ashukkim nosein lechem lare'evim." Blemish of mishpat = Hosea 7:7 = kings fall. Midrash: "v'eileh hamishpatim — erkam k'shulchan aruch." "Shadai lo ye'aves mishpat" (Job 34:12) = "ki az al Shadai tis'anag" (Job 22:26) = delight in Shadai = delight in Shabbos = tikkun halev = "nositin lo kol mishalos libo." "Honor it / no large strides / no anger" = "asheshah mika'as eyni" (Psalms 6:8) = blemish of eyes of Shabbos; also: allusion not to draw close Erev Rav → blemishes all the above. "Gam b'lo da'as nefesh lo tov v'atz b'raglayim choteh" (Proverbs 19:2) = Israel's souls rooted in sacred Da'as; Erev Rav's souls = Da'as of the husks = "Erev Rav gimatria Da'as" (writings). "From your affairs / speaking words" = no weekday speech = blemish holy speech = "yechalkel devarav b'mishpat" = essential time to draw spirit of wisdom to students. "Then delight" = Atika Kadisha = draw spirit of wisdom from Atik = root of tikkun hamishpat → heart blazes → sits on throne = "konein l'mishpat kis'o"; Sages: give him all desires of his heart = tikkun halev; Midrash Rabbah, Beshalach 25: decrees a decree and G-d fulfills = "im totzei yakar mizolel k'fi tihyeh" (Jeremiah 15:19; Bava Metzi'a 85a). "Heights of earth" = Chakla Tupichin = perfect ascent of Malchus = Heichal haKodesh; saved from subjugation = Malchus d'Sitra Achra completely subdued. "Heritage of Yaakov" = Ze'ir Anpin = mishpat = amuda d'emtza'isa = "v'hayah beis Yaakov eish" = fire of mishpat; "vayishlach Yaakov malachim" = the aforementioned angels; nachalah b'li metzarim = through mishpat = fire burns all adversaries surrounding the holiness = "eish lefanav telech v'salhet saviv tzarav" → evil completely nullified → "ki az ehpoch el ha'amim safah verurah likro chulam b'shem Hashem" = nachalah b'li metzarim = "ki veisi beis tefillah yikara l'chol ha'amim." "Ki pi Hashem diber" = Heichal haKodesh = Malchus peh rectified through mishpat = "u'mishpetay pihu" / "bisfasai siparti kol mishpetay picha" / "petach picha shifat tzedek" / "yechalkel devarav b'mishpat" / "u'leshono tedaber mishpat" / "v'eish mipiv tochal" (Psalms 18:9; fire = mishpat) / "hineni nosein devarai b'ficha l'eish" (Jeremiah 5:14); draws spirit of wisdom to students = "piha paschah b'chochmah / pi ydaber chochmos / pi tzadik yehgeh chochmah u'leshono tedaber mishpat." "Toras Elokav b'libo" (tikkun halev) / "lo timad ashurav" (the legs). Soul = peh v'dibbur = "l'nefesh chayyah l'ruach memalela" (Targum). Therefore: "k'fi tihyeh." Daniel 7:9–14 cited in full with Rashi on every phrase: thrones set up (one for judgment = downfall of nations; one for righteousness = favoring Israel); Atik Yomin sits; white garment = whitens Israel's sins; hair like wool = clears merits of nations and repays them; throne = fire; river of fire; thousand thousands serve Him; books opened; beast slain → "ללבת אש הוא אשו של יעקב" (Rashi); son of man = Mashiach; reaches Atik Yomin. Root of mishpat from Atik on His throne of mishpat → throne receives power of fire → angels serve Him. Yaakov = mishpat = amuda d'emtza'isa ascends to Atik = "az tis'anag al Hashem" → draws illumination to Malchus = Heichal haKodesh = Throne of Glory → evil completely nullified → good encompassed in holiness. Two thrones: (1) for judgment = downfall of nations; (2) for righteousness = favor Israel and draw them close. Chagigah 14: "achas lo v'achas l'David" (Rashi). "V'ad Atik Yomin mata" = even Mashiach sits in judgment. Isaiah 3:14 = great ones of Israel sit with G-d and judge the nations. Isaiah 9:6: "al kisei David… l'hachin osah v'lis'adah b'mishpat u'vitzedakah." "Mishpat u'tzedakah b'Yaakov." "Levushei k'selag chuvar — l'laben avonos Yisrael" = "leku na v'invachah" = disputation = clarification = mishpat (Rashi) → evil falls → "ויתערבו בגוים" = root of all evil → when evil falls → Israel return in great teshuvah → "im yihyu chataseichem k'shanim kasheleig yalvinu." Angels on Erev Shabbos lay hands on head and say "v'sar avonecha v'chata'ascha techupar"; "hashomer Shabbas mochalin lo al kol avonosaym" = also nachalah b'li metzarim = all constraints nullified = "tzivvah Hashem l'Yaakov savivav tzarav" (Lamentations 1:17) = their attack comes through sins; through Shabbos: sins atoned → all constraints nullified. Letters of "metzar" → "tzemer" = "v'se'ar reishei k'amar neka" = "im yadu'imu k'sola'as k'tzemer yiyu."
 

 Siman 60 (Pasach Rabbi Shimon — embedded within Siman 59) continues in the next installment.

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

Yikara DiShabsa — Siman 60: Pasach Rabbi Shimon

 Yikara DiShabsa · יקרא דשבתא
 Siman 60 — Pasach Rabbi Shimon

 נ נח נחמ נחמן מאומן

 Siman 60 — סימן ס
 Pasach Rabbi Shimon — "Rabbi Shimon opened…"
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 60 — embedded within Siman 59 in the source]

 Translator's note: This siman appears in the source manuscript as section 17 within the Siman 59 block, labeled "17 Siman 60 — Pasach Rabbi Shimon." It is a fully developed independent teaching on the opening of the paths of Torah, the awakening from sleep, length of days, fear, wealth, the sacred union, and the story-telling of the Ancient Years — all through the lens of the holiness of Shabbos. The text continues directly from Siman 59 without a break in the manuscript.

 The essential opening of the pathways of Torah —
 which contain very great contemplation [hisvonenvus] —
 is on Shabbos —
 as explained in the holy Zohar,
 Yisro, folio 85:
 "oraissa mis'atara bei b'itrin kadishin
 [the Torah is crowned on it with holy crowns],"
 and so on —
 and in Zohar Chadash, Chukas:
 that on Shabbos
 all the fifty gates of Binah are opened.
 And also — the general receiving of the Torah
 was on Shabbos — as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 and Shabbos itself is the aspect of Binah —
 as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of the wealth of Shabbos —
 as our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 "birchas Hashem hi sa'ashir — zeh Shabbas
 [the blessing of Hashem — it enriches — this is Shabbos]"
 — of which it is stated:
 "vayevarech
 [and He blessed],"
 and so on —
 for this contemplation requires great wealth —
 abundant substance.
 And to arrive at this wealth —
 it comes through the aspect of the rectifications of Atik —
 the aspect of length of days [arichas yamim] —
 that is, to lengthen and expand one's days —
 and to add in each and every moment
 that comes afterward
 with an even greater increment of holiness —
 and especially in each and every day —
 and so on —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 for the holiness multiplies and grows within it each time even more.

 And the holiness of the day of Shabbos
 is greater than the holiness of the night —
 as explained in the writings —
 and as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "kavod yom adif
 [the honor of the day is greater]."
 And within the holiness of the day itself —
 the holiness and the great ascents of Shabbos
 add even more each time —
 from Shacharis to Musaf
 and from Musaf to Minchah, and so on —
 and as explained in the writings of the holy Ari z"l.
 And likewise in the holiness of the preparation for Shabbos —
 the holiness grows from day to day:
 for on the fourth day [Wednesday]
 one receives the illumination of the nefesh
 of the coming Shabbos —
 and on the fifth day [Thursday]
 the illumination of the ruach —
 and on the sixth day [Friday]
 the illumination of the neshamah —
 and on Shabbos itself
 one receives the holiness of all of them
 in even greater perfection —
 as all of this is well-known.
 And even what happens after Shabbos —
 that the illumination of nefesh, ruach, and neshamah
 withdraws from him —
 that too is for the sake of receiving
 the holiness of nefesh, ruach, and neshamah
 of the coming Shabbos —
 in an even greater illumination —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "es Shabsosai tishmoru
 [My Shabbosim shall you observe]."
 [Leviticus 19:3]
 And likewise our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "almilai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos
 [were Israel to observe two Shabbosim]."
 For the holiness of Shabbos itself
 one must add to from Shabbos to Shabbos —
 so that in each Shabbos that comes afterward
 there should be added a greater illumination
 in the reception of the holiness of Shabbos.
 And Shabbos itself is a foretaste of the World to Come —
 which is the day that is entirely long —
 the aspect of the aforementioned length of days.
 And the aspect of the aforementioned length of days
 comes through fear [yirah], and so on.

 And this is the aspect of the fear of Shabbos —
 the aspect of:
 "yira Shabbas
 [one who fears Shabbos]"
 — as mentioned above many times.
 And also — through the fear of Shabbos
 one is protected from poverty —
 which comes through the aspect of:
 "sheker hachen v'hevel hayofi
 [charm is falsehood and beauty is vain]."
 [Proverbs 31:30]
 For the essential true grace of holiness
 is with Shabbos —
 in the aspect of:
 "v'Noach matza chen
 [and Noach found grace]"
 [Genesis 6:8] —
 and Noach is the aspect of Shabbos —
 "niyacha d'ila'in v'tata'in
 [the resting of the upper and lower ones]"
 — as brought in the Tikunim.
 And likewise Shabbos is the aspect of Moshe —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and it was stated of him:
 "ki matzas chen b'einai
 [for you have found grace in My eyes],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 [Exodus 33:12]
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of [Proverbs 11:16]:
 "eshes chen titmoch kavod
 [a gracious woman attains honor]"
 — in the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "Keneses Yisrael yihyeh ben zugcha
 [the Congregation of Israel shall be your mate]"
 — and as explained elsewhere.
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of [Proverbs 13:15]:
 "seichel tov yiten chen
 [good intellect grants grace]"
 — for the essential perfection of the intellect is on Shabbos —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the perfection
 of the holy speech —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and this is the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 10:12]:
 "divray fi chacham chen
 [the words of the mouth of a wise man are gracious]."
 And also — the essential sacred beauty
 is with Shabbos —
 for it is the aspect of the union of Yaakov and Rachel —
 as is well-known.
 And of Yaakov our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "shufra d'Yaakov
 [the beauty of Yaakov],"
 and so on —
 and of Rachel it is stated:
 "yefas to'ar v'yefas mar'eh
 [beautiful of form and beautiful of appearance]."
 [Genesis 29:17]
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of Yosef —
 as explained in Zohar Chadash —
 and it is stated of him:
 "vayehi Yosef yefeh to'ar
 [and Yosef was beautiful of form],"
 and so on [Genesis 39:6] —
 and it is also stated of him:
 "vayimtza Yosef chen
 [and Yosef found grace]"
 [Genesis 39:4] —
 and likewise of Yaakov:
 "ki channani Elokim
 [for G-d has graced me]."
 [Genesis 33:11]
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of Malchus —
 as is well-known —
 and it is stated of it [Isaiah 33:17]:
 "Melech b'yofyo tichzenah einecha
 [your eyes shall behold the King in His beauty]."
 And this is the aspect of [Psalms 45:3]:
 "yafyafita mibnay adam —
 hutzak chen bisfasosecha —
 al ken berachecha Elokim l'olam
 [You are the most beautiful among the sons of man —
 grace is poured upon Your lips —
 therefore G-d has blessed You forever]"
 — the aspect of:
 "vayevarech Elokim es yom hashevi'i
 [and G-d blessed the seventh day]"
 — stated regarding Shabbos —
 and likewise:
 "al ken beirach
 [therefore He blessed],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And then all the aspects of falsehood are subdued —
 for even an unlearned person fears to lie on Shabbos —
 and then the vanity of beauty is subdued
 through the holy havalim [vapors/exhalations]
 drawn on Shabbos —
 as explained in the kavannos
 of the psalm Havu laHashem, and so on.
 And therefore then is the essential time
 for the holiness of the sacred union —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 and as understood within.
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the elongation
 of the breath [arichas haneshimah] —
 as brought within —
 as understood from Rashi's commentary
 on the verse:
 "u'veyom hashevi'i shavas vayinafash
 [and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed]."
 And this is likewise the aspect of the extra soul
 one merits on Shabbos.
 And therefore then is the essential time
 for the falling of rain
 (which comes from the aspect of the breath —
 as explained within)
 — as Rashi explained:
 "v'nasati gishmeichem b'itam
 b'leiley Shabbasos
 [and I shall give your rains in their time —
 on the nights of Shabbos]."
 [Leviticus 26:4]
 And this is the aspect of [Job 32:8]:
 "v'nishmas Shadai tvinam
 [and the breath of Shadai gives them understanding]."
 For Shadai is the aspect of Shabbos —
 as explained elsewhere.
 And the aspect of the elongation of the breath is drawn on it —
 through which comes contemplation —
 as explained within —
 for this is likewise the aspect of [Proverbs 20:27]:
 "ner Hashem nishmas adam
 [the lamp of Hashem is the soul of a person]."

 And this is the aspect of the kindling of the Shabbos lamp —
 which is obligatory [chova] —
 and as explained in the kavannos:
 "chova — gimatria — Aleph-Heh-Yod-Heh
 [chova in gematria equals Aleph-Heh-Yod-Heh]"
 — the aspect of Binah —
 that is, the aspect of the aforementioned contemplation.

 And the perfection of fear [yirah]
 is in the aspect of three lines:
 the aspect of the fear of Heaven [mora shamayim] —
 the fear of one's teacher [mora rabbecha] —
 and the fear of one's father and mother [mora av va'eim].
 And each of them encompasses three aspects —
 as explained within.
 And the fear of Shabbos encompasses all the above.
 For the root of fear is in Da'as —
 and the essential Da'as is in the heart —
 as explained above within in Siman 15
 in the teaching HaGanuz.
 And this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of Da'as and the aspect of the heart —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And therefore then fear is in its perfection —
 that is, the fear is with Da'as —
 and as also explained in
 Likutay Moharan Tinyana, Siman 17.
 And this is the aspect of the perfect fear of Heaven —
 that is, the fear is encompassed and filled
 with all three mental faculties [mochin] —
 Chochmah, Binah, and Da'as —
 as explained within.
 And likewise the fear of the teacher
 is perfected on Shabbos —
 for this is the aspect of [Leviticus 19:30]:
 "es Shabsosai tishmoru — u'mikdashi tira'u
 [My Shabbosim shall you observe — and My sanctuary shall you revere]."
 See Zohar Kedoshim, folio 81:
 "mahu mikdashi —
 v'chol haggid —
 k'govana da: u'mimikdashi tachailu —
 al tikri u'mikdashi ela u'mikudoshai
 [what is 'My sanctuary'? —
 and so on —
 in this manner: 'and from My sanctuary you shall begin' —
 do not read 'u'mikdashi' but rather 'u'mikudoshai'],"
 and so on —
 and there it states that u'mikudoshai [My sanctified ones]
 refers to the elders and the sages of the generation —
 as explained in Tractate Shabbos, folio 55.
 And also — the true teacher himself
 is himself the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 as explained elsewhere.
 And therefore it is most propitious
 to spend Shabbos with the Tzadik
 and the teacher of the generation —
 for through the holiness of Shabbos
 one can attain more the holiness of the teacher —
 and likewise through the holiness of the teacher —
 the holiness of Shabbos illuminates for one even more.
 And then it is most propitious
 to receive the teaching from the teacher —
 for this is the aspect of what on Shabbos the Torah was given.
 And our Sages expounded on:
 "Vayakhel Moshe
 [and Moshe gathered],"
 and so on —
 that it is a mitzvah to assemble congregations
 on every Shabbos
 and teach them Torah.
 For the ultimate purpose of the teaching
 is the fear of Heaven —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "v'hayah emunes itecha —
 v'chol haggid —
 i ika yir'as Hashem — hi otzaro — ein
 [and the faithfulness of your times —
 and so on —
 if there is fear of Hashem — it is his treasure — yes],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 [Isaiah 33:6]

 And the essential perfection of fear is on Shabbos —
 as mentioned above —
 and then fear is drawn upon all the portions of the teaching —
 which are in the aspect of:
 "oraissa tilitai
 [the tripartite Torah]"
 [Torah — Prophets — Writings] —
 for this itself is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 which encompasses Torah, Prophets, and Writings —
 as explained in Zohar Yisro, folio 92.
 And likewise then is completed
 the aspect of the fear of father and mother —
 for this is likewise the aspect of:
 "es Shabsosai tishmoru — u'mikdashi tira'u"
 — as explained in the aforementioned Zohar Kedoshim.
 And this is the aspect of [Leviticus 19:3]:
 "ish imo v'aviv tira'u —
 v'es Shabsosai tishmoru —
 mokish dechilu d'aba v'ima l'Shabsosai —
 v'chol haggid —
 kula chad —
 man d'dachil mei'hai natir l'hai
 [each person shall revere his mother and his father —
 and My Shabbosim shall you observe —
 juxtaposing the fear of father and mother to My Shabbosim —
 and so on —
 all is one —
 one who fears this — guards that]"
 — as explained in the aforementioned Zohar Kedoshim.
 And therefore there too
 the holiness of the Shabbos union is alluded to —
 as explained there —
 for the essential holiness of the union
 depends on fear —
 and the perfection of fear is on Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.

 And the fear of the aspect of the fear of father and mother
 is drawn upon all the portions of wealth —
 which are three:
 a third in commerce [pirkmata'ya] —
 a third in hand [b'yado] —
 and a third in land [b'karka] —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of what is explained in the kavannos of Shabbos:
 for Malchus — even in its standing position
 facing the aspect of Neh"y —
 is likewise called by the name Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 [the Holy Apple Orchard] —
 which alludes to Neh"y, Chag"t, and Chab"d.
 For Neh"y themselves
 are likewise encompassed from the aspects of
 Neh"y, Chag"t, and Chab"d, and so on.
 That is — for Malchus is the aspect of fear —
 the aspect of the awe of the kingdom —
 and when it stands facing the aspect of Neh"y
 — which are the aspects of legs —
 this is the aspect of the fear of father and mother —
 drawn upon the portions of wealth —
 which are the aspects of legs —
 as in:
 "v'es hayekum asher b'ragleihem
 [and the substance that is at their feet]"
 [Numbers 16:30] —
 and as explained elsewhere.
 (And wealth is also from the aspect of Malchus —
 and as explained above within in Siman 56.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "ashir b'rashim yimshol
 [a rich man rules over the poor]."
 [Proverbs 22:7])
 Then it is also encompassed from Neh"y, Chag"t, Chab"d —
 which are the aspects of the three portions of wealth mentioned above.
 For through fear
 one merits to conduct commerce with faith and in its perfection —
 and this is the aspect of Neh"y — the aspects of legs —
 for commerce is called regel [foot/commerce] —
 as explained within —
 and this is the aspect of a third in commerce.

 And also — through fear
 one merits to perform much charity
 with one's wealth —
 and this is the aspect of a third in hand —
 corresponding to the aspect of Chag"t
 — which are the aspects of hands.
 And also — through fear one merits to understand
 that the wealth itself is the aspect of waste —
 and belongs only to women
 and those of limited Da'as, and so on —
 and one of true Da'as
 needs wealth only for the sake of contemplation —
 and so on —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of a third in land —
 corresponding to the aspect of Chab"d —
 the aspects of the mental faculties —
 the aspect of the aforementioned contemplation.
 But nonetheless —
 all the aforementioned aspects together
 are in the aspects of Neh"y —
 which is the aspect of the fear of father and mother —
 the aspect of:
 "bera kara d'avuha
 [a son is the leg of his father]."
 And the fear of the aspect of the fear of one's teacher
 is in the aspects of Chag"t —
 the aspect of:
 "ki samach Moshe es yadav alav
 [for Moshe laid his hands upon him]."
 [Deuteronomy 34:9]
 And the fear of the teacher himself —
 the aspect of the fear of Heaven —
 is in the aspects of Chab"d —
 as mentioned above.
 And then fear is completed in its perfection —
 and through this one merits
 the aforementioned length of days.
 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught —
 in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer, chapter 18:
 "kol hamevareych al haYayin b'leiley Shabbasos —
 ma'arichin lo yamav v'shanosav b'olam hazeh —
 v'yosifu lo shenos chayyim b'olam haba
 [all who bless over wine on the nights of Shabbos —
 their days and years in this world are lengthened —
 and years of life in the World to Come are added to them]."
 For it is explained in the kavannos:
 that at the time of the Kiddush over wine
 on Shabbos night —
 then Malchus receives
 the aspects of Chab"d of Ze'ir Anpin —
 which is the aspect of the perfect ascent
 of the aforementioned fear —
 until it is in the aspects of Chab"d —
 and through this one merits
 the aforementioned length of days —
 until through this one arrives
 at the aforementioned contemplation —
 which is the aspect of the World to Come.
 For the World to Come is the aspect of Binah —
 as is well-known.
 (And if I have erred, heaven forfend —
 may He Who is merciful forgive.)

 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of
 the awakening from sleep [his'orerus hashinah] —
 as it is written:
 "u'shemartem es haShabbas ki kodesh hu
 [and you shall guard the Shabbos — for it is holy]"
 — and all that is more holy
 is farther from sleep —
 as explained in Sefer haMidos.

 And this is the aspect of the blasts of the shofar [teki'os]
 that were sounded on Erev Shabbos —
 which are the aspects of the awakening from sleep —
 as explained within —
 for during the weekdays
 one engages in commerce —
 which is the aspect of sleep —
 as explained within in Siman 35
 in the teaching Ashray Zaraka.
 And even the simple study of the revealed Torah —
 which is the six orders of the Mishnah —
 that correspond to the six weekdays —
 is likewise in the aspect of sleep
 relative to the clinging to the Creator, blessed be He —
 as explained there in the aforementioned teaching —
 and the essential clinging in its perfection
 is on Shabbos — as mentioned above many times.
 For even the service of G-d
 of Torah study and prayer during the weekdays
 is in the aspects of mochin d'katnus [minor mental faculties]
 compared to the mental faculties of Shabbos.
 For the essential illumination of the great mental faculties
 is on Shabbos —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "ki kodesh hu
 [for it is holy]"
 — as is well-known.
 And therefore then is the essential time
 for the perfect ascent of Torah and prayer and so on
 of all the days of the week — as is well-known.
 And also — the eating of the weekdays
 has within it a grip of the Sitra Achra —
 and through this one also falls into the aspect of sleep —
 as explained within —
 but the eating of Shabbos is entirely holy —
 as explained in Siman 57.
 And it is in the aspect of lechem hapanim
 [the bread of the Presence] —
 for this is the secret of the twelve loaves
 that must be set out on the holy Shabbos —
 as is well-known.
 For the eating of Shabbos alludes to
 the very high mental faculties —
 as explained in the kavannos.
 And it is the aspect of the light of the face [or hapanim] —
 in the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 8:1]:
 "chochmas adam ta'ir panav
 [the wisdom of a person illuminates his face]."
 For this is the aspect of what our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "berchu b'or panav shel adam —
 v'chol haggid —
 berchu b'mat'amim
 [He blessed him with the light of the face of a person —
 and so on —
 He blessed him with delicacies],"
 and so on —
 that is, for the eating of the delicacies of Shabbos themselves
 are in the aspects of the illumination of the light of the face —
 as mentioned above.
 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the rectification of the heart —
 as mentioned above many times in the name of the Tikunim —
 and through this
 one returns and seeks the face —
 which is the aspect of the mental faculties —
 that were lost during the weekdays.
 And this itself is the aspect of the extra soul
 one merits on Shabbos —
 for the soul is the aspect of the mental faculties —
 as it is written [Job 32:8]:
 "v'nishmas Shadai tvinam
 [and the breath of Shadai gives them understanding]."

 And this is the aspect of [Exodus 31:17]:
 "u'veyom hashevi'i shavas vayinafash
 [and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed]"
 — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded:
 "keivan she'shavas — vav — avdah nefesh
 [since it rested — vav [woe] — the soul was lost]"
 — that is — since it is impossible
 to awaken a person from his sleep
 except when he first awakens himself somewhat —
 in the aspect of:
 "is'arus d'l'tata
 [an awakening from below]" —
 as explained within —
 therefore the Holy One, blessed be He,
 established through the power of the holiness of Shabbos:
 that the moment the holiness of Shabbos arrives —
 then each and every person of Israel
 is awakened according to his aspect —
 with some manner of partial awakening —
 and reminds himself
 of the loss of his soul during the weekdays —
 and cries out and sighs over this:
 "vav — avdah nefesh
 [woe — the soul was lost]"
 — and through this partial awakening —
 one merits to receive afterward
 the awakening by which one is aroused further
 each time
 through the holiness of Shabbos.

 Until the face returns to him —
 the aspect of:
 "pnay Shabbas nekabelah
 [let us receive the face of Shabbos]."
 And also — in its plain meaning —
 he wished to say:
 "keivan she'shavas
 [since it rested]"
 — that is, when Shabbos departs —
 then:
 "vav — avdah nefesh"
 — and this can also be explained in another manner —
 for sometimes —
 when one sees that a person
 has fallen into such a deep sleep
 that it is difficult for him to awaken himself at all —
 even just some small awakening —
 then they send down from above
 some awakening and illumination of holiness —
 and then immediately it withdraws from him —
 and then afterward he awakens on his own
 to seek and pursue
 this illumination that withdrew from him —
 and this is also counted as an awakening from below —
 and one merits through this
 to receive afterward
 a complete awakening from above.
 And this is likewise regarding the holiness of Shabbos —
 for they give the person
 some aspect of extra soul
 on the holy Shabbos —
 and afterward at the departure of Shabbos
 it withdraws from him —
 and then the person reflects upon his way —
 and sighs and yearns greatly:
 "vav — avdah nefesh"
 — and through this awakening
 one merits afterward
 to receive on the next Shabbos
 an extra soul from an even higher level.
 And this is likewise included in:
 "almilai shamru Yisrael shtay Shabbasos
 [were Israel to observe two Shabbosim],"
 and so on. [וכו']

 And behold — regarding the matter
 of the awakening from sleep
 through the showing and revealing
 of the holy face —
 there are several aspects —
 as explained within.

segments.he: סימן קב-אתה תהיה וכו'
segments.en: And therefore everyone must force himself to pray with concentration and with devekus always — in particular on the holy Shabbos itself — for at the time when prayer is completed with true devekus as required — which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos — then all the prayers are elevated through this — as mentioned above.

segments.he: שבת הוא בחינת יראה בחינת ירא שבת כידוע וכנ"ל כמה פעמים. ואז בא היראה להאדם ממילא מלמעלה על ידי אור קדושת שבת שהוא קביעא וקיימא. אך אף על פי כן צריך האדם לשמרה שלא תאבד ממנו על ידי בחינת היסח הדעת ושכחה והעלמת עין כידוע כי האדם הוא בעל בחירה אך העיקר לעורר על עצמו יראה עילאה בשבת קדש שזה עיקר שלימות היראה בחינת צדיק מושל יראת אלקים כמבואר בפנים.
segments.en:
For one must clothe the face, and so on —
 and sometimes they clothe it
 in story-telling [sipuray ma'asiyos]
 and in ordinary conversations —
 and sometimes they clothe it also
 in words of Torah, and so on.
 And likewise —
 sometimes one is awakened through his own face
 that is clothed in him, and so on —
 as mentioned above.
 And sometimes one needs to be awakened
 through a face higher than his own face.
 But there are those who have fallen
 from all the seventy facets of Torah —
 until it is impossible to awaken them
 through any facet —
 except through the stories
 of the ancient years [sipuray ma'asiyos shel shanim kadmoniyos] —
 from which all seventy facets of Torah —
 which are the aspects of seventy years —
 receive their vitality.
 And this is the aspect of Atik —
 the aspect of Zaken [the Elder] —
 the aspect of hadras panim [the splendor of countenance] —
 the aspect of:
 "v'rav chesed
 [and abundant in lovingkindness],"
 and so on. [וכו']
 And see in Zohar Bereishis, folio 7, side 2 —
 and in the commentary of the Ramaz there —
 and Zohar Beshalach, folio 45 — side 2 —
 and in the commentary of the Ramaz there.
 And this has already been explained elsewhere.
 And behold — on Shabbos night —
 then the essential ascent is only
 to the aspect of Malchus —
 as explained in the kavannos —
 and Malchus is nested in Asiyah — as is well-known.
 Therefore then one must draw
 its rectification, as it were —
 through the aspect of story-telling —
 for then there is no reading of the Torah at all —
 only what is recited three times: Vayechulu —
 which is only the aspect of a narration of events [sippur ma'aseh].
 And the first time —
 one draws to it through this
 the mental faculties from the aspects of
 Neh"y of Ze'ir Anpin —
 for that is its place of standing.

 And afterward — the second time
 with the recitation of Vayechulu —
 one draws to it from the aspects of Chag"t.
 And Chag"t Neh"ym
 are the aspects of the seventy facets of Torah.

 And this is the aspect of how initially
 one draws to it from the aspects of its own face —
 which is the aspect of Neh"y of Ze'ir Anpin —
 for that is the essential place of its building —
 as is well-known —
 and as explained below within in Siman 85.
 And afterward one draws to it
 from the aspects of Chag"t —
 which are the aspects of the face higher than its own level at present.
 And the third time —
 during the recitation of Vayechulu in the Kiddush —
 one draws to it from the aspects of
 Chab"d of Ze'ir Anpin —
 which correspond to its standing position then.
 The aspect of the stories of the ancient years —
 for Chab"d are the aspects of
 the days of old [yemay kedem]
 and the ancient years —
 as is well-known —
 and therefore one's days and years are lengthened —
 for they are in the aspects of
 the rectifications of Atik —
 the aspect of length of days.

 (And this is what is explained in the kavannos:
 the three times of saying Havu laHashem
 that are recited at the beginning of the entry of Shabbos —
 the number of Havu is 13 —
 to intend the 13 rectifications of the beard of Arich Anpin
 of Asiyah, of Yetzirah, and of Beriyah —
 to elevate through them
 the Chab"d of Asiyah
 into the Malchus of Yetzirah, and so on —
 and the 13 rectifications of the beard
 are the aspects of the rectifications of Atik —
 as understood within in this teaching, section 9.
 For in each and every world — according to its aspect —
 there is the aspect of the seven traits —
 which are the aspects of the seventy years —
 the seventy facets of Torah —
 and there is the aspect of Chab"d —
 which are likewise the aspects of the ancient years —
 and there is the aspect of the rectifications of the beard —
 and there is the aspect of Atik as such, and so on —
 as is well-known —
 and there is no place to expand on this here.
 And the essential illumination of Shabbos
 is from the aspect of Atik
 at the very high level —
 and through the ascents of Shabbos
 one ascends from level to level
 until one ascends to the aspect of Atik as such —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'Atika Kadisha gali retzoneh
 [and the Holy Ancient One reveals His will]."
 And likewise at Minchah of Shabbos —
 Ze'ir Anpin ascends to the actual beard of the Dik'na
 at their supernal root —
 as explained in the kavannos.
 And this is what is said
 in Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas:
 "ki simachtani Hashem b'fo'olecha —
 b'ma'aseh yadecha aranen
 [for You have gladdened me, Hashem, through Your work —
 in the works of Your hands I shall shout for joy]"
 — the aspect of the aforementioned story-tellings —
 for these are the aspects of:
 "Hashem fo'olecha
 [Hashem's works],"
 and so on —
 and this:
 "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem —
 me'od amku machshevosecha
 [how great are Your works, Hashem —
 how very deep are Your thoughts]."
 For within these stories
 there is clothed the aspect of the depth of thought —
 which are the aspects of Chab"d
 or Kach"b —
 which are the aspects of the ancient years.
 And likewise in the psalm:
 "Hashem Malach geo'us lavash — lavash Hashem
 [Hashem has reigned — He has clothed Himself in majesty —
 Hashem has clothed Himself],"
 and so on —
 [Psalms 93:1]
 the aspect of the aforementioned garments —
 with which the aspect of the faces of Torah —
 or the aspect of the ancient years mentioned above —
 are clothed.
 And this is what concluded:
 "Hashem l'orech yamim
 [Hashem — for the length of days]"
 [Psalms 93:5] —
 for through all of this
 the aspect of the aforementioned length of days is drawn.)

 And afterward —
