 And therefore our Sages of blessed memory taught:
 "hashomer Shabbas —
 v'chol haggid —
 mochalin lo
 [the Shabbos guardian —
 and so on —
 he is forgiven],"
 and so on — as mentioned above.
 And also through this
 he decrees and the Holy One, blessed be He, fulfills —
 and this is the aspect of [Jeremiah 15:19]:
 "im totzei yakar mizolel
 [if you bring forth the precious from the vile]"
 — that is, the drawing close of the distant mentioned above —
 "k'fi tihyeh
 [you shall be as My mouth]"
 — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 [Tractate Bava Metzi'a 85]:
 even the Holy One, blessed be He,
 decrees a decree —
 he annuls it for his sake.

 And this is the aspect of:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]"
 — that is, one merits
 that his speech is in the aspect of the word of Hashem —
 as it were —
 for he decrees and the Holy One, blessed be He, fulfills —
 in the aspect of:
 "k'fi tihyeh"
 — as mentioned above.

 Siman 63 — סימן סג
 Shabbos — Tzadik — covenant — six wings — revealing and concealing — Amalek — the ant — Isaiah 58
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 63]

 Shabbos and Tzadik and covenant [bris]
 are one aspect —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 and as also understood within.
 And therefore Shabbos also encompasses
 all the aspects of the six wings —
 the six handbreadths [shisha tefachim] —
 as explained within.
 For there is the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav
 [with two it covers its feet]"
 [Isaiah 6:2] —
 that is, the aspect of:
 "megaleh tefach u'mechaseh tefach
 [revealing a handbreadth and concealing a handbreadth]"
 — corresponding to the world —
 which is the people [anashim] who are drawn close to him
 and follow after him —
 and sometimes he conceals himself
 and clothes himself in small things —
 so that he can be revealed through this —
 and then the concealment itself
 is in the aspect of revealing a handbreadth.
 And sometimes he is in the aspect of true concealment —
 that he is hidden and obscured —
 and removed and made wondrous from them — and so on —
 as explained within.

 And [Isaiah 6:2]:
 "u'vshtayim ye'ofef —
 v'Targum: yishamshe
 [with two he flies —
 and the Targum translates: he serves]"
 — that is, he is the aspect of
 revealing a handbreadth and concealing a handbreadth
 regarding the service and the devotion
 with which he serves and devotes himself
 to G-d, blessed be He.
 For one must attach oneself to G-d, blessed be He,
 as if G-d, blessed be He, is revealed
 and drawing close to him.
 But the more one draws close —
 the more one must know
 that one is still far from G-d, blessed be He —
 for this is the aspect of [Isaiah 57:19]:
 "shalom l'rachok v'karov
 [peace to the far and to the near]"
 — as explained within.

 And [Isaiah 6:2]:
 "u'vshtayim yechaseh panav
 [with two he covers its face]"
 — this is the aspect of
 revealing a handbreadth and concealing a handbreadth
 regarding oneself.
 For panim [face] sometimes means anger —
 and sometimes means the favor
 and the Providence of G-d, blessed be He.
 And the Tzadik —
 sometimes he covers the face of favor —
 and accepts upon himself suffering —
 for the good of the world —
 and he chooses more the spiritual influence.
 And sometimes he covers the face of anger —
 and reveals the face of favor and Providence — and so on —
 as explained within.

 And all of this is likewise encompassed
 in the holiness of the holy Shabbos —
 for it is explained in the kavannos of Shabbos:
 the secret of Chakla Tupichin Kadishin
 alludes to the ascent of Malchus
 in the aspects of Neh"y, Chag"t, Chab"d
 of Ze'ir Anpin.
 And since even within Neh"y alone
 all three aspects are found —
 which are Neh"y, Chag"t, Chab"d —
 therefore even in its standing against Neh"y alone
 it is also called by these three terms — and so on.
 And see Zohar Pinchas, folio 236 —
 where it is explained there —
 from the secret of the six wings —
 that the covenant — the aspect of Yesod —
 encompasses them.
 For they are the aspects of the wings of the cherubim —
 the aspects of Netzach and Hod — and so on.
 And therefore even in its standing against Neh"y
 it also encompasses the three aforementioned aspects —
 which are:
 "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav"
 — corresponding to Neh"y.
 And:
 "u'vshtayim ye'ofef"
 — and the flying is with the wings —
 which correspond to the aspect of the arms [yadayim] of a person —
 as is well-known —
 and this is the aspect of [Ezekiel 1:8]:
 "v'yedey adam mitachas kanfeihem
 [and the hands of a man are beneath their wings]"
 (and this corresponds to the aspect of Chag"t).
 And:
 "u'vshtayim yechaseh panav"
 — this corresponds to the aspect of Chab"d —
 in the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 8:1]:
 "chochmas adam ta'ir panav
 [the wisdom of a person illuminates his face]"
 — and as explained elsewhere.
 And a fortiori afterward —
 when it truly ascends
 in the three aforementioned ascents —
 then certainly it encompasses all of the above.

 For within the holiness of Shabbos
 there is the aspect of revealing and concealing
 corresponding to the world —
 for this is the aspect of what our Sages taught:
 all the commandments were given to Israel openly —
 and Shabbos was given to them in privacy — and so on —
 its reward is not to be made known.
 For although the holiness of Shabbos
 is revealed and recognizable to all —
 even to the nations —
 it is possible to show and reveal
 somewhat of the sweetness of its holiness —
 as our Sages of blessed memory taught
 [Tractate Shabbos 119]:
 "amar leih Keisar l'Rabbi Yehoshua ven Chananyah:
 mipney mah tavshil shel Shabbas richo nodeph?
 Amar leih: tavlin echad yesh lanu —
 v'Shabbas shmo —
 v'anu mattilin l'socho v'richo nodeph
 [the Emperor said to Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah:
 why does the Shabbos dish
 have such a fragrant smell?
 He said to him: we have one spice —
 and Shabbos is its name —
 and we put it in — and its fragrance spreads],"
 and so on.
 And as our Sages taught in Midrash Rabbah, Bereishis as well:
 "berchu b'mat'amim
 [He blessed it with delicacies]."
 And likewise they taught:
 "berchu b'me'or panav shel adam.
 Lo domeh me'or panav shel adam b'Shabbas
 l'me'or panav shel adam b'chol
 [He blessed it with the light of a person's face.
 The light of a person's face on Shabbos
 is not comparable to the light of a person's face on a weekday]."
 And see Midrash Rabbah, Bereishis, section 11 —
 what Rabbi Akiva showed as decisive proofs
 regarding the holiness of Shabbos —
 from the Sambatyon River — and similar things —
 see there.
 It follows that its holiness is revealed to all.
 Nonetheless — the inner dimension of its holiness
 is wondrous and concealed and very hidden —
 the aspect of [Isaiah 64:3]:
 "ayin lo ra'asah
 [no eye has seen],"
 and so on —
 for it is literally a foretaste of the World to Come.
 And this is the aspect of
 revealing a handbreadth and concealing a handbreadth
 corresponding to the world.

 And the revelation itself
 is also the aspect of concealment.
 For the holiness of Shabbos —
 because its light is so immense —
 therefore it descends and is hidden
 and clothes itself in many garments and coverings —
 until through this it is possible
 for some radiance from its holiness
 to be revealed even in this physical world —
 and even in the physical matters
 of the physical delight and honor of Shabbos —
 which are the Shabbos meals
 and the garments of honor of Shabbos —
 and similar things —
 until through this itself
 one merits some radiance
 also from the inner dimension of its holiness —
 in the aspect of:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem"
 — as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav"
 — as mentioned above.

 "B'shtayim ye'ofef
 [with two it flies]"
 — this corresponds to the service and the devotion
 and the drawing close to G-d, blessed be He —
 which is likewise the aspect of revealing and concealing —
 as mentioned above.
 For through the holiness of Shabbos
 there is drawn upon each and every Israelite
 the aspect of the drawing close
 and the sacred awakening —
 to draw oneself close to G-d, blessed be He —
 as it is written [Exodus 31:13]:
 "ki os hi —
 v'chol haggid —
 lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadshechem
 [for it is a sign —
 and so on —
 to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you]."
 And this is the aspect of the extra soul
 that is added to a person on the holy Shabbos.
 For the essential clinging and drawing close
 to G-d, blessed be He,
 is from the aspect of the soul [neshamah] —
 in the aspect of [Psalms 150:6]:
 "kol haneshamah tehallel Yah
 [every soul shall praise Yah]"
 — and it is written [Job 32:8]:
 "v'nishmas Shadai tvinam
 [and the breath of Shadai gives them understanding]."

 And the clinging and the drawing close
 is the aspect of revealing —
 as if, as it were, the holiness
 is revealed and drawing close to him.
 But the more one draws close —
 the more one must know
 that one is still even farther — as mentioned above.

 And this is what our Sages expounded
 regarding the extra soul
 that a person merits on Shabbos —
 that it is stated [Exodus 31:17]:
 "vayom hashevi'i shavas vayinafash —
 keivan she'shavas — vav — avdah nefesh
 [and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed —
 since it rested — vav [woe] — the soul was lost]"
 — that is, as mentioned above —
 that this itself is the aspect of the drawing close
 and the great illumination of the extra soul
 that a person merits to receive
 at the entry of the holy Shabbos —
 until through this he knows
 and feels and attains even more
 his distance from G-d, blessed be He —
 and cries out and sighs over this:
 "vav — avdah nefesh."
 And this is what our Sages taught
 [Tractate Beitzah 16a]:
 "neshamah yetairah — lo ode'inuhu l'aku'm
 [the extra soul — We did not make known to the nations]."
 For truly the nations are utterly distant
 from this matter —
 and they have no comprehension of it —
 for since specifically then
 one is awakened even more
 to attain the distance —
 if so — what is this aspect of drawing close?
 But in truth it is the opposite —
 for in holiness —
 all who are close merit to attain and know their distance even more —
 in the aspect of:
 "shalom l'rachok v'karov
 [peace to the far and to the near]."
 And it follows the manner of what our Sages taught:
 "ki atem hame'at mikol ha'amim —
 hishpa'ti gadolah l'Nevuchadnetzar —
 v'chol haggid —
 aval atem — kol mah she'ani mashpia lachem tovah —
 atem mima'atin atzmeichem b'yoser —
 lafikhach chashak Hashem bachem
 [for you are the fewest of all the peoples —
 I bestowed great bounty on Nevuchadnetzar —
 and so on —
 but as for you — the more I bestow good upon you —
 the more you diminish yourselves even more —
 therefore Hashem desired you]"
 — that is, as mentioned above.

 And:
 "u'vshtayim yechaseh panav
 [with two he covers its face]"
 — this is the aspect of revealing and concealing
 regarding oneself — as mentioned above —
 in the manner of what our Sages taught:
 "berchu b'man —
 she'yarad b'yom hashishi lechem yomayim —
 v'kidsho b'man —
 she'lo yarad b'yom haShabbas
 [He blessed it with the manna —
 that fell on the sixth day — bread for two days —
 and sanctified it with the manna —
 that did not fall on the day of Shabbos],"
 and so on.
 And as the holy Zohar noted precisely
 [Zohar Yisro, folio 88]:
 "kesiv: vayevarech Elokim es yom hashevi'i —
 v'chesiv: b'yom hashevi'i Shabbas — lo yihyeh bo —
 v'keivan d'lo ishkachin bei mezonay —
 mah berchata ishkach bei —
 ela tana:
 kol birkan d'ila'in v'tata'in —
 b'yoma shevi'aa talyan
 [it is written: and G-d blessed the seventh day —
 and it is written: on the seventh day — Shabbos — there shall be none in it —
 and since no food is found on it —
 what blessing is found in it? —
 but it was taught:
 all the blessings of the above and the below —
 depend on the seventh day],"
 and so on — see there.
 And see Zohar Terumah, folio 155 —
 in the secret of the lechem hapanim:
 "d'ha mezonay v'sipuka d'alma —
 mei'inun panim ila'in k'asyan
 [for the food and sustenance of the world —
 comes from those supernal faces],"
 and so on.
 And therefore on Shabbos —
 when no material bounty fell in the form of manna —
 but rather spiritual bounty —
 which is the holy mental faculties
 that are revealed in the holiness of the holy Shabbos —
 this is the aspect of:
 "yechaseh panav
 [it covers its face]"
 — the aspect of covering the face of favor
 and Providence of material influence.
 And Shabbos is the aspect of poverty —
 as explained in the Tikunim.
 And also — the constellations
 that serve on it — are Mars and Saturn — as is well-known.
 And yet in truth —
 the root of all material influence
 is also drawn from the holiness of Shabbos —
 as mentioned above —
 for this is the aspect of what
 they were required to arrange the lechem hapanim
 on the table specifically on the day of Shabbos.
 And this is likewise the aspect of
 the delight and honor of Shabbos —
 that one must delight in the Shabbos
 also with material bounty and material pleasures —
 for from it is the root of everything —
 and as explained in the aforementioned Zohar Yisro:
 "ba'i l'is'anaga b'hai yoma —
 v'lemeikal telas se'udatay b'Shabbata —
 b'gin d'yishtakach shav'a v'anugo
 mei'hai yoma b'alma
 [one must delight on this day —
 and eat three meals on Shabbos —
 so that satiety and delight from this day
 should be found in the world],"
 and so on.
 And this is the aspect of revealing a handbreadth —
 that it reveals the face of favor and Providence
 of material influence as well — as mentioned above.
 And covering the face of anger —
 for then all judgments are suppressed
 and do not stir at all —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And behold — it is explained within
 that through holy speech
 one makes the sacred wings — and so on.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "v'daber davar
 [and speaking words]"
 — stated regarding Shabbos.

 And behold — the holiness of Shabbos
 is the aspect of the sacred Da'as —
 as mentioned above many times.
 For the eternal covenant [bris olam] —
 which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos —
 ascends to Da'as —
 as is well-known —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar,
 Mishpatim, folio 110:
 "ad d'salik ad mocha ila'ah
 [until it ascends to the supernal mind]"
 — and as also brought in Siman 36
 in the teaching b'Karov.
 But corresponding to this —
 in the husk and the Sitra Achra
 there is the aspect of the serpent —
 which is the aspect of the Da'as d'klifah [knowledge of the husks] —
 in the aspect of [Genesis 3:1]:
 "v'hanachash hayah arum
 [and the serpent was cunning]"
 — and this is the aspect of the husk of Amalek —
 which is the aspect of the Da'as d'klifah —
 as brought in the Zohar Beshalach.

 And therefore our Sages taught:
 "vayehi vayom hashevi'i —
 yatze'u min ha'am lilkot —
 v'chol haggid —
 miyad vayavo Amalek
 [and it was on the seventh day —
 some of the people went out to gather —
 and so on —
 and immediately Amalek came]."
 But the essential intensification [of Amalek]
 was through the words
 with which they blemished the honor of Moshe —
 as it is written [Exodus 17:2–4]:
 "vayarev ha'am im Moshe —
 v'chol haggid —
 ad she'amar Moshe:
 od me'at v'sekaluni
 [and the people quarreled with Moshe —
 and so on —
 until Moshe said:
 a little more and they will stone me]"
 — and this was on account of the strife of the children of Israel — and so on —
 "vayavo Amalek
 [and Amalek came],"
 and so on.

 And this is what Rashi explained:
 "samach parshah zo l'mikra zeh —
 v'chol haggid —
 hishlichu me'alav —
 u'va hanachash v'nashcho
 [this passage was juxtaposed to this verse —
 and so on —
 they cast it off of them —
 and the serpent came and bit it]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And in this is also implied precisely
 the expression:
 "vayavo Amalek
 [and Amalek came]"
 — that is, he came suddenly and from afar —
 as our Sages taught —
 for through the aforementioned blemishes —
 wings were made for the serpent —
 which is the aspect of Amalek —
 until he came quickly and with flying.
 And this is the aspect of what our Sages expounded:
 for from the root of the serpent
 there went forth a tzefa [viper]
 for Amalek and Haman —
 and it is also brought that:
 "tzefa — gimatria — Amalek
 [tzefa in gematria equals Amalek]."
 And this is what it concluded [Isaiah 14:29]:
 "u'firyo saraf me'ofef
 [and its fruit is a flying fiery serpent]"
 — for Amalek is the aspect of the flying fiery serpent —
 through the wings that it has
 when one blemishes, heaven forfend,
 the sacred wings —
 which are the aspects of the seraphim standing — and so on —
 six wings — six wings for each one.
 And therefore he cut off foreskins and threw them —
 for he wished to blemish
 the holiness of the covenant
 that encompasses the aspects
 of the aforementioned six wings.
 And therefore his subjugation was
 through the aspect of:
 "the sword that takes vengeance for the covenant"
 [Leviticus 26:25] —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.

 And behold — the aforementioned serpent
 sometimes walks and sometimes flies.
 And the flying harms more than the walking
 in three aspects —
 as explained within.
 And it is explained elsewhere
 that the flying aspect of the serpent
 is from the three completely impure husks —
 and the walking is from the husk of Nogah.
 And the ant [nemalah] in the mouth of the serpent
 is — as it were — the aspect of
 the legs of Malchus —
 from which they have some grip —
 as explained in Sefer Zohar haRakia.
 And this is what is explained in the writings of the holy Ari z"l:
 that on Erev Shabbos —
 when the good in Nogah ascends
 along with the legs of the holiness, as it were —
 then the three completely impure husks also wish
 to ascend with it —
 and to draw sustenance from the holiness —
 and then a flame of fire descends
 and scorches the heads of the husks —
 and they descend below — and so on —
 and then there is rest for the aspect
 of the aforementioned ant.
 And therefore all the labors
 and weekday pursuits are forbidden then —
 so as not to give through this
 a grip to the serpent, heaven forfend —
 to overpower the aforementioned ant —
 through any aspect of a treacherous assurance
 that is not complete and true trust [bitachon] as required.
 But merely placing some of one's trust
 also upon the act and the labor
 one engages in.
 But on Shabbos
 one merits complete and true faith and trust —
 that is not clothed in any cause at all.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]"
 — that is, that the legs of holiness
 should ascend from the grip of the husks, heaven forfend —
 and as explained in the writings.
 And this:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — he should refrain from the acts
 and weekday pursuits — as mentioned above.
 And this:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg —
 liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight —
 the holy one of Hashem, honored]"
 — this indicates complete and true trust —
 as required —
 for not only does one not engage
 in any business or labor on Shabbos —
 but even more so —
 one spends even more generously
 on the expenses of the delight and honor of Shabbos.
 And also:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha"
 — this corresponds to the aspect of Neh"y —
 the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav"
 — which is the aspect of the drawing
 of those close to the Tzadik
 and who follow him —
 in the aspect of [Exodus 11:8]:
 "v'chol ha'am asher b'raglecha
 [and all the people who are at your feet]"
 — for the holiness of Shabbos
 is most propitious for this.
 And therefore there is a mitzvah
 to receive the face of one's teacher on Shabbos —
 and likewise to assemble congregations
 and expound in words of Torah.

 "Me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi"
 — that is, one should not engage in his own affairs —
 but only in the affairs of Heaven —
 and this corresponds to the aspect of Chag"t —
 which are the instruments of doing —
 as it is written [Proverbs 31:13]:
 "v'ta'as b'chefetz kapehah
 [and she works with the desire of her hands]."
 And this corresponds to the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim ye'ofef"
 — and its Targum is: yishamshe [serves] —
 in the manner of what our Sages taught:
 "galuy v'yadu'a lefanecha —
 she'shimashti lefanecha b'eser etzbe'osai
 [it is revealed and known before You —
 that I served before You with my ten fingers],"
 and so on —
 for the service and devotion of the clinging
 and drawing close to G-d, blessed be He,
 is the aspect of:
 "achaztihu lo arpenu
 [I held him — I will not let him go]."
 [Song of Songs 3:4]
 And the holding is with the hands —
 which are the aspects of Chag"t.

 "V'karas l'Shabbas oneg —
 liKdosh Hashem mechubbad"
 — this corresponds to the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim yechaseh panav"
 — the aspects of Chab"d — as mentioned above —
 which are the aspects of the spiritual bounty
 of the aspects of the mental faculties —
 where is the root of all the influences —
 in the aspect of [Tractate Berachos 55a]:
 "da'as kanisa — mah chasarta
 [if you have acquired knowledge — what have you lacked?]"
 — and as understood in Siman 24
 in the teaching Emtza'isa —
 and there is the essential delight and honor —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And likewise — the delight and honor of Shabbos
 in their material dimension
 are also drawn from the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim yechaseh panav"
 — for also all the material bounty
 is drawn from Shabbos — as mentioned above.

 And this:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 one should not take large strides —
 for through this one gives power and grip
 to the Sitra Achra —
 as explained in the writings.
 That is — for through blemishing the honor of Shabbos
 in one's walking —
 through this one gives power
 to the aforementioned serpent
 to walk at even greater speed —
 which is also a distress for the aspect
 of the aforementioned ant.

 And this:
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — one should not speak any weekday speech on Shabbos —
 for through this one makes wings, heaven forfend,
 for the serpent —
 so that it should be in the aspect of
 the flying fiery serpent, heaven forfend — as mentioned above —
 and then there is even greater distress
 for the aforementioned ant.
 And in truth —
 the holiness of Shabbos is the aspect of
 the rest [niyacha] of the aforementioned ant —
 as explained in the aforementioned Zohar haRakia
 on Parashas Mishpatim —
 on this very teaching of the Sava
 as explained within.

 And this [Isaiah 58:14]:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem —
 da Atika Kadisha
 [then you will delight in Hashem —
 this is the Holy Ancient One]."
 That is, he merits to attain
 the holiness of the mental faculties at their root —
 which are the aspects of Atik —
 and there is the essential light of the face of favor
 and Providence of all the spiritual and material influences
 drawn on the holy Shabbos —
 as explained in the aforementioned holy Zohar of Yisro.
 And therefore our Sages taught in truth:
 they give him all the desires of his heart —
 as it is stated:
 "v'his'anag al Hashem —
 v'yiten lecha mishalos libecha
 [and delight in Hashem —
 and He will give you the desires of your heart]."
 "V'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz —
 da Chakla Tupichin Kadishin"
 — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the aforementioned ant —
 in the aspects of Neh"y, Chag"t, Chab"d —
 which are themselves the aspects
 of the aforementioned six wings.
 And our Sages expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms —
 that is, the aspect of the subjugation of the serpent —
 the husk of Amalek —
 which is the general sum of all the kingdoms
 of the Sitra Achra —
 as explained elsewhere.
 And this is what our Sages derived —
 from what is written [Deuteronomy 33:29]:
 "v'atah al bamosemo tidroch
 [and you shall tread upon their high places]"
 — that is, they are subdued
 beneath the legs of holiness — the aspects of Neh"y —
 from which is the essential building of
 the sacred Malchus —
 the aspect of the aforementioned ant —
 and as explained elsewhere.

 "V'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha —
 da Ze'ir Anpin"
 — the aspect of Tiferes —
 the general sum of Chag"t —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim ye'ofef"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this is what our Sages taught:
 one merits an inheritance without limits.
 For the service and the devotion
 with which he serves and devotes himself to G-d, blessed be He —
 in the aspect of:
 "b'shtayim ye'ofef"
 — is the aspect of without limits at all.
 For the more one serves
 and attains even more —
 then one knows even more
 that one is still far —
 and one strives to serve G-d
 with even greater attainment —
 and to draw even closer to Him, blessed be He,
 with even greater closeness.
 And this is the aspect of inheritance without limits —
 for one's service and attainment
 has no constraint or limit at all —
 but goes each time higher and higher
 in service and attainment —
 for the greatness of the Creator, blessed be He,
 has no measure —
 and as also explained within.

 And this [Isaiah 58:14]:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]."
 For Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred speech —
 which is the aspects of the sacred wings —
 the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 10:20]:
 "u'ba'al kenafayim yagid davar
 [and the winged one tells a matter]"
 — as explained within.
 And likewise all the aforementioned aspects
 are the aspects of the sacred speech.
 The covenant [bris] is the aspect of speech —
 as explained in the holy Zohar:
 "bris kayama peh Hashem hu
 [the eternal covenant — it is the mouth of Hashem]."
 The Tzadik is the aspect of speech —
 as explained in the Tikunim:
 "peh istkariyas misitra d'Tzadik
 [the mouth is called from the side of the Tzadik]."
 Shabbos is the aspect of the sacred speech —
 as explained in the Zohar Bereishis, folio 32 —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'daber davar."
 "B'shtayim yechaseh raglav"
 — the aspect of the drawing
 that the Tzadik draws to himself the people who are close —
 primarily through speech —
 in the aspect of [Ecclesiastes 9:17]:
 "divray chachamim b'nachas nishma'im
 [the words of the wise are heard in quietness]"
 — and it is written [Proverbs 22:17]:
 "shema divray chachamim
 [hear the words of the wise]."
 "B'shtayim ye'ofef"
 — that is, the service and the devotion of the Tzadik —
 primarily through the aspect of speech —
 the aspect of [Proverbs 4:22]:
 "ki chayyim hem l'motze'eihem b'fe
 [for they are life to those who find them — with the mouth]."
 And:
 "u'vshtayim yechaseh panav"
 — the aspect of the drawing forth of the bounty
 of the favor and Providence of G-d, blessed be He —
 is through the aspect of speech —
 as explained in Siman 34 —
 for this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 15:6]:
 "vayevarech eschem ka'asher diber lachem
 [and He will bless you as He spoke to you]."
 The ascent of Malchus —
 which is the aspect of the aforementioned ant —
 is the aspect of Malchus peh [Malchus — the mouth] —
 and it is the aspect of the Name Adona"y
 in its squared form [b'ribua] —
 as explained in the aforementioned Zohar haRakia.
 And this is the aspect of speech —
 as it is written [Psalms 51:17]:
 "Adona"y sefasai tiftach
 [O Adona"y — open my lips]."

 Siman 64 — סימן סד
 Shabbos — perfection of creation — chalal hapanui — faith — Song of Songs — Moshe's song — Isaiah 58
 [Likutay Moharan I, Siman 64]

 Shabbos is the aspect of the perfection of creation —
 as our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 on the verse [Genesis 2:2]:
 "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i
 [and G-d completed on the seventh day],"
 and so on —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And the essential creation
 was for the revelation of His mercy, blessed be He.
 And therefore on the holy Shabbos —
 great mercy is revealed —
 and all judgments are suppressed —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And this is the aspect of [Tractate Shabbos 12a]:
 "yecholah hi she'terachem —
 v'chen: v'rachamav merubim
 [she is able to have mercy —
 and likewise: and His mercies are abundant]."

 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of the perfection
 of the holy faith —
 as mentioned above many times —
 and then all heresy and denial are nullified.

 And therefore our Sages taught:
 even if he worshipped idolatry
 like the generation of Enosh — he is forgiven.
 For the essential idolatry of the generation of Enosh
 was through heresy and external wisdoms —
 as is well-known.
 But on Shabbos —
 the light of the holy faith shines in such perfection
 that all kinds of heresy are nullified.
 For then all the husks are subdued —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And through this —
 all kinds of heresy
 that come from external wisdoms —
 which are also drawn from that same aspect —
 are nullified — as explained within.

 And also — Shabbos is the aspect of
 the rectification of the breaking of the vessels [tikkun sheviyas hakelim].
 But on Shabbos —
 the holy letters spontaneously
 emerge and combine —
 and then such sacred intellect and mental faculties are drawn —
 until through this —
 all the questions of heresy
 that come from external wisdoms —
 which come from waste products —
 from the aspect of the breaking of the vessels —
 are settled.
 And this is the aspect of what our Sages taught
 [Tractate Shabbos 124b]:
 "kol hakelim hanitilin b'Shabbas —
 shivreichem nitilin imahem
 [all vessels that may be moved on Shabbos —
 their broken pieces may be moved along with them]"
 — an allusion to the rectification of the aspect
 of the breaking of the vessels —
 drawn on Shabbos — as mentioned above.

 And likewise — all the questions and the heresy
 coming from the aspect of the chalal hapanui
 [the empty space / the void]
 are nullified then —
 through the fact that on Shabbos
 the illumination of the Ein Sof
 is drawn with wondrous renewal —
 as explained in the writings.
 And then is drawn the song and the melody
 belonging to the aspect of
 faith in the Ein Sof Himself —
 Who is above all aspects of wisdom and faith in the world —
 in the aspect of [Song of Songs 4:8]:
 "tavo'i tashuri me'rosh emunahרוש אמנה
 [come — you shall gaze from the summit of faith]"
 — as explained within.
 For Shabbos is the aspect of Moshe our teacher,
 peace be upon him —
 as explained in the holy Zohar —
 and this is the aspect of:
 "yismach Moshe b'matan chelko
 [Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion]"
 — as mentioned above many times.
 And Moshe merited this song
 through the fact that he was the aspect of thought —
 the aspect of silence [shesakah] —
 in the aspect of:
 "az yashir Moshe —
 Yud —
 al shem hamachshavah ne'emrah
 [then Moshe sang —
 Yud —
 it was stated in the name of thought]"
 — as explained within.

 For this is the aspect of Shabbos —
 which is the World of Thought —
 as is well-known —
 and it is the aspect of silence —
 the aspect of:
 "v'daber davar
 [and speaking words]"
 — stated regarding Shabbos.

 And this is the aspect of:
 מ'זמור ש'יר ל'יום ה'שבת —
 initial letters: למש"ה [l'Moshe] —
 as is brought —
 that is, the aspect of the song of Moshe our teacher,
 peace be upon him.
 And this:
 "tov lehodos laHashem —
 v'lezamre lishimcha elyon
 [good it is to give thanks to Hashem —
 and to sing praises to Your Name — Most High]"
 — that is, the aspect of the song and the melody
 and the song mentioned above —
 which is high and most exalted
 above all aspects of the melodies and songs
 belonging to all the wisdoms and faiths.
 And through this melody —
 all the souls that fell into the heresy
 of the chalal hapanui
 ascend and go forth —
 as explained within.
 And this is what is brought in the writings of the holy Ari z"l
 in the kavannos of Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas:
 that at the entry of Shabbos —
 Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him,
 descends with other great Tzadikim —
 to elevate the souls of the living and the dead
 that fell into the depths of the husks —
 as mentioned above.
 And this [Psalms 92:3]:
 "lehagid baboker chasdecha
 [to declare in the morning Your lovingkindness]"
 — that is, the aspect of wisdom and intellect
 that is revealed on Shabbos —
 through which all the heresy
 coming from external wisdoms is nullified —
 and there are aspects of letters and utterances
 through which the entire creation was made —
 for the sake of the revelation
 of His mercy and lovingkindness, blessed be He —
 as explained within —
 and this:
 "lehagid
 [to declare]"
 — haggadah is the language of wisdom —
 as brought in the holy Zohar.
 And likewise haggadah means speech —
 for this is the aspect of the creation —
 which was through speech —
 and the aspect of wisdom —
 as explained within.
 And this [Psalms 92:3]:
 "v'emunascha baleilos
 [and Your faithfulness by night]."
 For then faith shines so greatly —
 that through this
 one passes even over the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 which is the aspect of night and darkness —
 for there it is called:
 "the depth of the comprehended"
 [omek hamushag] —
 and there it is impossible to find any Da'as or intellect
 to settle the questions coming from there —
 for this is the aspect of [Psalms 82:5]:
 "lo yad'u v'lo yavinu —
 b'chashecha yis'halachu
 [they know not and they understand not —
 they walk in darkness]."

 And this is the aspect of [II Samuel 22:12]:
 "vayashes choshech sevivosav
 [and He set darkness around Him]"
 — and it is written [Psalms 18:12]:
 "yashis choshech sisro sevivosav — sukaso
 [He made darkness His hiding — around Him His canopy]."
 And therefore there —
 one must strengthen oneself only through faith
 in the light of the Ein Sof Himself —
 Who surrounds all worlds —
 and encompasses also the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 and through this one passes over everything —
 as explained within.
 And this [Psalms 92:4]:
 "alay asor v'alay navel —
 alay higgayon b'chinor
 [upon the ten-stringed instrument and upon the lute —
 upon meditation on the harp]"
 — for this is the aspect of the song of the World to Come —
 that will be on a harp of ten strings —
 as our Sages of blessed memory expounded
 [Tractate Arachin 13b]
 on this very verse.
 And through this song —
 all the confusions
 of the aspect of the chalal hapanui are nullified —
 and this itself will be the reception of reward
 by the Tzadikim in the World to Come —
 as explained within.

 And therefore Shabbos is likewise
 a foretaste of the World to Come —
 as our Sages taught.
 And this [Psalms 92:6]:
 "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem
 [how great are Your works, Hashem]"
 — that is, the aspect of the general creation —
 which was through His wisdom and speech, blessed be He.

 "Me'od amku machshevosecha
 [how very deep are Your thoughts]"
 — the aspect of the depth of thought —
 that surrounds and encompasses, as it were,
 also the aspect of the chalal hapanui.
 And this [Psalms 92:7]:
 "ish ba'ar lo yeda
 [a boorish person does not know],"
 and so on —
 and there it settles the questions —
 that are difficult regarding the governance of G-d, blessed be He —
 in the matter of the success of the wicked — and so on —
 and it concluded [Psalms 92:16]:
 "lehagid ki yashar Hashem — tzuri —
 v'lo avlasah vo
 [to declare that Hashem is upright — my Rock —
 and there is no injustice in Him]."
 And this [Psalms 93:1]:
 "Hashem Malach geo'us lavash —
 v'chol haggid —
 af tikon tevel bal timot
 [Hashem has reigned — He has clothed Himself in majesty —
 and so on —
 also — the world is established — it shall not be moved]."
 That is — the aspect of the garments —
 which are the aspects of the holy contractions
 of the chalal hapanui —
 as explained within.
 And in truth they are the sustenance of the world —
 for were it otherwise —
 everything would revert to the Ein Sof —
 as is well-known — and as explained within.

 And therefore one recites Shir haShirim
 close to the entry of Shabbos —
 for it too is from the aforementioned aspect.
 And this is the aspect of
 the severity of the prohibition of the desecration of Shabbos —
 of which it is stated [Exodus 31:14]:
 "mechaleleha mos yumas
 [whoever desecrates it — shall surely be put to death]."
 For through the desecration of Shabbos, heaven forfend —
 one causes the awakening of the aspect of heresy
 drawn from the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 of which it is stated [Proverbs 2:19]:
 "kol ba'eha lo yashuvun —
 v'lo yassigu orchos chayyim
 [all who come to her shall not return —
 and they shall not attain the paths of life]."
 And therefore Shabbos is called
 from the language of cessation [shevitah] and rest —
 and also from the language of nullification [bitul] —
 as in [Exodus 12:15]:
 "tashbisu se'or mibateichem
 [you shall remove the leaven from your houses]"
 — and similar expressions.
 For on Shabbos —
 the holy mental faculties shine —
 through which all the questions
 that have answers are settled —
 and the questions are the aspects of:
 "vayemareiru —
 v'chol haggid —
 ba'avodah kashah
 [and they made bitter — and so on —
 with hard labor]"
 — and the holy Zohar expounded:
 "b'kashya
 [with a question],"
 and so on.
 But Shabbos is the aspect of the answer to the questions —
 for this is the aspect of cessation and rest.
 And also — on Shabbos —
 the holy faith shines —
 and one merits such nullification [bitul]
 and clinging to G-d, blessed be He —
 that through this —
 one passes even over the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 which is completely nullified and empty of everything —
 as explained within.
 And one can say that this is the aspect of:
 "es Shabsosai tishmoru —
 shtay Shabbasos
 [My Shabbosim shall you observe —
 two Shabbosim]"
 — that is, the two aforementioned aspects of Shabbos.
 And this is what it concluded:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadshechem
 [to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 "matanah tovah yesh li b'veys genzai —
 v'Shabbas shemah —
 lech v'hodiyam
 [a good gift I have in My treasury —
 and Shabbos is its name —
 go and make it known to them]."
 And it concludes there:
 "matan scharah shel Shabbas —
 lo avida l'galeyyei —
 v'chen amar sham —
 Shabbas nitnah b'tzin'ah
 [the reward of Shabbos —
 was not made to be revealed —
 and likewise it stated there:
 Shabbos was given in privacy],"
 and so on —
 that is — for the aspect of the mental faculties of Shabbos —
 through which the questions
 coming from external wisdoms are settled —
 this is the aspect of: made to be revealed —
 for they are the aspects of:
 "v'da mah she'tashiv
 [and know what you shall answer],"
 and so on.
 And its reward —
 this is the aspect of the song of Rosh Emunahרוש אמנה
 [the summit of faith] —
 the aspect of the supernal faith —
 above everything —
 above all the wisdoms and faiths —
 through which
 even the confusions coming from the chalal hapanui are nullified —
 for this will be the reception of reward
 by the Tzadikim in the World to Come —
 this was not made to be revealed.
 And only Moshe alone is able to enter there —
 and he illuminates for Israel
 a great illumination also from this aspect —
 on every single Shabbos —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "lech v'hodiyam
 [go and make it known to them]."
 And this:
 "lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadshechem"
 — for then a supremely wondrous holiness
 is drawn upon Israel —
 from the aspect of the light of the Ein Sof itself —
 which is the aspect of:
 "sovev kol almin
 [surrounding all worlds]"
 — that encompasses and surrounds
 even the chalal hapanui — as mentioned above.
 And perhaps this is likewise the secret
 of the Shabbos boundary — two thousand cubits —
 that is, the aspects of wisdom and faith —
 as mentioned above many times.

 And this [Exodus 35:1]:
 "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael
 [and Moshe gathered the entire congregation of the children of Israel]."
 For the Tzadik — who is the aspect of Moshe —
 engages in rectifying all the souls of Israel —
 both those who fell
 on account of the questions that have answers —
 to whom he illuminates mental faculties —
 so that they should be able to settle
 all the questions coming from the aspect
 of the breaking of the vessels —
 for this is the aspect of all the labors
 performed during the weekdays in holiness and perfection —
 in the aspect of the work of the Mishkan —
 through which one elevates the holy sparks
 and rectifies the aspect of the breaking of the vessels —
 as is well-known.
 And this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:2]:
 "sheshes yamim ta'aseh melachah —
 u'vayom hashevi'i yihyeh lachem Kodesh —
 Shabbas Shabason laHashem"
 and so on —
 for then is drawn the aspect of the rectification
 of the breaking of the vessels — spontaneously —
 through the holiness of Shabbos.
 And therefore all labors are forbidden then —
 and moreover —
 even the power of all the rectifications
 made through the sacred labors during the weekdays —
 all of it comes only through the holiness of Shabbos.
 And on the holy Shabbos —
 is also drawn the rectification
 of the confusions coming from the chalal hapanui —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "Shabbas Shabason laHashem"
 — for it is the aspect of: not made to be revealed —
 only to Hashem alone, as it were —
 for it is the aspect of [Isaiah 64:3]:
 "ayin lo ra'asah
 [no eye has seen],"
 and so on.
 And perhaps this is likewise within the category
 of what is explained in the holy Zohar:
 "es Shabsosai tishmoru —
 da igula v'ribua d'lagu"
 — that is, the two aforementioned aspects.
 For the supernal faith mentioned above —
 which is the aspect of:
 "sovev kol almin
 [surrounding all worlds]"
 — this is the aspect of igul — the aspect of surrounding —
 for this is the aspect of [Psalms 89:3]:
 "v'emunascha savivosecha
 [and Your faithfulness around You]."
 And the aspect of the wisdom and the intellect
 that are within the general creation —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "memale kol almin
 [filling all worlds]"
 — this is the aspect of ribua —
 for the mental faculties are four —
 the aspects of Chochmah and Binah —
 and Da'as encompasses Chasadim and Gevuros —
 and as explained elsewhere —
 and likewise the general creation
 is the aspects of four worlds — ABY"A —
 as is well-known —
 and is likewise encompassed
 from the four directions of the heavens —
 and the four corners of the earth —
 as explained in many verses.

 And therefore Shabbos is the aspect of peace —
 the aspect of Shabbas Shalom —
 as is well-known.
 For the six days of deed —
 in which the general creation was created —
 within the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 this is the aspect of sacred dispute —
 which is likewise the aspect of the contraction
 of the chalal hapanui —
 for the sake of the creation of the worlds —
 as explained within.
 But since from the aspect of this contraction
 those questions that have no answer
 can intensify, heaven forfend —
 therefore the essential rectification
 is through the adjudication and the peace of the dispute —
 the aspect of [Numbers 21:14]:
 "es Vahev b'Sufah
 [and Vahev in Sufah]"
 [expounded as: the dispute that is for the sake of Heaven — its end is to endure] —
 for this is the aspect of a dispute that is for the sake of Heaven —
 whose end is to endure —
 and as explained within in Siman 56 —
 and see Zohar Bereishis, folio 17.
 And the adjudication and peace
 of the entire general creation
 is Shabbos —
 the aspect of:
 "ba Shabbas — ba menuchah —
 bechinah menuchas shalom v'shalvah
 [Shabbos came — rest came —
 the aspect of the rest of peace and tranquility],"
 and so on.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael"
 and so on —
 that he gathered them
 and encompassed them all together —
 in love and peace —
 and then they were commanded
 regarding the work of the Mishkan and Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.
 And this [Exodus 35:1]:
 "eileh hadvarim asher tzivvah Hashem la'asos osam
 [these are the things that Hashem commanded — to do them]."
 That is — all the aspects of the utterances [devarim]
 that are spoken within the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 made through the aspect of the sacred dispute —
 for each person of Israel
 is differentiated from his fellow
 in his nature and his traits and his opinions.
 And therefore each speaks
 according to the aspect of his Da'as
 and his traits and the grip of the root of his soul.
 And through the holy utterances
 of the Torah scholars and the Tzadikim —
 the aspect of the creation of the worlds is made —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "lo hamidrash ikkar ela hama'aseh
 [it is not the study that is essential — but the deed]"
 — that is, the worlds
 that are made through their expositions and utterances —
 as explained within.
 And this is the aspect of:
 "eileh hadvarim —
 v'chol haggid —
 la'asos osam
 [these are the things —
 and so on —
 to do them]"
 — for through the utterances
 holy worlds are made and created —
 and therefore our Sages derived from this verse
 the thirty-nine categories of labor of the Mishkan.
 For:
 "tziyura d'Mishkana —
 k'tziyura d'uvda d'Bereishis
 [the form of the Mishkan
 is like the form of the act of creation]"
 — which is the aspect of the general creation.
 And this [Exodus 35:2]:
 "sheshes yamim ta'aseh melachah
 [six days shall labor be done]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 the labor is done of itself [hamelacha na'asis me'eilehah].
 That is — although the creation of worlds
 is made through the utterances of Torah scholars —
 as mentioned above.
 And their utterances are a literal act [ma'aseh mamash] —
 as mentioned above —
 for this is the aspect of what our Sages taught
 [Tractate Shabbos 119b]:
 "minayin she'hadibur k'ma'aseh —
 shene'emar: b'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu
 [from where [do we know] that speech is like deed? —
 as it is stated: by the word of Hashem the heavens were made]"
 [Psalms 33:6].
 And the utterances of Torah scholars
 are the aspects of the word of Hashem —
 as explained within.
 But nonetheless — one must know
 that the labor of the creation of the worlds
 (which is the aspect of the work of the Mishkan
 that is made through their utterances)
 is done of itself —
 and only through the power of Hashem alone.
 And therefore one must take care
 not to speak excessively —
 so as not to cause, heaven forfend,
 the aspect of an excess of light —
 which causes the breaking of the vessels.
 For this is the aspect of:
 "v'chol hamarbeh devarim mevi chet
 [and all who speak excessively — bring sin]"
 — as explained within.
 And the essential breaking of the vessels
 was through the aspect of:
 "ana emloch
 [I shall reign]"
 — the aspect of:
 "vayimloch — vayamos
 [and he reigned — and he died]."
 And the rectification was through the light of Mah
 [the new aspect] —
 the aspect of:
 "mah chayyinu — mah kochenu
 [what is our life — what is our strength?]"
 — as brought —
 and this is the aspect of:
 the labor is done of itself — as mentioned above.
 And this itself is likewise the aspect of
 the adjudication and peace
 between the dispute —
 the aspect of:
 "v'nachnu mah — ki salinnu aleinu
 [and what are we — that you murmur against us?]."
 [Exodus 16:8]

 And the adjudication and peace
 is drawn from the holiness of Shabbos —
 for this is the aspect of [Exodus 35:3]:
 "u'vayom hashevi'i yihyeh lachem Kodesh —
 v'chol haggid —
 lo seva'aru eish —
 b'chol moshevoseichem —
 b'yom haShabbas
 [and on the seventh day it shall be holy for you —
 and so on —
 you shall not kindle fire —
 in all your dwellings —
 on the day of Shabbos]"
 — and it is brought:
 that this alludes to the severity of the prohibition
 against kindling the fire of dispute on Shabbos —
 as mentioned above.

 For Shabbos is peace.
 For Shabbos is the aspect of echad [one].
 The aspect of:
 "raza d'Shabbas — ihu Shabbas —
 d'is'achad b'raza d'echad
 [the secret of Shabbos — it is Shabbos —
 that is united in the secret of One],"
 and so on.
 And in the One there is no dispute possible —
 and as explained elsewhere.
 And this is the aspect of [Deuteronomy 6:4]:
 "Atah echad —
 v'chol haggid —
 u'mi k'amcha Yisrael —
 goy echad
 [You are One —
 and so on —
 and who is like Your people Israel —
 one nation]"
 — said on Shabbos at Minchah —
 for then the light of the Ein Sof shines —
 which is the essential oneness —
 for it is above, as it were,
 the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 which is — as it were — the aspect of dispute — as mentioned above.
 And through this —
 all of Israel are encompassed in a single unity —
 in the aspect of:
 "goy echad ba'aretz
 [one nation in the land]"
 — as mentioned above.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha
 [if you return from Shabbos your foot]."
 Regel [foot] is the aspect of faith —
 as explained elsewhere.
 For then the light of the holy faith
 shines in its perfection — as mentioned above.
 And it alludes also
 to not going beyond the Shabbos boundary —
 which likewise alludes to this — as mentioned above —
 for this is the aspect of the Shabbos boundary — two thousand cubits.
 And this:
 "me'asos chafatzecha b'yom kadshi
 [from pursuing your affairs on My holy day]"
 — one should not engage in pursuing one's affairs —
 which are also the aspects of
 the clarification of the holy sparks —
 and the rectification of the breaking of the vessels.
 For on Shabbos —
 the aspect of the breaking of the vessels
 is rectified spontaneously —
 through the light of the holiness of Shabbos —
 and it is forbidden to engage in any weekday pursuits —
 so as not to blemish through this
 the holiness of the holy Shabbos —
 as explained in the holy Zohar.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg
 [and you shall call the Shabbos a delight]"
 — that is, the aspect of the supernal wondrous light of faith
 drawn from Shabbos —
 for this is the aspect of the delight of Shabbos —
 and:
 "u're'eh emunah —
 v'his'anag al Hashem
 [and tend faithfulness —
 and delight in Hashem]"
 — for this faith
 is from the aspect of the light of the Ein Sof itself —
 the aspect of sovev kol almin
 [surrounding all worlds] —
 that surrounds and encompasses all of creation —
 and even the chalal hapanui.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad
 [the holy one of Hashem, honored]"
 — this is the aspect of the light of wisdom
 that shines on the holy Shabbos —
 which is the aspect of:
 "chochmas adam ta'ir panav —
 v'kevod chachamim yinchalu
 [the wisdom of a person illuminates his face —
 and honor the sages shall inherit]"
 [Ecclesiastes 8:1; Proverbs 3:35] —
 and it is the root of all the creation —
 which was only for the sake of His honor, blessed be He —
 as it is written [Isaiah 43:7]:
 "lichvodi bera'asiv
 [for My glory I created it],"
 and so on —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "memale kol almin
 [filling all worlds]"
 — the aspect of:
 "melo kol ha'aretz kevodo
 [the whole earth is full of His glory]."
 [Isaiah 6:3]
 Or one can say:
 the delight of Shabbos is the aspect of the Shabbos meals —
 which are pleasures that enter
 into the body of a person —
 which is also a small world [olam katan] —
 as our Sages taught.
 This corresponds to the aspect of the light of wisdom —
 which is the aspect of the vitality
 of the general creation —
 the aspect of memale kol almin.
 And wisdom is likewise the aspect of delight —
 as mentioned above many times.
 And:
 "liKdosh Hashem mechubbad"
 — honor is the aspect of garments —
 as our Sages expounded
 regarding [Exodus 20:11]:
 "v'chibadto
 [and honor it],"
 and so on.
 And the garments
 are the aspects of the encompassing lights [makifin] —
 as is well-known —
 and this corresponds to the aspect of
 "sovev kol almin"
 — through which one merits to attain
 the secret of the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 which is the aspect of garments —
 as explained within.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "v'chibadto mei'asos derachecha
 [and honor it — from pursuing your own ways]"
 — and our Sages expounded:
 one should not take large strides —
 which is the aspect of anger —
 the aspect of:
 "al tirgazu badarech
 [do not quarrel on the way]"
 — as mentioned above many times —
 so as not to give sustenance
 to the questions coming from the aspect of the chalal hapanui —
 which is the aspect of contraction and judgment —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "b'sechilah alah b'machshavah livros olam b'midas hadin
 [at first it arose in thought
 to create the world with the attribute of judgment]"
 — and as explained elsewhere —
 and it is — as it were —
 the aspect of anger and dispute —
 as understood within.
 But in truth — everything
 is only for the sake of the revelation
 of His mercy, blessed be He —
 as is well-known — and as explained within.

 And this [Isaiah 58:13]:
 "mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar
 [from pursuing your affairs — and speaking words]"
 — this corresponds to the aspect of
 the revelation of divinity
 within the general creation —
 where there are aspects of letters and speech.
 But one must take great care
 not to cause, heaven forfend,
 the aspect of the breaking of the vessels
 through excess of speech —
 as mentioned above —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "v'chol hamarbeh devarim
 [and all who speak excessively],"
 and so on — as mentioned above.
 And this [Isaiah 58:14]:
 "az tis'anag al Hashem
 [then you will delight in Hashem]"
 — that is, one merits to delight
 in the clinging to the light of the Ein Sof —
 the aspect of sovev kol almin —
 for this is the aspect of:
 "al Hashem
 [upon Hashem]"
 — as is well-known.
 And this is what the holy Zohar expounded:
 "da Atika
 [this is Atika]"
 — for this is the aspect of the attainment of the World to Come —
 which is the aspect of:
 "oraissa d'Atika
 [the Torah of Atika]."
 And then the Tzadikim will attain
 the secret of the contraction of the chalal hapanui — as mentioned above.
 And this is what our Sages expounded:
 they give him all the desires of his heart — and so on.
 That is — the opposite of the heaviness of heart
 that exists now
 regarding the secret of the chalal hapanui —
 as explained within.

 "V'hirkavticha al bamosey aretz
 [and I will cause you to ride upon the heights of the earth]."
 That is, one merits to subdue the husks —
 the aspects of the Malchus d'Sitra Achra —
 coming from the aspect of the breaking of the vessels —
 as mentioned above.
 And therefore our Sages expounded:
 one is saved from the subjugation of kingdoms.
 "V'ha'achalticha nachalas Yaakov avicha
 [and I will feed you with the heritage of Yaakov your father]"
 — that is, one merits
 the aspect of the creation of worlds —
 made within the chalal hapanui —
 for the sake of the revelation of His mercy, blessed be He —
 for this is the aspect of Yaakov —
 who is the attribute of mercy [midas harachamim] —
 as is well-known.
 And therefore our Sages taught:
 "olami — olami — mi vera'acha —
 Yaakov vera'acha
 [My world — My world — who created you? —
 Yaakov created you]"
 — as mentioned above.
 And this is what the holy Zohar expounded:
 "da Ze'ir Anpin
 [this is Ze'ir Anpin]"
 — which is likewise this aspect mentioned above.
 And it is the aspect of all the traits —
 which are the worlds.
 And Ze'ir Anpin itself is called a world — as is well-known —
 and as explained in the holy Zohar.
 And this [Isaiah 58:14]:
 "ki pi Hashem diber
 [for the mouth of Hashem has spoken]."
 For there — in the worlds —
 there are aspects of letters and utterances —
 for the creation was through speech —
 as it is written [Psalms 33:6]:
 "b'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu
 [by the word of Hashem the heavens were made]."
 And within speech there is wisdom —
 for this is the aspect of [Proverbs 2:6]:
 "ki Hashem yiten chochmah —
 mipiv da'as u'sevunah
 [for Hashem gives wisdom —
 from His mouth — knowledge and understanding]."

 ✦ Translator's Summary — Simanim 62, 63, 64
 
 Siman 62 — Faith / intellect / peace / Psalm 92 / sacred union / fish / SA OC 249 / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = emunah + mochin (all gates of sacred intellect open); evil inclination subjugated to good inclination (Zohar); "lada'as ki ani Hashem Elokeichem" (Ezekiel 20:20); easier to pray and concentrate. Six weekdays = six orders of Mishnah = full of sacred dispute (Tannaim); sustenance for evil inclination's dispute in the heart = "chalak libam" (Hosea 10:2). Shabbos = shalom (Zohar) → sacred dispute rectified at its root → dispute of evil inclination nullified → serve G-d with whole heart → gates of intellect open → know how to answer the apikores. "Shalom" = roshei teivos = "v'da mah she'tashiv la'apikores." But unanswerable questions: rely on faith alone = also merited on Shabbos. Psalm 92: "tov lehodos / odecha b'yosher levav" = uprightness of heart = nullification of dispute. "Lehagid baboker chasdecha" = mochin = chasadim (Siman 56); Shabbos makes it easier to settle answerable questions. "V'emunascha baleilos" = unanswerable questions = night and darkness = rely on faith = completed on Shabbos. Eating of Shabbos precious because: essential tikkun of eating = through emunah = perfect emunah = through Shabbos; then yichud = panim b'fanim (Ari z"l writings). Essential perfection of emunah = drawing close the distant = "likro chulam b'shem Hashem" (Zephaniah 3:9); "v'gercha asher bish'arecha" (Exodus 20:10); "u'vnay haneychar / kol shomer Shabbas / v'hevi'osim." Drawing distant close = through clarification of letters of speech; "v'daber davar" = perfection of speech on Shabbos. Elevating sparks of speech requires fasting → SA OC 249: practice of "anshey ma'aseh" to fast on Erev Shabbos (but not if it diminishes appetite for Shabbos night); on Shabbos itself: forbidden to fast = eating precious = yichud panim b'fanim. Mitzvah to eat fish on Shabbos: Midrash Rabbah Bereishis 20: only three creatures interact face to face = human, serpent, fish. Fish = yichud panim b'fanim. Twelve Shabbos loaves = lechem hapanim. In merit of Shabbos delight: "gozar gzerah v'haKBH mekayem" (Midrash Rabbah Beshalach 25). At time of yichud through holy eating: Shechinah entreats G-d to annul compulsion of nature through Tzadik's prayer. "Hashomer Shabbas mochalin lo" = through peace of Shabbos all heresy nullified = "chavur atzavim Efrayim hanach lo" (Hosea 4:17). Isaiah 58 mapped: "raglecha" = emunah + livelihood/eating (Siman 31) + drawing close the distant + speech (Siman 38); "me'asos chafatzecha" = don't cover over light of emunah ("nafkat b'tzafra u'misakya b'yemama"); some people err — make causes the essential = this is negated on Shabbos = all nullified = light of faith shines = peace drawn = "chafetz shalom avdo" (Isaiah 42:19); gates of intellect = "divrey chefetz"; mental faculties of faith = truth = "hen emes chafatzta" (Psalms 51:8); drawing close = "Torah shel Chesed" (Siman 14); "ki chafetz chesed hu" (Micah 7:18); "hachafetz achphotz ki im b'shuvo" (Ezekiel 18:23); yichud panim b'fanim = "u'vachartu ba'asher chafatzti" (Isaiah 56:4; Zohar). "Oneg" = Shabbos meals = yichud panim b'fanim; peace = oneg = "v'his'angu al rov shalom" (Psalms 37:11). "Mechubbad" = nullification of dispute = "kavod l'ish sheves meyriv" (Proverbs 20:3). Mochin and Da'as = oneg v'kavod. Faith = oneg v'kavod = "shkon eretz u're'eh emunah v'his'anag al Hashem" (Psalms 37:3; Sages: re Shabbos delight) = eating rectified through emunah = essential tikkun emunah through Shabbos holiness = eating of Shabbos precious = great mitzvah of Shabbos delight = "nositin lo kol mishalos libo / gozar gzerah v'HKB"H mekayem." Emunah = Malchus = kavod = "v'chevodo hi emunasi." "V'chibadto" = no large strides = not to block pathways of intellect; also: even when pathways open — be deliberate — don't enter forbidden questions — rely on faith. "Mimitzo chafatzecha" = no weekday speech = not blemish holy Shabbos speech. "Az tis'anag al Hashem da Atika Kadisha" = such exalted mochin = aspects of mochin to be revealed in the future (Siman 21, Atika Tamir v'Satim). "Hirkavticha = Chakla Tupichin" = Malchus receives illumination from all aspects including Chab"d = faith completed through opening of pathways of intellect; saved from subjugation (Siman 7). "Heritage of Yaakov = Ze'ir Anpin" = holy Torah = study of poskin = peace = all dispute nullified; Sages: nachalah b'li metzarim = Torah draws illumination from highest mochin to all levels including faith (Malchus) → pathways open for answerable questions; unanswerable ones: strong faith = nachalah b'li metzarim. All aspects of questions and constraints nullified; also: clarify sparks of speech = "ki az ehpoch el kol ha'amim safah verurah likro chulam b'shem Hashem" (Zephaniah 3:9). "Ki pi Hashem diber" = perfection of sacred speech = "mipiv da'as u'sevunah" (Proverbs 2:6); speech = Malchus peh = emunah = "odiyah emunascha b'fi" (Psalms 89:2); speech = shalom (Siman 239) = "adabra na shalom" (Psalms 85:9); drawing close distant = pure tongue; holy eating drawn from speech = Ezekiel 41:22 = "shulchan mechaper"; Shechinah advocates for the distant; "hashomer Shabbas mochalin lo"; "im totzei yakar mizolel k'fi tihyeh" (Jeremiah 15:19) = drawing distant close; Bava Metzi'a 85: even G-d annuls His decree for his sake. "Ki pi Hashem diber" = one's speech = aspect of word of Hashem = "k'fi tihyeh."

 Siman 63 — Shabbos/Tzadik/bris = one / six wings / three aspects of revealing-concealing / Zohar Pinchas 236 / Chakla Tupichin / Amalek / the ant / Zohar haRakia / Erev Shabbos shalhava d'asha / Isaiah 58: Shabbos, Tzadik, bris = one aspect (Zohar; within). Shabbos encompasses the six wings / six tefachim. "B'shtayim yechaseh raglav" = revealing a tefach and concealing a tefach = (1) re: the world = those drawn close / sometimes conceals himself in small things so he can be revealed = concealment itself is a revealing / sometimes true concealment. "B'shtayim ye'ofef" (Targum: yishamshe = he serves) = revealing/concealing re: the service to G-d = attach to G-d as if He is revealed, yet the more one draws close, the more one knows one is far = "shalom l'rachok v'karov" (Isaiah 57:19). "B'shtayim yechaseh panav" = revealing/concealing re: oneself = panim = sometimes anger / sometimes favor and Providence; Tzadik sometimes covers face of favor and accepts suffering for the world; sometimes covers face of anger and reveals favor. All three encompassed in holiness of Shabbos = Chakla Tupichin Kadishin = ascent of Malchus in Neh"y/Chag"t/Chab"d (kavannos); within Neh"y alone: all three aspects present (Neh"y/Chag"t/Chab"d); Zohar Pinchas 236: bris = Yesod encompasses them = wings of cherubim = Netzach and Hod; three aspects in Neh"y: "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav" = Neh"y; "b'shtayim ye'ofef" = Chag"t = "v'yedey adam mitachas kanfeihem" (Ezekiel 1:8); "b'shtayim yechaseh panav" = Chab"d = "chochmas adam ta'ir panav." When truly ascends in three ascents: certainly encompasses all. Five levels of revealing/concealing in Shabbos: (1) vs. the world = "kol hamitzvos nitnu b'farheisya / Shabbas nitnah b'tzin'ah / matan scharah lo avida l'agleyyei" (Beitzah); Shabbos 119: "kaisar l'Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah / tavlin echad yesh lanu v'Shabbas shmo"; Midrash Rabbah Bereishis: "berchu b'mat'amim / berchu b'me'or panav shel adam / lo domeh me'or panav shel adam b'Shabbas l'me'or panav b'chol"; Midrash Rabbah Bereishis 11: Rabbi Akiva's proofs from the Sambatyon River. Outer holiness revealed to all; inner dimension = "ayin lo ra'asah" = foretaste of World to Come. Revelation itself = concealment (great light → clothes itself in many garments → Shabbos meals / garments of honor → some radiance of inner holiness → "az tis'anag al Hashem"). "B'shtayim yechaseh raglav" = described above. "B'shtayim ye'ofef" = service/devotion/drawing close to G-d = Shabbos draws upon every Jew the sacred awakening = "ki os hi / lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadshechem" (Exodus 31:13) = extra soul = essential clinging = from the soul = "kol haneshamah tehallel Yah / v'nishmas Shadai tvinam." Clinging = aspect of revealing (as if holiness draws close); yet more one draws close = knows more how far he is. Beitzah 16a: "neshamah yetairah lo ode'inuhu l'aku'm" = nations totally distant from this = paradox of drawing close/knowing distance = "shalom l'rachok v'karov" = manner of: "ki atem hame'at / kol mah she'ani mashpia lachem tovah / atem mima'atin atzmeichem / lafikhach chashak Hashem bachem." "B'shtayim yechaseh panav" = Zohar Yisro 88 (cited in Aramaic): "vayevarech Elokim es yom hashevi'i / b'yom hashevi'i Shabbas lo yihyeh bo / v'keivan d'lo ishkachin bei mezonay mah berchata / tana kol birkan d'ila'in v'tata'in b'yoma shevi'aa talyan"; Zohar Terumah 155: "d'ha mezonay v'sipuka d'alma / mei'inun panim ila'in k'asyan." On Shabbos no manna fell = no material bounty / spiritual bounty = holy mochin = "yechaseh panav" = covers face of material Providence. Shabbos = aspect of poverty (Tikunim); Mars and Saturn serve it. Yet: root of all material influence drawn from Shabbos = they had to set lechem hapanim on Shabbos specifically. Delight and honor of Shabbos also in physical pleasures (Zohar Yisro: "ba'i l'is'anaga b'hai yoma / lemeikal telas se'udatay / b'gin d'yishtakach shav'a v'anugo mei'hai yoma b'alma"). "Megaleh tefach" = reveals face of material Providence. "Mechaseh panim shel rogez" = all dinnim suppressed. Holy speech makes holy wings = "v'daber davar." Shabbos = sacred Da'as (many previous simanim); "bris olam ascends to Da'as" (Zohar Mishpatim 110; Siman 36 "b'Karov" cross-reference). Corresponding to this in the husk: the serpent = Da'as d'klifah = "v'hanachash hayah arum" (Genesis 3:1) = husk of Amalek (Zohar Beshalach). "Vayehi vayom hashevi'i yatze'u / miyad vayavo Amalek" (Sages): but essential intensification was through blemish of Moshe's honor = "vayarev ha'am im Moshe / od me'at v'sekaluni / vayavo Amalek." Rashi: "samach parshah zo l'mikra zeh / hishlichu me'alav / u'va hanachash v'nashcho." "Vayavo Amalek" = suddenly and from afar = wings made for the serpent = Amalek flies; Sages: from root of serpent = tzefa for Amalek and Haman; "tzefa gimatria Amalek"; Isaiah 14:29: "u'firyo saraf me'ofef" = Amalek = flying fiery serpent through wings made when holy wings blemished = "seraphim omidim / shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim l'echad." Amalek cut off foreskins = blemish holiness of bris = encompasses six wings. Subjugation through "cherev nokemet nekam bris" (Leviticus 26:25; Zohar). Serpent: sometimes walks / sometimes flies; flying harms more in three aspects (within). Flying of serpent = three completely impure husks; walking = Nogah. Ant in mouth of serpent = legs of Malchus = some grip from there (Zohar haRakia). Ari z"l: on Erev Shabbos = good in Nogah ascends with legs of holiness = three impure husks wish to ascend → shalhava d'asha descends → scorches heads of husks → they descend → rest for the ant. Therefore: all labors forbidden on Shabbos = don't give grip to serpent through "bitachon bogeid" = partial trust in one's actions. On Shabbos: complete and true emunah and bitachon = not clothed in any cause. Isaiah 58: "im tashiv miShabbos raglecha" = legs of holiness ascend from grip of husks (writings); "me'asos chafatzecha" = refrain from weekday acts; "v'karas l'Shabbas oneg / liKdosh Hashem mechubbad" = complete and true bitachon = not just refraining from labor but spending generously on Shabbos delight and honor. "Im tashiv" = Neh"y = "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav" = drawing those close to Tzadik = "v'chol ha'am asher b'raglecha" (Exodus 11:8); Shabbos most propitious for this; mitzvah to receive face of teacher on Shabbos + assemble congregations. "Me'asos chafatzecha" = not one's own affairs but affairs of Heaven = Chag"t = instruments of doing = "v'ta'as b'chefetz kapehah" (Proverbs 31:13) = "b'shtayim ye'ofef / yishamshe" = "galuy v'yadu'a lefanecha she'shimashti b'eser etzbe'osai"; service/clinging = "achaztihu lo arpenu" (Song of Songs 3:4); holding = with hands = Chag"t. "V'karas l'Shabbas oneg / liKdosh Hashem mechubbad" = "b'shtayim yechaseh panav" = Chab"d = spiritual bounty of mochin = root of all influences = "da'as kanisa mah chasarta" (Berachos 55a; Siman 24 "Emtza'isa"); essential oneg v'kavod there; also physical oneg v'kavod drawn from this. "V'chibadto" = no large strides = gives power and grip to the Sitra Achra (writings) = gives serpent power to walk faster = distress for the ant. "Mimitzo chafatzecha v'daber davar" = no weekday speech = makes wings for the serpent, heaven forfend = flying fiery serpent = greater distress for the ant. Shabbos = niyacha [rest] of the ant = Zohar haRakia on Parashas Mishpatim on the Sava's teaching. "Az tis'anag al Hashem da Atika Kadisha" = attain holiness of mochin at their root = Atik = essential light of face of favor and Providence of all influences (Zohar Yisro; Sages: "nositin lo kol mishalos libo"). "Hirkavticha = Chakla Tupichin" = ascent of Malchus = the ant = Neh"y/Chag"t/Chab"d = themselves the six wings; saved from subjugation = subjugation of the serpent = husk of Amalek = general sum of all kingdoms of Sitra Achra; Sages derived from "v'atah al bamosemo tidroch" (Deuteronomy 33:29) = they are subdued beneath legs of holiness = Neh"y = essential building of sacred Malchus = the ant. "Heritage of Yaakov = Ze'ir Anpin = Tiferes" = general sum of Chag"t = "b'shtayim ye'ofef"; nachalah b'li metzarim = service of the Tzadik = without limits = the more he serves and attains the more he knows he is still far → strives for even greater attainment → no constraint or limit on service → "goes each time higher and higher / for the greatness of the Creator has no measure." "Ki pi Hashem diber" = Shabbos = sacred speech = sacred wings = "u'va'al kenafayim yagid davar" (Ecclesiastes 10:20); bris = speech (Zohar: "bris kayama peh Hashem hu"); Tzadik = speech (Tikunim: "peh istkariyas misitra d'Tzadik"); Shabbos = speech (Zohar Bereishis 32; "v'daber davar"); "b'shtayim yechaseh raglav" = drawing of those close to Tzadik = primarily through speech = "divray chachamim b'nachas nishma'im / shema divray chachamim"; "b'shtayim ye'ofef" = service of Tzadik = primarily through speech = "ki chayyim hem l'motze'eihem b'fe" (Proverbs 4:22); "b'shtayim yechaseh panav" = drawing forth of divine bounty = through speech (Siman 34) = "vayevarech eschem ka'asher diber lachem" (Deuteronomy 15:6). Ascent of Malchus = ant = Malchus peh = Adona"y b'ribua (Zohar haRakia) = speech = "Adona"y sefasai tiftach" (Psalms 51:17).

 Siman 64 — Perfection of creation / revelation of mercy / breaking of vessels / chalal hapanui / Song of Songs / Moshe's song / Psalm 92 / Vayakhel / Shabbas Shabason / peace / one nation / Isaiah 58: Shabbos = perfection of creation (Sages on "vayechal Elokim b'yom hashevi'i"; Zohar); creation was for revelation of His mercy; on Shabbos: great mercy revealed, all judgments suppressed (Zohar); Shabbos 12a: "yecholah hi she'terachem / v'rachamav merubim." Shabbos = perfection of holy faith = all heresy nullified. Sages: "afilu aved avodah zarah k'dor Enosh mochalin lo" = generation of Enosh's idolatry was through heresy and external wisdoms; on Shabbos: light of holy faith shines so completely that all kinds of heresy nullified = all husks subdued (Zohar) = all heresy from external wisdoms nullified. Shabbos = tikkun of breaking of the vessels; holy letters spontaneously emerge and combine → sacred mochin drawn → questions from external wisdoms settled. Shabbos 124b: "kol hakelim hanitilin b'Shabbas shivreichem nitilin imahem" = allusion to tikkun of sheviyas hakelim drawn on Shabbos. Questions from chalal hapanui nullified = through Shabbos: illumination of Ein Sof drawn with wondrous renewal (writings); then drawn: the song and melody belonging to faith in Ein Sof Himself = above all wisdom and faith = Song of Songs 4:8: "tavo'i tashuri me'rosh emunahרוש אמנה." Shabbos = Moshe (Zohar); "yismach Moshe b'matan chelko"; Moshe merited the song through thought / silence / "az yashir Moshe — Yud — al shem hamachshavah ne'emrah." Shabbos = World of Thought = silence = "v'daber davar." "Mizmor Shir l'Yom haShabbas" = roshei teivos = LMSH"H = "l'Moshe" = the song of Moshe. "Tov lehodos / lezamer lishimcha elyon" = the song and melody above all aspects of melodies and wisdoms and faiths. Through this melody all souls that fell into heresy of chalal hapanui ascend (within). Ari z"l kavannos of Mizmor Shir: at entry of Shabbos Moshe descends with other great Tzadikim to elevate souls of living and dead that fell into depths of husks. "Lehagid baboker chasdecha" = wisdom and intellect revealed on Shabbos = nullification of heresy from external wisdoms = aspects of letters and utterances through which creation was made for revelation of His lovingkindness = "lehagid" = language of wisdom (Zohar); haggadah = speech = creation = through speech = through wisdom. "V'emunascha baleilos" = faith shines so greatly on Shabbos = passes even over chalal hapanui = night and darkness = "omek hamushag" = impossible to find Da'as or intellect there = "lo yad'u v'lo yavinu b'chashecha yis'halachu" (Psalms 82:5); II Samuel 22:12: "vayashes choshech sevivosav"; Psalms 18:12: "yashis choshech sisro sevivosav sukaso" = there: strengthen only through faith in Ein Sof Himself = "sovev kol almin" = encompasses even chalal hapanui = through this passes over everything. Psalm 92:4: "alay asor v'alay navel alay higgayon b'chinor" = song of World to Come = harp of ten strings (Arachin 13b on this very verse); through this song = all confusions of chalal hapanui nullified = this itself will be the reward of Tzadikim in the World to Come. Therefore Shabbos = foretaste of World to Come. Psalm 92:6: "mah gadlu ma'asecha Hashem" = general creation through wisdom and speech. "Me'od amku machshevosecha" = depth of thought = surrounds even chalal hapanui. Psalm 92:7: "ish ba'ar lo yeda" = settles questions about governance and success of wicked; conclusion: "lehagid ki yashar Hashem / v'lo avlasah vo." Psalms 93:1: "Hashem Malach geo'us lavash / af tikon tevel bal timot" = garments = aspects of holy contractions of chalal hapanui = these are actually the sustenance of the world. Therefore recite Shir haShirim at entry of Shabbos. "Mechaleleha mos yumas" = desecration of Shabbos causes awakening of heresy from chalal hapanui = "kol ba'eha lo yashuvun v'lo yassigu orchos chayyim" (Proverbs 2:19). Shabbos = shevitah and bitul = "tashbisu se'or" etc.; holy mochin settle answerable questions; questions = "vayemareiru / ba'avodah kashah" = Zohar: "b'kashya"; Shabbos = the answer = shevitah u'menuchah. Also: faith shines → bitul and clinging → pass even over chalal hapanui = completely nullified and empty of everything. "Es Shabsosai tishmoru — shtay Shabbasos" = two aspects of Shabbos. "Lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadshechem" = Sages: "matanah tovah yesh li / v'Shabbas shemah / lech v'hodiyam" = "matan scharah lo avida l'galeyyei / Shabbas nitnah b'tzin'ah." Mochin of Shabbos that settle questions from external wisdoms = made to be revealed = "v'da mah she'tashiv." Its reward = song of Rosh Emunahרוש אמנה = supernal faith above everything above all wisdoms and faiths = nullifies even confusions of chalal hapanui = reward of Tzadikim in World to Come = not made to be revealed. Only Moshe alone can enter there → illuminates Israel every Shabbos → "lech v'hodiyam." "Lada'as ki ani Hashem mekadshechem" = supremely wondrous holiness drawn on Israel = light of Ein Sof itself = "sovev kol almin" = encompasses even chalal hapanui. Perhaps: Shabbos boundary = two thousand cubits = wisdom and faith. "Vayakhel Moshe es kol adas Bnay Yisrael" = Tzadik as Moshe: (1) those who fell on answerable questions → illuminates them mochin → settle questions from sheviyas hakelim → weekday holy labor = work of Mishkan = elevate sparks = tikkun sheviyas hakelim; (2) Shabbos itself → tikkun of chalal hapanui. "Sheshes yamim ta'aseh melachah / u'vayom hashevi'i yihyeh lachem Kodesh / Shabbas Shabason laHashem" = then tikkun sheviyas hakelim drawn spontaneously; all labors forbidden; power of all weekday tikkunim = only through Shabbos; "Shabbas Shabason laHashem" = not made to be revealed = "ayin lo ra'asah." "Es Shabsosai tishmoru da igula v'ribua d'lagu" (Zohar) = two aspects: supernal faith = "sovev kol almin" = igul = "v'emunascha savivosecha" (Psalms 89:3); wisdom and intellect within creation = "memale kol almin" = ribua = mochin = four (Chochmah, Binah, Da'as comprising Chasadim and Gevuros); creation = four worlds ABY"A = four directions = four corners. Shabbos = shalom = Shabbas Shalom. Six weekdays within chalal hapanui = sacred dispute = contraction of chalal hapanui for creation of worlds; essential tikkun = adjudication and peace of dispute = "es Vahev b'Sufah" = dispute for the sake of Heaven (Siman 56; Zohar Bereishis 17). Peace of all creation = Shabbos = "ba Shabbas ba menuchah bechinah menuchas shalom v'shalvah." "Vayakhel Moshe" = gathered in love and peace → commanded on Mishkan and Shabbos. "Eileh hadvarim asher tzivvah Hashem la'asos osam" = all utterances spoken within chalal hapanui = made through sacred dispute = each Jew differentiated from fellow in nature/traits/opinions → speaks according to Da'as and soul-root → holy utterances of Torah scholars and Tzadikim = creation of worlds = "lo hamidrash ikkar ela hama'aseh" = the worlds made through their expositions (within); "eileh hadvarim / v'chol haggid / la'asos osam" = through utterances holy worlds made. Sages derived from this verse the 39 categories of Mishkan labor; "tziyura d'Mishkana k'tziyura d'uvda d'Bereishis." "Sheshes yamim ta'aseh melachah" = "hamelacha na'asis me'eilehah" (Sages); although creation made through utterances of Torah scholars = literal act = Shabbos 119b: "minayin she'hadibur k'ma'aseh shene'emar b'dvar Hashem shamayim na'asu" (Psalms 33:6); utterances of Torah scholars = word of Hashem (within). Yet: must know = labor done of itself = only through power of Hashem. Therefore: don't speak excessively = don't cause breaking of vessels (excess of light) = "v'chol hamarbeh devarim mevi chet." Breaking of vessels = "ana emloch / vayimloch vayamos." Rectification = light of Mah = "mah chayyinu mah kochenu." Labor done of itself = tikkun of the "breaking" = also the adjudication and peace between the dispute = "v'nachnu mah ki salinnu aleinu" (Exodus 16:8). Adjudication and peace = drawn from Shabbos holiness = Exodus 35:3: "lo seva'aru eish b'chol moshevoseichem b'yom haShabbas" = allusion (brought) to severity of prohibition against kindling fire of dispute on Shabbos. Shabbos = peace = Shabbos = echad = "raza d'Shabbas ihu Shabbas d'is'achad b'raza d'echad" = in the One there is no dispute. "Atah echad / u'mi k'amcha Yisrael goy echad" = said at Minchah of Shabbos = then light of Ein Sof shines = essential oneness = above the chalal hapanui = which is as it were the aspect of dispute; through this: all Israel encompassed in single unity = "goy echad ba'aretz." Isaiah 58: "raglecha" = emunah (elsewhere); also: don't go beyond Shabbos boundary = two thousand cubits = wisdom and faith. "Me'asos chafatzecha" = don't engage in pursuing affairs = also aspects of birurim and tikkun sheviyas hakelim = on Shabbos: tikkun sheviyas hakelim done spontaneously by light of Shabbos = forbidden to engage in weekday pursuits = don't blemish Shabbos holiness (Zohar). "V'karas l'Shabbas oneg" = supernal wondrous light of faith drawn from Shabbos = "shkon eretz u're'eh emunah v'his'anag al Hashem" = faith from light of Ein Sof itself = "sovev kol almin" = encompasses even chalal hapanui. "LiKdosh Hashem mechubbad" = light of wisdom shining on Shabbos = "chochmas adam ta'ir panav / kevod chachamim yinchalu" (Ecclesiastes 8:1; Proverbs 3:35) = root of all creation = for His honor = "lichvodi bera'asiv" (Isaiah 43:7) = "memale kol almin / melo kol ha'aretz kevodo" (Isaiah 6:3). Or: delight = Shabbos meals = pleasures entering into body = small world (Sages) = aspect of wisdom = vitality of general creation = memale kol almin; wisdom = oneg.
